translations.translation: maiM allAha kA nAma lekara, usa sarvazaktimAna kI sahAyatA lete hue, usake nAma ke ullekha se barakata lete hue quraAna par3hanA zurU karatA hU~| 'bismillAhira rahamAnira rahIma' meM allAha ke tIna suMdara nAma maujUda haiM: 1- 'allAha', arthAt: satya pUjya| yaha allAha kA sabase viziSTa nAma hai| yaha usa mahimAvAna ke alAvA kisI aura kA nAma nahIM rakhA sakatA| 2- 'ar-raha़mAna', arthAt: vistRta dayA vAlA| cunA~ce vaha svataH parama dayAvAn hai| 3- 'ar-raha़Ima', arthAt: dayA karane vAlA| cunA~ce vaha apanI dayA ke sAtha apanI sRSTi meM se jisapara cAhatA hai, dayA karatA hai, jinameM usake momina baMde bhI zAmila haiM|

pUrNa stuti, tathA pratApa evaM pUrNatA ke guNoM kI sabhI prakAra kI prazaMsA kevala allAha kI hai, kisI aura kI nahIM| kyoMki vahI pratyeka cIz2a kA pAlanahAra, usakA racayitA aura prabaMdhaka hai| 'al-AlamUna', 'Alama' kA bahuvacana hai aura isase abhiprAya allAha sarvazaktimAna ke alAvA sabhI cIz2eM haiM|
pichalI Ayata meM allAha taAlA kI hamda (stuti) karane ke bAda, yahA~ usakI prazaMsA kI jA rahI hai|

yahA~ allAha kI mahattA kA varNana kiyA gayA hai ki vaha qiyAmata ke dina kI hara cIz2a kA mAlika hai, jisa dina koI kisI ke lie kucha bhI na kara sakegA| 'yaumuddIna' se abhiprAya: badale aura ha़isAba kA dina hai|

hama hara prakAra kI ibAdata aura AjJApAlana kevala tere lie karate haiM| ataH hama tere sAtha kisI ko sAjhI nahIM banAte tathA hama apane sabhI mAmaloM meM kevala tujhase hI madada mA~gate haiM| kyoMki tere hI hAtha meM sArI bhalAiyA~ haiM aura tere sivA koI madadagAra nahIM|

hameM sIdhA mArga dikhA, hameM usapara calA, hameM usapara sudRr3ha kara de tathA hamAre mArgadarzana meM vRddhi kara de| 'as-sirAta al-mustaqIma' (sIdhe mArga) kA matalaba hai vaha spaSTa mArga, jisameM koI bhI Ter3hApana nahIM hai| aura yaha islAma hai, jisake sAtha allAha ne muha़mmada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko bhejA|

hameM apane una baMdoM kA rAstA dikhA, jinheM tUne mArgadarzana se puraskRta kiyA; jaise nabI, satya niSTha, zahIda evaM sadAcArI loga, aura ye bahuta acche sAthI haiM| una logoM kA rAstA nahIM, jinapara prakopa utarA, jinhoMne satya ko jAnane ke bAvajUda usakA pAlana nahIM kiyA, jaise yahUdI loga| tathA na una logoM kA rAstA, jo satya se bhaTaka gae, jo satya kI khoja aura use pAne kI koziza meM lAparavAhI ke kAraNa, satya taka nahIM pahu~ca sake, jaise IsAI loga|

{alifa, lAma, mIma} ye una akSaroM meM se haiM, jinase kucha sUratoM (sUrata kA bahuvacana) kA AraMbha kiyA gayA hai| yaha arabI bhASA kI varNamAlA hai jisakA apane Apa meM koI artha nahIM hai yadi ve isa taraha (alipha, bA, tA) alaga-alaga Ae~| lekina inakI eka hikamata aura matalaba hai; kyoMki quraAna meM koI aisI vastu nahIM hai, jisakI koI ha़ikamata na ho| inakI sabase mahatvapUrNa hiqamatoM meM se eka: quraAna ke dvArA cunautI kI ora saMketa hai, jo unhIM akSaroM se banA hai, jinheM ve jAnate aura bolate haiM; yahI kAraNa hai ki aksara ina akSaroM ke bAda quraAna pAka kA ullekha hotA hai, jaisA ki isa sUrata meM hai|

isa mahAna quraAna meM koI saMdeha nahIM| na isake allAha kI ora se utarane ke saMdarbha meM, aura na hI isake zabda aura artha ke saMdarbha meM| cunA~ce yaha quraAna allAha kI vANI hai, jo parahez2agAroM kA allAha taka pahu~cAne vAle rAste kA mArgadarzana karatA hai|

3-4- jo loga g2aiba (parokSa, anadekhI) para ImAna lAte haiM| g2aiba se abhiprAya hara vaha cIz2a hai, jisakA bodha jJAneMdriyoM dvArA nahIM hotA hai aura vaha hamase ojhala hai, jisake bAre meM allAha ne yA usake rasUla ne sUcanA dI hai, jaise ki Aqhirata kA dina| tathA vahI loga namAz2a kI sthApanA karate haiM isa prakAra ki allAha dvArA nirdhArita kI gaI zartoM, arkAna, vAjibAta aura sunnatoM ke anusAra usakI adAyagI karate haiM| tathA vahI loga haiM, jo usameM se kharca karate haiM jo allAha ne unheM pradAna kiyA hai, arthAt allAha ke savAba kI AzA meM, anivArya dAna jaise ki z2akAta athavA g2aira-vAjiba jaise ki svaicchika dAna dete haiM| tathA vahI haiM jo usa vaha़ya para jo allAha ne - ai nabI! - Apapara utArI hai tathA Apase pUrva anya sabhI nabiyoM para utArI hai, binA bhedabhAva ke ImAna lAte haiM| tathA vahI loga Aqhirata tathA usake puNya evaM daMDa para dRr3ha vizvAsa rakhate haiM|

3-4- jo loga g2aiba (parokSa, anadekhI) para ImAna lAte haiM| g2aiba se abhiprAya hara vaha cIz2a hai, jisakA bodha jJAneMdriyoM dvArA nahIM hotA hai aura vaha hamase ojhala hai, jisake bAre meM allAha ne yA usake rasUla ne sUcanA dI hai, jaise ki Aqhirata kA dina| tathA vahI loga namAz2a kI sthApanA karate haiM isa prakAra ki allAha dvArA nirdhArita kI gaI zartoM, arkAna, vAjibAta aura sunnatoM ke anusAra usakI adAyagI karate haiM| tathA vahI loga haiM, jo usameM se kharca karate haiM jo allAha ne unheM pradAna kiyA hai, arthAt allAha ke savAba kI AzA meM, anivArya dAna jaise ki z2akAta athavA g2aira-vAjiba jaise ki svaicchika dAna dete haiM| tathA vahI haiM jo usa vaha़ya para jo allAha ne - ai nabI! - Apapara utArI hai tathA Apase pUrva anya sabhI nabiyoM para utArI hai, binA bhedabhAva ke ImAna lAte haiM| tathA vahI loga Aqhirata tathA usake puNya evaM daMDa para dRr3ha vizvAsa rakhate haiM|

ina vizeSatAoM se paripUrNa loga hI hidAyata ke patha para calane vAle haiM tathA yahI loga duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM, jisakI ve AzA karate haiM use prApta karake aura jisa cIz2a se ve Darate haiM usase mukti pAkara, kAmayAba haiM|

jaba allAha ne parahez2agAra mominoM kI vizeSatAoM kA varNana kiyA, jinake bAharI aura AMtarika donoM rUpa zuddha hote haiM, to kAfiroM ke eka samUha kI vizeSatAoM kA bhI ullekha kiyA jinake bAharI aura AMtarika donoM rUpa bhraSTa hote haiM| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
jina logoM para ImAna na lAne kI allAha kI bAta siddha ho cukI hai, ve apanI pathabhraSTatA aura haTha para qAyama rahane vAle haiM| isalie ApakA unheM DarAnA aura na DarAnA barAbara hai|

kyoMki allAha ne unake diloM para muhara lagA dI hai aura unameM maujUda kufra sahita unheM baMda kara diyA hai| tathA unake kAnoM para muhara lagA dI hai, ataH ve satya ko use svIkArane aura usakA anusaraNa karane kI nIyata se nahIM sunate haiM| tathA unakI A~khoM para pardA DAla diyA hai, ataH ve satya ke spaSTa hone ke bAvajUda use nahIM dekhate haiM, aura unake lie Aqhirata meM bahuta bar3I yAtanA hai|

jaba allAha taAlA ne kAfiroM kI vizeSatAoM kA varNana kiyA, jinakA bAharI aura AMtarika donoM rUpa bhraSTa hotA hai, to una munAfiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) kI vizeSatAoM kA bhI ullekha kara diyA, jinakA AMtarika rUpa bhraSTa hotA hai aura unakA bAharI rUpa logoM ke dekhane meM sahI hotA hai, cunA~ce pharamAyA:
logoM kA eka samUha aisA hai, jo yaha dAvA karatA hai ki ve ImAna vAle haiM| ve apanI jAna aura apane mAla ke Dara se kevala apanI z2abAna se aisA kahate haiM| jabaki aMdara se ve kAfira haiM|

ve apanI ajJAnatAvaza yaha samajhate haiM ki ve ImAna kA pradarzana karake aura kufra ko chipAkara allAha aura mominoM ko dhokhA de rahe haiM| lekina unheM isakA ehasAsa nahIM hai; kyoMki allAha rahasya aura chipI bAtoM ko jAnatA hai aura usane ImAna vAloM ko unakI vizeSatAoM aura sthitiyoM ke bAre meM sUcita kara diyA hai|
jaba unheM kufra, pApoM aura anya cIjoM ke dvArA dharatI para upadrava karane se manA kiyA jAtA hai, to ve inakAra karate haiM aura dAvA karate haiM ki ve to sadAcAra aura sudhAra vAle haiM|

jabaki vAstavikatA yaha hai ki vahI upadrava karane vAle aura utpAta macAne vAle haiM, lekina unheM isakA ehasAsa nahIM hai, aura na hI ve yaha samajhate haiM ki unakA yaha kRtya hI asala upadrava hai|

jaba unheM muha़mmada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke sAthiyoM ke ImAna lAne kI taraha ImAna lAne kA Adeza diyA jAtA hai, to ve asvIkRti aura upahAsa ke rUpa meM usakA uttara dete hue kahate haiM: kyA hama alpabuddhi vAloM ke ImAna lAne kI taraha ImAna le Ae~?! saca to yaha hai ki ve svayaM mUrkha haiM, lekina ve isase anajAna haiM|

jaba ve mominoM se milate haiM, to unake Dara se kahate haiM: hama usapara ImAna lAte haiM jisapara tuma ImAna lAte ho| aura jaba ve ImAna vAloM ke pAsa se apane saradAroM kI ora vApasa lauTate haiM aura unake sAtha ekAMta meM hote haiM, to unake sAtha hone kA vizvAsa dilAte hue kahate haiM: nizcaya hama tumhAre sAtha tumhAre mArga hI para haiM| lekina hama ImAna vAloM se z2AhirI taura para, unakA maz2Aqa ur3Ane aura upahAsa karane ke lie, sahamata haiM|

unake ImAna vAloM kA upahAsa karane ke muqAbile meM, allAha unakA maz2Aqa ur3AtA hai, unheM unake kArya hI ke samAna badalA dene ke taura para| yahI kAraNa hai ki unake lie isa duniyA meM musalamAnoM ke niyama lAgU kie haiM, lekina Aqhirata meM unheM unake kufra tathA nifAqa kA badalA degA| tathA allAha unheM DhIla detA hai, tAki ve apanI gumarAhI aura sarakazI meM bane raheM| isa taraha ve acaMbhe tathA asamaMjasa (duvidhA), meM par3e raheM|

ve munAfiqa jinheM ina vizeSatAoM ke sAtha varNita kiyA gayA hai, vahI loga haiM jinhoMne ImAna ke badale kufra ko cunA| isalie unake vyApAra se koI lAbha nahIM huA; kyoMki ve allAha para ImAna se hAtha dho baiThe aura unheM satya mArga bhI prApta nahIM huA|

allAha taAlA ne ina munAfiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) ke do udAharaNa peza kie haiM: eka Aga kA udAharaNa, aura dUsarA pAnI kA udAharaNa| unakA Aga kA udAharaNa yaha hai ki: ve (munAfiqa) usa AdamI kI taraha haiM, jisane rozanI prApta karane ke lie Aga jalAI| jaba usakI rozanI camakI aura usane socA ki aba usase lAbhAnvita hogA, to vaha bujha gaI| cunA~ce usameM jo camakane vAlA tatva thA, vaha samApta ho gayA tathA jo kucha usameM jalAne kA tatva thA, vaha raha gayA| isalie ve Aga jalAne vAle aMdhakAra meM par3e raha gae| unheM kucha dikhAI nahIM detA aura na ve koI rAstA hI pAte haiM|
ve bahare haiM, satya ko svIkAra karane kI nIyata se nahIM sunate| ve gU~ge haiM, satya nahIM bolate haiM| (ve) satya ko dekhane se aMdhe haiM| isalie ve apanI pathabhraSTatA se vApasa nahIM lauTate|

jahA~ taka unake pAnI ke udAharaNa kA saMbaMdha hai: to ve saMcita aMdhakAra, garaja aura bijalI (camaka) vAle bAdaloM se hone vAlI bahuta adhika bAriza ke samAna haiM, jo kucha logoM para utaratI hai, to ve saqhta ghabarAhaTa se grasta ho jAte haiM, aura kar3akane vAle vajra kI tIvratA ke kAraNa mRtyu ke bhaya se apanI uMgaliyoM se apane kAnoM ko baMda kara lete haiM| hAlA~ki allAha kAfiroM ko ghere hue hai, ve use vivaza nahIM kara sakate|

nikaTa hai ki bijalI apanI camaka aura rozanI kI tIvratA ke kAraNa unakI A~khoM ko ucaka le jAe| jaba bhI bijalI camakatI aura unake lie rozanI karatI hai, to ve Age bar3hate haiM aura jaba vaha rozanI nahIM karatI hai, to ve aMdhere hI meM bane rahate haiM, apanI jagaha se hila nahIM sakate| hAlA~ki yadi allAha cAhatA, to unake satya se mu~ha mor3ane ke kAraNa apanI sarvasamAvezI zakti ke dvArA unake kAna aura unakI dRSTiyoM ko chIna letA, phira ve unake pAsa vApasa nahIM lauTatIM| yahA~ bAriza quraAna kA udAharaNa hai, bijalI kI kar3aka quraAna kI cetAvaniyoM kA udAharaNa hai, bijalI kI rozanI kabhI-kabhI unake sAmane satya ke spaSTa hone kA udAharaNa hai, tathA bijalI kI kar3aka kI tIvratA se kAnoM ko baMda kara lene ko unake satya se mu~ha mor3ane aura use svIkAra na karane kA udAharaNa banAyA gayA hai| munAfiqoM aura donoM udAharaNoM vAle logoM ke bIca sAdRzya kA biMdu: lAbha na uThAnA hai| cunA~ce Aga ke udAharaNa meM: Aga jalAne vAle ko aMdhere aura jalane ke sivA koI lAbha na huA, aura pAnI ke udAharaNa meM: bAriza meM ghire hue logoM ne bhayaMkara garaja aura camaka ke alAvA koI lAbha nahIM uThAyA| yahI hAla munAfiqoM kA hai, unheM islAma ke aMdara saqhtI evaM kaThoratA ke sivA kucha naz2ara nahIM AtA|

jaba allAha taAlA ne logoM ke prakAra: mominoM, kAfiroM aura munAfiqoM kA ullekha kiyA, to una sabhI ko kevala apanI hI ibAdata karane ke lie AhvAna karate hue pharamAyA:
ai logo! akele apane pAlanahAra kI ibAdata karo, usake atirikta kisI aura kI nahIM; kyoMki vahI hai jisane tumheM paidA kiyA aura una samudAyoM ko paidA kiyA jo tumase pahale the| isa AzA meM ki tuma usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara, usakI yAtanA se bacane kA upAya kara sako|

vahI hai jisane tumhAre lie z2amIna ko samatala bichaunA banAyA tathA usake Upara AkAza ko eka dRr3ha saMracanA banAyA| tathA vahI bAriza utArakara upakAra karane vAlA hai| cunA~ce usane usake dvArA dharatI se vibhinna prakAra ke phala ugAe, tAki vaha tumhArI jIvikA bana sake| ataH allAha ke lie kisI taraha ke sAjhIdAra aura udAharaNa na banAo, jabaki tuma jAnate ho ki allAha sarvazaktimAna ke sivA koI sraSTA nahIM hai|

ai logo! yadi tumheM hamAre baMde muha़mmada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) para utAre gae quraAna ke bAre meM kisI prakAra kA saMdeha hai, to hama tumheM cunautI dete haiM ki usa jaisI eka sUrata hI lAkara usakA virodha karo, bhale hI vaha usakI choTI se choTI sUrata ke barAbara hI kyoM na ho| tathA apane samarthakoM meM se jise bhI bulA sakate ho, bulA lo, yadi tuma apane dAve meM sacce ho|

agara tumane aisA nahIM kiyA - aura tuma aisA kabhI nahIM kara pAoge - to usa Aga se baco, jo yAtanA ke haqadAra logoM aura una sabhI prakAra ke pattharoM se bhar3akAI jAegI, jinheM ve pUjA karate the| isa Aga ko allAha taAlA ne kAfiroM ke lie taiyAra kiyA hai|

agara pichalI dhamakI kAfiroM ke lie thI; to - ai nabI - Apa satkarma karane vAle mominoM ko aise bAg2oM kI zubha sUcanA de deM, jinake mahaloM aura per3oM ke nIce nahareM bahatI haiM| jaba bhI unheM una bAg2oM ke svAdiSTa phaloM meM se koI phala diyA jAegA, to duniyA ke phaloM se bilakula milatA-julatA hone ke kAraNa ve kaheMge: ye to bilakula vaise hI phala haiM, jo hameM pahale die gae the| daraasala unheM AkAra tathA nAma meM samarUpa phala isalie die jAe~ge, tAki jAne pahacAne phala hone ke kAraNa, dila unheM svIkAra kara leM| lekina ve apane svAda aura z2Ayaqe meM bhinna hoMge| unake lie jannata meM aisI patniyA~ hoMgI, jo duniyA ke logoM meM kalpanA kI jAne vAlI hara usa cIz2a se pavitra hoMgI, jisase mana bhAgatA hai aura mAnava svabhAva ghRNA karatA hai| ve duniyA kI bAdhita hone vAlI nematoM ke viparIta, hamezA bAqI rahane vAlI nematoM meM hoMge, jo kabhI qhatma nahIM hoMgI|

allAha taAlA kisI bhI cIz2a ke sAtha udAharaNa dene se nahIM zaramAtA hai| cunA~ce vaha macchara tathA usase bhI choTI yA usase bhI bar3I vastu ke sAtha udAharaNa detA hai| jabaki ina udAharaNoM ke prati logoM ke do prakAra haiM: momina aura kAfira| momina loga unakI puSTi karate haiM aura isa bAta para vizvAsa rakhate haiM ki unake dvArA udAharaNa dene ke pIche eka hikamata hai| paraMtu kAfira loga maz2Aqa ur3Ate hue eka-dUsare se pUchate haiM ki allAha ne macchara, makkhI evaM makar3I jaisI ina tuccha prANiyoM ke sAtha udAharaNa kyoM diyA hai? to allAha kI tarapha se usakA uttara yaha AtA hai: ina udAharaNoM meM logoM ke lie kaI prakAra ke mArgadarzana, nirdeza aura parIkSaNa haiM| unameM se kucha ko allAha, unake ina para vicAra karane se mu~ha pherane ke kAraNa, gumarAha kara detA hai| aura aise logoM kI saMkhyA bahuta hai| tathA unameM se kucha kA mArgadarzana karatA hai kyoMki ve unase upadeza grahaNa karate haiM, aura ye bhI bahuta haiM| vaha kevala usI ko gumarAha karatA hai, jo gumarAhI kA haqadAra ho| aura ve usakI AjJAkAritA se nikala jAne vAle loga haiM, jaise ki munAfiqa loga|

jo loga allAha ke usa vacana ko tor3a dete haiM, jo usane unase liyA thA ki ve kevala usI kI ibAdata kareMge tathA usake usa rasUla kA anusaraNa kareMge, jisake bAre meM Apa sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke pahale ke rasUloM ne sUcanA dI thI| tathA ve una riztoM-nAtoM ko kATate haiM, jinheM allAha ne jor3ane kA Adeza diyA hai aura pApoM ke mAdhyama se pRthvI meM bhraSTAcAra phailAne kI koziza karate haiM, to yahI loga duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM bahuta kama hisse vAle haiM|

ai kAfiro! tumhArA mAmalA bar3A adbhuta hai! tuma allAha kA inakAra kaise karate ho, jabaki tuma usake sAmarthya kI nizAniyA~ khuda apane aMdara dekhate ho; kyoMki tuma kucha bhI nahIM the, to usane tumheM banAyA aura jIvana diyA, phira vaha tumheM dUsarI mauta degA, phira tumheM dUsarA jIvana pradAna karegA, phira vaha tumheM apanI ora lauTAegA, tAki jo kucha tumane kiyA hai usakA tumase hisAba le|

akelA allAha hI hai, jisane dharatI para jo kucha bhI hai, jaise- nadiyA~, per3a aura anya cIz2eM jinakI ginatI nahIM kI jA sakatI, tumhAre lie paidA kiyA, tathA tuma usase lAbhAnvita hote aura usakA AnaMda lete ho jo usane tumhAre adhIna kiyA hai| phira vaha AsamAna kI racanA karane kI ora mutavajjeha huA aura unheM ThIka-ThAka sAta AsamAna banA diyA| tathA usake jJAna ne hara vastu ko apane ghere meM le rakhA hai|

allAha taAlA sUcanA de rahA hai ki usane fariztoM se kahA ki vaha dharatI para manuSya ko paidA karegA, jo allAha kI AjJAkAritA para dharatI ko AbAda karane ke lie eka-dUsare ke uttarAdhikArI hoMge| to fariztoM ne apane pAlanahAra se - mArgadarzana aura pUchatAcha ke taura para - Adama ke beToM ko pRthvI para uttarAdhikArI banAne kI hikamata ke bAre meM pUchA, jabaki ve dharatI meM bigAr3a paidA kareMge aura anyAyapUrvaka khUna bahAe~ge, yaha kahate hue: hAlA~ki hama tere AjJAkArI haiM, terI prazaMsA karate hue tathA tere pratApa evaM pUrNatA kA mahimAmaMDana karate hue hama terI pavitratA bayAna karate haiM, hama isameM koI sustI nahIM karate| to allAha taAlA ne unake prazna kA uttara diyA: maiM unheM paidA karane kI zAnadAra hikamatoM tathA unake uttarAdhikAra ke mahAna uddezyoM ke bAre meM jo jAnatA hU~, tuma nahIM jAnate|

Adama alaihissalAma ke sthAna (rutabA) ko spaSTa karane ke lie, allAha taAlA ne unheM sabhI sajIva evaM nirjIva vastuoM Adi ke nAma arthAt unake zabda evaM artha sikhA die| phira una vastuoM ko fariztoM ke sAmane rakhate hue kahA: mujhe inake nAma batAo, yadi tuma apane isa dAve meM sacce ho ki tuma isa prANI se adhika pratiSThita aura usase behatara ho!!

unhoMne - apanI kamI ko svIkAra karate hue, allAha ko zreya dete hue - kahA: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hama tere faisale aura vidhAna ke bAre meM tujhapara Apatti karane se tujhe pavitra ThaharAte aura terA mahimAmaMDana karate haiM| kyoMki tUne hameM jo jJAna diyA hai, usake sivA hama aura kucha nahIM jAnate| niHsaMdeha tU sarvajJa hai, jisase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai, tU pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai, apanI niyati aura apane vidhAna meM cIjoM ko unake ucita sthAna para rakhatA hai|

taba allAha taAlA ne Adama alaihissalAma se kahA: unheM ina vastuoM ke nAma batAo| cunA~ce jaba Adama alaihissalAma ne unheM batA diyA jisa taraha unake pAlanahAra ne unheM sikhAyA thA, to allAha taAlA ne fariztoM se kahA: kyA maiMne tumase nahIM kahA thA: niHsaMdeha maiM AkAzoM tathA dharatI kI chipI huI bAtoM ko jAnatA hU~, tathA maiM use bhI jAnatA hU~, jo tuma apanI sthitiyoM meM se prakaTa karate ho aura jo tuma apane mana se bAteM karate ho|

aura hamane kahA: ai Adama! tuma aura tumhArI patnI - ha़vvA - jannata meM raho aura usameM se jannata ke kisI bhI bhAga meM eka sukhada aura vistRta bhojana khAo| tathA tuma donoM isa per3a ke pAsa mata jAnA, jisase maiMne tumheM khAne se manA kiyA hai| anyathA tuma donoM merI avajJA karane ke kAraNa atyAcAriyoM meM se ho jAoge|

phira Adama alaihissalAma ne ve zabda sIkha lie, jo allAha ne unake dila meM DAla die the aura unake sAtha unheM duA karane ke lie prerita kiyA thA| ye vahI zabda haiM, jinakA ullekha allAha ke isa kathana meM hai: (الأعراف: 23)﴾قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ﴿ ''una donoM ne kahA: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hamane apanI jAnoM para atyAcAra kiyA hai| aura yadi tUne hameM kSamA na kiyA aura hamapara dayA na kI, to nizcaya hama avazya nuqasAna uThAne vAloM meM se ho jAe~ge|'' (sUratula ArAfa: 23) cunA~ce allAha ne unakI taubA qabUla kara lI aura unheM kSamA kara diyA| kyoMki vaha mahimAvAn apane baMdoM kI taubA bahuta z2yAdA qabUla karane vAlA aura unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

hamane unase kahA: tuma saba jannata se dharatI para utara jAo| phira yadi mere rasUloM ke hAthoM tumhAre pAsa koI mArgadarzana Ae, to usapara calane vAloM aura mere rasUloM para ImAna lAne vAloM para na to Aqhirata meM koI Dara hai, aura na hI ve duniyA ke chUTane para dukhI hoMge|
jahA~ taka una logoM kI bAta hai jinhoMne kufra kiyA aura hamArI AyatoM ko jhuThalAyA, to vahI loga Aga (jahannama) vAle haiM, ve usase kabhI bAhara nahIM nikaleMge|

ai allAha ke nabI yAqUba ke beTo! tuma apane Upara allAha kI lagAtAra nematoM ko yAda karo aura unakA zukriyA adA karo aura mujhapara tathA mere rasUloM para ImAna lAne aura mere nirdhArita kie hue niyamoM para amala karane ke mere Adeza ko pUrA karo| yadi tuma ise pUrA karate ho, to maiM duniyA meM saubhAgyazAlI jIvana tathA qiyAmata ke dina behatara badale kA tumase kiyA huA vAdA pUrA karU~gA| tathA kevala mujha hI se Daro aura merI pratijJA ko mata tor3o|

tathA usa quraAna para ImAna lAo, jise maiMne muha़mmada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama para utArA hai, jo usakI puSTi karane vAlA hai jo allAha kI tauha़Ida (ekezvaravAda) tathA muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI nubuvvata ke viSaya meM taurAta meM usake vikRta hone se pUrva AyA hai| tathA sAvadhAna rahanA, kahIM aisA na ho ki tuma usakA inakAra karane vAle pahale dala bana jAo| tathA merI utArI huI AyatoM ke badale pratiSThA evaM pada ke rUpa meM eka choTI sI qImata na lo, aura mere krodha tathA merI yAtanA se Daro|

namAz2a ko usake arakAna, vAjibAta aura sunnatoM ke sAtha sampUrNa tarIqe se adA karo, aura apane una dhanoM kI z2akAta nikAlo jo allAha ne tumhAre hAthoM meM rakhA hai, tathA muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI ummata meM se allAha ke samakSa jhukane vAloM ke sAtha allAha ke sAmane jhuka jAo|

kitanI burI bAta hai ki tuma dUsaroM ko to ImAna aura bhalAI karane kA Adeza do, aura apane Apako bhUlakara khuda usase mu~ha phera lo, hAlA~ki tuma taurAta par3hate ho, usameM maujUda allAha ke dharma kA pAlana karane tathA usake rasUloM para vizvAsa karane ke Adeza se avagata ho| to kyA tuma apanI buddhiyoM se lAbha nahIM uThAte?!

apane sabhI dhArmika aura sAMsArika mAmaloM meM sabra (dhairya) ke sAtha madada mA~go tathA namAz2a ke sAtha jo tumheM allAha ke qarIba lAtI hai aura tumheM usase jor3atI hai| ataH vaha tumhArI madada karatA hai aura tumhArI rakSA karatA hai aura tumhAre nuqasAna ko dUra kara detA hai| aura nizcaya namAz2a qAyama karanA bahuta kaThina aura bhArI hai, sivAya unake jo apane pAlanahAra ke prati samarpita hone vAle haiM|

isakA kAraNa yaha hai ki vahI loga haiM jo isa bAta para vizvAsa rakhate haiM ki ve apane raba ke pAsa Ane vAle aura qiyAmata ke dina usase milane vAle haiM| aura yaha ki ve usI ke pAsa lauTane vAle haiM, tAki vaha unheM unake karmoM kA pratiphala de|

tathA AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura niSedhoM ko chor3akara apane aura qiyAmata ke dina kI yAtanA ke bIca, bacAva kA sAdhana apanAo| usa dina koI kisI ke kucha kAma na AegA, na usa dina allAha kI anumati ke binA nukasAna ko dUra karane yA lAbha prApta karane kI kisI kI sifAriza qabUla kI jAegI, aura na hI koI chur3autI svIkAra kI jAegI; cAhe z2amIna ke barAbara sonA hI kyoM na ho, aura na usa dina unakA koI madadagAra hogA| jaba koI sifArizI, yA chur3autI yA madadagAra kAma nahIM AegA, to phira bhAgane kA sthAna kahA~ hai?!

ai banI isarAIla! usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba hamane tumheM firaauna ke logoM se chur3AyA, jo tumheM nAnA prakAra kI yAtanAe~ dete the; ve tumhAre beToM ko burI taraha z2abaha kara dete the, tAki tumhArA koI astitva na rahe aura tumhArI beTiyoM ko jIvita chor3a dete the, tAki ve unakI sevA karane vAlI striyAM ho jAe~| isase unakA maqasada tumhArA ghora apamAna karanA thA| tumheM firaauna aura usake anuyAyiyoM ke atyAcAra se bacAnA tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se eka bar3I parIkSA hai; tAki tuma usakA zukriyA adA karo|

ina nematoM meM se yaha bhI yAda rakho ki hamane mUsA alaihissalAma se cAlIsa rAtoM ke lie vAdA kiyA, tAki isameM, prakAza aura mArgadarzana ke taura para, taurAta ko utArA jAe| phira tumane yaha kiyA ki usa avadhi ke daurAna bachar3e kI pUjA karane lage| aura aisA karake tuma atyAcAra karane vAle the|

phira tumhAre taubA (kSamA yAcanA) kara lene ke bAda, hamane tumheM kSamA kara diyA, cunA~ce hamane tumhArI pakar3a nahIM kI, tAki tuma allAha kI acchI ibAdata aura AjJApAlana karake usakA zukriyA adA karo|

ina nematoM meM se ise bhI yAda karo ki hamane mUsA alaihissalAma ko satya tathA asatya ke bIca aMtara karane vAlI tathA hidAyata evaM gumarAhI ke bIca farqa karane vAlI pustaka taurAta pradAna kI, tAki tuma usake dvArA satya kA mArga pA sako|

ina nematoM meM se yaha bhI yAda rakho ki allAha ne tumheM bachar3e kI pUjA se taubA karane kA sAmarthya pradAna kiyA| jaba mUsA alaihissalAma ne tumase kahA: tumane bachar3e ko usakI ibAdata karane ke lie pUjya banAkara apane Apa para atyAcAra kiyA hai| ataH pazcAtApa karo aura apane paidA karane vAle kI ora lauTa jAo| isa prakAra ki tuma eka-dUsare ko qatla karo| isa taraha se pazcAtApa karanA, tumhAre lie kufra meM bane rahane se behatara hai jo ki Aga meM amaratA kI ora le jAtA hai| cunA~ce allAha kI taufIqa aura madada se tumane aisA kara liyA, to usane tumhArI taubA qabUla kara lI| kyoMki vaha bahuta z2yAdA taubA qabUla karane vAlA, apane baMdoM para dayA karane vAlA hai|

tathA usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba tumhAre pUrvajoM ne mUsA alaihissalAma ko sAhasapUrvaka saMbodhita karate hue kahA thA: hama tumapara usa samaya taka ImAna nahIM lA sakate, jaba taka hama allAha ko apanI A~khoM se isa taraha na dekha leM ki hamAre bIca koI Ar3a na ho| isapara jalAne vAlI Aga ne tumheM pakar3a liyA, aura tumheM mAra DAlA, jabaki tuma eka-dUsare ko dekha rahe the|
phira hamane tumhAre marane ke pazcAta tumheM punarjIvita kiyA, tAki tuma allAha kA apane Upara isa upakAra para zukriyA adA karo|

tumapara hamArI eka kRpA yaha hai ki jaba tuma dharatI meM bhaTaka rahe the, to hamane tumheM sUrya kI garmI se chAyA dene ke lie bAdaloM ko bhejA| isI taraha hamane apanI nematoM meM se tumapara zahada kI taraha eka mIThA peya, tathA baTera ke sadRza acche mA~sa vAlA eka choTA pakSI utArA, aura hamane tumase kahA: una acchI cIjoM meM se khAo jo hamane tumheM pradAna kI haiM| unhoMne ina nematoM kA inakAra aura unakI nAzukrI karake hamArA kucha nuqasAna nahIM kiyA, balki unhoMne apane hisse kA savAba kama karake aura apane Apako daMDa se do cAra karake qhuda para atyAcAra kiyA|

apane Upara allAha kI nematoM meM se usa samaya ko yAda karo jaba hamane tumase kahA: baitula-maqdisa meM praveza kara jAo aura usameM maujUda acchI cIz2oM meM se jisa sthAna se bhI cAho AnaMdamaya, vizAla bhojana khAo| tathA jaba tuma praveza karo, to allAha ke Age sira jhukAe hue ho aura allAha se yaha duA karate raho: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hamAre gunAhoM ko miTA de; hama tumhArI duA qabUla kara leMge aura hama una logoM ke savAba ko bar3hA deMge, jinhoMne acche kAma kie|

lekina unameM se atyAcAriyoM ne kAryoM ko badala diyA, aura zabdoM ko vikRta kara diyA| cunA~ce ve apane nitaMboM para ghisaTate hue dAqhila hue aura allAha ke Adeza kA maz2Aqa ur3Ate hue unhoMne kahA: 'bAlI meM dAnA'| jisake pariNAmasvarUpa allAha ne unameM se atyAcAra karane vAloM para, unake zarIyata kI sImA se bAhara nikalane aura Adeza kA ullaMghana karane ke kAraNa AkAza se az2Aba utAra diyA|

tathA apane Upara allAha kI usa nemata ko bhI yAda karo jaba tuma caTiyala maidAna meM bhaTaka rahe the aura tuma bahuta pyAse the, to mUsA alaihissalAma ne apane raba se prArthanA kI aura usase tumhAre lie pAnI mA~gA| isalie hamane unheM apanI lAThI patthara para mArane kA Adeza diyA| jaba unhoMne usako mArA, to usase tumhAre gotroM kI saMkhyA ke anusAra bAraha sote phUTa par3e aura unameM se pAnI nikala AyA| hamane hara gotra ke lie usake pIne kA viziSTa sthAna spaSTa kara diyA, tAki unake bIca koI vivAda na ho, aura hamane tumase kahA: allAha kI usa roz2I se khAo aura piyo, jo usane tumheM binA kisI parizrama yA kArya ke pradAna kI hai aura dharatI para bigAr3a phailAte na phiro|

usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba tumane apane raba kI nemata kI nAzukrI kI| cunA~ce manna aura salavA ke rUpa meM allAha kI utArI huI roz2I ko khAne se Uba gae aura kahane lage: hama eka hI prakAra ke khAne para saMtoSa nahIM kara sakate, jo nahIM badalatA hai| phira tumane mUsA alaihissalAma se mutAlabA kiyA ki vaha allAha se duA kareM ki vaha tumhAre lie dharatI kI upaja meM se, jaise usakI phaliyoM evaM sAga-sabz2iyoM, usakI kakar3I, anAja, masUra aura pyAz2a meM se koI khAnA nikAle| isapara mUsA alaihissalAma ne (tumhAre anurodha kI niMdA karate hue: kyA tuma manna aura salavA jaise behatarIna aura adhika udAra bhojana ke badale eka kamatara aura tuccha cIz2a ko apanAte ho, jabaki vaha tumhAre pAsa binA parezAnI aura thakAna ke AtA thA?) pharamAyA: tuma yahA~ kI dharatI se nikalakara kisI bhI bastI meM jA utaro| tumheM vahA~ ke khetoM aura bAz2AroM meM vaha saba mila jAegA, jo tumane mA~gA hai| unake apanI icchAoM kA pAlana karane aura allAha ne unake lie jo cunA thA, usase bAra-bAra mu~ha pherane ke kAraNa; unheM apamAna, daridratA aura vipatti ne ghera liyA| sAtha hI ve allAha kI ora se bhArI prakopa ke sAtha lauTe; kyoMki unhoMne usake dIna se mu~ha pherA, usakI AyatoM kA inakAra kiyA aura usake nabiyoM kI anyAyapUrNa aura AkrAmaka tarIqe se hatyA kI; yaha saba isa kAraNa huA ki unhoMne allAha kI avajJA kI aura ve usakI sImAoM ko pAra kara rahe the|

isa ummata ke jo loga ImAna lAe, tathA isI taraha muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke nabI banane se pahale pichale samudAyoM, jaise yahUdiyoM, IsAiyoM aura sAbiyoM - ye kisI nabI ko mAnane vAloM kA eka samUha thA - meM se jo ImAna lAe, inameM se jo sahI mAyane meM allAha tathA aMtima dina para ImAna lAe; to unakA savAba unake raba ke pAsa hai| ve Aqhirata meM jisa cIz2a kA sAmanA karane vAle haiM usake bAre meM unheM koI bhaya nahIM hai, tathA duniyA meM se jo cIz2a unase chUTa gaI hai, usake lie unheM koI malAla nahIM hogA|

allAha tathA usake rasUloM para ImAna lAne ke usa pakke vacana ko yAda karo, jo hamane tumase liyA thA, aura hamane tumheM DarAne ke lie tathA vacana para amala na karane se sAvadhAna karate hue pahAr3a ko tumhAre Upara uThA liyA, tumheM yaha Adeza dete hue ki hamArI utArI huI pustaka taurAta ko pUrI zakti ke sAtha, binA kisI lAparavAhI aura Alasya ke thAma lo, tathA jo kucha usameM hai use yAda kara lo aura usapara ciMtana-manana karo| tAki aisA karake, tuma allAha ke az2Aba se baca jAo|

lekina apane Upara dRr3ha vacana lie jAne ke bAda bhI tumane mu~ha pherA aura avajJA kI| aise meM agara allAha ne apanI kRpA se tumheM mAfa na kiyA hotA aura apanI dayA se tumhArI taubA qabUla na karatA, to tuma isa vimukhatA aura avajJA ke kAraNa nuqasAna uThAne vAloM meM se hote|

tumane apane una pUrvajoM kA samAcAra saMdeha rahita spaSTa rUpa se jAna liyA hai, jinhoMne zanivAra ke dina zikAra karake z2yAdatI kI, jisameM unake lie zikAra karanA manA thA| isalie unhoMne isake lie yaha cAla calI ki zanivAra se pahale jAla lagA diyA aura ravivAra ko use nikAla liyA| cunA~ce allAha ne ina cAlabAz2oM ko unakI cAlabAz2I kI saz2A ke rUpa meM bahiSkRta baMdara banA diyA|

to hamane isa AkrAmaka bastI ko isake Asa-pAsa kI bastiyoM ke lie eka ibarata tathA isake bAda Ane vAle ke lie eka ibarata banA diyA| tAki koI usa jaisA amala karake usI taraha ke az2Aba kA haqadAra na bane| tathA hamane use una Darane vAloM ke lie anusmAraka banA diyA, jo allAha kI saz2A aura usakI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karane vAloM se usake badalA lene se Darate haiM|

tathA apane pUrvajoM ke samAcAra meM se usa saMvAda ko yAda karo, jo unake aura mUsA alaihissalAma ke bIca huA| jaba mUsA alaihissalAma ne unheM sUcita kiyA ki allAha ne unheM eka gAya z2abaha karane kA Adeza diyA hai| to unhoMne allAha ke Adeza kA pAlana karane meM jaldI karane ke bajAya haThapUrvaka kahA: kyA tuma hamArA maz2Aqa ur3A rahe ho?! mUsA alaihissalAma ne kahA: maiM una logoM meM zAmila hone se allAha kI zaraNa letA hU~, jo allAha para jhUTha bolate haiM aura logoM kA maz2Aqa ur3Ate haiM|

unhoMne mUsA alaihissalAma se kahA: apane raba se prArthanA karo ki vaha hameM usa gAya kA vivaraNa samajhAe jise usane hameM z2abaha karane kA Adeza diyA hai| unhoMne unase kahA: allAha kahatA hai: vaha eka aisI gAya hai jo na to bUr3hI hai aura na hI bachar3I, balki vaha donoM ke bIca madhyama Ayu kI hai| ata: apane raba kI AjJA kA pAlana karane meM jaldI karo|

unhoMne apane tarka-vitarka aura haTha ko jArI rakhate hue mUsA alaihissalAma se kahA: apane pAlanahAra se prArthanA karo ki vaha hameM samajhAe ki usakA raMga kyA hai| to mUsA alaihissalAma ne unase kahA: allAha kahatA hai: vaha eka bahuta hI pIlI gAya hai, jo hara kisI ko bhA jAtI hai jo use dekhatA hai|

phira ve apane haTha meM hada se bar3hate hue kahane lage: apane pAlanahAra se prArthanA karo ki vaha hamAre lie isake guNoM ko aura adhika spaSTa kara de; kyoMki uparyukta vizeSatAoM vAlI gAyeM bahuta haiM, unameM se hama usakI pahacAna nahIM kara sakate| unhoMne isa bAta kI puSTi bhI kI ki - yadi allAha ne cAhA - to ve z2abaha ke lie apekSita gAya taka pahu~ca jAe~ge|

mUsA alaihissalAma ne unase kahA: allAha taAlA kahatA hai: vaha gAya aisI hai jo jutAI meM kAma karane aura bhUmi ko sIMcane ke lie sadhAI huI nahIM hai, aura vaha doSoM se mukta hai, tathA usameM usake pIle raMga ke alAvA kisI aura raMga kA nizAna nahIM hai| taba unhoMne kahA: aba tU saTIka vivaraNa ke sAtha AyA hai jo pUrI taraha se usa gAya kA nirdhAraNa karatA hai| aura unhoMne usa gAya ko z2abaha kiyA, jabaki ve vAda-vivAda aura haTha ke kAraNa qarIba the ki use z2abaha na kareM|

tathA usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba tumane apane hI meM se eka vyakti kI hatyA kara dI, phira Apasa meM lar3ane lage| hara eka apane Apako hatyA ke Aropa se bacAne lagA aura dUsaroM para Aropa dharane lagA, yahA~ taka ki tuma Apasa meM jhagar3a baiThe| jabaki allAha usa nirdoSa vyakti kI hatyA ke mAmale ko prakAza meM lAne vAlA thA, jise tume chipA rahe the|

to hamane tumase kahA: mare hue vyakti ke zarIra para usa gAya ke kisI bhAga se mAro, jise tumheM z2abaha karane kA Adeza diyA gayA thA| kyoMki hatyArA kauna hai yaha batAne ke lie allAha use punarjIvita karegA! cunA~ce unhoMne vaisA hI kiyA aura usane apane hatyAre ko batA diyA| aura isa mare hue vyakti ko phira se jIvita karane kI taraha, allAha qiyAmata ke dina mare huoM ko punarjIvita karegA| allAha tumheM apanI zakti ke spaSTa pramANa dikhAtA hai, tAki tuma unheM samajho aura allAha para sahI mAyane meM vizvAsa rakho|

ataH vinAza aura ghora yAtanA ina logoM kI pratIkSA kara rahI hai, jo apane hAthoM se kitAba likhate haiM, phira - jhUTha-mUTha - kahate haiM: yaha allAha kI ora se hai; tAki ve satya aura mArgadarzana kA pAlana karane ke badale isa duniyA meM eka choTI sI qImata, jaise ki dhana aura saradArI prApta kara sakeM| ataH unake lie bar3I tabAhI aura saqhta az2Aba hai usake kAraNa jo unake hAthoM ne likhakara allAha ke khilApha jhUTha bolA hai, tathA unake lie tabAhI aura saqhta az2Aba hai usake kAraNa jo ve usase dhana aura saradArI kamAte haiM|

aura - ai banI isarAIla! - usa dRr3ha vacana ko yAda karo, jo hamane tumase liyA thA, ki tuma allAha ko ekamAtra pUjya mAnoge aura usake sAtha kisI kI ibAdata nahIM karoge, aura yaha ki tuma mAtA-pitA, riztedAroM, anAthoM aura z2arUratamaMda nirdhanoM ke sAtha acchA vyavahAra karoge| aura yaha ki tuma logoM se acchI bAta bolo, binA saqhtI aura kaThoratA ke bhalAI kA Adeza dete hue evaM burAI se rokate hue| aura yaha ki tuma pUrI taraha se namAz2a adA karo jaisA maiMne tumheM Adeza diyA hai, aura yaha ki tuma z2akAta adA karo use usake haqadAroM ko khuzI ke sAtha dekara| phira, isa vacana ke bAda, jo tumase liyA gayA thA, tuma use pUrA karane se mu~ha mor3ate hue phira gae, sivAya usake jise allAha ne tumameM se bacA liyA, to usane allAha ke lie usake vacana aura pratijJA ko pUrA kiyA|

yadi yahUdI sacamuca allAha para ImAna lAte, tathA usakI AjJAkAritA karake aura usakI avajJA ko tyAgakara usase Darate; to allAha kA savAba unake lie usase behatara hotA, jisapara ve haiM, yadi ve apane hita se avagata hote|

allAha taAlA mominoM ko zabdoM ke sahI cunAva ke lie nirdezita karate hue kahatA hai: ai ImAna vAlo! tuma {rA-inA} (arthAt hamArA dhyAna rakhie) zabda kA prayoga na karo; kyoMki yahUdI ise vikRta kara dete haiM aura isake sAtha nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko saMbodhita karate haiM, jisase ve eka g2alata artha 'ruUnata' (tucchatA) murAda lete haiM| isalie allAha ne isa daravAz2e ko baMda karane ke lie isa zabda ke istemAla se manA kara diyA aura apane baMdoM ko Adeza diyA ki usake sthAna para {unz2uranA} kaheM; arthAt hamArI pratIkSA kareM, tAki hama ApakI bAta samajha jAe~| kyoMki isa zabda se binA kisI qharAbI ke artha pUrA ho jAtA hai| tathA allAha kA inakAra karane vAloM ke lie kaSTadAyI yAtanA hai|

kAfira - cAhe ahle kitAba hoM yA muzrika - yaha pasaMda nahIM karate haiM ki tumapara tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se koI bhI bhalAI utare, cAhe vaha thor3I ho yA bahuta| tathA allAha apane baMdoM meM se jise cAhatA hai, apanI dayA, jaise nubuvvata, vaha़ya aura ImAna ke sAtha khAsa kara letA hai| aura allAha bahuta bar3e anugraha vAlA hai| ataH kisI bhI prANI ko, jo bhI bhalAI pahu~catI hai, vaha usI kI ora se hotI hai tathA usake anugraha meM se rasUla kA bhejanA aura kitAba utAranA bhI hai|

allAha taAlA bayAna kara rahA hai ki jaba vaha quraAna kI kisI Ayata ke ha़ukma ko uThA detA (samApta kara detA) hai, yA usake zabda ko qhatma kara detA hai aura loga use bhUla jAte haiM, to allAha usake sthAna para aisI Ayata le AtA hai, jo tatkAla aura bhaviSya meM usase adhika phAyademaMda hotI hai, athavA usake samAna hotI hai, aura yaha saba kucha allAha ke jJAna aura usakI ha़ikamata ke mutAbiqa hotA hai| aura - ai nabI! - Apa jAnate haiM ki allAha hara cIz2a kA sAmarthya rakhatA hai| cunA~ce vaha jo cAhatA hai, karatA hai, aura jo cAhatA hai, Adeza detA hai|

niHsaMdeha (ai nabI!) Apa jAnate haiM ki allAha hI AsamAnoM aura z2amIna kA mAlika hai, vaha jo cAhatA hai, hukma detA hai| vaha apane baMdoM ko jisa cIz2a kA cAhatA hai, Adeza detA hai aura jisa cIz2a se cAhatA hai, unheM manA kara detA hai| tathA vaha zarIyata meM se jo cAhatA hai, sthira kara detA hai aura jo cAhatA hai, nirasta kara detA hai| allAha ke bAda, tumhAre mAmaloM ko saMbhAlane ke lie tumhAre pAsa koI saMrakSaka nahIM, aura na hI tumheM nukasAna se bacAne ke lie koI sahAyaka hai| balki allAha hI ina saba kA saMrakSaka hai aura aisA karane meM sakSama hai|

(ai ImAna vAlo!) tumheM yaha zobhA nahIM detA ki tuma apane rasUla se - Apatti aura DhiThAI ke taura para - prazna karo, jisa taraha ki mUsA alaihissalAma kI qauma ke logoM ne isase pahale apane nabI (mUsA) se kiyA thA| jaise ki unhoMne kahA thA: (النساء: 153) {أَرِنَا اللَّهَ جَهْرَةً} ''hameM allAha ko khullama khullA dikhA do|'' (sUratun-nisA: 153) aura jo vyakti ImAna ke badale kufra ko apanA le, to nizcaya vaha madhyama mArga se bhaTaka gayA jo ki sIdhA mArga hai|

yahUdiyoM aura IsAiyoM meM se bahuta-se loga cAhate haiM ki tumheM tumhAre ImAna ke bAda vApasa kAfira banA deM, jaise tuma (pahale) mUrtiyoM kI pUjA kiyA karate the| aisA ve usa IrSyA ke kAraNa kara rahe haiM, jo unake diloM meM hai| yaha kAmanA ve usake bAda kara rahe haiM jaba unake lie spaSTa ho cukA hai ki nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama jo kucha lAe haiM, vaha allAha kI ora se satya hai| ataH (ai ImAna vAlo!) unake kAryoM ko kSamA karo, aura unakI ajJAnatA aura unakI AtmA kI burAI ko naz2araaMdAz2a karo, yahA~ taka ki unake bAre meM allAha kA Adeza A jAe - aura aba allAha kA yaha Adeza aura nirNaya A cukA hai| isalie kAfira ko islAma svIkArane yA jiz2ayA dene yA lar3AI karane ke bIca cayana karane kA vikalpa diyA jAtA hai - niHsaMdeha allAha hara cIz2a para sarvazaktimAna hai| isalie ve allAha ko vivaza nahIM kara sakate|

phira, allAha taAlA ne ImAna vAloM ko kaSTa para dhairya rakhane kA Adeza dene ke bAda, unheM apane dIna para sudRr3ha rahane aura apane ImAna ko maz2abUta karane kA Adeza diyA hai, cunA~ce pharamAyA:
namAz2a ko usake arakAna, vAjibAta aura sunnatoM ke sAtha pUrNa rUpa se adA karo, aura apane dhanoM kI z2akAta nikAlakara usake haqadAroM ko do| tuma apane jIvana kAla meM jo bhI neka kAma karoge aura use apanI mRtyu se pahale apane lie eka koSa ke rUpa meM Age bhejoge; qiyAmata ke dina tuma apane raba ke pAsa usakA savAba pAoge| vaha tumheM usakA pratiphala pradAna karegA| niHsaMdeha allAha, jo kucha tuma karate ho, use qhUba dekhane vAlA hai| isalie vaha hara eka ko usake kAma kA pratiphala degA|

yahUdiyoM aura IsAiyoM meM se hara saMpradAya ne kahA: jannata unhIM ke lie viziSTa hai| yahUdiyoM ne kahA: usameM kevala vahI praveza karegA, jo yahUdI hai| tathA IsAiyoM ne kahA: usameM kevala vahI praveza karegA, jo IsAI hai| ye unakI jhUThI icchAe~ aura unake bhraSTa bhrama haiM| (ai nabI!) Apa unakA khaMDana karate hue kaha dIjie: tuma jo kucha dAvA karate ho usapara apanA tarka prastuta karo, yadi vAstava meM tuma apane dAve meM sacce ho|

kevala vahI vyakti jannata meM praveza karegA, jo niSThA ke sAtha apane Apa ko allAha ke adhIna kara de, tathA vaha - apanI niSThA ke sAtha-sAtha - rasUla ke lAe hue tarIqe kA anusaraNa karake acchI taraha se ibAdata karane vAlA hai| cunA~ce aisA hI vyakti jannata meM praveza karegA, cAhe vaha kisI bhI saMpradAya se ho| tathA usake lie usakA badalA usake pAlanahAra ke pAsa hai| Aqhirata meM unheM na koI bhaya hogA aura na hI ve duniyA meM na milane vAlI vastuoM para dukhI hoMge| jJAta ho ki ye aisI vizeSatAe~ haiM, jo nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke Ane ke bAda, kevala mominoM hI meM pAI jA sakatI haiM|

yahUdiyoM ne kahA: IsAI sacce dharma para nahIM haiM| aura IsAiyoM ne kahA: yahUdI sacce dharma para nahIM haiM| hAlA~ki hara koI apanI kitAba meM usa cIz2a kI puSTi par3hatA hai jisakA usane inakAra kiyA hai, tathA sabhI nabiyoM para binA kisI bhedabhAva ke ImAna lAne kA Adeza par3hatA hai| ve apane isa kArya meM una muzrikoM ke kahane ke samAna ho gae, jinake pAsa koI jJAna nahIM; jaba unhoMne sabhI rasUloM aura unapara utArI gaI pustakoM kA inakAra kara diyA| ataH allAha sabhI matabheda karane vAle logoM ke bIca qiyAmata ke dina nirNaya karegA, apane usa nyAyapUrNa faisale ke sAtha jisakI usane apane baMdoM ko sUcanA dI hai: ki allAha kI utArI huI samasta cIz2oM para ImAna lAe binA koI saphalatA nahIM hai|

usa vyakti se bar3A atyAcArI koI nahIM hai, jo allAha kI masjidoM meM usakA nAma lene se roke| cunA~ce unameM namAz2a, z2ikra aura quraAna kI tilAvata se manA kara de, tathA unheM girAkara athavA unameM ibAdata karane se rokakara, unheM barbAda aura bhraSTa karane kA bharapUra prayAsa kare| jo loga masjidoM ko naSTa karane meM prayAsarata haiM, unheM unameM praveza nahIM karanA cAhie paraMtu isa sthiti meM ki ve Dare sahame hoM, unake dila kA~pa rahe hoM; unake kufra tathA allAha kI masjidoM se rokane ke kAraNa| aise logoM ke lie sAMsArika jIvana meM ImAna vAloM ke hAthoM apamAna evaM rusavAI hai tathA unake lie Aqhirata meM allAha kI masjidoM se logoM ko rokane ke kAraNa eka bar3I yAtanA hogI|

pUrva evaM pazcima aura unake bIca kA rAjya allAha hI kA hai| allAha apane baMdoM ko jo cAhatA hai, Adeza detA hai| ataH tuma jidhara bhI mukha karoge, allAha kA sAmanA karoge| yadi vaha tumheM baitula-maqadisa yA kAbA kI ora mu~ha karane kA Adeza de, athavA tumase qibalA (ke nirdhAraNa) meM galatI ho jAe, yA usakI ora mukha karanA tumhAre lie muzkila ho; to tumhAre lie koI hAni kI bAta nahIM hai; kyoMki sabhI dizAe~ sarvazaktimAna allAha ke lie haiM| bezaka allAha sarvavyApI hai| vaha apanI dayA aura suvidhA ke sAtha apanI samasta sRSTi ko vyApta hai, unake irAdoM evaM kAryoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|

tathA yahUdiyoM, IsAiyoM aura muzrikoM ne kahA: allAha ne apane lie koI saMtAna banA rakhI hai! allAha isase pAka evaM pavitra hai| kyoMki vaha apanI sRSTi se beniyAz2a hai aura saMtAna to vaha banAtA hai, jise usakI AvazyakatA hotI hai| balki vahI mahimAvAna AkAzoM aura dharatI kI sabhI cIz2oM kA mAlika hai| sabhI prANI usI mahimAvAna ke dAsa aura usake adhIna haiM, vaha jaise cAhatA hai, unameM vyavahAra karatA hai|

allAha mahimAvAna AkAzoM tathA dharatI aura unameM maujUda sabhI cIz2oM kA binA kisI pUrva udAharaNa ke sRSTikartA hai| jaba vaha kisI kAma kA phaisalA karatA hai aura usakI icchA karatA hai, to usa kAma se kahatA hai: ''ho jA''; to vaha vaise hI ho jAtA hai, jaise allAha cAhatA hai ki vaha ho| usake Adeza aura nirNaya ko koI TAlane vAlA nahIM|

ahle kitAba aura bahudevavAdiyoM meM se jo nahIM jAnate, unhoMne satya ke prati haTha ke kAraNa kahA: allAha hamase binA kisI madhyastha ke bAta kyoM nahIM karatA, yA hamAre pAsa hamAre hI lie viziSTa koI bhautika nizAnI kyoM nahIM AtI? ina logoM kI isI bAta kI taraha, isase pahale jhuThalAne vAle samudAyoM ne bhI apane rasUloM se kahI thI, bhale hI unake samaya aura sthAna alaga-alaga hoM| ina logoM ke dila kufra, haTha aura ahaMkAra meM una logoM ke diloM ke samAna haiM jo inase pahale the| hamane una logoM ke lie AyateM spaSTa kara dI haiM, jo satya para vizvAsa karate haiM, jaba vaha unake sAmane prakaTa hotA hai, na to unheM koI saMdeha gheratA hai aura na hI haTha unheM rokatA hai|

hamane Apako (ai nabI!) satya dharma ke sAtha bhejA hai, jisameM koI saMdeha nahIM; tAki Apa ImAna vAloM ko jannata kI zubha sUcanA deM aura kAfiroM ko jahannama kI Aga se DarAe~| ApakA kAma kevala spaSTa rUpa se pahu~cA denA hai| allAha Apase una jahannamiyoM ke bAre meM haragiz2a nahIM pUchegA, jo Apapara ImAna nahIM lAe|

allAha apane nabI ko nirdeza evaM cetAvanI dete hue unheM saMbodhita karate hue kahatA hai: Apase yahUdI aura IsAI haragiz2a rAz2I nahIM hoMge, yahA~ taka ki Apa islAma ko chor3akara unake dharma kA pAlana karane lageM| Apa kaha dIjie: niHsaMdeha allAha kI kitAba aura usakA bayAna hI saccA mArgadarzana hai, na ki vaha jhUTha jisapara ve qAyama haiM| yadi Apake pAsa spaSTa satya A jAne ke bAda, Apane yA Apake kisI anuyAyI ne unakA anusaraNa kiyA, to Apako allAha kI pakar3a se bacAne ke lie haragiz2a koI madada yA sahAyatA nahIM milegI| yaha satya ko chor3ane aura asatya ke logoM ke sAtha qadama milAkara calane ke qhatare ko spaSTa karane ke adhyAya se hai|

isa Ayata meM quraAna ahle kitAba ke eka samUha ke bAre meM bAta karatA hai, jo apane hAthoM meM maujUda avatarita pustakoM para amala karate haiM aura unakA pAlana karate haiM jaise unakA pAlana kiyA jAnA cAhie| ye loga ina pustakoM meM nabI muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke sacce nabI hone ko darzAne vAlI nizAniyA~ pAte haiM| yahI kAraNa hai ki unhoMne Apapara ImAna lAne meM jaldI kI| jabaki dUsarA samUha apane kufra para ar3A rahA, to use hAni uThAnI par3I|

ai banI isarAIla! merI pradAna kI huI dhArmika evaM sAMsArika nematoM ko yAda karo aura yAda rakho ki niHsaMdeha maiMne hI tumheM tumhAre samaya ke logoM para nubuvvata evaM bAdazAhata dvArA pradhAnatA pradAna kI|

allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara apane aura qiyAmata ke dina kI yAtanA ke bIca, bacAva kA sAdhana apanAo| kyoMki usa dina koI bhI kisI ke kucha kAma na AegA, aura usa dina usase koI chur3autI svIkAra nahIM kI jAegI, cAhe vaha kitanI bhI bar3I kyoM na ho, aura na usa dina use kisI kI sifAriza lAbha degI, cAhe usakA sthAna kitanA bhI U~cA kyoM na ho| aura na hI allAha ke alAvA usake lie koI madadagAra hogA, jo usakI madada kara sake|

usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba allAha ne ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ko una AdezoM aura kartavyoM ke dvArA Az2amAyA, jinakA unheM Adeza diyA thA, to unhoMne unakA niSpAdana kiyA aura unheM pUrNatama rUpa se aMjAma diyA| allAha ne apane nabI ibarAhIma alaihissalAma se kahA: maiM tumheM logoM ke lie Adarza banAne vAlA hU~, tAki tumhAre kriyAkalApoM aura AcAra-vyavahAra meM tumhArA anukaraNa kiyA jAe| ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ne kahA: ai mere pAlanahAra! merI aulAda meM se bhI kucha logoM ko imAma banA, jinakA loga anukaraNa kareM| allAha taAlA ne unheM uttara dete hue kahA: merA tumhAre lie dharma kI pezavAI kA vacana, tumhAre vaMza ke atyAcAriyoM ko nahIM pahu~catA|

tathA usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba allAha ne sammAnita ghara kAbA ko logoM ke lie bAra-bAra lauTa kara Ane kI jagaha banAI, jisase unakA dila jur3A huA rahatA hai| jaba bhI ve vahA~ se vApasa jAte haiM, dobArA usakI ora lauTakara Ate haiM| tathA use unake lie sarvathA zAMti kA sthala (surakSita sthAna) banA diyA, jisameM unapara koI atyAcAra nahIM kiyA jAtA| aura logoM se kahA: usa patthara ko - jisapara khar3e hokara ibarAhIma alaihissalAma kAbA kA nirmANa karate the - namAz2a kI jagaha banA lo| tathA hamane ibarAhIma aura unake putra isamAIla alaihimassalAma ko Adeza diyA ki ve kAbA ko gaMdagiyoM aura mUrtiyoM se zuddha kareM, tathA use tavAfa, etikAfa aura namAz2a Adi ke dvArA ibAdata karane vAloM ke lie taiyAra rakheM|

tathA (ai nabI!) yAda kIjie, jaba ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ne apane pAlanahAra se duA karate hue kahA: ai mere pAlanahAra! makkA ko eka zAMti vAlA (surakSita) zahara banA de, jisameM kisI ko kaSTa na pahu~cAyA jAe, tathA usameM rahane vAloM ko vibhinna prakAra ke phala pradAna kara, aura use tujhapara aura aMtima dina para ImAna rakhane vAloM ke lie eka viziSTa roz2I banA de| allAha ne kahA: tathA unameM se jo kufra karegA, to maiM use isa duniyA meM jo kucha bhI pradAna karatA hU~, usake sAtha use thor3A-sA lAbha dU~gA, phira Akhirata meM use Aga kI yAtanA kI ora vivaza kara dU~gA aura vaha bahuta burA ThikAnA hai, jisakI ora vaha qiyAmata ke dina lauTakara AegA|

tathA (ai nabI!) usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba ibarAhIma aura isamAIla alaihimassalAma kAbA kI buniyAdeM U~cI kara rahe the, aura ve donoM (namratA ke sAtha) kaha rahe the: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hamase hamAre kAryoM ko - jinameM se eka isa ghara kA nirmANa hai - qabUla pharamA| niHsaMdeha tU hI hamArI duA ko sunane vAlA, hamAre irAdoM aura kAryoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|

ai hamAre pAlanahAra! tU hameM apane Adeza ke prati samarpita hone vAlA aura apanA AjJAkArI banA de ki hama tere sAtha kisI ko bhI sAjhI na banAe~| tathA hamAre vaMza se bhI eka aisA samudAya banA, jo terA AjJAkArI ho| aura hameM apanI ibAdata sikhA de ki vaha kaise honI cAhie, tathA hamAre gunAhoM aura apane AjJApAlana meM hamArI kamiyoM ko kSamA kara de; niHsaMdeha tU hI hai jo apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM kI taubA ko bahuta qabUla karane vAlA, unapara atyaMta dayAlu hai|

ai hamAre pAlanahAra!, aura unake bIca unhIM meM se isamAIla kI saMtAna se eka rasUla bheja, jo unapara terI utArI huI AyateM par3he, tathA unheM quraAna evaM sunnata kI zikSA de aura unheM zirka evaM burAiyoM se pAka kare; niHsaMdeha tU hI sarvazaktimAna, prabhutvazAlI aura apane kAryoM evaM AdezoM meM pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai|

ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ke dharma se vimukha hokara dUsare dharmoM kI ora vahI AkarSita hogA, jisane apanI mUrkhatA tathA kuprabaMdhana se satya ko chor3a gumarAhI ko apanAkara apane Upara atyAcAra kiyA aura apane lie apamAna se saMtuSTa ho gayA| nizcaya hamane use duniyA meM eka rasUla aura dosta ke rUpa meM cuna liyA, tathA Aqhirata meM vaha nizcaya una sadAcAriyoM meM se hai, jinhoMne apane Upara allAha ke anivArya kie hue AdezoM ko pUrA karake sarvocca pada prApta kie|

allAha ne unheM unake islAma (AjJApAlana) kI ora jaldI karane ke kAraNa cunA| jaba unake pAlanahAra ne unase kahA: ibAdata ko mere lie vizuddha kara do aura AjJAkAritA ke sAtha mere adhIna ho jAo, to unhoMne apane raba ko uttara dete hue kahA: maiM allAha kA AjJAkArI ho gayA, jo baMdoM ko paidA karane vAlA, unheM roz2I dene vAlA aura unake mAmaloM kA prabaMdhaka hai|

ibarAhIma ne apane beToM ko isI bAta kI vasIyata kI, ki: {أَسْلَمْتُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} ''maiM sAre saMsAroM ke pAlanahAra kA AjJAkArI ho gayA|'', isI taraha yAqUba ne bhI apane beToM ko isI bAta kI vasIyata kI| una donoM ne apane beToM ko AvAz2a dete hue kahA: niHsaMdeha allAha ne tumhAre lie islAma dharma ko cuna liyA hai| ataH tuma use dRr3hatA se pakar3e raho yahA~ taka ki tumhAre pAsa mRtyu A jAe, aura tuma bAharI aura AMtarika rUpa se allAha ke AjJAkArI ho|

yA tuma usa samaya upasthita the, jaba yAqUba alaihissalAma kI mRtyu nikaTa AI| jaba unhoMne apane beToM se pUchate hue kahA: tuma merI mRtyu ke bAda kisakI ibAdata karoge? unhoMne unake savAla ke javAba meM kahA: hama Apake pUjya aura Apake pUrvajoM ibarAhIma, isamAIla tathA isaha़Aqa ke pUjya kI ibAdata kareMge, jo eka akelA pUjya hai, usakA koI sAjhI nahIM| aura hama akele usI ke prati samarpita aura usI ke AjJAkArI haiM|

yaha tumase pahale guz2are hue samudAyoM meM se eka samudAya thA, jo guz2ara cukA aura usa kArya kI ora jA cukA jo usane Age bar3hAyA thA| ataH usake lie usake kamAe hue acche yA bure karma haiM, aura tumhAre lie tumhAre kamAe hue karma| na tumase unake karmoM ke bAre meM pUchA jAegA, na unase tumhAre karmoM ke bAre meM pUchA jAegA, tathA koI bhI kisI dUsare ke gunAha ke badale nahIM pakar3A jAegA| balki pratyeka ko usake karma kA badalA diyA jAegA| isalie apane pahale guz2are hue logoM ke karma ke pIche par3anA tumheM khuda apane karma ko dekhane se vicalita na kare| kyoMki kisI ko allAha kI dayA ke bAda, usake satkarma ke sivA koI cIz2a haragiz2a phAyadA na degI|

yahUdiyoM ne musalamAnoM se kahA: yahUdI bana jAo, hidAyata ke mArga para calane lagoge, tathA IsAiyoM ne kahA: IsAI bana jAo, hidAyata ke mArga para calane lagoge| (ai nabI!) Apa unheM javAba dete hue kaha dIjie: balki, hama ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ke dharma kA anusaraNa kareMge, jo jhUThe dharmoM se vimukha hokara sacce dharma kI ora pravRta the tathA una logoM meM se nahIM the jinhoMne allAha ke sAtha kisI ko sAjhI banAyA|

ai ImAna vAlo! isa jhUThe dAvA vAle yahUdiyoM aura IsAiyoM se kaha do: hama allAha para aura usa quraAna para ImAna lAe jo hamArI ora utArA gayA| tathA hama usapara ImAna lAe jo ibarAhIma aura unake putroM isamAIla, isaha़Aqa aura yAqUba para utArA gayA| aura hama usapara ImAna lAe jo yAqUba alaihissalAma kI saMtAna meM se hone vAle nabiyoM para utArA gAya| isI taraha hama ImAna lAe usa taurAta para jo allAha ne mUsA alaihissalAma ko pradAna kiyA aura usa injIla para jo allAha ne IsA alaihissalAma ko pradAna kiyA| tathA hama una kitAboM para ImAna lAe jo allAha ne sabhI nabiyoM ko pradAna kIM| hama unameM se kisI ke bIca aMtara (bhedabhAva) nahIM karate, ki hama kucha para ImAna lAe~ aura kucha kA inakAra kara deM| balki hama una sabhI (nabiyoM) para ImAna rakhate haiM aura hama akele usI mahimAvAna allAha ke AjJAkArI aura adhIna haiM|

yadi yahUdI, IsAI aura anya kAfira tumhAre ImAna lAne kI taraha ImAna lAe~; to unhoMne usa sIdhe mArga ko pA liyA, jise allAha ne pasaMda kiyA hai| lekina yadi ve sabhI yA kucha nabiyoM ko jhuThalAkara ImAna se upekSA kareM, to ve virodha aura zatrutA meM par3e hue haiM| isalie - ai nabI! - Apa dukhI na hoM, kyoMki allAha Apako unake kaSTa se bacAne ke lie paryApta ho jAegA, ApakI unakI burAI se rakSA karegA aura unake khilApha ApakI madada karegA| kyoMki vaha unakI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, aura unake irAdoM aura kAryoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|

allAha ke usa dharma para bAharI aura AMtarika rUpa se jame raho, jisapara usane tumheM paidA kiyA hai| kyoMki allAha ke dharma se behatara koI dharma nahIM| kyoMki vaha prakRti ke anukUla hai, hitoM ko lAne vAlA aura ahitoM ko rokane vAlA hai| tathA kaho: hama kevala allAha kI ibAdata karane vAle haiM, hama usake sAtha kisI dUsare ko sAjhI nahIM banAte|

ai nabI! kaha dIjie: (ai kitAba vAlo!) kyA tuma hamase isa bAre meM bahasa karate ho ki tuma allAha aura usake dharma ke hamase z2yAdA haqadAra ho; isa kAraNa ki tumhArA dharma purAnA hai aura tumhArI pustaka pahale kI hai| to (jAna lo) isase tumheM koI phAyadA nahIM hogA| kyoMki allAha hI hama saba kA raba hai, vaha vizeSa rUpa se kevala tumhArA hI raba nahIM hai| tathA hamAre lie hamAre karma haiM, jinake bAre meM tumase nahIM pUchA jAegA, aura tumhAre lie tumhAre karma haiM, jinake bAre meM hamase nahIM pUchA jAegA| balki pratyeka ko usake kAma kA badalA diyA jAegA| hama ibAdata aura AjJAkAritA meM allAha ke prati niSThAvAna haiM, usake sAtha kisI cIz2a ko sAjhI nahIM ThaharAte|

(ai ahle kitAba!) kyA tuma kahate ho: ibarAhIma aura isamAIla aura isaha़Aqa aura yAqUba tathA yAqUba kI saMtAna meM se hone vAle paig2aMbara, yahUdI yA IsAI dharma ke anuyAyI the? ai nabI! Apa unakA uttara dete hue kaha deM: kyA tuma adhika jAnate ho yA allAha?! yadi unakA dAvA hai ki ve (ukta nabIgaNa) unake dharma para the, to nizcaya unhoMne jhUTha bolA hai| kyoMki unakI nubuvvata aura mRtyu kA z2amAnA taurAta aura iMjIla utarane se pahale kA hai! isase yaha patA calA ki jo kucha ve kahate haiM, vaha allAha aura usake rasUloM ke khilApha jhUTha hai, aura unhoMne usa satya ko chipAyA hai, jo unapara utarA thA| aura usase bar3A z2Alima koI nahIM, jo apane pAsa maujUda usa pakkI gavAhI ko chipAe, jisakA jJAna use allAha kI ora se huA hai, jaisA ki kitAba vAloM ne kiyA| aura allAha tumhAre karmoM se anajAna nahIM hai aura vaha tumheM unakA badalA degA|

yaha eka samudAya thA, jo guz2ara cukA aura usa kArya kI ora jA cukA jo usane Age bar3hAyA thA| ataH usake lie usake kamAe hue (acche yA bure) karma haiM, aura tumhAre lie tumhAre kamAe hue karma| na tumase unake karmoM ke bAre meM pUchA jAegA, na unase tumhAre karmoM ke bAre meM pUchA jAegA, tathA koI bhI kisI dUsare ke gunAha ke badale nahIM pakar3A jAegA aura na hI vaha kisI dUsare ke karma se lAbhAnvita hogA| balki pratyeka ko usake karma kA badalA diyA jAegA|

zIghra hI ajJAnI, alpabuddhi yahUdI aura unake jaise munAfiqa (pAkhaMDI) kaheMge: musalamAnoM ko baitula-maqadisa ke qibalA se, jo pahale unakA qibalA thA, kisa cIz2a ne phera diyA?! (ai nabI!) Apa unheM uttara dete hue kaha dIjie: pUrva aura pazcima tathA anya dizAoM kA mAlika akelA allAha hI hai, vaha apane baMdoM meM se jise cAhatA hai, jisa dizA kI ora bhI cAhatA hai, nirdezita kara detA hai| tathA vaha apane baMdoM meM se jise cAhatA hai, sIdhe rAste kA mArgadarzana pradAna karatA hai, jisameM koI Ter3hApana aura vicalana nahIM hai|

jisa taraha hamane tumhAre lie vaha qibalA nirdhArita kiyA hai, jise hamane tumhAre lie pasaMda kiyA hai; vaise hI hamane tumheM sabase behatara, nyAyapUrNa ummata (samudAya) banAyA, jo aqAyada, ibAdAta aura mAmalAta meM sabhI ummatoM (samudAyoM) ke bIca madhyama hai; tAki tuma qiyAmata ke dina allAha ke sabhI rasUloM ke lie gavAhI dene vAle bana jAo ki unhoMne apanI ummatoM ko vaha saMdeza pahu~cA diyA thA jise pahu~cAne kA allAha ne unhe Adeza diyA thA, tathA rasUla muha़mmada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama tumapara yaha gavAhI dene vAle ho jAe~ ki unhoMne tumheM allAha kA dharma pahu~cA diyA| tathA hamane usa qibale ko jisakI ora Apa ruqha karate the arthAt baitula-maqadisa ko isalie badala diyA, tAki hama - isa taraha pratyakSa rupa se jisapara badalA niSkarSita hotA hai - jAna leM ki kauna allAha ke nirdhArita kie hue niyama se saMtuSTa hotA hai aura usake sAmane apanA sira jhukAte hue rasUla kA anusaraNa karatA hai, tathA kauna apane dharma se phira jAtA hai aura apanI icchAoM kA pAlana karatA hai| isalie vaha allAha ke banAe hue niyama ke Age sira nahIM jhukAtA| vAstava meM, pahale qibale ko badalane kI bAta bahuta bar3I thI, sivAya una logoM ke lie jinheM allAha ne usapara tathA isa bAta para vizvAsa karane kI taufIqa dI ki allAha apane baMdoM ke lie jo niyama banAtA hai, vaha vyApaka hikamatoM kI vajaha se banAtA hai| tathA allAha aisA nahIM ki tumhArA ImAna barbAda kara de, jisameM tumhArI ve namAz2eM bhI zAmila haiM, jo tumane qibalA badalane se pahale par3hI thIM| niHsaMdeha allAha logoM para bahuta karuNA karane vAlA, atyaMta dayAvAn hai| isalie vaha unheM kaSTa meM nahIM DAlatA hai, aura unake karmoM kA pratiphala vyartha nahIM karatA hai|

hamane - ai nabI! - Apake cehare aura nigAha ko bAra-bAra AsamAna kI ora uThate hue dekhA hai, isa pratyAzA meM ki Apako apane manapasaMda qibale kI ora mukha karake namAz2a par3hane kI anumati prApta ho jAe| ataH nizcaya hama vartamAna qibalA baitula-maqadisa ke badale, Apako usa qibale kI ora phera deMge, jise Apa pasaMda karate haiM (aura vaha allAha kA pavitra ghara kAbA hai)| so (aba) Apa apanA ceharA makkA mukarramA meM sthita allAha ke pavitra ghara kI ora phera leM| tathA - ai ImAna vAlo! - tuma jahA~ bhI ho, namAz2a par3hate samaya usI kI ora mukha kara lo| nizcaya yahUdI tathA IsAI isa bAta se avagata haiM ki qibale kA badalanA unake pAlanahAra aura unake mAmaloM ke prabhaMdhaka kI ora se avatirata satya hai; kyoMki yaha unakI pustaka meM pramANita hai| tathA allAha usa bAta se anajAna nahIM hai jo ye satya se mu~ha mor3ane vAle karate haiM| balki, vaha mahimAvAn use jAnatA hai aura unheM usakA badalA degA|

allAha kI qasama! (ai nabI!) yadi Apa una yahUdiyoM aura IsAiyoM ke pAsa jinheM kitAba dI gaI thI, isa bAta para hara prakAra kI nizAnI aura pramANa le Ae~ ki qibalA kA badalanA satya hai; taba bhI ve Apake qibale kI ora rukha nahIM kareMge, usake prati haTha karake jo Apa lekara Ae haiM tathA satya kA pAlana karane se ahaMkAra karate hue| tathA Apa unake qibale kI ora mukha karane vAle nahIM haiM jabaki allAha ne Apako usase phera diyA hai| tathA ve svayaM paraspara eka-dUsare ke qibale kI ora ruqha karane vAle nahIM haiM; kyoMki unameM se pratyeka dUsare samUha ko kAfira kahatA hai| yadi Apane qibalA tathA anya niyamoM aura vidhAnoM ke bAre meM ina logoM kI icchAoM kA pAlana kiyA, isake bAda ki Apake pAsa sahI jJAna A cukA hai, jisameM koI saMdeha nahIM; to nizcaya Apa usa samaya hidAyata ko chor3ane tathA icchA kA anusaraNa karane ke kAraNa, atyAcAriyoM meM se ho jAe~ge| yahA~ nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko saMbodhita karane kA maqasada ahle kitAba kA pAlana karane kI burAI (kurUpatA) ko darzAnA hai| anyathA, allAha ne apane nabI ko usase surakSita rakhA hai| isalie yaha Apake bAda ApakI ummata ke lie eka cetAvanI hai|

yahUdiyoM aura IsAiyoM ke vidvAnoM meM se jinheM hamane kitAba dI thI; ve qibalA ke badalane kI bAta ko, jo ki unake nikaTa muha़mmada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI nubuvvata kI nizAniyoM meM se hai, bilkula vaise hI jAnate haiM, jaise apane baccoM ko jAnate haiM aura unheM dUsaroM se alaga karate haiM| phira bhI unameM se eka samUha, apanI ora se IrSyA karate hue, usa satya ko chipAtA hai, jo Apa lAe haiM| ve yaha jAnate hue bhI aisA karate haiM ki yaha saca hai|
yahI Apake pAlanahAra kI aura se satya hai| ataH (ai rasUla!) Apa kadApi isakI prAmANikatA para saMdeha karane vAloM meM se na hoM|

hara qauma kI koI na koI dizA hotI hai, jisakI ora vaha rukha karatI hai, cAhe vaha dizA iMdriyagocara ho yA agocara (abhautika) ho| yahI kAraNa hai ki alaga-alaga samudAyoM ke alaga-alaga qibale aura zaraI prAvadhAna haiM| isalie unakI dizAoM kI vividhatA se koI nuqasAna nahIM, yadi vaha allAha ke Adeza aura usakI zarIyata ke anusAra hai| ataH - ai momino! - una acche kAmoM ko karane meM eka-dUsare se Age bar3ho, jinheM karane kA tumheM Adeza diyA gayA hai| tathA tuma jahA~ bhI hoge, vahA~ se qiyAmata ke dina allAha tumheM ikaTThA karegA; tAki tumheM tumhAre kAryoM kA badalA de| niHsaMdeha allAha hara cIz2a kA sAmarthya rakhatA hai| ataH usakA tumheM ikaTThA karanA aura badalA denA use vivaza nahIM kara sakatA|

tathA (ai nabI!) Apa aura Apake anuyAyI jahA~ se bhI nikaleM aura jisa sthAna para bhI hoM aura namAz2a kA irAdA kareM, to apanA ceharA sammAnita masjida (kAbA zarIfa) kI ora kara leM| kyoMki yahI satya hai jisakI Apake raba ne ApakI ora vaha़ya kI hai| aura tuma jo kucha karate ho, allAha usase anajAna nahIM hai, balki vaha usake bAre meM khU़ba jAnatA hai aura tumheM usakA badala degA|

(ai nabI!) Apa jisa sthAna se bhI nikaleM aura namAz2a par3hanA cAheM, to apanA ceharA masjide-ha़rAma kI ora kara leM| tathA - ai momino! - tuma jisa sthAna para bhI ho, to agara tuma namAz2a par3hanA cAho, to apane cehare usI kI dizA meM kara lo; tAki logoM ke pAsa koI tarka (hujjata) na rahe jisake dvArA ve tumase vAda-vivAda kareM, sivAya una logoM ke jinhoMne unameM se atyAcAra kiyA| kyoMki ve apane haTha para bane raheMge aura tumhAre viruddha kamaz2ora se kamaz2ora tarka ke sAtha bahasa kareMge| ataH unase mata Daro aura akele apane pAlanahAra se Daro, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara| kyoMki allAha ne kAbA kI ora ceharA karane kA niyama isalie banAyA hai, tAki tumheM zeSa sArI qaumoM se utkRSTa karake tumapara apanI nemata pUrI kare aura tAki logoM ke lie sabase sammAnanIya qibalA kI ora tumhArA mArgadarzana kare|

isI taraha hamane tumheM eka aura nemata pradAna kI; ki hamane tumhArI ora tumhAre bIca se eka rasUla bhejA, jo tumheM hamArI AyateM par3hakara sunAtA hai, tumheM acchAiyoM tathA bhalI bAta kA Adeza dekara aura ghRNita cIz2oM tathA burI bAta se manAhI karake pavitra karatA hai, tathA tumheM quraAna aura sunnata sikhAtA hai aura tumheM tumhAre dharma evaM saMsAra ke mAmaloM ke bAre meM aisI bAteM sikhAtA hai, jo tuma nahIM jAnate the|

tuma mujhe apane diloM aura zArIrika aMgoM dvArA yAda karo; maiM tumhArI prazaMsA karake aura tumheM saMrakSaNa pradAna karake tumheM yAda rakhU~gA| kyoMki badalA kArya ke samAna hI milatA hai| tathA merI una nematoM kA zukriyA adA karo, jo maiMne tumheM pradAna kI haiM, aura unakA inakAra karake aura unheM harAma cIz2oM meM istemAla karake merI nAzukrI na karo|

ai ImAna vAlo! dhairya tathA namAz2a ke sAtha merI AjJAkAritA karane aura mere Adeza ke prati samarpita hone meM madada hAsila karo| nizcaya allAha dhairya rakhane vAloM ke sAtha hai, unheM sAmarthya pradAna karatA tathA unakI sahAyatA karatA hai|

(ai momino!) tuma unake bAre meM jo allAha ke mArga meM jihAda ke kAraNa mAre jAe~, yaha mata kaho: ve mara gae, jaise unake alAvA dUsare loga marate haiM| balki, ve apane raba ke pAsa jIvita haiM| lekina tuma unake jIvana kA ehasAsa nahIM karate; kyoMki vaha eka viziSTa jIvana hai, jise jAnane kA ekamAtra tarIqA allAha kI vaha़ya hai|

hama aneka prakAra kI vipattiyoM ke sAtha tumheM z2arUra Az2amAe~ge; apane duzmanoM ke kucha bhaya ke sAtha, bhojana kI kamI ke kAraNa bhUkha ke sAtha, dhana ke samApta ho jAne yA use prApta karane kI kaThinAI ke kAraNa dhana kI kamI ke sAtha, logoM ko naSTa karane vAlI ApadAoM ke kAraNa yA allAha ke mArga meM zahIda hone ke kAraNa jAnoM ke nuqasAna ke sAtha, tathA una phaloM kI kamI ke sAtha jinheM dharatI ugAtI hai| aise meM - ai nabI! - ina vipattiyoM para dhairya rakhane vAloM ko usa cIz2a kI zubha sUcanA sunA deM, jisase unheM duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM prasannatA hAsila hogI|

jaba unapara ina vipattiyoM meM se koI vipatti AtI hai, to ve allAha ke nirNaya ke prati saMtoSa aura samarpaNa ke sAtha kahate haiM: niHsaMdeha hama allAha ke haiM, vaha hamAre sAtha jaisA cAhatA hai, vyavahAra karatA hai| tathA niHsaMdeha hama qiyAmata ke dina usI kI ora lauTane vAle haiM| kyoMki usI ne hameM paidA kiyA aura hameM vibhinna prakAra kI nemateM pradAna kIM, tathA usI kI tarafa hamArA lauTanA aura hamAre mAmale kA aMta hai|
isa vizeSatA ke mAlika logoM ke lie fariztoM kI sarvocca sabhA meM allAha kI ora se prazaMsA hai, tathA unapara rahamata utaratI hai aura yahI loga satya ke mArga para nirdezita haiM|

kAbA ke pAsa safA aura maravA ke nAma se jAnI jAne vAlI do pahAr3iyA~, zarIyata ke dRzya sthaloM meM se haiM| isalie jo hajja athavA umrA ke lie kAbA pahu~ce; usapara koI pApa nahIM ki vaha ina donoM ke bIca daur3a lagAe| yahA~ pApa kA inakAra karane meM una musalamAnoM ke lie AzvAsana hai, jo ina donoM ke bIca daur3a lagAne ko jAhiliyyata (pUrva-islAmI yuga) kA kAma samajhakara gunAha samajhate the| cunA~ce allAha ne spaSTa kara diyA ki yaha hajja ke anuSThAnoM meM se hai| jo bhI vyakti svecchA se niSThApUrvaka mustahaba AjJAkAritA kA kArya kare; allAha usakI qadra karane vAlA hai, use usase svIkAra karegA aura use usapara badalA degA| vaha usake bAre meM jAnane vAlA hai, jo acchA kAma karatA hai aura savAba kA haqadAra hai|

yahUdiyoM, IsAiyoM aura anya logoM meM se jo loga nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama aura Apake lAe hue saMdeza kI saccAI ko darzAne vAle spaSTa pramANoM ko chipAte haiM, isake bAda ki hamane unheM unakI kitAboM meM logoM ke lie kholakara bayAna kara diyA hai; ve aise loga haiM jinheM allAha apanI dayA se niSkAsita kara detA hai| sAtha hI farizte, nabI gaNa aura sabhI loga yaha duA karate haiM ki allAha unheM apanI rahamata se niSkAsita kara de|

paraMtu jo loga una spaSTa nizAniyoM ko chipAne para pachatAvA karate hue allAha kI ora lauTa Ae, tathA apane bAharI aura AMtarika kAryoM ko sudhAra liyA aura unhoMne jo saccAI aura mArgadarzana chupAyA thA, unheM spaSTa kara diyA; to aise logoM kI maiM apanI AjJAkAritA kI ora vApasI ko svIkAra karatA hU~, aura maiM taubA karane vAle baMdoM kI taubA qabUla karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hU~|

niHsaMdeha jina logoM ne kufra kiyA aura usase taubA karane se pahale kufra hI kI avasthA meM mara gae, to aise logoM para allAha kA yaha abhizApa hai ki unheM apanI dayA se niSkAsita kara detA hai, tathA fariztoM aura sabhI logoM kA unapara yaha zrApa hai ki allAha unheM apanI dayA se niSkAsita aura dUra kara de|
ve isI lAnata (abhizApa) se pIr3ita raheMge, unakI yAtanA eka dina ke lie bhI kama nahIM hogI aura na unheM qiyAmata ke dina mohalata dI jAegI|

(ai logo!) tumhArA saccA mA'bUda eka hI hai, jo apane astitva aura guNoM meM advitIya hai, usake alAvA koI saccA mA'bUda nahIM| vaha atyaMta dayAvAn vizAla dayA vAlA, apane baMdoM para asIma dayAlu hai| kyoMki usane unheM anaginata nemateM pradAna kI haiM|

niHsaMdeha AsamAnoM aura z2amIna kI racanA aura unameM upasthita adbhuta prANiyoM meM, tathA rAta aura dina ke eka-dUsare ke pazcAta Ane-jAne meM, tathA una kaztiyoM meM jo logoM ko lAbha pahu~cAne vAle bhojana, vastra, vyApAra aura anya AvazyakatA kI cIz2oM ko lekara samudra ke pAnI meM daur3atI haiM, tathA usa pAnI meM jo allAha ne AsamAna se utArA, phira usake dvArA dharatI ko usameM ugane vAlI phasaloM aura paudhoM (ghAsa) ke dvArA punarjIvita kiyA| tathA dharatI ke Upara jIvita prANiyoM ko phailAne meM, tathA eka tarafa se dUsarI tarafa havAoM ke pherane meM, tathA dharatI aura AkAza ke bIca vazIbhUta kie hue bAdaloM meM; nizcaya ina saba meM una logoM ke lie allAha ke ekatva (ekezvaravAda) ke spaSTa saMketa (pramANa) haiM, jo tarkoM aura pramANoM ko samajhate haiM|

allAha ne tumapara kevala ye khAne kI cIz2eM harAma kI haiM: vaha jAnavara jo zaraI tarIqe se z2abaha kie binA mara jAe, bahatA khUna, sUara kA mA~sa aura vaha jAnavara jise z2abaha karate samaya allAha ke sivA kisI aura kA nAma liyA gayA ho| lekina yadi AdamI inameM se koI vastu khAne para majabUra ho jAe, jabaki vaha unameM se binA AvazyakatA ke khAkara atyAcAra karane vAlA aura z2arUrata kI sImA se Age bar3hane vAlA nahIM hai; to usapara koI doSa tathA daMDa nahIM hai| niHsaMdeha allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko kSamA karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai| usakI dayA meM se yaha bhI hai ki usane majabUrI kI hAlata meM ina harAma vastuoM ko khAne kI anumati pradAna kI hai|

niHsaMdeha jo loga allAha kI utArI huI kitAboM aura unameM maujUda satya aura muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI nubuvvata ke saMketa (pramANa) ko chipAte haiM, jaisA ki yahUdI aura IsAI karate haiM, tathA ve ise chipAkara thor3A muAvaz2A jaise saradArI, yA pada (pratiSThA), yA dhana prApta karate haiM; ve vAstava meM apane peToM meM isake sivA kucha nahIM khAte jo unake Aga se yAtanA die jAne kA kAraNa hogA| tathA allAha qiyAmata ke dina unase aisI bAta nahIM karegA, jo unheM pasaMda ho, balki aisI bAta karegA jo unheM burI lage| tathA na unheM pavitra karegA aura na unakI prazaMsA karegA aura unake lie dardanAka yAtanA hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! una logoM ke mAmale meM jo jAnabUjhakara aura AkrAmakatA meM dUsaroM hatyA kara dete haiM, hatyAre ko usake aparAdha ke samAna daMDa denA tumapara anivArya kara diyA gayA hai| ataH Az2Ada AdamI ko Az2Ada ke badale qatla kiyA jAegA, g2ulAma ko g2ulAma ke badale qatla kiyA jAegA tathA nArI ko nArI ke badale qatla kiyA jAegA| yadi vadhita vyakti apanI mRtyu se pahale kSamA kara de, yA usakA abhibhAvaka diyata - vaha dhanarAzi jo hatyArA apanI kSamA ke badale meM bhugatAna karatA hai - lekara kSamA kara de, to kSamA karane vAle ko cAhie ki qAtila se diyata (rakta dhana) kI mA~ga acche tarIqe se kare, upakAra jatalAne tathA kaSTa dene se bace| qAtila ko bhI cAhie ki binA TAla-maTola ke bhale tarIqe se diyata (qhUna-bahA) adA kara de| yaha kSamA karanA aura qhUna-bahA lenA, tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se tumapara eka AsAnI aura isa ummata para eka dayA hai| phira jo vyakti kSamA karane aura qhUna-bahA lene ke bAda qAtila para atyAcAra kare; to usake lie allAha kI ora se eka dardanAka saz2A hai|

allAha ne tumhAre lie qisAsa kA jo niyama nirdhArita kiyA hai, usameM tumhAre lie jIvana hai; kyoMki isase tumhAre qhUna kI rakSA hotI hai aura tumhAre bIca z2yAdatI (atyAcAra) ko rokA jAtA hai| ise ve buddhi vAle loga mahasUsa karate haiM, jo allAha kI zarIyata kA pAlana karake aura usake Adeza ke anusAra kArya karake usase Darate haiM|

jaba tumameM se kisI kI mRtyu ke lakSaNa tathA kAraNa sAmane A jAe~, aura yadi usane bahuta sArA dhana chor3A hai, to usapara mAtA-pitA aura riztedAroM ke lie zarIyata kI nirdhArita kI huI mAtrA ke anusAra vasIyata karanA z2arUrI hai, jo ki eka tihAI dhana se adhika nahIM honA cAhie| aisA karanA una logoM para eka pakkA adhikAra hai jo sarvazaktimAna allAha se Darane vAle haiM| jJAta rahe ki yaha hukma mIrAsa kI AyateM utarane se pahale thA| jaba mIrAsa kI AyateM utarIM, to unake dvArA spaSTa kara diyA gayA ki mRtaka kA vArisa kauna hogA aura use virAsata meM kitanA milegA|

ramaz2Ana kA mahInA vaha hai, jisakI sammAnita rAta (lailatula qadra) meM nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama para pavitra quraAna utaranA zurU huA| allAha ne ise logoM ke lie mArgadarzana ke rUpa meM utArA hai| isameM mArgadarzana tathA satya aura asatya ke bIca aMtara karane ke spaSTa pramANa haiM| ataH jo vyakti ramaz2Ana ke mahIne meM upasthita ho, isa hAla meM ki vaha svastha evaM nivAsI ho (yAtrA para na ho), to vaha anivArya rUpa se usakA roz2A rakhe| tathA jo vyakti aisI bImArI se pIr3ita ho ki usake lie roz2A rakhanA kaThina ho, yA vaha musAfira ho; to usake lie roz2A na rakhanA anumeya hai| yadi vaha roz2A na rakhe, to usake lie anivArya hai ki (bAda meM) una dinoM kI qaz2A kare jinake roz2e usane nahIM rakhe the| allAha ke ina vidhAnoM kA maqasada tumhAre lie AsAnI paidA karanA hai, na ki kaThinAI| aura tAki tuma pUre mahIne ke roz2e kI ginatI pUrI karo aura tAki ramaz2Ana kA mahInA samApta hone ke bAda tathA Ida ke dina isa bAta para allAha kI mahimA kA varNana karo ki usane tumheM isakA roz2A rakhane kA sAmarthya diyA aura use pUrA karane para tumhArI madada kI, aura tAki tuma allAha kA isa dharma ke lie tumhArA mArgadarzana karane para zukriyA adA karo, jise usane tumhAre lie pasaMda kiyA hai|
