varSa 7 hijarI kA huramata vAlA mahInA, jisameM allAha ne tumheM harama meM praveza karane aura umrA adA karane meM sakSama kiyA, usa huramata vAle mahIne ke badale hai, jisameM muzrikoM ne tumheM varSa 6 hijarI meM ha़rama meM praveza kane se roka diyA thA| sabhI huramata vAlI cIz2oM - jaise huramata vAle nagara kI huramata, huramata vAle mahIne kI huramata aura eha़rAma kI huramata - meM z2yAdatI karane vAloM para qisAsa kA niyama lAgU hogA| ataH jisane bhI inameM tumapara z2yAdatI kI hai, usake sAtha vaisA hI vyavahAra karo jaisA usane kiyA hai, aura samAnatA kI sImA se Age na bar3ho| nizcaya allAha apanI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karane vAloM se prema nahIM karatA| tathA allAha ne tumheM jo kucha karane kI anumati dI hai, usase Age na bar3ho, aura jAna lo ki allAha sAmarthya evaM samarthana ke dvArA una logoM ke sAtha hai, jo usase Darane vAle haiM|

allAha kI AjJAkAritA ke kAryoM, jaise jihAda Adi meM dhana kharca karo, tathA apane Apako vinAza meM na DAlo, isa prakAra ki usake rAste meM jihAda aura kharca karanA chor3a do, yA apane Apako aisI cIz2a meM DAla do jo tumhAre vinAza kA kAraNa ho| tathA apanI ibAdatoM, mAmaloM aura AcaraNa meM acchA bano| niHsaMdeha allAha apane sabhI mAmaloM meM acchA karane vAloM se pyAra karatA hai| isalie vaha unake savAba ko bar3hA detA hai aura unheM sIdhe rAste para calane kA sAmarthya pradAna karatA hai|

allAha taAlA kI prasannatA kI talAza meM, ha़jja aura umrA saMpUrNa rUpa se adA karo| yadi bImArI yA duzmana yA isI prakAra ke anya kAraNoM se unheM pUrA karane se tumheM roka diyA jAe; to tumheM apane eha़rAma se halAla hone ke lie - U~Ta yA gAya athavA bakarI meM se - jo bhI qurbAnI kA jAnavara upalabdha ho, use z2abaha़ karanA hogA| tathA usa samaya taka apane sira na mu~DAo yA bAla na kaTAo, jaba taka qurbAnI usa sthAna para na pahu~ca jAe, jahA~ use z2abaha karanA halAla hai| yadi use ha़rama pahu~cane se roka diyA jAe, to vahIM z2abaha़ kara diyA jAe, jahA~ use roka diyA gayA hai| yadi ha़rama se nahIM rokA gayA hai, to harama meM qurbAnI ke dina aura usake bAda 'tazarIqa ke dinoM' meM z2abaha kiyA jAnA cAhie| phira tumameM se jo vyakti bImAra ho, athavA usake sira ke bAloM meM koI takalIfa ho, jaise jU~ Adi, aura isake kAraNa vaha apanA sira mu~DA le, to usapara koI gunAha nahIM hai| lekina usake badale use fidayA adA karanA par3egA| fidayA ke taura para yA to tIna roz2e rakhe, yA ha़rama ke nirdhanoM meM se tIna nirdhanoM ko khAnA khilAe, yA eka bakarI z2abaha karake harama ke g2arIboM meM bA~Ta de| phira yadi tumheM koI bhaya na ho, to tumameM se jo vyakti ha़jja ke mahInoM meM umrA adA karane ke bAda eha़rAma kholanA cAhe aura usI sAla ha़jja kA eharAma bA~dhane taka una vastuoM se lAbhAnvita honA cAhe, jo eha़rAma kI avasthA meM harAma haiM; to jo kucha usake pAsa upalabdha ho use z2abaha kare: eka bakarI z2abaha kare athavA eka U~Ta yA gAya meM sAta AdamI zarIka ho jAe~| yadi vaha qurbAnI na kara sake, to usake badale ha़jja ke dinoM meM tIna roz2e rakhe aura sAta roz2e apane ghara vApasa Ane ke bAda rakhe, tAki kula dasa dina pUre ho jAe~| qurbAnI athavA usakI zakti na hone kI sthiti meM roz2e kI anivAryatA ke sAtha umrA kA yaha lAbha uThAnA usa vyakti ke lie hai, jo ha़rama kA nivAsI aura harama ke Asa-pAsa rahane vAlA na ho| tathA allAha kI zarIyata kA anusaraNa karake aura usakI sImAoM kA sammAna karake usase Daro aura jAna lo ki allAha apane AdezoM kA ullaMghana karane vAloM ko kaThora daMDa dene vAlA hai|

ha़jja kA samaya kucha jJAta mahIne haiM, jo zavvAla ke mahIne se zurU hote haiM aura z2ula-ha़ijjA ke dasa dinoM ke sAtha samApta ho jAte haiM| jo vyakti ina mahInoM meM apane Apako ha़jja ke lie bAdhya kara le aura usakA eharAma bA~dha le; usake lie saMbhoga aura saMbhoga pUrva krIr3Ae~ ha़rAma haiM| tathA samaya aura jagaha kI mahAnatA ke kAraNa, usake lie pApa karake allAha ke AjJApAlana se nikalane kA niSedha (doSa) bar3ha jAtA hai| isI taraha usake lie aisI bahasa (vAda-vivAda) meM par3anA bhI harAma hai, jo krodha aura jhagar3e kI ora le jAtI hai| tathA tuma jo bhI acchA kArya karoge, allAha use jAna legA aura tumheM usakA badalA pradAna karegA| tathA khAne-pIne kI z2arUrata kI cIjeM lekara ha़jja kI adAyagI meM madada hAsila karo aura jAna lo ki tumhAre sabhI mAmaloM meM tumhArI madada ke lie sabase acchI cIz2a allAha kA taqvA (Dara) hai| ataH ai svastha buddhi vAlo! merI AjJAoM kA pAlana karake aura mere niSedhoM se bacakara mujhase Daro|

ha़jja ke daurAna vyApAra aura anya cIz2oM ke mAdhyama se ha़lAla jIvikA kI talAza karane meM tumapara koI pApa nahIM hai| jaba tuma z2ula-ha़ijjA kI nau tArIqha ko arafA meM Thaharane ke bAda, dasavIM tArIqha kI rAta ko vahA~ se muz2adalifA kI ora prasthAna karo; to muz2adalifA meM mazare ha़rAma ke pAsa tasabIha़ (subha़AnallAha), tahalIla (lA ilAhA illallAha) aura duA karake allAha ko yAda karo| tathA allAha ko isalie yAda karo ki usane apane dharma ke sthaloM aura apane ghara ke ha़jja ke anuSThAnoM ke lie tumhArA mArgadarzana kiyA, kyoMki isase pahale tuma una logoM meM se the jo usakI zarIyata se anajAna the|

phira tuma arafAta se vApasa Ao, jaise ki ibarAhIma alaihissalAma kA anusaraNa karane vAle loga karate the, una jAhiliyyata ke logoM kI taraha nahIM, jo yahA~ Thaharate hI nahIM the| tathA tuma allAha ke Adeza kA pAlana karane meM apanI kotAhI para usase kSamA mA~go| niHsaMdeha allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko kSamA karane vAlA aura unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

jaba tuma ha़jja ke kArya pUre kara lo aura unase phArig2a ho jAo, to allAha ko yAda karo aura usakI atyadhika prazaMsA karo, jaise tuma apane bApa-dAdA para garva aura unakI prazaMsA kiyA karate the, athavA allAha ko apane bApa-dAdA ko yAda karane se kahIM bar3hakara yAda karo| kyoMki hara vaha nemata jisakA tuma AnaMda le rahe ho, vaha allAha hI kI dI huI hai| isa viSaya meM loga alaga-alaga prakAra ke haiM| unameM se eka bahudevavAdI kAfira hai, jo kevala isa sAMsArika jIvana para vizvAsa karatA hai| isalie vaha apane pAlanahAra se kevala saMsAra kI nematoM aura usakI zobhA, jaise svAsthya, dhana aura saMtAna ko mA~gatA hai| aise logoM ke lie, unake duniyA kI icchA rakhane aura Aqhirata se upekSA karane ke kAraNa, usameM koI hissA nahIM hai, jo allAha ne apane momina baMdoM ke lie Aqhirata meM taiyAra kara rakhA hai|

jabaki logoM kA eka samUha allAha para ImAna rakhane vAlA hai aura Aqhirata para ImAna rakhatA hai| isalie vaha apane pAlanahAra se duniyA kI nemata aura usameM acche kArya kA savAla karatA hai, sAtha hI vaha usase jannata kI prApti aura Aga kI yAtanA se surakSita rahane kA prazna karatA hai|

duniyA evaM Aqhirata kI bhalAiyA~ mA~gane vAle hI ve loga haiM, jinake lie unake duniyA meM kie hue neka kAryoM ke badale meM bahuta bar3A savAba hai aura allAha kAryoM kA bahuta jalda hisAba lene vAlA hai|

kucha thor3e dinoM arthAt z2ula-ha़ijjA ke gyArahaveM, bArahaveM aura terahaveM dina meM takabIra (allAhu akabara) aura tahalIla (lA ilAhA illallAha) ke sAtha allAha ko yAda karo| phira jo jaldI kare aura bArahavIM tArIqha ko kaMkarI mArane ke bAda minA se nikala jAe, to usake lie aisA karanA anumeya hai aura usapara koI pApa nahIM; kyoMki allAha ne use yaha AsAnI pradAna kI hai| tathA jo terahavIM tArIqha taka derI kare yahA~ taka ki kaMkarI mAra le, to vaha aisA bhI kara sakatA hai aura usapara koI Apatti kI bAta nahIM hai, balki usane sabase pUrNa rUpa apanAyA, aura usane nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke kRtya kA pAlana kiyA| yaha saba kucha usake lie hai, jo apane hajja meM allAha se Dare aura use allAha ke Adeza ke anusAra adA kare| tathA allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usakI manA kI huI bAtoM se bacakara usase Daro aura sunizcita raho ki tuma kevala usI kI ora lauTAe jAoge, phira vaha tumheM tumhAre kAryoM kA badalA degA|

jaba usa upadrava karane vAle se - sadupadeza ke taura para - kahA jAtA hai: allAha kI sImAoM kA sammAna karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara usase Dara, to usakA garva aura ahaMkAra use saccAI kI ora lauTane se roka detA hai aura vaha pApa meM lIna rahatA hai| ataH usakA badalA jo usake lie paryApta hai, jahannama meM praveza hai aura nizcaya vaha usake vAsiyoM ke lie bahuta burA ThikAnA aura sthAna hai|

tathA logoM meM eka ImAna vAlA bhI hai, jo apanA prANa beca detA hai| isalie vaha apane pAlanahAra kI AjJAkAritA meM, usake mArga meM jihAda karate hue aura usakI khuzI kI talAza meM use nyochAvara kara detA hai| tathA allAha apane baMdoM para vizAla dayA vAlA aura unapara anaMta karuNAmaya hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! samagra islAma meM praveza kara jAo aura usakI kisI bhI vastu ko na chor3o, jaisA ki ahle-kitAba kA ravaiyA rahA hai ki kitAba ke kucha bhAga para ImAna rakhate haiM aura kucha bhAga kA inakAra karate haiM| aura zaitAna ke mArgoM para na calo; kyoMki vaha tumhArA spaSTa zatru hai, apanI zatrutA ko prakaTa karane vAlA hai|

yadi tuma apane pAsa saMdeha rahita spaSTa pramANa A jAne ke pazcAta bhI kisI truTi aura jhukAva meM par3a jAo; to jAna lo ki allAha apanI zakti evaM vazIkaraNa meM parAkramI hai, apane prabaMdhana evaM vidhAna meM pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai| isalie usase Daro aura usakA sammAna karo|

zaitAna ke rAstoM para calane vAle, satya ke mArga se vicalita ye loga kevala isa bAta kI pratIkSA kara rahe haiM ki unake bIca nirNaya karane ke lie qiyAmata ke dina allAha apanI mahimA evaM pratApa ke yogya, bAdaloM ke sAyoM meM unake pAsa A jAe, tathA farizte bhI unheM cAroM ora se ghere hue unake pAsa A jAe~, aura usa samaya unake bAre meM allAha ke hukma ko pUrA kara diyA jAegA aura kAma tamAma ho jAegA| tathA logoM ke sAre mAmale aura viSaya akele allAha hI kI ora lauTAe jAte haiM|

(ai nabI!) banI isarAIla se unakI bhartsanA karate hue pUchie: allAha ne tumhAre sAmane nabiyoM kI saccAI ko ujAgara karane vAlI kitanI spaSTa nizAniyA~ rakhIM?! to tumane unheM jhuThalA diyA aura unase mu~ha phera liyA| tathA jo allAha kI nemata ko use pahacAna lene aura usake spaSTa ho jAne ke pazcAta jhuThalA de aura inakAra kara de; to (jJAta honA cAhie ki) niHsaMdeha allAha jhuThalAne vAle kAfiroM ko kaThina yAtanA dene vAlA hai|

allAha kA inakAra karane vAloM ke lie sAMsArika jIvana aura usameM maujUda kSaNika sukhoM aura samApta ho jAne vAlI khuziyoM ko suMdara banA diyA gayA hai| tathA ve allAha aura aMtima dina para ImAna rakhane vAloM kA maz2Aqa ur3Ate haiM| jabaki jo loga allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM ko tyAga karake allAha se Darate haiM, ve Aqhirata meM ina kAfiroM se Upara hoMge| kyoMki allAha unheM hamezA rahane vAlI jannatoM meM ThaharAegA aura allAha apanI maqhlUqa meM se jise cAhatA hai, binA ginatI aura gaNanA ke pradAna karatA hai|

(zurU meM) loga eka hI samudAya the, apane pitA Adama ke dharma para (rahate hue) mArgadarzana para sahamata the, yahA~ taka ki zaitAna ne unheM gumarAha kara diyA, to ve matabheda ke zikAra hokara momina aura kAphira meM ba~Ta gae| isa kAraNa se, allAha ne rasUloM ko bhejA, jo ImAna vAloM aura AjJAkAriyoM ko usa cIz2a kI zubha sUcanA dene vAle the jo allAha ne apanI dayA meM se unake lie taiyAra kara rakhI hai, tathA kufra kA mArga apanAne vAloM ko allAha kI kaThina yAtanA se DarAne vAle the jisakI usane unheM dhamakI dI hai| tathA allAha ne apane rasUloM ke sAtha saMdeha rahita satya para AdhArita kitAbeM utArIM; tAki ve logoM ke bIca unake vivAdita mAmaloM kA nirNaya kareM| aura usa pustaka meM jise allAha ne avatarita kiyA - aura vaha taurAta hai - unhIM logoM ne matabheda kiyA jo yahUdiyoM meM se usakA jJAna die gae the, isake bAda ki unake pAsa allAha ke pramANa A cuke the ki vaha allAha kI ora se saccI (pustaka) hai, jisameM unake lie matabheda karanA saMbhava nahIM thA, unhoMne aisA atyAcAra karate hue kiyA| isalie allAha ne apanI anumati aura icchA se mominoM ko gumarAhI se mArgadarzana ko pahacAnane kA sAmarthya pradAna kiyA| tathA allAha jise cAhatA hai sIdhA mArga dikhAtA hai, jisameM koI Ter3hApana nahIM hai aura vaha ImAna kA mArga hai|

yA (ai momino!) tumane samajha rakhA hai ki tuma jannata meM praveza kara jAoge, jabaki tuma abhI taka apane se pahale guz2are hue logoM ke parIkSA kI taraha kisI parIkSA se pIr3ita nahIM hue| ve saqhta g2arIbI aura gaMbhIra bImArI se prabhAvita hue aura Dara ne unheM hilAkara rakha diyA, yahA~ taka ki unapara vipatti isa hada taka pahu~ca gaI ki ve allAha kI madada ke jaldI Ane kI kAmanA karane lage| cunA~ce rasUla aura unake sAtha ImAna lAne vAle kahane lage: allAha kI madada kaba AegI? suna lo, allAha kI madada usapara ImAna rakhane vAloM aura usapara bharosA karane vAloM se qarIba hI hai|

(ai nabI!) Apake sAthI Apase pUchate haiM: ve apane vibhinna prakAra ke dhanoM meM se kyA qharca kareM aura kahA~ qharca kareM? to Apa unheM javAba dete hue kaha dIjie: tuma qhaira - arthAt halAla evaM pavitra dhana - meM se jo bhI qharca karo, to use mAtA-pitA para, AvazyakatA ke anusAra apane nikaTatama riztedAroM para, z2arUratamaMda yatImoM para, una besahArA logoM para jinake pAsa koI dhana nahIM, tathA usa yAtrI para qharca karanA cAhie jo yAtrA ke kAraNa apane parivAra aura svadeza se kaTa gayA hai| (ai momino!) tuma jo bhI bhalAI karoge, cAhe vaha kama ho yA adhika, niHsaMdeha allAha use jAnane vAlA hai, usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai, aura vaha tumheM usakA badalA degA|

(ai momino!) tumapara allAha ke rAste meM lar3AI karanA anivArya kara diyA gayA hai, hAlA~ki svAbhAvika rUpa se dila use nApasaMda karatA hai; kyoMki isameM jAna evaM mAla donoM qharca karanA par3atA hai| aura zAyada tuma kisI cIz2a ko nApasaMda karo aura vaha vAstava meM tumhAre haqa meM behatara aura lAbhadAyaka ho; jaise ki allAha ke mArga meM lar3AI karanA| kyoMki isake pratiphala kI mahAnatA ke sAtha, isameM zatruoM para vijaya aura allAha ke dharma kI sarvopari hai| tathA zAyada tuma kisI cIz2a ko pasaMda karo aura vaha cIz2a tumhAre lie burI aura vipatti (saMkaTa) kA karaNa ho; jaise ki jihAda se pIche rahanA| kyoMki isameM niHsahAyatA aura duzmanoM kA prabhutva hai| aura allAha acchI aura burI bAtoM ko bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai, aura tuma use nahIM jAnate, so tuma usakI AjJA kA pAlana karo; kyoMki isI meM tumhAre lie bhalAI hai|

(ai nabI!) Apake sAthI Apase zarAba (arthAt hara vaha cIz2a jo aqla ko DhA~pa le aura usase buddhi calI jAe) ke bAre meM pUchate haiM; ve Apase usake pIne, becane aura kharIdane ke hukma ke bAre meM pUchate haiM| tathA ve Apase jue ke hukma ke bAre meM pUchate haiM (juA se abhiprAya vaha dhana hai jo una pratiyogitAoM ke mAdhyama se prApta kiyA jAtA hai jinameM pratiyogitA meM zAmila donoM pakSoM kI ora se muAvaz2A rakhA jAtA hai) to Apa unheM javAba dete hue kaha dIjie: ina donoM meM bahuta-se sAMsArika evaM dhArmika nuqasAna aura burAiyA~ haiM; jaise- buddhi aura dhana kI hAni, duzmanI aura dveSa meM par3anA| jabaki una donoM meM thor3e lAbha bhI haiM, jaise- kucha dhana kI prApti| paraMtu inakA nuqasAna aura inake dvArA hone vAlA pApa inake lAbha se adhika hai| aura jisa cIz2a kA nuqasAna usake lAbha se adhika ho; buddhimAna vyakti usase bacatA hai| allAha kI ora se yaha varNana zarAba ke niSedha kI prastAvanA hai| tathA (ai nabI!) Apake saha़AbA Apase pUchate haiM ki ve apane dhana kI kitanI mAtrA svecchA se aura dAna ke rUpa meM kharca kareM? Apa unheM javAba dete hue kaha dIjie: apane dhana meM se use qharca karo, jo tumhArI z2arUrata se adhika ho| (yaha zurU islAma meM thA, phira usake bAda allAha ne viziSTa dhanoM aura nirdhArita nisAboM meM anivArya z2akAta kA qAnUna banA diyA|) isI taraha ke spaSTa bayAna ke sAtha, allAha tumhAre lie zarIyata ke AdezoM ko bayAna karatA hai, tAki tuma soca-vicAra karo|

yaha (ukta vidhAna) isalie nirdhArita kiyA gayA hai tAki tuma soca-vicAra karo ki duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM kauna-sI cIz2a tumhAre lie lAbhadAyaka hai| tathA (ai nabI!) Apake sAthI Apase anAthoM ke abhibhAvaka banane ke bAre meM pUchate haiM ki: ve unake sAtha kaisA vyavahAra kareM? kyA ve anAthoM ke dhana ko qharca, khAne-pIne aura rahane-sahane meM apane dhana ke sAtha milA leM? Apa unheM javAba dete hue kaha dIjie: yadi tuma binA muAvaz2e ke yA unake dhana ko apane dhana meM milAe binA unake dhana ke sudhAra ke lie kAma karo, to tumhAre lie allAha ke nikaTa sabase acchA aura adhika ajra va savAba vAlA hai, tathA yaha unake lie unake dhana meM uttama hai; kyoMki isameM unake dhana kA saMrakSaNa hai| aura yadi tuma unake dhana ko apane dhana ke sAtha milAkara khAne-pIne aura AvAsa Adi meM unake sAtha sAjhA kara lo; to isameM koI Apatti kI bAta nahIM hai| kyoMki ve tumhAre dhArmika bhAI haiM aura bhAI eka-dUsare kI madada karate haiM aura eka-dUsare ke mAmaloM kI dekha-bhAla karate haiM| aura allAha khUba jAnatA hai ki kauna abhibhAvaka anAthoM ke dhana ko apane sAtha milAkara usameM sudhAra cAhatA hai aura kauna bigAr3a cAhatA hai| yadi allAha yatImoM ke bAre meM tumheM parezAnI meM DAlanA cAhatA, to vaha tumheM avazya parezAnI meM DAla detA| lekina allAha ne tumhAre lie unake sAtha vyavahAra kA rAstA AsAna kara diyA; kyoMki usakI zarIyata AsAnI para AdhArita hai| niHsaMdeha allAha saba para prabhutvazAlI hai, use koI cIz2a parAsta nahIM kara sakatI| vaha apanI racanA, prabaMdhana aura vidhAna meM hikamata vAlA hai|

(ai momino!) allAha ke sAtha zirka karane vAlI striyoM se zAdI na karo, yahA~ taka ki ve eka allAha para ImAna le Ae~ aura islAma meM praveza kara jAe~| nizcaya allAha aura usake rasUla para ImAna rakhane vAlI dAsI, eka mUrti kI pUjA karane vAlI Az2Ada strI se uttama hai, bhale hI vaha apanI suMdaratA aura dhana ke kAraNa Apako pasaMda ho| isI taraha musalamAna striyoM kA nikAha muzrika mardoM se na karo, nizcaya allAha aura usake rasUla para vizvAsa rakhane vAlA eka momina g2ulAma, eka Az2Ada muzrika se uttama hai, bhale hI vaha tumheM acchA lage| ye zirka meM lipta loga - puruSa aura mahilAe~ - apane zabdoM aura kAryoM ke sAtha usakI ora bulAte haiM, jo jahannama meM praveza karane kI ora le jAtA hai| jabaki allAha acche kAryoM kI ora bulAtA hai, jo usakI anumati aura anugraha se jannata meM praveza karane aura pApoM kI kSamA kA kAraNa banate haiM| tathA vaha apanI AyatoM ko logoM ke lie spaSTa karatA hai, tAki ve usapara vicAra kara sakeM jo unase iMgita hotA hai, phira usake anusAra kArya kareM|

(ai nabI!) Apake sAthI Apase mAsika dharma (yaha eka prAkRtika rakta hai jo viziSTa samaya para mahilA ke garbhAzaya se nikalatA hai) ke bAre meM pUchate haiM| Apa unheM javAba dete hue kaha dIjie: mAsika dharma puruSa aura mahilA donoM ke lie kaSTadAyaka (hAnikAraka) hai, isalie usake samaya para mahilAoM ke sAtha saMbhoga karane se baco, tathA saMbhoga ke uddezya se unake pAsa na jAo, yahA~ taka ki unakA rakta baMda ho jAe aura ve snAna karake usase acchI taraha pAka-sAfa ho jAe~| jaba rakta baMda ho jAe aura ve usase pavitra ho jAe~, to unase usa tarIqe se saMbhoga karo, jo allAha ne tumhAre lie anumeya kiyA hai: isa hAla meM ki ve pAka hoM aura unakI yoni meM saMbhoga kiyA jAe| allAha una logoM se prema karatA hai, jo gunAhoM se bahuta z2yAdA taubA karane vAle aura gaMdagiyoM se pavitratA hAsila karane meM atizayokti se kAma lene vAle haiM|

tumhArI patniyA~ tumhAre lie ropaNa sthAna haiM, ve tumhAre lie bacce janatI haiM; vaise hI jaise bhUmi phala detI hai| isalie ropane ke sthAna para - jo ki yoni hai - jisa dizA se bhI cAho aura jisa taraha bhI cAho Ao, bazarte ki vaha yoni meM ho| tathA apane lie acche kArya Age bhejo, jisameM yaha bhI zAmila hai ki AdamI apanI patnI ke sAtha allAha kI nikaTatA prApta karane aura neka saMtAna kI ummIda meM saMbhoga kare| tathA allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara, usase Daro| jisameM vaha bhI zAmila hai jo usane mahilAoM ke bAre meM tumhAre lie nirdhArita kiyA hai| aura jAna lo ki tuma qiyAmata ke dina usase milane vAle ho, usake sAmane khar3e hone vAle ho aura vaha tumheM tumhAre kAryoM kA badalA dene vAlA hai| aura - ai nabI! - mominoM ko zubha samAcAra sunA dIjie ki unheM apane pAlanahAra se mulAqAta ke samaya hamezA bAqI rahane vAlI nemateM mileMgI aura allAha ke sammAnita cehare ko dekhane kA saubhAgya prApta hogA|

allAha kI qasama ko nekI karane, parahez2agArI tathA logoM ke bIca mela-milApa karAne ke viruddha tarka mata banAo| balki agara tuma bhalAI na karane kI qasama khA lo; to bhalAI kA kArya karo aura apanI qasamoM kA kaffArA adA kara do| tathA allAha tumhArI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, tumhAre kAryoM ko jAnane vAlA hai, aura vaha tumheM unakA badalA degA|

allAha tumheM una qasamoM ke kAraNa nahIM pakar3atA, jo binA irAde ke tumhArI z2abAnoM para A jAtI haiM, jaise tumameM se kisI vyakti kA: 'lA vallAha' (nahIM, allAha kI qasama!) aura 'balA vallAha' (hA~, allAha kI qasama!) kahanA| ina qasamoM meM tumapara na koI kaffArA (prAyazcita) hai aura na koI daMDa| paraMtu una qasamoM meM se jisakA tumane irAdA kiyA hai, usapara vaha tumhArI pakar3a karegA| tathA allAha apane baMdoM ke gunAhoM ko bahuta kSamA karane vAlA, atyaMta sahanazIla hai, unheM saz2A dene meM jaldI nahIM karatA|

jo loga apanI patniyoM se saMbhoga na karane kI qasama khA lete haiM, unheM qasama khAne ke samaya se lekara adhikatama cAra mahIne taka pratIkSA karanA hai| jise 'IlA' ke nAma se jAnA jAtA hai| yadi ve saMbhoga na karane kI qasama khAne ke bAda cAra mahIne yA usase kama kI avadhi ke bhItara apanI patniyoM ke sAtha saMbhoga karane kI ora vApasa lauTa Ae~; to allAha bahuta kSamA karane vAlA hai, jo kucha unase huA hai (allAha) use unake lie kSamA kara degA, tathA unapara bahuta dayA karane vAlA hai kyoMki usane unake lie isa qasama se bAhara nikalane ke lie kaffArA nirdhArita kiyA hai|

tathA yadi ve apanI striyoM ke sAtha saMbhoga ko chor3anA jArI rakhate hue aura usakI ora vApasa na lauTakara talAqa kA irAdA kara leM, to allAha unakI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA hai, jinameM se talAqa bhI zAmila hai, unakI sthitiyoM aura unake irAdoM ko jAnatA hai aura unheM unakA badalA degA|

talAqazudA aurateM tIna mAsika dharma taka pratIkSA kareMgI, jisake daurAna ve zAdI nahIM kareMgI| tathA unake lie yaha jAyaz2a nahIM hai ki ve usa garbha ko chipAe~, jo allAha ne unake garbhAzayoM meM paidA kiyA hai, yadi ve allAha tathA aMtima dina para apane ImAna meM saccI haiM| tathA unheM talAqa dene vAle unake patiyoM ko pratIkSA avadhi ke daurAna unheM lauTAne kA adhika adhikAra hai, yadi unake lauTAne kA uddezya pyAra-mohabbata (se rahanA) aura talAqa ke kAraNa paidA hone vAle manamuTAva ko dUra karanA ho| tathA patniyoM ke lie bhI paraMparA ke anusAra usI prakAra adhikAra aura kartavya haiM, jisa taraha unake patiyoM ke lie unake Upara haiM| jabaki puruSoM ko striyoM para eka darjA (varIyatA) prApta hai, jaise saMrakSakatA aura talAqa kA adhikAra| aura allAha saba para prabhutvazAlI hai, use koI cIz2a parAsta nahIM kara sakatI| vaha apanI zarIyata (vidhAna) aura prabaMdhana meM hikamata vAlA hai|

aisA talAqa jisameM pati apanI patnI ko lauTAne kA adhikAra rakhatA hai, do bAra hai| isa prakAra ki vaha talAqa de, phira lauTA le, phira (dUsarI bAra) talAqa de, phira lauTA le| phira do talAqoM ke bAda yA to use acche sahavAsa ke sAtha apane patnItva meM rakhe, yA usake sAtha bhalAI karate hue aura usake adhikAroM ko pUrA karate hue use tIsarA talAqa de de| tathA - ai patiyo! - tumhAre lie apanI patniyoM ko dI huI mahara meM se kucha bhI lenA halAla nahIM hai| hA~, yadi patnI apane pati ko usake caritra athavA raMga-rUpa ke kAraNa nApasaMda karatI ho aura daMpati isa napharata ke kAraNa socate haiM ki ve apane adhikAroM ko pUrA nahIM kara sakeMge, to ve apanA mAmalA usa vyakti ke sAmane peza kareM jisake sAtha unakI riztedArI yA saMbaMdha ho| aba agara abhibhAvakoM ko Dara hai ki ve donoM Apasa meM apane vaivAhika adhikAroM ko pUrA nahIM kara sakeMge, to donoM para koI pApa nahIM hai ki patnI apane pati ko use alaga karane ke badale meM kucha dhana bhugatAna karake qhulA' le le| ye zaraI ahakAma, halAla evaM harAma (anumeya aura niSiddha) ke bIca vibhAjaka haiM, isalie unase Age na bar3ho, aura jo koI bhI halAla evaM harAma ke bIca allAha kI sImAoM ko pAra karatA hai; to vahI loga apane Apako vinAza ke sAdhanoM para lAkara aura unheM allAha ke krodha aura daMDa kA bhAgI banAkara svayaM para atyAcAra karane vAle haiM|

yadi usakA pati use tIsarA talAqa de de, to pati ke lie usase punarvivAha karane kI anumati nahIM hai, yahA~ taka ki vaha strI kisI anya puruSa se vivAha kare, jo (jIvana basara karane kI) icchA se, eka vaidha vivAha ho, (prathama pati ke lie) halAla karane ke uddezya se na ho, aura vaha isa vivAha meM usake sAtha saMbhoga kare| phira yadi dUsarA pati use talAqa de de yA mara jAe; to usa strI aura usake prathama pati para koI pApa nahIM hai ki ve eka nae anubaMdha aura nayI mahara ke sAtha Apasa meM rujU' (dobArA milApa) kara leM, agara unheM prabala gumAna hai ki ve apane prati anivArya zaraI niyamoM kA pAlana kareMge| ina zaraI niyamoM ko allAha una logoM ke lie kholakara bayAna karatA hai, jo usake niyamoM aura sImAoM ko jAnate haiM; kyoMki vahI loga inase lAbha uThAte haiM|

jaba tuma apanI patniyoM ko talAqa de do aura ve apanI pratIkSA avadhi ke aMta hone ke qarIba ho jAe~; to tumhAre lie anumeya hai ki unheM lauTA lo, athavA unheM binA lauTAe ucita tarIqe se chor3a do yahA~ taka ki unakI iddata qhatma ho jAe| tathA unapara atyAcAra karane aura unheM nuqasAna pahu~cAne ke uddezya se na lauTAo, jaisA ki jAhiliyyata (pUrva-islAmika yuga) meM kiyA jAtA thA| jo koI bhI aisA unheM nuqasAna pahu~cAne ke irAde se kare; to nizcaya usane apane Apako pApa aura daMDa kA bhAgI banAkara khuda para atyAcAra kiyA| tathA allAha kI AyatoM ko unake sAtha khilavAr3a karake aura unake viruddha sAhasa dikhAkara upahAsa kA viSaya na banAo| aura apane Upara allAha kI nematoM ko yAda karo, jinameM se sabase bar3I nemata usakA tumapara quraAna evaM sunnata kA utAranA hai| vaha tumheM isake dvArA pralobhana aura dhamakI ke rUpa meM upadeza detA hai| tathA allAha se, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara, Daro aura jAna lo ki allAha hara cIz2a ko jAnane vAlA hai| ataH usase koI cIz2a chipI nahIM hai aura vaha tumheM tumhAre karmoM kA badalA degA|

jaba tuma apanI patniyoM ko tIna se kama talAqa do aura unakI pratIkSA avadhi (iddata) samApta ho jAe, to - ai abhibhAvako! - unheM usa samaya nae nikAha ke sAtha apane patiyoM ke pAsa lauTane se na roko, yadi ve aisA karanA cAheM aura apane patiyoM ke sAtha usapara sahamata ho jAe~| unheM manA karane ke niSedha para AdhArita isa hukma kA upadeza use diyA jA rahA hai, jo tuma meM se allAha tathA aMtima dina (pralaya) para ImAna rakhatA hai| isase tumhAre bIca bhalAI ko adhika bar3hAvA milegA tathA tumhArI ismateM aura tumhAre karma gaMdagiyoM se adhika pavitra raheMge| allAha sAre mAmaloM ke tathyoM aura unake pariNAmoM se avagata hai, aura tuma inase anabhijJa ho|

mAtAe~ apane baccoM ko pUre do sAla taka dUdha pilAe~| do sAla kI yaha samaya sImA usake lie hai, jo dUdha pilAne kI avadhi pUrI karanA cAhatA ho| bacce ke pitA para talAqazudA dUdha pilAne vAlI mAtAoM ke qharca aura unake kapar3oM kI z2immedArI hai, usake anusAra jo logoM meM pracalita hai, jo zarIyata ke viruddha na ho| allAha kisI vyakti para usakI kSamatA evaM zakti se adhika bojha nahIM DAlatA| mAtA-pitA meM se kisI ke lie jAyaz2a nahIM hai ki bacce ko dUsare ko nuqasAna pahu~cAne kA mAdhyama banA le| yadi bApa na ho aura bacce ke pAsa dhana na ho, to bacce ke vArisa (uttarAdhikArI) para bhI usI prakAra ke adhikAra haiM jo pitA para hote haiM| yadi mAtA-pitA do sAla pUre hone se pahale hI bacce kA dUdha chur3AnA cAheM aura donoM bacce ke hita ko dhyAna meM rakhate hue ApasI parAmarza aura sahamati ke bAda yaha qadama uThAe~, to unapara koI gunAha nahIM hai| phira yadi tuma apane baccoM ke lie unakI mAtAoM ke alAvA anya dUdha pilAne vAliyA~ rakhanA cAho, to tumapara koI gunAha nahIM, yadi dUdha pilAne vAlI ke sAtha jisa pArizramika para sahamata hue ho, use binA kamI-bezI athavA TAla-maTola ke adA kara do| allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se dUra rahakara usase Daro, aura jAna lo ki jo kucha tuma karate ho, allAha use dekhatA hai, cunA~ce usameM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai, aura vaha tumhAre kie hue kAmoM ke lie tumheM pratiphala degA|

jo loga mara jAte haiM aura apane pIche agarbhavatI patniyA~ chor3a jAte haiM; ve patniyA~ anivArya rUpa se cAra mahIne aura dasa dina kI avadhi ke lie apane Apako pratIkSA meM rakheMgI, jisake daurAna ve pati ke ghara se nikalane, zrRMgAra karane aura vivAha se baceMgI| jaba yaha avadhi samApta ho jAe; to - ai abhibhAvako! - tumapara koI pApa nahIM ki ve zaraI aura prathAgata tarIqe ke anusAra, vaha kArya kareM jo usa avadhi ke daurAna unake lie varjita thA| tathA allAha usase, jo kucha tuma karate ho, bhalI-bhA~ti avagata hai| usase tumhAre prokSa aura pratyakSa meM se koI cIz2a chipI nahIM hai aura vaha tumheM usakA badalA degA|

zAdI karane kI icchA ghoSita kie binA, pati kI mRtyu athavA 'talAqe bAina' kI iddata guz2Arane vAlI strI ko zAdI ke saMdeza kA saMketa dene meM tumapara koI pApa nahIM hai; jaise ki vaha kahe: jaba tumhArI pratIkSA avadhi samApta ho jAe, to mujhe batAo| tathA isameM bhI tumapara koI gunAha nahIM hai ki tumane iddata guz2Arane vAlI strI se usakI pratIkSA avadhi samApta hone ke bAda nikAha karane kI icchA ko apane dila meM chipAe rakhA hai| allAha jAnatA hai ki tuma unake lie apanI tIvra icchA ke kAraNa unheM avazya yAda karoge, isalie usane tumheM binA ghoSaNA kie saMketa dene kI anumati pradAna kI| tathA jaba ve pratIkSA avadhi meM hoM, to eka-dUsare se gupta rUpa se zAdI kA vAdA karane se sAvadhAna raho| sivAya prathAgata bAta ke aura vaha sAMketika rUpa se bAta kahanA hai| tathA pratIkSA avadhi ke daurAna vivAha kA anubaMdha pakkA na karo| aura yaha jAna lo ki allAha jAnatA hai ki usane tumhAre lie jo kucha halAla kiyA hai aura jo kucha tumapara harAma ThaharAyA hai, usameM se kauna-sI bAta tuma apane diloM meM chipAe hue ho| isalie usase sAvadhAna raho aura usakI AjJA kA ullaMghana na karo| tathA jAna lo ki allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko kSamA karane vAlA, atyaMta sahanazIla hai, saz2A dene meM jaldI nahIM karatA|

jina patniyoM se tumane nikAha kiyA hai, yadi tuma unheM unake sAtha saMbhoga karane se pahale tathA unake lie eka viziSTa mahara nirdhArita karane se pahale talAqa de do, to tumapara koI pApa nahIM hai| yadi tuma unheM isa sthiti meM talAqa dete ho, to tumapara unake lie koI mahara vAjiba nahIM hogI| lekina AdamI dhanI ho yA nirdhana usa para yaha z2arUrI hogA ki apanI kSamatA ke anusAra unheM kucha de de, jisase ve lAbha uThA sakeM aura unake TUTe hue dila kI sAMtvanA ho jAe| yaha denA una logoM para eka nizcita adhikAra hai, jo apane kAryoM aura lenadena meM sadAcArI haiM|

yadi tuma apanI una patniyoM ko jinase tumane nikAha kiyA hai, unake sAtha saMbhoga karane se pahale talAqa de do, jabaki tuma unake lie eka viziSTa mahara nirdhArita kara cuke ho, to tumheM unheM nirdhArita mahara kA AdhA bhugatAna karanA hogA, paraMtu yaha ki ve - yadi ve samajhadAra hoM - use tumhAre lie mAfa kara deM, athavA patigaNa svayaM unheM pUrA mahara de deM| tumhArA apane bIca adhikAroM ke prati sahiSNu honA allAha ke bhaya aura usakI AjJAkAritA ke adhika nikaTa hai| tathA - ai logo! - tuma eka-dUsare para upakAra karanA aura adhikAroM ke bAre meM kSamA se kAma lenA na chor3o| kyoMki allAha jo tuma karate ho, use dekha rahA hai| isalie qhUba bhalAI karo, tAki usapara allAha kA badalA pAo|

namAz2oM ko allAha ke Adeza ke anusAra pUrNa rUpa se adA karake, unakA saMrakSaNa (pAbaMdI) karo aura samasta namAz2oM ke bIca madhya namAz2a arthAt asra kI namAz2a kA saMrakSaNa (pAbaMdI) karo aura apanI namAz2a meM allAha ke AjJAkArI banakara vinayapUrvaka khar3e raho|

yadi tumheM kisI zatru Adi kA bhaya ho aura namAz2a ko saMpUrNa rUpa se adA karane meM sakSama na ho, to apane pairoM para calate hue, yA U~Ta aura ghor3e Adi para savAra hokara, athavA jisa taraha bhI tuma sakSama ho, namAz2a par3ho| phira jaba tumhArA Dara dUra ho jAe, to sabhI prakAra ke z2ikra ke sAtha allAha ko yAda karo, jisameM namAz2a ko pUrNa rUpa se adA karanA bhI zAmila hai, jaise usane tumheM usa prakAza aura mArgadarzana kI zikSA dI, jise tuma nahIM jAnate the|

tumameM se jo mara jAte haiM aura apane pIche patniyA~ chor3a jAte haiM, ve Avazyaka rUpa se apanI patniyoM ke lie vasIyata kara jAe~ ki unake lie pUre eka varSa ke AvAsa aura kharca (rakharakhAva) kA prabaMdha kiyA jAe, aura tumhAre vArisa unheM ghara se na nikAleM| aisA Adeza unheM pahu~cane vAlI musIbata kI kSatipUrti ke lie aura mRtaka ke prati vafAdArI nibhAne ke lie diyA gayA hai| yadi ve eka sAla pUrA hone se pahale apanI marz2I se nikala jAe~, to na to tumapara pApa hai aura na hI una para, jo ve apane Apa meM banAva-zRMgAra aura sugaMdha kA istemAla kareM| allAha saba para prabhutvazAlI hai, usapara kisI kA z2ora nahIM calatA| vaha apane prabaMdhana, vidhAna aura niyati meM hikamata vAlA hai| jamahUra (bahusaMkhyaka) mufassirIna kA mAnanA hai ki isa Ayata kA hukma allAha taAlA ke isa kathana dvArA nirasta kara diyA gayA hai: {وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنْفُسِهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا } (البقرة: ٢٣٤) ''aura jo loga tumameM se mara jAe~ aura patniyA~ chor3a jAe~, ve (patniyA~) apane Apako cAra mahIne aura dasa dina pratIkSA meM rakheM|'' (sUratul-baqarA: 234)

talAqazudA mahilAoM ko, pati kI Arthika sthiti ko dhyAna meM rakhate hue rIti ke anusAra, kapar3A yA paisA yA anya cIz2oM ke rUpa meM, kucha na kucha sAmagrI denA cAhie; tAki talAqa ke kAraNa unake TUTe hue diloM kI sAMtvanA ho sake| yaha hukma una logoM para eka nizcita (anivArya) adhikAra hai, jo allAha se, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara, Darane vAle haiM|

ukta spaSTIkaraNa kI taraha, allAha tumhAre lie - ai momino! - apanI sImAoM aura AdezoM para AdhArita AyatoM ko spaSTa karatA hai; tAki tuma unheM samajho aura unapara amala karo, jisake pariNAmasvarUpa tumheM duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM bhalAI prApta ho|

(ai nabI!) kyA Apake saMjJAna meM una logoM kI qhabara nahIM AI, jo mahAmArI yA kisI aura kAraNa mauta ke Dara se, apane gharoM ko chor3akara nikala par3e, jabaki ve bahuta bar3I saMkhyA meM the| ve banI isarAIla kA eka samUha the| allAha ne unase kahA: mara jAo; so ve mara gae| phira allAha ne unheM jIvita kara diyA| tAki unake lie yaha tathya spaSTa kara de ki sArA mAmalA usI mahimAvAn ke hAtha meM hai aura yaha ki ve apane lie kisI lAbha yA hAni ke mAlika nahIM haiM| niHsaMdeha allAha logoM ke prati udAra aura anugrahakArI hai, paraMtu adhikAMza loga allAha kA usakI nematoM para zukriyA adA nahIM karate|

(ai momino!) allAha ke dharma ke samarthana aura usake vacana ko sarvocca karane ke lie, usake zatruoM se yuddha karo aura jAna lo ki allAha tumhArI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, tumhAre irAdoM aura kAryoM ko jAnane vAlA hai, aura vaha tumheM unakA badalA degA|

vaha kauna vyakti hai jo qarz2a dene vAle kA kArya kare, cunA~ce vaha acche irAde aura acche mana ke sAtha allAha ke mArga meM apanA dhana qharca kare, tAki vaha usake pAsa bahuta adhika gunA hokara vApasa Ae? allAha apanI hikamata aura nyAya ke sAtha jIvikA, svAsthya aura anya meM (kabhI) taMgI karatA hai, tathA (kabhI) una saba meM vistAra karatA hai| tathA Aqhirata meM tuma usI kI ora lauTAe jAoge, phira vaha tumheM tumhAre kAryoM kA badalA pradAna karegA|

(ai nabI!) kyA Apake saMjJAna meM mUsA alaihissalAma ke samaya ke bAda banI isarAIla ke pramukhoM kI qhabara nahIM AI, jaba unhoMne apane eka nabI se kahA: hamAre lie eka bAdazAha sthApita kara dIjie, jisake sAtha milakara hama allAha ke rAste meM yuddha kareM| to unake nabI ne unase kahA: ho sakatA hai ki yadi tumapara yuddha karanA anivArya kara diyA jAe, to tuma allAha ke mArga meM yuddha na karo! unhoMne apane bAre meM nabI ke gumAna kA khaMDana karate hue kahA: kauna sI bAdhA hameM allAha ke mArga meM lar3ane se rokatI hai jabaki aise kAraNa maujUda haiM jo hamase aisA karane kI apekSA karate haiM? kyoMki hamAre zatruoM ne hameM hamAre ghara se nikAla diyA, aura hamAre baccoM ko baMdI banA liyA| isalie hama apanI mAtRbhUmi ko bahAla karane aura apane qaidiyoM ko mukta karAne ke lie lar3eMge| paraMtu jaba allAha ne unapara yuddha farz2a kara diyA, to ve pIche haTa gae, kyoMki unameM se kucha ko chor3akara, unhoMne jo vAdA kiyA thA use pUrA nahIM kiyA| tathA allAha una atyAcAriyoM ko khUba jAnane vAlA hai, jo usakI AjJA se mukara jAne vAle, usake vacana ko tor3a dene vAle haiM, aura vaha unheM usakA badalA degA|

unake nabI ne unase kahA: allAha ne tAlUta ko tumapara bAdazAha nirdhArita kiyA hai, tAki tuma usake jhaMDe tale lar3o| unake pramukhoM ne isa cayana kA khaMDana karate aura isapara Apatti jatAte hue kahA: vaha hamapara rAjya kaise kara sakatA hai, jabaki hama rAjya ke usase adhika yogya haiM; kyoMki vaha rAjAoM ke putroM meM se nahIM hai aura na hI use koI bar3I saMpatti dI gaI hai, jisase vaha rAja-kAja para sahAyatA le sake?! unake nabI ne unase kahA: allAha ne use tumhAre Upara cuna liyA hai aura tumase adhika jJAna meM vistAra tathA zArIrika bala pradAna kiyA hai| aura allAha apanI hikamata aura dayA se jise cAhatA hai use apanA rAjya pradAna karatA hai| allAha bahuta vistRta anugraha vAlA hai, vaha jise cAhatA hai detA hai, vaha jAnatA hai ki usakI sRSTi meM kauna usakA haqadAra hai|

unake nabI ne unase kahA: usake tumhAre Upara rAjA cune jAne kI saccAI kI nizAnI yaha hai ki allAha tumheM vaha tAbUta - yaha eka saMdUqa thA jisakA banI isarAIla sammAna karate the, jo unase chIna liyA gayA thA - lauTA degA, jisameM eka saMtoSa hai jo usake sAtha hai, tathA mUsA aura hArUna ke gharAnoM dvArA chor3e gae avazeSa haiM, jaise lAThI aura kucha taqhtiyA~| niHsaMdeha isameM tumhAre lie eka spaSTa nizAnI hai, yadi tuma saca meM ImAna vAle ho|

jaba tAlUta senAoM ke sAtha nagara se nikale, to unase kahA: niHsaMdeha allAha tumheM eka nahara dvArA Az2amAne vAlA hai| so jisane usameM se pI liyA, vaha mere mArga para nahIM hai aura yuddha meM mere sAtha nahIM calegA| aura jisane usameM se nahIM piyA, vaha mere mArga para hai aura yuddha meM mere sAtha calegA| paraMtu jo koI majabUra ho jAe aura eka cullU bhara pAnI pI le, to usa para kucha bhI nahIM hai| lekina sabhI sainikoM ne usase pAnI pI liyA sivAya unameM se thor3e logoM ke, jinhoMne saqhta pyAsa ke bAvajUda na pIne para dhairya se kAma liyA| phira jaba tAlUta aura usake sAtha ImAna vAloM ne nahara pAra kiyA, to usake kucha sainikoM ne kahA: Aja hamAre pAsa jAlUta aura usake sainikoM se lar3ane kI koI kSamatA nahIM hai| usa samaya una logoM ne, jo qiyAmata ke dina allAha se milane para vizvAsa rakhate the, kahA: kitane ImAna vAle dala, jinakI saMkhyA kama thI, allAha kI anumati aura sahAyatA se, adhika saMkhyA vAle kAfira daloM para vijaya prApta kara cuke haiM| isalie vijaya meM ImAna kA etibAra hai, adhikatA kA nahIM| aura allAha apane dhairya rakhane vAle baMdoM ke sAtha hai, unakA samarthana karatA aura unakI madada karatA hai|

jaba ve jAlUta aura usakI senA kA sAmanA karane ke lie nikale, to unhoMne allAha kI ora mutavajjeha hokara duA karate hue kahA: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hamAre diloM para sabra u~Dela de, aura hamAre pA~voM ko jamA de tAki hama bhAgeM nahIM aura na apane duzmana ke sAmane parAjita hoM, tathA apanI zakti aura samarthana ke sAtha kAfira qauma para hamArI madada kara|

unhoMne allAha ke hukma se unheM parAjita kara diyA aura dAUda ne unake saradAra jAlUta ko qatla kara diyA| phira allAha ne dAUda ko bAdazAhata aura nubuvvata pradAna kI aura unheM jisa prakAra ke bhI jJAna cAhatA thA, sikhAyA| isa taraha duniyA aura Aqhirata ke lie jo bhI cIz2a upayukta thI, unake lie ekatrita kara diyA| yadi allAha kA yaha niyama na hotA ki vaha kucha logoM dvArA kucha logoM ke upadrava ko haTAtA hai; to nizcaya dharatI usameM upadrava (bhraSTAcAra) karane vAloM ke prabhutva se bhraSTa ho jAtI| lekina, allAha sabhI prANiyoM para anugraha vAlA hai|

ye allAha kI khulI huI spaSTa AyateM haiM, jo hama - ai nabI! - Apako sunAte haiM, jinameM saccI sUcanAe~ aura nyAyasaMgata vidhAna maujUda haiM| aura niHsaMdeha Apa sarva saMsAra ke pAlanahAra kI ora se bheje gae rasUloM meM se haiM|

ye rasUla jinakA hamane Apase varNana kiyA hai, unameM se kucha ko hamane vaha़ya, anuyAyiyoM aura darjoM ke mAmale meM dUsaroM para zreSThatA pradAna kI hai| unameM se kucha ve haiM jinase allAha ne bAta kI, jaise- mUsA alaihissalAma, aura unameM se kucha ko U~ce pada pradAna kie, jaise muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama; kyoMki Apako sabhI mAnava jAti ke lie bhejA gayA tathA Apapara nubuvvata (IzdUtatva) kI muhara lagA dI gaI (aura IzdUtatva kA krama samApta ho gayA) aura ApakI ummata ko dUsarI ummatoM para zreSThatA dI gaI| aura hamane marayama ke putra IsA ko, unakI nubuvvata (IzdUtatva) ko pramANita karane vAle spaSTa camatkAra die; jaise mare hue vyakti ko punarjIvita karanA aura janmajAta aMdhe aura koढ़I ko ThIka karanA| tathA allAha ke Adeza ko pUrA karane ke lie zakti pradAna karane hetu, hamane jibarIla alaihissalAma ke dvArA unakA samarthana kiyA| agara allAha cAhatA, to rasUloM ke bAda Ane vAle loga, unake pAsa spaSTa nizAniyA~ A jAne ke pazcAta Apasa meM na lar3ate| paraMtu una logoM ne vivAda kiyA aura ve vibhAjita ho gae; unameM se kucha allAha para ImAna lAe aura kucha ne usakA inakAra kiyA| agara allAha cAhatA ki ve Apasa meM na lar3eM, to ve Apasa meM na lar3ate, lekina allAha jo cAhatA hai, karatA hai| ataH vaha jise cAhatA hai apanI dayA aura anugraha se ImAna kI hidAyata detA hai aura jise cAhatA hai apane nyAya aura hikamata se gumarAha kara detA hai|

ai allAha para ImAna lAne aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! hamane tumheM vibhinna halAla (vaidha) dhana meM se jo kucha pradAna kiyA hai, usameM se kharca karo, isase pahale ki qiyAmata kA dina A jAe| usa samaya, vahA~ na koI kraya-vikraya hogA ki jisase manuSya vaha cIz2a prApta kara sake jo use lAbha de, na koI dostI hogI jo use saMkaTa ke samaya meM lAbha de, aura na hI koI madhyasthatA (sifAriza) hogI jo hAni ko dUra kare yA lAbha pahu~cAe| sivAya isake ki jaba allAha jise cAhe aura jisase vaha prasanna ho, anumati pradAna kara de| aura kAfira loga hI vAstava meM atyAcArI haiM kyoMki ve sarvazaktimAna allAha kA inakAra karate haiM|

allAha vaha hai jisa akele ke sivA koI bhI vAstavika rUpa se ibAdata ke lAyaqa nahIM hai| vaha jIvita hai, eka pUrNa jIvana vAlA hai jisameM koI mRtyu yA kamI nahIM hai| hara cIz2a ko sa~bhAlane vAlA hai, jo svayaM qAyama hai, ataH vaha apanI sArI sRSTi se beniyAz2a hai| tathA usI se sArI sRSTi qAyama hai, isalie ve apanI sabhI sthitiyoM meM usase beniyAz2a nahIM ho sakate| usake jIvana kI pUrNatA aura usake saMpUrNa rUpa se hara cIz2a ko saMbhAlane ke kAraNa, use na kucha U~gha AtI hai aura na koI nIMda| jo kucha AkAzoM meM aura jo kucha dharatI meM hai, sabakA akelA vahI mAlika hai| usakI anumati aura sahamati ke binA kisI ko bhI usake pAsa kisI ke lie sifAriza karane kA adhikAra nahIM hai| vaha jAnatA hai apanI sRSTi ke pichale mAmaloM ko jo ghaTita ho cuke aura jinakA ve bhaviSya meM sAmanA karane vAle haiM, jo abhI ghaTita nahIM hue| aura ve usa sarvazaktimAna ke jJAna meM se kisI bhI cIz2a ko apane jJAna se nahIM ghera sakate, sivAya usake jisase vaha unheM svayaM avagata karAnA cAhe| usakI kursI ne (jo usake pA~va rakhane kA sthAna hai) AkAzoM aura dharatI ko, unakI vizAlatA aura mahAnatA ke bAvajUda ghera rakhA hai| una donoM kA saMrakSaNa karanA usake lie kucha kaThina yA bhArI nahIM hai| vaha apane astitva, apanI niyati aura apane prabhutva meM sabase U~cA, apane rAjya aura adhikAra meM sabase mahAna hai|

islAma dharma meM praveza karane ke lie kisI ko bhI majabUra nahIM kiyA jAegA; kyoMki yaha spaSTa satya dharma hai| ataH kisI ko ise grahaNa karane ke lie majabUra karane kI koI AvazyakatA nahIM hai| hidAyata, gumarAhI se bilkula spaSTa ho cukI hai| isalie jo vyakti allAha ke alAvA pUjA kI jAne vAlI hara cIz2a kA inakAra kare aura usase alagAva prakaTa kare aura kevala allAha para ImAna rakhe; to usane qiyAmata ke dina mokSa ke lie dharma kI sabase maz2abUta rassI pakar3a lI hai, jo kabhI nahIM TUTegI| aura allAha apane baMdoM kI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, unake karmoM ko jAnane vAlA hai aura vaha unheM unakA badalA degA|

allAha una logoM kI dekhabhAla (saMrakSaNa) karatA hai jo usa para ImAna lAe haiM, vaha unheM sAmarthya pradAna karatA aura unakI sahAyatA karatA hai, tathA unheM kufra aura ajJAnatA ke aMdhakAra se nikAlakara ImAna aura jJAna ke prakAza meM lAtA hai| aura jina logoM ne kufra kiyA, unake saMrakSaka ve mUrtiyA~ aura sAjhedAra haiM, jinhoMne unake lie kufra ko suzobhita kiyA hai| aura unheM ImAna aura jJAna ke prakAza se nikAlakara kufra aura ajJAnatA ke a~dhiyAroM meM DAla diyA hai| ve loga Aga (doz2aqha) vAle haiM, ve hamezA usI meM raheMge|

jaba allAha ne do samUhoM kA ullekha kiyA, to donoM samUhoM ke do udAharaNa die, cunA~ce pharamAyA:
(ai nabI!) kyA Apane usa sarakaza kI jurata (duHsAhasa) se adhika Azcaryajanaka cIz2a dekhI, jisane ibarAhIma alaihissalAma se allAha kI rubUbiyata (Izvaratva) aura tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) ke saMbaMdha meM bahasa kI? usane aisA isalie kiyA kyoMki allAha ne use rAjya pradAna kiyA, jisase vaha sarakaza ho gayA| isapara ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ne usase apane pAlanahAra kI vizeSatAoM kA varNana karate hue kahA: merA raba vaha hai, jo prANiyoM ko jIvana aura mRtyu detA hai| usa sarakaza ne durAgraha se kahA: maiM bhI jIvana aura mRtyu detA hU~, isa prakAra ki maiM jise cAhatA hU~, qatla kara detA hU~ aura jise cAhatA hU~, chor3a detA hU~| taba ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ne eka dUsarA usase bar3A tarka prastuta kiyA, Apane usase kahA: merA pAlanahAra, jisakI maiM ibAdata karatA hU~, pUrva dizA se sUrya lAtA hai, ataH tU use pazcima kI dizA se le A| isapara vaha sarakaza cakita raha gayA aura usase koI javAba nahIM bana par3A, tathA tarka kI zakti se parAjita ho gayA| aura allAha atyAcAriyoM ko, unake atyAcAra aura sarakazI ke kAraNa, apane patha para calane kI tauphIqa nahIM detA|

yA kyA Apane usa vyakti kI taraha koI AdamI dekhA hai, jisakA guz2ara eka aisI bastI se huA, jisakI chateM gira gaI thIM, usakI dIvAreM Dhaha gaI thIM aura usake nivAsI naSTa ho gae the, isalie vaha eka sunasAna ujAr3a bana gaI thI? usa AdamI ne Azcarya se kahA: allAha isa bastI ke logoM ko marane ke bAda kaise punarjIvita karegA?! to allAha ne use eka sau sAla ke lie mauta de dI, phira use jIvita kiyA aura usase pUchA: tU kitane samaya taka marA huA rahA? usane uttara diyA: maiM eka dina yA usakA kucha bhAga rahA hU~| allAha ne usase kahA: balki, tU pUre sau sAla rahA hai| isalie tere sAtha jo khAnA aura pAnI thA use dekha| vaha apanI hAlata para bAqI hai, usameM koI badalAva nahI AyA| hAlA~ki sabase tez2a badalAva khAnA aura pAnI meM hotA hai| tathA tU apane mare hue gadhe ko dekha| hamane aisA isalie kiyA, tAki hama tujhe logoM ke lie isa bAta kI spaSTa nizAnI banA deM ki allAha unheM dobArA z2iMdA karane kI pUrI zakti rakhatA hai| tathA tU apane gadhe kI haDDiyoM ko dekha jo bikharI huI aura alaga ho gaI haiM, hama unheM kaise uThAte haiM aura unheM eka sAtha jor3ate haiM, phira usake bAda unapara mA~sa car3hAte haiM aura unheM phira se jIvita kara dete haiM| jaba usane yaha dekhA, to usake lie mAmale kI vAstavikatA spaSTa ho gaI aura usane allAha kI zakti ko jAna liyA| isalie usane ise svIkArate hue kahA: maiM jAnatA hU~ ki allAha hara cIz2a para sarvazaktimAna hai|

(ai nabI!) usa samaya ko yAda kIjie jaba ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ne kahA: ai mere raba! mujhe merI dRSTi se dikhA ki murdoM ko punarjIvita karanA kaise hogA? allAha ne unase kahA: kyA tumane isa bAta para vizvAsa nahIM kiyA? ibarAhIma ne uttara diyA: kyoM nahIM, maiMne vizvAsa kiyA, paraMtu yaha mere dila ke AzvAsana meM vRddhi ke uddezya se hai| allAha ne unheM Adeza kiyA aura pharamAyA: cAra pakSiyoM ko le lo, phira unheM apane se acchI taraha paracA lo aura unake Tukar3e-dukar3e kara do, phira apane Asa-pAsa ke pahAr3oM meM se hara pahAr3a para unakA eka hissA rakha do, phira unheM bulAo| ve tumhAre pAsa dor3ate hue Ae~ge, unameM jIvana lauTa AyA hogA| aura ai ibarAhIma! jAna lo ki allAha apane rAjya meM bahuta prabhutvazAlI aura apane Adeza, vidhAna aura racanA meM pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai|

allAha ke mArga meM apanA dhana kharca karane vAle mominoM ke savAba kA udahAraNa eka dAne kI taraha hai, jise kisAna eka acchI bhUmi meM DAlatA hai, phira usase sAta bAliyA~ nikalatI haiM, jinameM se pratyeka bAlI meM eka sau dAne hote haiM| allAha apane baMdoM meM se jisakA cAhatA hai, savAba baढ़A detA hai, cunA~ce vaha unheM unakA pratiphala binA hisAba detA hai| aura allAha anugraha aura dene meM bahuta vistAra vAlA hai, vaha qhUba jAnatA hai ki kauna kaI gunA bar3hAkara die jAne kA haqadAra hai|

jo loga apanA dhana allAha kI AjJAkAritA aura usakI prasannatA kI cIz2oM meM kharca karate haiM, phira apane kharca karane ke bAda koI aisA kAma nahIM karate, jo usake pratiphala ko naSTa karane vAlA ho, jaise ki apane zabda yA karma se logoM para upakAra jatAnA, unake lie unakA pratiphala unake pAlanahAra ke pAsa hai| ve jisa cIz2a kA sAmanA karane vAle hai usameM unake lie koI bhaya nahIM hai, aura na hI ve, unheM prApta nematoM kI mahAnatA ke kAraNa, bIta cukI cIz2oM para zoka kareMge|

eka acchI bAta jisase Apa kisI ImAna vAle ke dila meM khuzI le Ae~, aura jisa vyakti ne Apake sAtha durvyavahAra kiyA hai, kSamA kara deM; yaha usa dAna se behatara hai, jisake bAda usa AdamI para upakAra jatAkara kaSTa diyA jAe, jisapara dAna kiyA gayA hai| aura allAha apane baMdoM se bahuta beniyAz2a, atyaMta sahanazIla hai unheM daMDa dene meM jaldI nahIM karatA hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! jise dAna diyA gayA hai, usapara ehasAna jatAkara aura use kaSTa pahu~cAkara apane dAna kA pratiphala kharAba na karo| kyoMki aisA karane vAle kA udAharaNa usa vyakti ke samAna hai jo apanA dhana isa irAde se kharca karatA hai ki loga use dekheM aura usakI prazaMsA kareM| aura vaha eka kAfira vyakti hai, jo na allAha para aura na qiyAmata ke dina aura usameM maujUda savAba evaM saz2A para ImAna rakhatA hai| to isakA udAharaNa eka cikane patthara jaisA hai, jisapara miTTI par3I ho, phira usapara tez2a bAriza ho jAe aura vaha patthara se miTTI ko haTA de aura use cikanA chor3a de, usapara koI cIz2a na ho| isI taraha dikhAvA karane vAloM kA mAmalA hai, unake kAryoM aura kharca kA savAba samApta ho jAtA hai aura usameM se kucha bhI allAha ke pAsa bAqI nahIM rahatA| aura allAha kAfiroM ko usakI hidAyata nahIM detA, jisase vaha sarvazaktimAna prasanna hotA hai aura jo unheM unake kAryoM aura unake kharca meM lAbha pahu~cAe|

una ImAna vAloM kA udAharaNa, jo apanA dhana allAha kI prasannatA kI talAza meM kharca karate haiM, isa hAla meM ki unake dila binA kisI majabUrI ke allAha ke vAde kI saccAI se Azvasta hote haiM, usa bAg2a ke udAharaNa jaisA hai, jo kisI acche U~ce sthAna para ho| jisapara eka bhArI bAriza barase, to vaha (bAg2a) duganA phala utpanna kare| phira yadi usapara bhArI varSA na ho, to usa para eka halkI varSA ho, jo usa bhUmi ke acchI hone ke kAraNa usake lie kAphI ho| isI taraha, niSThAvAna logoM ke kharca ko allAha svIkAra karatA aura unake pratiphala ko kaI gunA kara detA hai, bhale hI vaha kama ho| aura allAha jo kucha tuma karate ho, use dekha rahA hai| usase dikhAvA karane vAloM aura niSThA ke sAtha kharca karane vAloM kA hAla chipA huA nahIM hai aura vaha pratyeka ko vaha badalA degA, jisakA vaha yogya hai|

phira allAha ne eka udAharaNa diyA hai jisake dvArA usane dikhAve ke lie kharca karane vAle kI dazA ko citrita kiyA hai| usane pharamAyA:
kyA tumameM se kisI ko pasaMda hai ki usake pAsa khajUroM aura a~gUroM kA eka bAg2a ho, jisake bIca se mIThA pAnI bahatA ho| usa bAg2a meM usake lie pratyeka prakAra ke acche phala hoM| usa bAg2a ke mAlika ko bur3hApA A pahu~ce aura vaha itanA bUr3hA ho gayA ho ki kAma karane aura kamAne meM asamartha ho, tathA usake kamaz2ora choTe-choTe bacce hoM, jo kAma na kara sakate hoM| phira usa bAg2a para eka A~dhI cale, jisameM eka tez2a Aga ho aura sArA bAg2a jalakara khAka ho jAe| hAlA~ki apane buढ़Ape aura apane baccoM kI kamaz2orI ke kAraNa use isakI saqhta z2arUrata thI?! ataH logoM ko dikhAne ke lie apanA dhana kharca karane vAle kI sthiti isI AdamI kI taraha hai; vaha qiyAmata ke dina allAha ke pAsa binA nekiyoM ke AegA, eka aise samaya meM jaba use unakI sabase adhika AvazyakatA hogI| isI prakAra allAha tumhAre lie ve cIz2eM khola-kholakara bayAna karatI hai, jo duniyA aura Aqhirata meM tumheM lAbha pahu~cAne vAlI haiM, tAki tuma unapara ciMtana karo|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! jo acchA halAla (vaidha) dhana tumane kamAyA hai, usameM se kharca karo, aura jo kucha hamane tumhAre lie pRthvI ke paudhoM meM se nikAlA hai, usameM se kharca karo, aura usameM se raddI (doSapUrNa) cIz2a kA irAdA na karo ki tuma use kharca karo, hAlA~ki yadi vaha tumako dI jAe, to tuma use nahIM logo, sivAya isake ki tuma usakI burAI (qharAbI) kI unadekhI kara jAo| to tuma allAha ke lie vaha cIz2a kaise pasaMda karate ho, jo tuma apane lie pasaMda nahIM karate?! aura jAna lo ki allAha tumhAre kharca se beniyAz2a hai, apane astitva aura apane kAryoM meM prazaMsanIya hai|

jaba allAha ne unheM acchI cIz2eM kharca karane kA Adeza diyA, to unheM zaitAna kI cAla aura usake bure vicAroM se sAvadhAna kiyA, cunA~ce pharamAyA:
zaitAna tumheM g2arIbI se DarAtA aura kaMjUsI para ubhAratA hai, tathA tumheM pApa aura avajJA karane ke lie bulAtA hai| jabaki allAha tumhAre pApoM ke lie bar3I kSamA tathA vyApaka jIvikA kA vAdA karatA hai| aura allAha vizAla anugraha vAlA, apane baMdoM kI sthitiyoM ke bAre meM qhUba jAnane vAlA hai|

allAha apane baMdoM meM se jise cAhatA hai, use kathana meM satyatA evaM kArya meM zuddhatA pradAna karatA hai aura jise yaha vizeSatA de dI gaI, to vAstava meM use bahuta bhalAI dI gaI| tathA allAha kI nizAniyoM se kevala ve pUrNa buddhi vAle upadeza grahaNa karate haiM, jo allAha ke prakAza se prakAza prApta karate aura usake mArgadarzana se nirdeza hAsila karate haiM|

tuma allAha kI prasannatA prApta karane ke lie jo bhI thor3A ho yA bahuta kharca karo, yA tuma apanI ora se allAha kI AjJAkAritA kA koI kArya karane ke lie pratibaddha ho jAo, jisake lie tuma bAdhya nahIM kie gae ho; to niHsaMdeha allAha vaha saba jAnatA hai| ataH usameM se koI bhI cIz2a usake pAsa barbAda nahIM hogI aura vaha tumheM usakA sabase bar3A badalA degA| tathA una atyAcAriyoM ke lie, jo apane Upara anivArya cIz2oM ko rokane vAle, allAha kI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karane vAle haiM, koI madada karane vAle nahIM hoMge, jo unase qiyAmata ke dina kI saz2A ko dUra kara sakeM|

tuma jo kucha bhI dAna meM dhana dete ho, yadi use dikhAkara do to tumhArA yaha dAna denA acchA hai, paraMtu yadi tamu use gupta rakhate hue g2arIboM ko do, to yaha tumhAre lie dikhAne se behatara hai| kyoMki yaha iqhlAsa (niSThA) ke adhika nikaTa hai| tathA niSThAvAnoM ke dAna meM unake pApoM ke lie eka AvaraNa aura unake lie kSamA hai| tathA allAha tumhAre kAryoM se avagata hai| ataH tumhArI hAlatoM meM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai|

(ai nabI!) unheM satya ko svIkAra karane aura usakA pAlana karane kI hidAyata denA aura unheM usapara tatpara karanA Apake z2imme nahIM hai| ApakA kAma kevala unheM satya ke lie mArgadarzana karanA aura unheM usake bAre meM paricaya denA hai| kyoMki satya kI taufIqa denA aura usakI hidAyata pradAna karanA allAha ke hAtha meM hai| vaha jise cAhatA hai, hidAyata pradAna karatA hai| tathA tuma jo bhI dhana kharca karoge, usakA lAbha tumhAre pAsa hI AegA, kyoMki allAha usase beniyAz2a hai| aura tumhArA kharca kevala allAha ke lie honA cAhie| kyoMki sacce ImAna vAle kevala allAha kI prasannatA prApta karane ke lie hI kharca karate haiM| tathA tuma jo kucha bhI kharca karoge, cAhe thor3A yA bahuta, tumheM usakA bharapUra badalA diyA jAegA, usameM koI kamI nahIM kI jAegI| kyoMki allAha kisI para atyAcAra nahIM karatA|

jaba allAha ne apane rAste meM qharca karane kA ullekha kiyA aura ImAna vAloM se usakA AhvAna kiyA, to unake lie qharca karane kI jagahoM ko bhI spaSTa kara diyA| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
yaha dAna una g2arIboM ko do, jinheM allAha ke mArga meM jihAda ne AjIvikA kI talAza meM yAtrA karane se roka diyA hai| unakI sthiti se anabhijJa vyakti unheM unake mA~gane se bacane ke kAraNa dhanavAn samajhatA hai| hAlA~ki jo vyakti unase paricita hai, vaha unheM unake lakSaNoM se pahacAnatA hai, kyoMki unake zarIra aura kapar3oM para AvazyakatA spaSTa dikhAI detI hai| unakI pahacAna yaha bhI hai ki ve anya g2arIba logoM kI taraha nahIM haiM, jo logoM se mA~gate hue unake pIche par3a jAte haiM| tathA tuma apane dhana ityAdi meM se jo kucha bhI qharca karoge, to nizcaya allAha use bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai aura vaha tumheM usakA bahuta bar3A badalA degA|

jo loga rAta aura dina, chipe aura khule, binA kisI dikhAvA aura khyAti ke allAha kI prasannatA prApta karane ke lie apanA dhana kharca karate haiM, to unake lie unakA pratiphala qiyAmata ke dina unake pAlanahAra ke pAsa hai| unako apane bhaviSya ke bAre meM koI Dara nahIM hai aura na hI ve saMsAra kI chUTI huI cIz2oM kA zoka kareMge| yaha saba allAha kI ora se eka anugraha aura kRpA ke taura para hai|

• jaba allAha ne apane mArga meM kharca karane kI preraNA dI; kyoMki usameM musalamAnoM ke bIca sahayoga aura anyonyAzrayatA (paraspara nirbharatA) pAyA jAtA hai, to usake viparIta cIz2a ke khilApha cetAvanI dI, aura vaha sUda (byAja) hai| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
jo loga byAja kA lena-dena karate aura use lete haiM, ve qiyAmata ke dina apanI qabroM se aise uTheMge, jaise vaha AdamI uThatA hai jise zaitAna ne chU liyA ho| cunA~ce vaha apanI qabra se aise lar3akhar3Ate hue uThegA, jaise mirgI se grasta vyakti apane uThane-baiThane meM lar3akhar3AtA hai| aisA isalie hogA kyoMki unhoMne sUda kA upabhoga karanA jAyaz2a ThaharA liyA aura unhoMne allAha ke halAla kie hue vyApAra ke munAphe aura byAja ke bIca koI aMtara nahIM kiyA| unhoMne kahA: vyApAra to halAla hone meM byAja hI kI taraha hai| kyoMki donoM se dhana meM vRddhi aura baढ़otarI hotI hai| to allAha ne unakA khaMDana kiyA, unake qayAsa ko amAnya karate hue unheM jhuThalA diyA aura yaha spaSTa kara diyA ki allAha ne vyApAra ko ha़lAla kiyA hai; kyoMki usameM sAmAnya aura viziSTa lAbha hai aura byAja ko harAma (avaidha) kiyA hai; kyoMki usameM atyAcAra aura logoM kA dhana binA muAvaz2e ke anucita tarIqe se khAnA zAmila hai| phira jisake pAsa usake pAlanahAra kI ora se koI upadeza Ae, jisameM byAja se niSedha aura usase sAvadhAna kiyA gayA ho, to vaha usase ruka jAe aura allAha se taubA kara le; to isase pahale jo kucha byAja vaha le cukA hai, usake bAre meM usapara koI pApa nahIM hai| tathA usake bAda bhaviSya meM jo kucha vaha karatA hai, usakA mAmalA allAha ke havAle hai| paraMtu jo vyakti allAha kI ora se niSedhAjJA pahu~ca jAne ke bAda tathA usapara tarka sthApita ho jAne ke pazcAta dobArA byAja lene kI ora lauTa AyA; to vaha jahannama meM praveza karane aura usameM hamezA rahane kA bhAgI bana gayA| yahA~ jahannama meM hamezA rahane kA matalaba sUda ko halAla samajhate hue usakA upabhoga karanA hai yA isakA abhiprAya usameM laMbe samaya taka rahanA hai| kyoMki jahannama meM hamezA ke lie kevala kAfiroM ko rahanA hai| tauhIda para qAyama rahane vAle loga usameM hamezA ke lie nahIM raheMge|

jaba allAha ne apane rAste meM kharca karane aura byAja lene kA ullekha kiyA, to donoM ke bIca pratiphala meM aMtara ko bhI spaSTa kara diyA| pharamAyA:
allAha byAja ke dhana ko naSTa aura samApta kara detA hai; yA to z2AhirI taura para use vinaSTa kara detA hai yA AMtarika taura para usase barakata ko chIna letA hai| tathA vaha dAna ke pratiphala ko kaI gunA karake, use bar3hAtA aura vikasita karatA hai| cunA~ce vaha eka nekI ko dasa gunA se sAta sau gunA taka balki usase bhI adhika gunA taka kara detA hai aura dAna karane vAloM ke dhana meM barakata detA hai| tathA allAha kisI aise vyakti se prema nahIM karatA jo haThI kAphira ho, jo harAma ko halAla ThaharAne vAlA, avajJA aura kukarmoM meM lipta rahane vAlA ho|

niHsaMdeha jo loga allAha para ImAna lAe, usake rasUla kA anusaraNa kiyA,acche kAma kie aura allAha ne jaisA nirdhArita kiyA hai, usake anusAra pUrI taraha se namAz2a adA kI aura una logoM ko apane dhana kI z2akAta dI jo usake haqadAra haiM; unakA pratiphala unake raba ke pAsa hai, unheM bhaviSya meM apane mAmaloM ke bAre meM kisI cIz2a kA bhaya nahIM hai aura na hI ve duniyA kI chUTI huI cIz2oM aura usakI nematoM para duHkhI hoMge|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! allAha se Daro; isa taura para ki usake AdezoM kA pAlana karo aura usake niSedhoM se baco, tathA logoM ke pAsa byAja ke dhana se jo kucha bacA hai, use mA~ganA chor3a do, yadi tuma vAstava meM allAha para aura usapara vizvAsa rakhate ho jo allAha ne tumheM byAja se manA kiyA hai|

agara tuma vaha kAma na karo, jisakA tumheM Adeza diyA gayA hai, to tuma jAna lo aura yaqIna kara lo ki allAha aura usake rasUla kI ora se yuddha kI ghoSaNA hai| agara tuma allAha ke samakSa taubA kara lo aura byAja chor3a do, to tumheM udhAra dI huI mUla pU~jI vasUla karane kA adhikAra hai| apanI mUla pU~jI se adhika lekara na tuma kisI para atyAcAra karoge aura na usameM kamI karake tumapara atyAcAra kiyA jAegA|

aura yadi tuma jisase qarz2a cukAne kI mA~ga kara rahe ho vaha divAliyA ho, apanA qarz2a cukAne meM samartha na ho, to usase qarz2a kI mA~ga ko vilaMbita kara do yahA~ taka ki usake pAsa dhana upalabdha ho jAe aura vaha qarz2a kA bhugatAna karane meM sakSama ho jAe| aura yaha ki tuma qarz2a cukAne kA mutAlabA tyAgakara yA usameM se kucha hissA chor3akara usapara dAna kara do, to tumhAre lie behatara hai, yadi tuma jAnate ho ki allAha ke pAsa isakI kyA phaz2Ilata hai|

usa dina kI yAtanA se Daro, jaba tuma saba allAha kI ora lauTAe jAoge aura usake sAmane khar3e ho jAoge, phira hara prANI ko usake kie hue kA badalA diyA jAegA, cAhe vaha acchA ho yA burA| unake acche karmoM ke pratiphala ko kama karake, yA unake bure karmoM kI saz2A ko bar3hAkara una para atyAcAra nahIM kiyA jAegA|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! jaba tuma Apasa meM udhAra kA lena-dena karo, isa prakAra ki tumameM se eka vyakti dUsare ko eka nizcita avadhi ke lie udhAra de, to usa udhAra ko likha lo| aura eka likhane vAlA tumhAre bIca zarIyata ke anusAra saccAI aura nyAya ke sAtha likhe| tathA likhane vAlA udhAra ko usake anusAra likhane se inakAra na kare jo allAha ne use nyAya ke sAtha likhanA sikhAyA hai| ataH use cAhie ki denadAra jo kucha likhavA rahA ho, use likha de; tAki yaha denadAra kI ora se eka svIkRti ho jAe| likhavAne vAle ko cAhie ki allAha se Dare aura likhavAne meM udhAra kI mAtrA, yA usake prakAra yA usake vivaraNa meM se kucha bhI kama na kare| yadi jisake z2imme adhikAra hai, vaha acchI taraha se apane kArya kA niyaMtraNa karane meM akSama hai, yA vaha apanI bAlAvasthA yA pAgalapana ke kAraNa kamaz2ora hai, yA apane gU~gepana ke kAraNa bolakara likhavAne meM sakSama nahIM hai, to ina jaisI paristhitiyoM meM usakI tarapha se usakA vaha abhibhAvaka saccAI aura nyAya ke sAtha likhavAe, jo usake bAre meM z2immedAra hai| tathA do samajhadAra aura nyAyapriya puruSoM ko gavAha banA lo| agara do puruSa na mileM, to eka puruSa aura do mahilAoM ko gavAha banA lo, jinake dharma aura ImAnadArI se tuma saMtuSTa ho, tAki yadi eka mahilA bhUla jAe, to usakI bahana use yAda dilA de| aura gavAhoM se jaba qarja para gavAhI dene ke lie kahA jAe, to pIche na haTeM| aura agara unheM aisA karane ke lie bulAyA jAe to unake lie gavAhI denA anivArya hai| tathA qarz2a ko, cAhe vaha thor3A ho yA bahuta, usakI nirdhArita avadhi ke lie likhane meM tuma Uba se grasta na ho| kyoMki qarz2a kA likha lenA, allAha kI zarIyata meM adhika nyAyasaMgata hai, gavAhI ko qAyama karane aura usakI adAyagI meM adhika prabhAvI hai aura qarz2a ke prakAra, usakI mAtrA aura usakI avadhi ke bAre meM kisI bhI saMdeha ko dUra karane ke adhika nikaTa hai| paraMtu yadi tumhAre bIca anubaMdha vartamAna sAmAna aura vartamAna mUlya meM vyApAra para ho; to usa samaya likhanA chor3a dene meM tumapara koI pApa nahIM, kyoMki isakI koI AvazyakatA nahIM hai| lekina vivAda ke kAraNoM ko rokane ke lie, tumhAre lie gavAha rakhanA dharmasaMgata hai| tathA likhane vAloM aura gavAhoM ko nuqasAna pahu~cAnA jAyaz2a nahIM hai| isI taraha likhane vAloM tathA gavAhoM ke lie usa vyakti ko nuqasAna pahu~cAnA jAyaz2a nahIM hai, jo unase likhane yA gavAhI dene ke lie kahe| agara tumhArI ora se unheM nuqasAna pahu~cAyA jAtA hai, to yaha allAha kI AjJAkAritA se usakI avajJA kI ora nikalanA hai| tathA - ai ImAna vAlo! - allAha se Daro, isa taura para ki usake AdezoM kA pAlana karo aura usake niSedhoM se baco| allAha tumheM vaha bAteM sikhAtA hai, jinameM tumhArI duniyA aura Aqhirata kI behatarI va bhalAI hai| aura allAha hara cIz2a ko qhUba jAnane vAlA hai| ataH usase koI cIz2a chipI nahIM hai|

yadi tuma yAtrA kara rahe ho aura tumheM koI likhane vAlA na mile, jo tumhAre lie qarz2a kI dastAvez2a likhe, to denadAra ke lie itanA kAphI hai ki koI sAmAna giravI rakha de, jise RNa dene vAlA apane qabz2e meM le legA, jo usake adhikAra kI gAraMTI hogI, yahA~ taka ki denadAra apane qarz2a kA bhugatAna kara de| agara tumameM se koI vyakti kisI para bharosA kare, to aisI sthiti meM likhane, yA gavAha banAne yA giravI rakhane kI AvazyakatA nahIM hai| usa samaya qarz2a denadAra ke z2imme eka amAnata ke taura para rahegA, usapara use apane lenadAra ko cukAnA anivArya hai| use cAhie ki isa amAnata ke bAre meM allAha se Dare aura usameM se kisI bhI cIz2a kA inakAra na kare| agara vaha inakAra karatA hai, to lena-dena ko dekhane vAle ko gavAhI denI cAhie| aura usake lie gavAhI chipAnA jAyaz2a nahIM hai| aura jo koI gavAhI chipAtA hai, to usakA dila eka pApI (duSTa) dila hai| yAda rakho ki jo kucha tuma karate ho, allAha use jAnatA hai, usase koI cIz2a chipI nahIM hai| aura vaha tumheM tumhAre kAryoM kA badalA degA|

jo kucha AkAzoM meM aura jo kucha pRthvI para hai, sabakA paidA karane vAlA, mAlika aura prabaMdhana karane vAlA kevala allAha hai| yadi tuma apane diloM meM jo kucha hai use prakaTa karo yA use chipAo, allAha use jAnatA hai aura vaha tumase usakA hisAba legA| phira usake bAda apanI kRpA aura dayA se jise cAhegA, kSamA kara degA aura jise cAhegA, apane nyAya aura hikamata se yAtanA degA| aura allAha hara cIz2a para sarvazaktimAna hai|

rasUla muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama hara usa cIz2a para ImAna lAe, jo unake pAlanahAra kI ora se unakI tarafa utArI gaI aura isI prakAra momina bhI ImAna lAe| ve sabhI allAha para ImAna lAe, tathA usake sabhI phariztoM para, usakI sabhI una kitAboM para jo usane nabiyoM para utArI aura usake bheje hue sabhI rasUloM para ImAna lAe| ve unapara yaha kahate hue ImAna lAe: hama allAha ke rasUloM meM se kisI ke bIca bhI aMtara nahIM karate| tathA una logoM ne kahA: hamane use sunA jisakA tUne hameM Adeza diyA aura jisase hameM manA kiyA, tathA jisa cIz2a kA tUne Adeza diyA use aMjAma dekara aura jisase tUne manA kiyA use tyAgakara hamane terI AjJA kA pAlana kiyA| ai hamAre raba! hama tujhase prArthanA karate haiM ki tU hameM kSamA kara de| kyoMki hamAre sabhI mAmaloM meM hamArA lauTanA kevala terI hI ora hai|

allAha kisI prANI para kevala usI kA bhAra DAlatA hai jisake karane meM vaha sakSama ho|kyoMki allAha kA dIna (dharma) AsAnI para AdhArita hai, isalie usameM koI kaThinAI nahIM hai| ataH jisane acchA kArya kiyA, use apane kie kA pratiphala milegA, usameM koI kamI nahIM kI jAegI| tathA jisanA burA kArya kiyA, use apane kie hue pApa kA daMDa milegA, usakI ora se koI dUsarA usakA bhAra nahIM uThAegA| rasUla aura ImAna vAloM ne kahA: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! agara hama bhUla gae hoM yA binA irAde ke kisA kArya yA bAta meM hamase koI galatI ho gaI ho, to hameM saz2A na de| ai hamAre pAlanahAra! aura hama para usa cIz2a kA bhAra na DAla, jo hamAre lie kaThina ho aura hama use sahana na kara sakeM, jaisA ki tUne hamase pahale una logoM para bhAra DAlA thA, jinheM tUne unake atyAcAra ke kAraNa daMDita kiyA thA, jaise yahUdI loga| tathA hamapara aise AdezoM aura niSedhoM kA bojha na DAla, jo hamAre lie kaThina hoM aura hama unheM karane meM sakSama na hoM| tathA hamAre pApoM ko kSamA kara de aura hameM mAfI pradAna kara, tathA apanI kRpA se hamapara dayA kara| tU hI hamArA saMrakSaka aura sahAyaka hai, ataH hameM kAfiroM para vijaya pradAna kara|

{alifa, lAma, mIma} inheM 'ha़urUfe muqattaAta' kahA jAtA hai| inake samAna akSara sUratula-baqarA ke zurU meM bhI Ae haiM| ye isa prakAra kA quraAna lAne meM araboM kI akSamatA ko iMgita karate haiM, hAlA~ki pUrA quraAna unhIM jaise akSaroM se banA hai, jo isa sUrata ke AraMbha meM Ae haiM aura jinase ve apane zabdoM kA nirmANa karate haiM|

allAha vaha hai jisa akele ke sivA koI bhI vAstavika rUpa se ibAdata ke lAyaqa nahIM hai| vaha jIvita hai, eka pUrNa jIvana vAlA hai jisameM koI mRtyu yA kamI nahIM hai| hara cIz2a ko sa~bhAlane vAlA hai, jo svayaM qAyama hai, ataH vaha apanI sArI sRSTi se beniyAz2a hai| jabaki sabhI prANI usI ke dvArA qAyama haiM, isalie ve apanI sabhI sthitiyoM meM usase beniyAz2a nahIM ho sakate|

3-4 - (ai nabI!) usane Apapara sacce samAcAroM aura nyAyapUrNa niyamoM ke sAtha quraAna utArA, jo isase pahale kI IzvarIya pustakoM ke anukUla hai| ataH unake bIca koI virodhAbhAsa nahIM hai| usane Apapara quraAna utArane se pahale mUsA alaihissalAma para taurAta aura IsA alaihissalAma para iMjIla utArI| ye sabhI IzvarIya pustakeM logoM ke lie usa cIz2a kI ora mArgadarzana ke srota haiM, jisameM unake dharma aura unakI duniyA kI bhalAI hai| aura usane phuraqAna (satya aura asatya meM aMtara karane vAlA mAnadaMDa) utArA, jisake dvArA satya ko jhUTha se aura mArgadarzana ko pathabhraSTatA se pahacAnA jAtA hai| aura jina logoM ne allAha kI una AyatoM kA inakAra kiyA jo usane Apapara utArI haiM, unake lie bahuta kaThora yAtanA hai| tathA allAha saba para prabhutvazAlI hai, usapara kisI kA z2ora nahIM calatA| vaha usase badalA lene vAlA hai, jisane usake rasUloM ko jhuThalAyA aura usake Adeza kA ullaMghana kiyA|

allAha se dharatI para yA AkAza meM koI cIz2a chipI nahIM hai| usake jJAna ne bAharI aura AMtarika sabhI cIz2oM ko ghera rakhA hai|

vahI hai jo tumheM tumhArI mAtAoM ke peToM meM vibhinna rUpoM meM paidA karatA hai, jaisA vaha cAhatA hai, cAhe puruSa ho yA mahilA, acchA ho yA burA, gorA ho yA kAlA| usake sivA koI satya pUjya (saccA mA'bUda) nahIM| vaha saba para prabhutvazAlI hai, usapara kisI kA z2ora nahIM calatA| vaha apanI racanA, prabaMdhana aura vidhAna meM hikamata vAlA hai|

vahI allAha hai, jisane (ai nabI!) Apapara quraAna utArA| usameM se kucha AyateM aisI haiM jinake artha spaSTa haiM, unameM koI saMdeha nahIM hai| yahI kitAba kA mUla aura usakA adhikAMza bhAga haiM aura yahI matabheda ke samaya saMdarbha haiM| jabaki usameM se kucha dUsarI AyateM aisI haiM, jinake eka se adhika artha ho sakate haiM, unakA artha adhikAMza logoM ke lie aspaSTa (saMdigdha) hotA hai| phira jinake diloM meM satya se vicalana hai, ve mohakama (spaSTa artha vAlI) AyatoM ko chor3akara mutazAbeha (eka se adhika artha vAlI) AyatoM kA pAlana karate haiM; isake dvArA ve saMdeha ko bhar3akAne aura logoM ko gumarAha karane kI koziza karate haiM, tathA isake dvArA ve apane bhraSTa siddhAMtoM ke anurUpa apanI icchA ke anusAra isakI vyAkhyA karanA cAhate haiM| hAlA~ki ina AyatoM ke arthoM kI vAstavikatA aura unake pariNAma ko allAha ke sivA koI nahIM jAnatA| jo loga jJAna meM dRr3ha haiM aura usa para pakar3a rakhate haiM, kahate haiM: hama pUre quraAna para ImAna rakhate haiM; kyoMki yaha pUrA kA pUrA hamAre pAlanahAra kI ora se hai aura ve mutazAbeha AyatoM kI vyAkhyA mohakama AyatoM ke anusAra karate haiM| tathA zuddha (svastha) buddhi vAle loga hI nasIhata hAsila karate aura upadeza grahaNa karate haiM|

ye jJAna meM dRr3ha loga kahate haiM: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hamAre diloM ko satya se na phera, isake bAda ki tUne hamArA usakI ora mArgadarzana kiyA| tathA hameM satya se bhaTakane vAle pathabhraSToM ke pariNAma se surakSita rakha| aura hameM apanI ora se eka vyApaka dayA pradAna kara, jisake dvArA tU hamAre diloM kA mArgadarzana kara aura usake dvArA tU hameM pathabhraSTa hone se bacA le| niHsaMdeha - ai hamAre pAlanahAra! - tU mahAna dAtA hai|
