jina logoM ne allAha aura usake rasUloM kA inakAra kiyA, unake dhana aura unakI aulAda unase allAha kI yAtanA ko haragiz2a nahIM roka sakate, na duniyA meM aura na hI Aqhirata meM| ve loga jinakI ye vizeSatAe~ haiM, vahI jahannama ke IMdhana haiM, jisake dvArA use qiyAmata ke dina bhar3akAyA jAegA|

ina kAphiroM kI sthiti firaauna ke logoM aura unase pahale ke logoM kI taraha hai, jinhoMne allAha kA inakAra kiyA aura usakI AyatoM (nizAniyoM) ko jhuThalAyA thA| to allAha ne unheM unake pApoM ke kAraNa daMDita kiyA aura unake dhana aura unakI aulAda ne unheM koI lAbha nahIM pahu~cAyA| aura allAha use kaThora saz2A dene vAlA hai, jisane usakA inakAra kiyA aura usakI AyatoM (nizAniyoM) ko jhuThalAyA|

(ai rasUla!) vibhinna dharmoM ke mAnane vAle kAfiroM se kaha deM: ImAna vAle zIghra hI tumheM parAjita kara deMge aura tuma kufra kI hAlata meM maroge tathA allAha tumheM jahannama kI Aga meM ikaTThA karegA| aura vaha tumhAre lie bahuta burA ThikAnA hai|

tumhAre lie una do daloM meM eka saMketa aura sIkha thI, jo badra ke dina lar3ane ke lie Apasa meM mile the| unameM se eka dala ImAna vAloM kA thA aura vaha allAha ke rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama aura Apake sAthiyoM kA dala thA| ve allAha ke rAste meM isa uddezya se yuddha kara rahe the tAki allAha kI bAta sarvocca ho aura kAfiroM kI bAta nIcI ho| aura dUsarA dala kAfiroM kA thA aura ve makkA ke kAfira the, jo garva, dikhAvA aura dhArmika pakSapAta ke taura para nikale the| ImAna vAle unako apanI A~khoM se vAstavikatA meM dogunA dekha rahe the| to allAha ne apane dostoM ko vijaya pradAna kI aura allAha jise cAhatA hai apane vijaya ke sAtha usakA samarthana karatA hai| niHsaMdeha isameM ibarata aura upadeza hai samajha-bUjha rakhane vAloM ke lie, tAki unheM mAlUma ho jAe ki vijaya ImAna vAloM ke lie hai, agarace unakI saMkhyA kama ho, aura yaha ki parAjaya asatyavAdiyoM ke lie hai, bhale hI unakI saMkhyA adhika ho|

allAha sUcita kara rahA hai ki usane logoM ke lie - unakI parIkSA lene ke lie - sAMsArika icchAoM kA prema susajjita kara diyA hai, jaise ki mahilAe~, beTe, sone aura cA~dI ke ekatrita qhaz2Ane, nizAna lagAe hue acche nasla ke ghor3e, U~Ta, gAya aura bher3a jaise mavezI aura bhUmi kI khetI| yaha sAMsArika jIvana kA sAmAna hai, jisase kucha samaya ke lie lAbha uThAyA jAtA hai, phira vaha qhatma ho jAtA hai| isalie momina ko isase cipakanA nahIM cAhie| aura allAha ke pAsa hI uttama ThikAnA hai aura vaha jannata hai, jisakI caur3AI AkAzoM evaM dharatI ke barAbara hai|

cU~ki sAMsArika vAsanAe~ samApta ho jAne vAlI haiM, isalie allAha ne usa cIz2a kI ora dhyAna AkarSita kiyA jo usase behatara hai, cunA~ce pharamAyA:
(ai rasUla!) kaha dIjie: kyA maiM tumheM ina icchAoM se behatara cIz2a ke bAre meM batAU~? jo loga allAha kI AjJAkAritA karake aura usakI avajJA ko tyAgakara usase Darate haiM, unake lie aise bAg2a haiM, jinake mahaloM aura per3oM ke nIce se nahareM bahatI haiM, jinameM ve hamezA rahane vAle haiM, na unheM mauta AegI aura na unakA vinAza hogA| unake lie usameM aisI patniyA~ hoMgI jo apanI saMracanA aura AcaraNa meM sabhI burAiyoM se zuddha hoMgI| isake bAvajUda, unapara allAha kI ora se prasannatA utaregI, phira vaha unase kabhI nArAz2a nahIM hogA| aura allAha apane baMdoM ke hAlAta se avagata hai, usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai, aura vaha unheM unapara badalA degA|

ye jannata vAle hI haiM jo apane pAlanahAra se duA karate hue kahate haiM: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hama tujhapara ImAna lAe aura usapara bhI jo kucha tUne apane rasUloM para utArA hai, tathA hamane terI zarIyata kA pAlana kiyA| ataH tU hamAre dvArA kie gae pApoM ko kSamA kara de aura hameM Aga kI yAtanA se bacA|

jo AjJAkAritA ke kAma karane aura bure kAmoM ko tyAgane, tathA unapara Ane vAlI vipattiyoM para dhairya rakhane vAle haiM, tathA ve apane kathanoM aura kAryoM meM sacce haiM, aura ve pUrI taraha se allAha ke AjJAkArI haiM, aura ve allAha kI rAha meM apanA dhana kharca karane vAle haiM, tathA ve rAta kI aMtima ghar3iyoM meM allAha se kSamA mA~gane vAle haiM| kyoMki usa samaya duA svIkAra hone kI saMbhAvanA adhika hotI hai aura dila vyastatAoM se khAlI hotA hai|

allAha ne gavAhI dI ki niHsaMdeha vahI vAstava meM ibAdata ke yogya pUjya hai| usake sivA koI upAsanA ke yogya nahIM| aisA usane zaraI aura brahmAMDIya AyatoM (nizAniyoM) ko sthApita karake kiyA hai, jo usake ekamAtra pUjya hone ko darzAtI haiM| tathA phariztoM ne bhI isakI gavAhI dI, aura jJAna vAle logoM ne tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) ko logoM ke lie spaSTa karane aura unheM usakI ora AmaMtrita karane ke dvArA isakI gavAhI dI| unhoMne duniyA ke sabase bar3e tathya arthAt isa bAta kI gavAhI dI ki allAha hI ekamAtra pUjya hai aura vaha apanI sRSTi aura zarIyata meM nyAya sthApita karane vAlA hai| usake sivA koI pUjya nahIM, vaha saba para prabhutvazAlI hai, usapara kisI kA z2ora nahIM calatA, apanI racanA, prabaMdhana aura zarIyatasAz2I meM pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai|

ni:saMdeha allAha ke nikaTa svIkArya dharma islAma hai| islAma kA matalaba hai AjJAkAritA ke sAtha akele allAha ke prati adhInatA aura upAsanA (baMdagI) ke sAtha usake prati samarpaNa; tathA sabhI rasUloM para unakI aMtima kar3I muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama taka ImAna lAnA, jinapara allAha ne rasUloM kA silasilA samApta kara diyA| ataH allAha ApakI zarIyata ke alAvA kucha bhI svIkAra nahIM karegA| yahUdiyoM aura IsAiyoM ne apane dharma ke bAre meM jo bhI matabheda kiyA aura vibhinna samUhoM aura daloM meM vibhAjita ho gae, vaha unake pAsa jJAna Ane ke sAtha unapara tarka sthApita hone ke bAda, IrSyA aura duniyA kI lAlaca ke kAraNa thA| tathA jo allAha kI usake rasUla para avatarita AyatoM kA inakAra kare, to niHsaMdeha allAha usase bahuta jalda hisAba lene vAlA hai, jisane usakA inakAra kiyA aura usake rasUloM ko jhuThalAyA|

(ai rasUla!) agara ve Apase usa satya ke saMbaMdha meM jhagar3eM, jo Apapara allAha kI ora se utarA hai, to unheM uttara dete hue kaha dIjie: maiM aura ImAna vAloM meM se merA anusaraNa karane vAle allAha ko samarpita ho gae| aura (ai rasUla!) kitAba vAloM aura muzrikoM se pUchie: kyA tuma loga allAha ke prati, usake lie vizuddha hokara aura jo maiM lAyA hU~ usakA anusaraNa karate hue, samarpita ho gae? yadi ve allAha ke prati samarpita ho jAe~ aura ApakI zarIyata kA anusaraNa kareM, to niHsaMdeha unhoMne hidAyata kA mArga apanA liyA| aura agara ve islAma se mu~ha phera leM, to ApakA kAma kevala apanI bAta una taka pahu~cA denA hai aura unakA mAmalA allAha ke havAle hai| kyoMki vaha apane baMdoM ko qhUba dekhane vAlA hai, aura vaha pratyeka kAryakartA ko usake kArya kA badalA degA|

jo loga allAha ke una tarkoM kA inakAra karate haiM jo usane unapara utAre haiM, tathA usake nabiyoM ko binA adhikAra ke anyAya va AkrAmakatA ke sAtha qatla karate haiM aura una logoM ko qatla karate haiM, jo logoM meM se nyAya karane kA Adeza dete haiM aura ve acchI bAta kA Adeza dene vAle aura burAI se rokane vAle loga haiM, to ina kAfira hatyAroM ko eka dardanAka yAtanA kI zubha sUcanA de deM|

jo loga ina guNoM se vizeSita haiM, unake karma barbAda ho gae| ataH unheM isa duniyA meM yA Aqhirata meM unase koI lAbha nahIM hogA| kyoMki ve allAha para ImAna nahIM rakhate haiM| tathA unake lie koI sahAyaka nahIM hoMge, jo unase az2Aba ko TAla sakeM|

ai nabI! kyA Apane una yahUdiyoM kA hAla nahIM dekhA, jinheM allAha ne taurAta tathA usameM maujUda ApakI nubuvvata (IzdUtatva) kI nizAniyoM ke jJAna kA eka hissA diyA| unheM allAha kI pustaka taurAta kI ora bulAyA jAtA hai, tAki vaha unake bIca unake vivAdoM kA nirNaya kare| paraMtu unake vidvAnoM aura pramukha logoM kA eka samUha mu~ha phera letA hai, isa hAla meM ki ve usake Adeza se upekSA karane vAle hote haiM kyoMki vaha unakI icchAoM ke anukUla nahIM hai| hAlA~ki unake lie behatara yaha thA - jabaki ve taurAta kA anusaraNa karane kA dAvA karate haiM - ki usase phaisalA karAne meM sabase Age rahate|

yaha satya se mu~ha pheranA aura usase upekSA karanA isa kAraNa hai, kyoMki ve dAvA karate the ki qiyAmata ke dina doz2akha kI Aga unheM kevala kucha dinoM ke lie hI chuegI, phira ve jannata meM praveza kareMge| unake isa gar3he hue jhUThe aura asatya bhrama ne unheM dhokhe meM DAla diyA aura unhoMne allAha aura usake dharma kI avahelanA karane kA sAhasa kiyA|

(usa samaya) unakA hAla aura unakA pachatAnA kaisA hogA?! nizcaya vaha bahuta burA hogA jaba hama unheM hisAba ke lie eka aise dina meM ekatra kareMge, jisameM koI saMdeha nahIM aura vaha qiyAmata kA dina hai| aura hara prANI ko usake kie hue kAryoM kA usake yogya badalA diyA jAegA| usakI nekiyoM ko ghaTAkara yA usakI burAiyoM ko bar3hAkara usapara atyAcAra nahIM kiyA jAegA|

ai rasUla! Apa apane pAlanahAra kI prazaMsA aura usakI mahimA karate hue kaha deM: ai allAha! tU hI duniyA aura Aqhirata meM sAre rAjya kA mAlika hai| tU apanI sRSTi meM se jise cAhatA hai, use rAjya pradAna karatA hai aura jisase cAhatA hai, use chIna letA hai| tathA unameM se jise tU cAhatA hai, sammAna detA hai aura jise tU cAhatA hai, use apamAnita karatA hai| yaha saba terI hikamata aura nyAya se hotA hai| kevala tere hI hAtha meM sArI bhalAI hai aura tU saba kucha karane meM sakSama haiM|

terI zakti kI nizAniyoM meM se eka yaha hai ki tU rAta ko dina meM dAqhila karatA hai, to dina kA samaya laMbA ho jAtA hai aura tU dina ko rAta meM dAkhila karatA hai, to rAta kA samaya laMbA ho jAtA hai, tathA tU jIvita ko mRta se nikAlatA hai; jaise momina ko kAfira se aura khetI ko dAne se| tathA tU mRta ko jIvita se nikAlatA hai; jaise kAfira ko momina se aura aMDe ko murgI se| aura tU jise cAhe binA hisAba aura ginatI ke vistRta jIvikA pradAna karatA hai|

ai ImAna vAlo! tuma kAfiroM ko mitra (sahayogI) na banAo ki mominoM ko chor3akara unase prema karo aura unakA samarthana karo| aura jo aisA karegA, vaha allAha se barI ho gayA aura allAha usase barI ho gayA| paraMtu agara tuma unake prabhutva meM ho aura tumheM unase apane Apapara Dara mahasUsa ho, to aisI paristhiti meM unake prati (dila meM) zatrutA rakhate hue bAtacIta meM komalatA aura kAryoM meM dayA dikhAkara, unake kaSTa se bacAva karane meM kucha bhI galata nahIM hai, tathA allAha tumheM apane Apase DarAtA hai, isalie usase Daro, aura avajJA karake usake krodha kA zikAra na bano| tathA qiyAmata ke dina sabhI baMdoM ko akele allAha hI kI ora lauTanA hai, tAki unheM unake kAmoM kA badalA mile|

(ai nabI!) Apa kaha deM: yadi tuma usa cIz2a ko apane sInoM meM chipAo jisase allAha ne tumheM manA kiyA hai, jaise kAphiroM se dostI karanA, yA use z2Ahira karo, allAha use janatA hai aura usameM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai| vaha AkAzoM aura dharatI kI sArI cIz2oM ko jAnatA hai| aura allAha hara cIz2a ko karane meM sakSama hai, use koI cIz2a vivaza nahIM kara sakatI|

qiyAmata ke dina pratyeka prANI apane acche kArya ko binA kisI kamI ke sAmane hAz2ira pAegA tathA jisane burA kArya kiyA hogA, vaha kAmanA karegA ki usake tathA usake bure karmoM ke bIca eka laMbA samaya hotA| lekina usakI kAmanA kaise pUrI ho sakatI hai! aura allAha tumheM apane Apase DarAtA hai| ataH pApa karake apane Apako usake krodha se pIr3ita na karo| allAha apane baMdoM ke prati atyaMta karuNAmaya hai| isIlie unheM cetAvanI detA hai aura unheM DarAtA hai|

(ai rasUla!) Apa kaha dIjie: yadi tuma vAstava meM allAha se prema karate ho, to jo kucha maiM lekara AyA hU~ usakA prokSa evaM pratyakSa rUpa se pAlana karo, tumheM allAha kA prema prApta hogA aura vaha tumhAre pApoM ko kSamA kara degA| aura allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko bahuta kSamA karane vAlA, unapara atyaMta dayAvAn hai|

(ai rasUla!) Apa kaha deM: AdezoM ko kriyAnvita karake aura niSedhoM se bacakara allAha kI AjJA kA pAlana karo aura usake rasUla kI AjJA kA pAlana karo| yadi ve isase mu~ha phera leM, to niHsaMdeha allAha una kAfiroM ko pasaMda nahIM karatA jo usakI AjJA aura usake rasUla ke Adeza kA virodha karane vAle haiM|

ni:saMdeha allAha ne Adama alaihissalAma ko cuna liyA aura unake Age apane phariztoM se sajadA karavAyA| aura nUha alaihissalAma ko cunA aura unheM dharatI vAloM kI ora prathama rasUla banAyA| tathA ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ke gharAne ko cunA aura unake vaMza meM nubuvvata (IzdUtatva) ko bAqI rakhA| aura imarAna ke gharAne ko cunA; allAha ne ina sabhI ko cunA aura unheM apane samaya ke logoM para zreSThatA pradAna kI|

ye pUrvokta nabIgaNa aura unakI saMtAneM jo unake mArga kA anusaraNa karane vAlI haiM, ve eka aisA vaMza haiM jo allAha kI tauha़Ida (ekezvaravAda) aura acche karma karane meM eka dUsare se saMbaMdhita haiM, ve eka dUsare se acche svabhAva aura guNoM ke vArisa hote haiM| aura allAha apane baMdoM kI bAteM sunane vAlA, unake kAryoM ko jAnane vAlA hai; isIlie vaha unameM se jise cAhatA hai, pasaMda kara letA hai aura jise cAhatA hai, cuna letA hai|

(ai rasUla!) usa samaya ko yAda kareM, jaba marayama alaihassalAma kI mA~ imarAna kI patnI ne kahA: ai mere pAlanahAra! maiMne apane lie yaha anivArya kara liyA hai ki mere peTa meM jo garbha hai, use vizuddha rUpa se tere lie viziSTa kara dU~, jo terI aura tere ghara kI sevA karane ke lie hara cIz2a se Az2Ada kiyA huA ho| isalie use mujhase svIkAra kara le| ni:saMdeha tU hI merI duA sunane vAlA aura merA irAdA jAnane vAlA hai|

phira jaba unakA garbha pUrA ho gayA, to unhoMne use jana diyA jo unake peTa meM thA aura (vaha ummIda kara rahI thIM ki garbha puruSa hogA, isalie) kSamA cAhate hue kahA: ai mere pAlanahAra! yaha to maiMne baccI janI hai! aura allAha z2yAdA jAnane vAlA hai jo unhoMne janA, aura vaha lar3akA jisakI vaha AzA kara rahI thIM, zakti aura saMracanA meM usa lar3akI ke samAna nahIM, jo unheM dI gaI thI| tathA maiMne usakA nAma marayama rakhA hai aura maiMne use aura usakI saMtAna ko terI dayA se niSkAsita zaitAna se tere saMrakSaNa meM de diyA hai|

allAha ne unakI mannata ko acchI taraha svIkAra kiyA, aura una (marayama) kA acchI taraha pAlana-poSaNa kiyA, aura apane neka baMdoM ke diloM meM unake prati sahAnubhUti paidA kara dI aura unakA abhibhAvaka z2akariyyA alaihissalAma ko banA diyA| jaba bhI z2akariyyA alaihissalAma unake pAsa upAsanA sthala meM praveza karate, unake pAsa acchI-acchI khAne kI cIz2eM pAte| yaha dekhakara z2akariyyA alaihissalAma ko Azcarya huA aura marayama ko saMbodhita karate hue kahA: ai marayama! tumheM yaha jIvikA kahA~ se milI? unhoMne uttara dete hue kahA: yaha jIvikA allAha kI ora se hai| ni:saMdeha allAha jise cAhatA hai kisI hisAba ke binA vistRta roz2I pradAna karatA hai|

usI samaya, jaba z2akariyyA ne marayama binta imarAna ke pAsa jIvikA meM allAha ke sAmAnya niyama ke viparIta allAha kI jIvikA dekhI, to unake aMdara yaha AzA paidA huI ki unakI vRddhAvasthA aura unakI patnI ke bA~jhapana kI sthiti ke bAvajUda allAha unheM saMtAna de sakatA hai| cunA~ce unhoMne prArthanA kI: ai mere pAlanahAra! mujhe eka acchI saMtAna pradAna kara| niHsaMdeha tU prArthanA karane vAle kI prArthanA sunane vAlA aura use qabUla karane vAlA hai|

fariztoM ne unheM saMbodhita karate hue, jabaki vaha apane upAsanA sthala meM namAz2a par3ha rahe the, AvAz2a dekara kahA: allAha tumheM eka putra kI zubha sUcanA detA hai jo Apake hA~ paidA hogA, jisakA nAma 'yaha़yA' hogA| usakI vizeSatA yaha hogI ki vaha 'allAha ke zabda' arthAt marayama ke putra IsA kI puSTi karane vAlA hogA| (IsA ko 'allAha kA zabda' isalie kahA gayA kyoMki vaha eka vizeSa tarIqe se allAha ke eka zabda ('kuna' yAnI 'ho jA') se paidA hue the) aura yaha lar3akA jJAna tathA ibAdata meM apane samudAya kA saradAra hogA, khuda ko icchAoM se rokane vAlA hogA, jinameM mahilAoM ke nikaTa jAnA bhI zAmila hai, apane pAlanahAra kI ibAdata ke lie pUrNa rUpa se samarpita hogA| tathA vaha sadAcAriyoM meM se eka nabI - bhI - hogA|

jaba phariztoM ne z2akariyyA ko yaha़yA kI qhuzaqhabarI dI, to unhoMne kahA: ai mere pAlanahAra! mere hA~ lar3akA kaise ho sakatA hai, jabaki maiM bUढ़A ho cukA hU~ aura merI patnI bA~jha hai, usake bacce nahIM hote?! to allAha ne use uttara dete hue pharamAyA: tumhAre buढ़Ape aura tumhArI patnI ke bA~jhapana ke bAvajUda, yaha़yA ko paidA karane kA udAharaNa; allAha ke sAmAnya niyama ke viparIta anya cIz2oM ko paidA karane kI taraha hai| kyoMki allAha hara cIz2a para sarvazaktimAna hai| vaha apanI hikamata tathA jJAna ke anusAra jo cAhatA hai, karatA hai|

z2akariyyA ne kahA: ai mere pAlanahAra! mere lie isa bAta kI koI nizAnI banA de ki merI patnI mujhase garbhavatI hai| allAha ne kahA: tumane jo nizAnI mA~gI hai, vaha yaha hai ki: tuma tIna dina aura tIna rAta logoM se bAta nahIM kara sakate, sivAya izArA ityAdi karake, jabaki tuma kisI doSa se pIr3ita nahIM hoge| ataH tuma dina ke aMta aura usakI zuruAta meM adhika se adhika allAha ko yAda karo aura usakI pavitratA kA varNana karo|

(ai rasUla!) usa samaya ko yAda kareM, jaba fariztoM ne marayama alaihassalAma se kahA: allAha ne tumheM tumhAre prazaMsanIya guNoM ke kAraNa cuna liyA hai, tumheM kamiyoM se zuddha kiyA hai tathA tumheM tumhAre samaya meM sArI duniyA kI mahilAoM ke Upara cuna liyA hai|
ai marayama! namAz2a meM laMbe samaya taka khar3I raho, apane pAlanahAra ko sajadA karo aura usake rukU karane vAle neka baMdoM ke sAtha rukU karo|

z2akariyyA aura marayama alaihimassalAma ke bAre meM uparyukta bAteM parokSa (g2aiba) kI khabaroM meM se haiM, jo hama (ai rasUla!) ApakI ora vaha़ya karate haiM| aura Apa una vidvAnoM aura neka logoM ke pAsa usa samaya upasthita nahIM the, jaba unhoMne isa bAre meM jhagar3A kiyA thA ki marayama ke pAlana-poSaNa kA adhika yogya kauna hai, yahA~ taka ki unheM qura'A-aMdAz2I kA sahArA lenA par3A| cunA~ce unhoMne apanI qalamoM ko DAlA, to z2akariyyA alaihissalAma kI qalama jIta gaI|

(ai rasUla!) usa samaya ko yAda kareM, jaba fariztoM ne kahA: ai marayama! allAha tumheM eka aise lar3ake kI qhuzaqhabarI detA hai, jisakI racanA binA pitA ke hogI| usakI racanA allAha ke eka zabda se hogI, isa prakAra ki vaha kahegA: "kuna" (ho jA) to vaha allAha kI AjJA se eka putra ho jAegA| usa bacce kA nAma: 'masIha IsA bina marayama' hai| usakA duniyA aura Aqhirata meM eka mahAna sthAna hogA aura vaha allAha ke nikaTavartiyoM meM se hogA|

vaha bAta karane kI Ayu se pahale, zaizavAvasthA hI meM logoM se bAta karegA aura usa samaya bhI bAta karegA jaba vaha bar3A ho jAegA, usakI zakti aura usakA puruSatva paripUrNa ho jAegA| vaha unheM aisI bAtoM ke sAtha saMbodhita karegA jinameM unake dhArmika aura sAMsArika mAmaloM kI bhalAI hogI| tathA vaha apane kathanoM evaM kAryoM meM sadAcArI logoM meM se hogA|

marayama ne isa bAta se Azcaryacakita hokara ki unake hA~ binA pati ke eka beTA hogA, kahA: mere hA~ putra kaise hogA, jabaki koI manuSya vaidha athavA avaidha tarIqe se mere pAsa nahIM AyA?! farizte ne unase kahA: jisa taraha allAha tumhAre hA~ binA bApa ke lar3akA paidA karegA, usI taraha vaha jo cAhatA hai, sAmAnya niyama ke viparIta paidA karatA hai| isalie jaba vaha kisI kAma kA irAdA kara letA hai, to usase kahatA hai: "ho jA" to vaha ho jAtA hai| ataH use koI cIz2a vivaza nahIM kara sakatI|

allAha unheM likhanA tathA kathana evaM kArya meM zuddhatA sikhAegA, tathA unheM vaha taurAta sikhAegA, jise usane mUsA alaihissalAma para utArA, aura unheM usa iMjIla kI zikSA degA, jo vaha unapara avatarita karegA|

aura (isI prakAra) allAha unheM banI isarAIla kI ora rasUla banAkara bhejegA| vaha unase kaheMge: maiM tumhArI ora allAha kA bhejA huA rasUla hU~| maiM tumhAre pAsa aisI nizAnI lAyA hU~, jo merI nubuvvata kI satyatA ko pramANita karane vAlI hai| jo yaha hai ki: maiM tumhAre lie miTTI se pakSI ke rUpa kA eka AkAra banAtA hU~, phira usameM phU~ka mAratA hU~, to vaha allAha kI anumati se jIvita pakSI bana jAtA hai| aura maiM caMgA kara detA hU~ usa vyakti ko jo janmajAta aMdhA hai, to vaha dekhane lagatA hai aura usa vyakti ko jo koढ़ se pIr3ita hai, to usakI tvacA ThIka ho jAtI hai| aura maiM murdoM ko z2iMdA kara detA hU~| aura yaha saba allAha kI anumati se hotA hai| aura maiM tumheM usake bAre meM bhI batA detA hU~, jo tuma apane gharoM meM khAte ho aura jo saMgraha karate aura chipAkara rakhate ho| niHsaMdeha ina mahAna cIz2oM meM jinakA maiMne tumase ullekha kiyA hai, jo manuSya nahIM kara sakate; nizcaya isa bAta kI spaSTa nizAnI hai ki maiM tumhArI ora allAha kA bhejA huA rasUla hU~, yadi tuma ImAna lAnA cAhate ho aura aura pramANoM ko saccA mAnate ho|

isI prakAra, maiM tumhAre pAsa apane se pUrva utarI huI pustaka taurAta kI puSTi karane vAlA banakara AyA hU~| tathA maiM isalie AyA hU~, tAki tumhAre lie sugama aura AsAna banAne ke lie tumhAre lie kucha aisI cIz2oM ko vaidha kara dU~, jo pahale tumapara harAma kI gaI thIM| tathA jo kucha maiMne tumase kahA hai, usakI satyatA para maiM tumhAre pAsa eka spaSTa tarka lekara AyA hU~| ataH allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara, usase Daro aura maiM jisa bAta kI ora tumheM bulAtA hU~, usameM merI AjJA kA pAlana karo|

aisA isalie hai kyoMki allAha hI merA pAlanahAra aura tumhArA pAlanahAra hai| cunA~ce vahI akelI AjJA mAnane aura Darane ke yogya hai| ataH tuma akele usI kI ibAdata karo| yaha jo maiMne tumheM allAha kI ibAdata karane aura usase Darane kA Adeza diyA hai, yahI sIdhA mArga hai, jisameM koI Teढ़ nahIM|

jaba IsA alaihissalAma ko unake kufra para Agraha kA AbhAsa huA, to unhoMne banI isarAIla ko saMbodhita karate hue kahA: allAha kI ora bulAne meM merI sahAyatA kauna karegA? unake anuyAyiyoM meM se cuniMdA logoM ne kahA: hama allAha ke dharma ke samarthaka haiM| hama allAha para ImAna lAe aura hamane ApakA anusaraNa kiyA| aura - ai IsA! - Apa gavAha raheM ki hama allAha ko ekamAtra pUjya mAnate hue aura usakI AjJAkAritA ke sAtha usake adhIna haiM|

ha़vAriyoM ne yaha bhI kahA: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hama usa iMjIla para ImAna lAe jo tUne utArA tathA hamane IsA alaihissalAma kA anusaraNa kiyA| ataH tU hameM una satya kI gavAhI dene vAloM meM zAmila kara le, jo tujhapara aura tere rasUloM para ImAna lAe|

banI isarAIla ke kAphiroM ne sAjiza racI aura unhoMne IsA alaihissalAma kI hatyA karane kA prayAsa kiyA| to allAha ne unake khilApha gupta yojanA banAI| isalie usane unheM unakI gumarAhI meM chor3a diyA aura eka anya vyakti ko IsA alaihissalAma se milatA julatA rUpa-raMga pradAna kara diyA| aura allAha yojanA banAne vAloM meM sabase acchA hai| kyoMki allAha apane duzmanoM ke virUddha jo yojanA banAtA hai, usase bar3hakara kisI kI yojanA nahIM ho sakatI|

allAha ne unake viruddha usa samaya bhI yojanA banAI, jaba usane IsA alaihissalAma ko saMbodhita karate hue kahA: ai IsA! maiM tumheM mRtyu ke binA qabz2a kara lU~gA, aura tumhAre zarIra aura AtmA ko apane pAsa uThA lU~gA, tathA tumheM una logoM kI gaMdagI se zuddha aura unase dUra kara dU~gA, jinhoMne tumhAre sAtha kufra kiyA aura una logoM ko jinhoMne sacce dharma para tumhArA anusaraNa kiyA - jisameM muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama para ImAna lAnA bhI zAmila hai - pramANa aura prabhutva evaM gaurava ke sAtha qiyAmata ke dina taka una logoM ke Upara kara dU~gA, jinhoMne tumhArA inakAra kiyA| phira tumheM qiyAmata ke dina merI hI ora lauTakara AnA hai| to maiM tumhAre bIca saccAI ke sAtha usa cIz2a ke bAre meM phaisalA karU~gA, jisameM tuma matabheda kiyA karate the|

jina logoM ne ApakA aura usa satya kA inakAra kiyA jo Apa unake pAsa lekara Ae, to maiM unheM duniyA meM qatla, qaida tathA apamAna Adi ke dvArA, tathA Aqhirata meM Aga kI yAtanA ke dvArA kaThora daMDa dU~gA| aura unake pAsa koI sahAyaka na hoMge, jo unase yAtanA dUra kara sakeM|

aura jo loga Apapara aura usa satya para ImAna lAe jo Apa unake pAsa lekara Ae, aura namAz2a, z2akAta, roz2A aura riztedAroM ke sAtha sadvyavahAra ityAdi jaise acche karma kie; allAha unheM unake karmoM kA pUrA badalA degA, usameM kucha kamI nahIM karegA| yaha bAta muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke IzdUtatva se pahale masIha ke anuyAyiyoM ke bAre meM hai, jinakI svayaM masIha ne zubha sUcanA dI thI| aura allAha atyAcAriyoM se prema nahIM karatA| aura sabase bar3A atyAcAra allAha ke sAtha kisI ko sAjhI banAnA tathA usake rasUloM ko jhuThalAnA hai|

yaha jo hama Apako IsA alaihissalAma kA samAcAra paढ़kara sunA rahe haiM, isa bAta ko pramANita karane vAlI spaSTa nizAniyoM meM se hai ki ApakI ora jo kucha utArA gayA hai vaha satya hai| tathA vaha Darane vAloM ke lie dRr3ha upadeza hai, jisameM bAtila (asatya) kA samAveza nahIM ho sakatA|

niHsaMdahe allAha ke nikaTa IsA alaihissalAma ko paidA karane kA udAharaNa, Adama alaihissalAma ko, binA pitA aura mAtA ke, thor3I-sI miTTI se paidA karana kI taraha hai| kevala allAha ne usase kahA: "mAnava bana jA" to vaha vaisA hI ho gayA, jaisA allAha ne cAhA thA| phira ye loga kaise dAvA karate haiM ki IsA alaihissalAma pUjya haiM, yaha tarka dete hue ki vaha binA pitA ke paidA kie gae the? hAlA~ki ve svIkAra karate haiM ki Adama alaihissalAma mAnava haiM, jabaki vaha binA pitA aura mAtA ke paidA kie gae the?!

IsA alaihissalAma ke bAre meM jisa saccAI meM koI saMdeha nahIM, vaha vahI hai jo Apapara Apake pAlanahAra kI ora se utarI hai| ataH Apa saMdeha evaM saMkoca karane vAloM meM se na baneM, balki Apako usa satya para dRr3ha rahanA cAhie jisa para Apa qAyama haiM|

(ai rasUla!) Apase najarAna ke IsAiyoM meM se jo bhI IsA alaihissalAma ke mAmale meM bahasa kare, yaha dAvA karate hue ki vaha allAha ke baMde nahIM haiM, isake pazcAta ki unake bAre meM Apake pAsa sahI jJAna A cukA; to unase kaha deM: Ao, hama apane putroM aura tumhAre putroM, apanI striyoM aura tumhArI striyoM ko bulA leM aura apane Apako aura tumheM bhI, aura hama saba ikaTThe ho jAe~, aura phira allAha se gir3agir3Akara vinatI kareM ki vaha hamAre aura tumhAre bIca jhUTha bolane vAloM para apanA zrApa (lA'nata) bheje|

yaha jo hamane Apako IsA alaihissalAma ke viSaya meM batAyA, nizcaya vahI saccI qhabara hai jisameM koI jhUTha yA saMdeha nahIM hai| tathA akele allAha ke sivA koI satya pUjya nahIM| niHsaMdeha allAha apane rAjya meM zaktizAlI, tathA apane prabaMdhana, Adeza aura racanA meM hikamata vAlA hai|

((ai ImAna vAlo) kitAba aura sunnata ko maz2abUtI se pakar3e raho aura aisA kArya na karo jisase matabheda meM par3a jAo| aura tuma apane Upara allAha kI usa kRpA ko yAda karo, jaba tuma islAma se pUrva eka-dUsare ke zatru the, choTI se choTI bAta para Apasa meM lar3ate the| phira usane islAma ke dvArA tumhAre diloM ko jor3a diyA| cunAMce tuma usakI kRpA se eka dUsare para dayA karane vAle tathA eka dUsare kI bhalAI cAhane vAle dhArmika bhAI bana gae| hAlA~ki isase pUrva tuma kuphra ke kAraNa Aga meM praveza karane ke kagAra para the| phira allAha ne tumheM islAma ke dvArA usase bacA liyA aura tumheM ImAna ke lie mArgadarzana kiyA| jisa taraha allAha ne tumhAre lie ise bayAna kiyA hai, usI taraha vaha tumhAre lie ve sArI bAteM bayAna karatA hai, jo duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM tumhArI sthitiyoM ko sudhArane vAlI haiM| tAki tuma sIdhA mArga pA sako aura dhArmikatA ke patha para cala sako|

(ai ImAna vAlo) tumhAre aMdara eka samUha aisA honA cAhie jo hara usa bhalAI kI ora bulAe jo allAha ko pasaMda hai, vaha usa nekI kA Adeza de jo zarIyata se pramANita hai aura zuddha buddhi use acchA samajhatI hai, tathA usa burAI se roke jisase zarIyata ne rokA hai aura zuddha buddhi use burA samajhatI hai| tathA isa guNa se susajjita loga hI duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM saphalatA prApta karane vAle haiM|

(ai ImAna vAlo) tuma una kitAba vAloM kI taraha na ho jAo, jo vibheda karake girohoM tathA daloM meM baTa gae| unhoMne allAha kI ora se unake pAsa spaSTa nizAniyA~ A jAne ke bAda apane dharma ke bAre meM matabheda kiyA| aura ina ukta logoM ke lie allAha kI ora se bar3I yAtanA hai|

yaha bar3A az2Aba unapara pralaya ke dina utaregA, jaba ImAna vAloM ke cehare khuzI aura prasannatA se camaka rahe hoMge aura kAfiroM ke cehare du:kha aura udAsI se kAle par3a jAeMge| cunAMce usa mahAna dina para jina logoM ke cehare kAle par3a gae hoMge, unheM DA~Tate hue kahA jAegA: kyA tumane, apanI puSTi aura svIkRti ke bAda, allAha ke ekezvaravAda aura usake usa vacana kA inakAra kara diyA, jo usane tumase liyA thA ki tuma usake sAtha kisI bhI cIz2a ko sAjhI nahIM ThaharAogeॽ! ataH tuma allAha ke usa az2Aba kA svAda cakho jo usane tumhAre lie tumhAre kuphra ke kAraNa taiyAra kara rakhA hai|
aura jinake cehare camaka rahe hoMge, unakA ThikAnA nematoM vAlI jannatoM meM hogA, jinameM ve hamezA raheMge| ve aisI nematoM meM hoMge, jo na kabhI khatma hoMgI aura na kabhI badaleMgI|

(ai nabI) hama Apako allAha ke vacana evaM cetAvanI para AdhArita ye AyateM, samAcAra meM saccAI aura prAvadhAnoM meM nyAya ke sAtha paढ़kara sunAte haiM| aura allAha saMsAra vAloM meM se kisI para bhI atyAcAra nahIM karanA cAhatA, balki vaha kisI ko usake hAthoM kI kamAI ke kAraNa hI daMDita karatA hai|

jo kucha AkAzoM meM aura jo kucha dharatI meM hai sabakA svAmI (rAjA) allAha sarvazaktimAna hai, racanA kI dRSTi se bhI aura prabaMdhana kI dRSTi se bhI, aura usakI sArI sRSTi kA mAmalA aMtataH usI sarvazaktimAna kI ora lauTanA hai| phira vaha unameM se hara eka ko usakI pAtratA ke anusAra badalA degA|

(ai muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI ummata ke logo!) tuma apane ImAna evaM karma meM sabase acchI ummata ho, jise allAha ne logoM ke lie prakaTa kiyA hai, aura tuma logoM ke lie sabase adhika lAbhakArI loga ho, tuma usa acchI bAta kA Adeza dete ho jo zarIyata se pramANita hai aura zuddha buddhi use acchA samajhatI hai, aura usa burAI se rokate ho jisase zarIyata ne rokA hai aura zuddha buddhi use burA samajhatI hai| aura tuma allAha para dRr3ha vizvAsa rakhate ho, jisakI tumhAre kArya se puSTi hotI hai| aura yadi kitAba vAle yahUdI aura IsAI muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama para ImAna lAte, to yaha unake lie duniyA evaM Aqha़irata donoM meM behatara hotA| kitAba vAloM meM se bahuta kama loga haiM, jo muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI lAI huI zarIyata para vizvAsa rakhate haiM, jabaki unameM se adhikAMza loga allAha ke dharma aura usakI zarIyata se bAhara haiM|

ve cAhe jitanI bhI duzmanI kara leM, ve tumheM - ai ImAna vAlo - tumhAre dharma tathA tumhArI jAnoM ke saMbaMdha meM koI hAni nahIM pahu~cA sakate| ve kevala apanI z2abAna se dharma para doSAropaNa karake tathA tumhArA maz2Aka ur3Akara, tumheM kaSTa de sakate haiM| yadi ve tumhAre sAtha yuddha kareM, to tumhAre sAmane parAjita hokara bhAga khar3e hoMge aura tumhAre viruddha unakI kabhI bhI sahAyatA nahIM kI jAegI|

yahUdI jahA~ bhI raheM, apamAna aura tiraskAra unheM ghere hue aura unapara hAvI hai| ataH ve usI samaya surakSita raha sakate haiM, jaba unheM sarvazaktimAna allAha kI ora se yA logoM kI ora se vacana athavA zaraNa (surakSA) mila jAe| tathA ve allAha ke prakopa va krodha ke pAtra bana gae haiM aura z2arUrata aura daridratA unapara cAroM ora se ghera dI gaI hai| aura yaha saba isa kAraNa huA ki ve allAha kI nizAniyoM kA inakAra karate aura allAha ke nabiyoM kI anyAyapUrvaka hatyA karate the| aura aisA isalie - bhI - huA ki ve avajJA karate aura allAha kI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karate the|

jaba allAha ne ahle kitAba ke adhikAMza logoM kI sthiti kA varNana kiyA, to unameM se eka aise samUha kI sthiti kA bhI varNana kiyA jo satya para sudRr3ha aura usapara sthApita hai| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
kitAba vAle apanI sthiti meM samAna nahIM haiM| balki unameM se eka samUha allAha ke dharma para sudRr3ha hai aura allAha ke Adeza va niSedha kA pAlana karatA haiM| ve rAta kI ghar3iyoM meM allAha kI AyatoM kA pATha karate haiM jabaki ve allAha ke lie namAz2a par3ha rahe hote haiM| yaha samUha paigaMbara muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke nabI banAe jAne se pahale thA aura unameM se jise nubuvvata kA samaya kAla milA, usane islAma grahaNa kara liyA|

ve allAha tathA aMtima dina para dRr3ha vizvAsa rakhate haiM, aura acchI bAtoM aura bhalAI kA Adeza dete haiM, tathA ghRNita bAtoM aura burAI se rokate haiM, aura acche kAryoM meM jaldI karate haiM, tathA nekiyoM ke avasaroM kA lAbha uThAte haiM| aura ina guNoM se viziSTa loga hI allAha ke aise baMde haiM, jinake irAde aura kArya acche haiM|

ye loga jo bhI thor3A yA bahuta acchA kArya kareMge, usakA puNya kadApi akAratha nahIM jAegA aura usake pratiphala meM kamI nahIM kI jAegI| aura allAha una parahez2agAra logoM ko bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai, jo usake AdezoM kA pAlana karate tathA usakI manA kI huI cIz2oM se bacate haiM| unake kAryoM meM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai aura vaha unheM unakA badalA degA|

niHsaMdeha jina logoM ne allAha aura usake rasUla kA inakAra kiyA, unake dhana aura unakI saMtAna allAha ke muqAbale meM unake kucha bhI kAma nahIM AeMge| ve na unase usake az2Aba ko dUra kareMge aura na unake lie usakI dayA ko lAeMge| balki unakI pIr3A aura kheda meM vRddhi kara deMge| tathA vahI loga naraka vAle haiM jo usameM hamezA raheMge|

ye kAfira (nAstika) loga puNya ke rAstoM meM jo kucha kharca karate haiM aura ve usake pratiphala kI jo pratIkSA karate haiM, usakA udAharaNa usa havA kI taraha hai jisameM atyadhika ThaMDa ho, jo kisI aisI qauma kI khetI ko laga jAe jinhoMne pApoM Adi ke dvArA apane Apa para atyAcAra kiyA ho, aura vaha use barbAda kara de, hAlA~ki unheM usase acchI paidAvAra kI AzA thI| to jisa taraha isa havA ne khetI ko naSTa kara diyA aura usase lAbha nahIM uThAyA jA sakA, usI prakAra kuphra unake una kAryoM ke pratiphala ko vyartha (amAnya) kara degA jisakI ve AzA rakhate haiM| allAha ne unapara atyAcAra nahIM kiyA - allAha aisA karane se sarvocca hai -, balki unhoMne allAha kA inakAra karake tathA usake rasUloM ko jhuThalAkara svayaM apane Apa para atyAcAra kiyA|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! tuma ImAna vAloM ko chor3akara dUsaroM ko apanA jigarI dosta aura aMtaraMga mitra na banAo, jinheM tuma apane bhedoM aura viziSTa sthitiyoM kI jAnakArI do| kyoMki ve tumhArI sthiti bigAr3ane aura tumheM nukasAna pahu~cAne meM koI kamI nahIM karate haiM| unakI icchA hai ki tumheM hAni aura kaSTa pahu~ce| tumhAre dharma para Aropa lagAkara, tumhAre bIca phUTa DAlakara aura tumhAre bhedoM ko prakaTa karake unhoMne apane mu~ha se ghRNA aura duzmanI ko prakaTa kara diyA hai| aura jo nafarata ve apane hradaya meM chipAe baiThe haiM, vaha isase kahIM bar3hakara hai| (ai momino) hamane tumhAre sAmane usa cIz2a ke spaSTa pramANa rakha die haiM, jisameM tumhAre loka aura paraleka ke hita nihita haiM, yadi tuma apane pAlanahAra kI ora utArI gaI AyatoM ko samajha sakate ho|

dekho (ai ImAna vAlo!) tuma una logoM se prema karate ho aura unake lie acchAI kI AzA karate ho, jabaki ve tumase prema nahIM karate aura na tumhAre lie acchAI kI kAmanA karate haiM, balki isake viparIta ve tumase dveSa rakhate haiM| tathA tuma sabhI pustakoM para vizvAsa rakhate ho, jinameM unakI pustakeM bhI zAmila haiM| paraMtu ve usa pustaka para ImAna nahIM rakhate jo allAha ne tumhAre nabI para utArI hai| jaba ve tumase milate haiM, to apanI z2abAna se kahate haiM ki hamane satya ko mAna liyA, paraMtu jaba ve akele meM hote haiM, to tumhArI ekatA, akhaMDatA aura islAma kI garimA tathA apanA apamAna dekhakara zoka aura krodha meM apanI u~galiyoM ke poroM ko kATate haiM| (ai nabI!) Apa una logoM se kaha dIjie: tuma isI hAla meM raho yahA~ taka ki zoka aura krodha meM mara jAo| niHsaMdeha allAha diloM meM pAe jAne vAle ImAna aura kufra tathA acchAI aura burAI ko jAnatA hai|

yadi (ai ImAna vAlo!) tumheM koI nemata mila jAe, jaise zatruoM para vijaya athavA dhana aura saMtAna meM vRddhi; to unheM du:kha aura ciMtA ghera letI hai, aura yadi tumheM koI vipatti pahu~ce, jaise duzmanoM kI jIta athavA dhana evaM saMtAna meM kamI, to isase ve prasanna hote haiM aura tumhArI vipadA para khuza hote haiM| lekina yadi tuma allAha ke AdezoM tathA usake nirdhArita bhAgyoM para dhairya se kAma lo aura apane Upara usake krodha se bacate raho; to unake chala karane aura kaSTa dene se tumheM koI nukasAna nahIM hogA| ni:saMdeha allAha unakI cAlabAz2iyoM se avagata hai aura vaha unheM nirAza lauTAegA|

tathA (ai nabI) Apa usa samaya ko yAda kIjie, jaba Apa madInA se, uhuda ke maidAna meM, muzrikoM se yuddha ke lie nikala par3e, jahA~ Apane ImAna vAloM ko unake yuddha ke sthAnoM para niyukta karanA AraMbha kiyA| cunAMce Apane pratyeka vyakti ko usakA sthAna batAyA| aura allAha tumhArI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, tumhAre kAmoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|

(ai nabI) yAda kIjie jo kucha vizvAsiyoM ke do samUhoM banU salimA aura banU hArisA ke sAtha ghaTita huA, jisa samaya ve sAhasahIna ho gae aura munAphiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) ke vApasa Ane para vApasI kA irAdA kara liyA, hAlA~ki allAha unheM lar3AI para sudRr3ha rakhakara tathA unheM unake usa irAde se pherakara unakI sahAyatA karane vAlA hai| aura mominoM ko apanI sabhI sthitiyoM meM allAha hI para bharosA karanA cAhie|

aura allAha badra ke yuddha meM bahudevavAdiyoM ke viruddha tumhArI sahAyatA kara cukA hai, jabaki tuma apanI saMkhyA aura upakaraNoM kI kamI ke kAraNa kamaz2ora the| ataH allAha se Daro, tAki tuma apane Upara usakI nematoM ke lie AbhArI ho sako|

(ai nabI) usa samaya ko yAda kIjie, jaba vizvAsiyoM ke bahudevavAdiyoM ke lie Ane vAlI sahAyatA ke bAre meM sunane ke bAda Apane unheM badra kI lar3AI meM sAhasa dilAte hue unase kahA: kyA tumhAre lie yaha paryApta nahIM hogA ki allAha tumheM lar3AI meM majabUta karane ke lie apanI ora se utAre huai tIna haz2Ara phariztoM ke dvArA tumhArI sahAyatA kare?!

hA~ (kyoM nahIM), tumhAre lie itanA hI kAphI hai| jabaki tumhAre lie allAha kI ora se eka anya madada kI zubha sUcanA hai: yadi tuma lar3AI meM dhairya se kAma lo aura allAha se Darate raho, aura tumhAre duzmanoM ko tvarita madada mila jAe aura ve tumapara caढ़ daur3eM, yadi aisA hotA hai, to tumharA pAlanahAra pA~ca haz2Ara phariztoM ke dvArA tumhArI sahAyatA karegA, jo svayaM ko aura apane ghor3oM ko spaSTa nizAna ke sAtha cihnita kie hoMge|

aura allAha ne phariztoM ke dvArA isa sahAyatA aura isa ApUrti ko kevala tumhAre lie eka zubha sUcanA banAyA hai, jisase tumhAre diloM ko AzvAsana ho jAe| anyathA, vAstava meM sahAyatA mAtra ina z2AhirI kAraNoM se nahIM hotI, balki vAstavika sahAyatA usa prabhutvazAlI allAha kI ora se AtI hai, jise koI parAjita nahIM kara sakatA, aura jo apane Akalana va anumAna aura apane vidhAna meM hikamata vAlA (tatvadarzI) hai|

yaha madada (jIta) jo tumheM badra kI lar3AI meM prApta huI hai, usase allAha kA uddezya yaha thA ki kAfiroM ke eka samUha ko hatyA kara naSTa kara de aura dUsare samUha ko apamAnita kara de tathA unakI parAjaya se unheM krodhita kara de, phira ve viphalatA aura apamAna ke sAtha lauTeM|

uhuda kI lar3AI meM bahudevavAdiyoM kI ora se jo kucha atyAcAra huA usake bAda jaba rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ne unheM vinAza kA zApa diyA, to allAha ne Apase pharamAyA: unake mAmale meM Apako koI adhikAra nahIM, balki sArA mAmalA allAha ke hAtha meM hai| ataH Apa dhairya rakheM yahA~ taka ki allAha tumhAre bIca phaisalA kara de, yA unheM taubA kI taufIka pradAna kara de aura ve islAma grahaNa karaleM, yA ve niraMtara apane kuphra (avizvAsa) hI para bane raheM to allAha unheM yAtanA se pIr3ita kare, kyoMki ve yAtanA ke pAtra haiM|

jo kucha AkAzoM meM aura jo kucha dharatI meM hai, saba allAha kA hai, racanA kI dRSTi se bhI aura prabaMdhana kI dRSTi se bhI hai| vaha apane baMdoM meM se jise cAhatA hai, apanI dayA se kSamA kara detA hai, aura jise cAhatA hai apane nyAya se saz2A detA hai| aura allAha apane taubA (pazcAtApa) karane vAle baMdoM ko kSamA karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! apane mUla dhana jo tumane udhAra die the, usa para kaI guNA baढ़Akara byAja lene se baco, jaisA ki jAhiliyata (ajJAnatA) kAla ke loga kiyA karate the| aura allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usakI manA kI huI bAtoM se bacakara usase Daro, tAki tuma duniyA aura Aqhirata kI jo bhalAI cAhate ho, use prApta kara sako|
aura tuma acche kArya karake aura varjanAoM ko chor3akara, apane aura usa Aga ke bIca jise allAha ne kAphiroM ke lie taiyAra kara rakhI hai, bacAva yA saMrakSaNa kA sAdhana apanAo|
tathA tuma AdezoM kA pAlana kara aura varjanAoM ko tyAga kara allAha aura usake rasUla kI AjJA kA pAlana karo| tAki tuma duniya evaM Aqhirata meM usakI dayA prApta kara sako|

acche kAma karane aura vibhinna prakAra ke nekI ke kAmoM ke dvArA allAha kI nikaTatA prApta karane meM jaldI aura pahala karo, tAki tumheM allAha kI mahAna kSamA mila sake aura tuma aisI jannata meM praveza kara sako, jisakI caur3AI AkAzoM aura dharatI ke barAbara hai, jise allAha ne apane Darane vAle baMdoM ke lie taiyAra kiyA hai|

allAha se Darane vAle (taqvA vAle) ve loga haiM, jo kaThinAI evaM AsAnI kI sthiti meM apanA dhana allAha ke mArga meM kharca karate haiM, tathA badalA lene kI kSamatA hone ke uparAMta bhI apane krodha ko rokane vAle aura jisane unake sAtha anyAya kiyA hai use kSamA kara dene vAle haiM| aura allAha aisI naitikatA se susajjita paropakArI logoM se pyAra karatA hai|

aura ve aise loga haiM ki jaba ve koI bar3A gunAha kara baiThate haiM yA choTe gunAha meM par3akara apanA bhAga kama kara lete haiM, to allAha ko yAda karate haiM, tathA avajJAkAriyoM ke lie usakI dhamakI aura AjJAkAriyoM ke lie usake vacana ko yAda karate haiM, phira ve apane pAlanahAra se pazcAtApI (lajjita) hokara apane gunAhoM ko chipAne aura unapara pakar3a na karane kI yAcanA karate haiM| kyoMki gunAhoM ko kevala allAha hI kSamA kara sakatA hai| aura ve apane gunAhoM para aDiga nahIM rahate haiM, jabaki ve jAnate haiM ki ve doSI haiM aura yaha ki allAha sabhI gunAhoM ko kSamA kara detA hai|

ina acche guNoM aura gauravazAlI vizeSatAoM se susajjita logoM kA badalA yaha hai ki allAha unake gunAhoM para pardA DAla degA aura unheM kSamA kara degA| tathA unake lie Aqhirata meM aise bAg2a haiM, jinake mahaloM ke nIce nahareM bahatI hoMgI, jinameM ve hamezA raheMge| aura allAha kA AjJApAlana karane vAloM ke lie yaha badalA kyA hI acchA hai|

jaba uhuda ke dina mominoM ko unapara utarane vAlI vipadA ke dvArA Az2amAyA gayA, to allAha ne unheM sAMtvanA dete hue faramAyA: tumase pUrva bhI kAphiroM ke vinAza kie jAne tathA mominoM kI parIkSA ke pazcAta una kA aMta sumaMgala hone ke kaI IzvarIya paraMparAeM guz2ara cukI haiM| ataH tuma dharatI meM calo-phiro aura sIkha prApta karate hue dekho ki allAha aura usake rasUla ko jhuThalAne vAloM kA aMta kaise huA| unake ghara ujar3a gae aura unakA rAjya samApta ho gayA|

yaha quraAna sabhI logoM ke lie satya kA varNana aura asatya se cetAvanI hai, tathA vaha allAha se Darane vAloM (dharmiyoM) ke lie mArgadarzana kA saMketa aura (burAI kA) pratirodhaka hai| kyoMki yahI loga usake mArgadarzana aura nirdeza se lAbha uThAne vAle haiM|

(ai ImAna vAlo) tuma kamaz2ora na par3o aura na hI uhuda ke dina pahu~cane vAlI taklIpha para zoka karo, aura na hI tumhAre lie aisA karanA ucita hai| kyoMki apane ImAna ke kAraNa tuma hI sarvocca ho, tathA allAha kI sahAyatA aura usakI madada kI AzA rakhane ke kAraNa tuma hI bulaMda ho, yadi tuma allAha aura usake apane sadAcArI baMdoM se kie hue vAde para vizvAsa rakhane vAle ho|

(ai ImAna vAlo) yadi uhuda ke dina tumheM ghAva lage haiM aura tuma meM se kucha loga zahIda hue haiM, to isI prakAra kAphiroM ko bhI ghAva lage haiM aura unake bhI loga mAre gae haiM| aura allAha dinoM ko mominoM aura kAfiroM ke bIca jaise cAhatA hai, vijaya aura parAjaya ke sAtha pheratA (badalatA) rahatA hai; jisake pIche vyApaka hikamateM haiM, jinameM se eka yaha hai ki: sacce ImAna vAle, munAfiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) se spaSTa ho jAe~| tathA eka hikamata yaha bhI hai ki: allAha jise cAhe apane rAste meM zahAdata se sammAnita kare| aura allAha apane rAste meM jihAda ko chor3akara khuda para atyAcAra karane vAloM se pyAra nahIM karatA|

ina hikamatoM meM se eka hikamata, ImAna vAloM ko pApoM se zuddha karanA aura unake pakSa ko munAphikoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) se pavitra karanA hai, aura tAki allAha kAphiroM kA vinAza kara de aura unheM miTA de|

(ai ImAna vAlo) kyA tumane samajha rakhA hai ki binA kisI aisI parIkSaNa aura dhairya ke jannata meM praveza kara jAoge, jisase allAha ke rAste meM sacce dila se jihAda karane vAloM aura isa rAste meM Ane vAlI musIbatoM ke samaya sabra karane vAloM kI pahacAna ho jAe?!

(ai ImAna vAlo) tuma to mauta aura usakI kaThinAiyoM kA sAmanA karane se pahale, kAphiroM se muThabher3a kI kAmanA kiyA karate the, tAki tumheM bhI allAha ke rAste meM zahIda hone kA saubhAgya prApta ho jAe, jisa taraha ki badra kI lar3AI meM tumhAre bhAiyoM ko usakA saubhAgya prApta huA thA| lo, aba tumane uhuda kI lar3AI ke dina vaha bhI dekha liyA, jisakI tumane kAmanA kI thI, aura aba tuma use khulI A~khoM se dekha rahe ho|

uhuda ke dina jaba logoM meM yaha aphavAha phaila gaI ki nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI hatyA ho gaI, to isake kAraNa jo musalamAna lar3AI se ruka gae, unheM phaTakArate hue allAha taAlA ne yaha Ayata utArI, pharamAyA:
aura muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama bhI apane pUrvavartI allAha ke rasUloM kI jAti ke eka rasUla haiM, jo mara gae yA mAra die gae| to kyA yadi vaha mara jAe~ athavA mAra die jAe~, to tuma apane dharma se palaTa jAoge aura jihAda chor3a doge?! aura tuma meM se jo bhI apane dharma se phira jAegA, vaha allAha ko kucha bhI nukasAna nahIM pahuMcAegA; kyoMki vaha bar3A zaktivAna, prabhutvazAlI hai| balki dharmatyAgI khuda ko nukasAna pahu~cAegA, kyoMki isa prakAra vaha apane Apako duniyA aura Aqhirata donoM jagahoM ke ghATe meM DAla degA| aura allAha apane kRtajJoM ko, unake usake dharma para jame rahane aura usake rAste meM jihAda karane ke kAraNa, sabase acchA badalA pradAna karegA|

aura koI bhI prANI allAha ke phaisale hI se maratA hai, jaba vaha usa avadhi ko pUrA kara letA hai jise allAha ne likhI thI aura use usakA aMta banA diyA thA, na vaha usase Age bar3ha sakatA hai, na pIche raha sakatA| aura jo apane karma se duniyA kA badalA cAhatA hai, hama use utanA hI dete haiM jitanA usake nasIba meM hotA hai, aura Aqhirata meM usakA koI hissA nahIM hogA| aura jo vyakti apane karma se Aqhirata meM allAha kA badalA cAhatA hai, hama use usakA badalA deMge| aura hama zIghra hI una logoM ko bar3A badalA deMge, jo apane pAlanahAra ke AbhArI haiM|

aura allAha ke nabiyoM meM se kitane hI nabI aise haiM, jinake sAtha milakara unake anuyAyiyoM meM se aneka samUhoM ne lar3AI lar3I| to ve allAha ke rAste meM pahu~cane vAlI hatyA aura ghAva ke kAraNa jihAda se kAyara nahIM hue aura na ve duzmana se lar3ane meM kamaz2ora par3e aura na unake sAmane ghuTane Teke| balki unhoMne dhairya se kAma liyA aura DaTe rahe| aura allAha apane rAste meM kaSToM aura kaThinAiyoM para dhairya se kAma lene vAloM se prema karatA hai|

jaba ina dhairya se kAma lene vAloM para yaha vipatti AI, to unakA kevala yaha kahanA thA ki: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hamAre pApoM aura hamAre apane mAmale meM sImAoM ke ullaMghana ko mAfa kara de, aura hamAre duzmana se muThabher3a ke samaya hamAre paira jamAe rakha aura apane sAtha kufra karane vAloM para hameM vijaya pradAna kara|

to allAha ne unheM vijaya aura sazaktIkaraNa pradAna kara duniyA kA badalA diyA, aura Akhirata meM acchA badalA isa taraha diyA ki unase prasanna ho gayA tathA nematoM vAlI jannatoM meM hamezA bAkI rahane vAlI nemateM pradAna kIM| aura allAha acchI taraha ibAdata aura acchA vyavahAra karane vAle logoM se prema karatA hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! yadi tuma yahUdiyoM, IsAiyoM aura bahudevavAdiyoM meM se kAphiroM ke sIdhe rAste se haTAne vAle AdezoM ko mAnane lago ge, to ve tumheM tumhAre ImAna lAne ke bAda tumhArI purAnI avasthA arthAta kuphra kI ora lauTA deMge, phira tuma duniyA evaM Aqhirata kA ghATA uThAne vAle bana jAoge|

yadi tuma ina kAfiroM kA pAlana karoge, to ye kabhI tumhArI sahAyatA nahIM kareMge| balki allAha hI tumhAre zatruoM ke viruddha tumhArA sahAyaka hai| ataH tuma usI kI AjJA kA pAlana karo| vaha sarvazaktimAna sabase acchA sahAyaka hai| isalie tumheM usake bAda kisI kI bhI AvazyakatA nahIM hai|

hama allAha kA inakAra karane vAle logoM ke diloM meM atyadhika bhaya DAla deMge, tAki ve tumhAre sAmane yuddha meM Thahara na pAe~| aisA isa kAraNa hogA ki unhoMne allAha ke aise sAjhI ThaharA lie haiM, jinakI ve apanI icchAoM ke anusAra pUjA karate haiM, jisake lie allAha ne unapara koI tarka nahIM utArA| unakA ThikAnA jisakI ora ve Aqhirata meM lauTeMge, vaha Aga hai, aura Aga atyAcAriyoM kA kyA hI burA ThikAnA hai|

aura allAha ne uhuda ke dina tumhAre duzmanoM ke viruddha madada kA apanA vAdA pUrA kara dikhAyA, jaba tuma usakI anumati se unheM gaMbhIra rUpa se mAra rahe the, yahA~ taka ki jaba tumane kAyaratA dikhAI aura rasUla ke Adeza para jame rahane se kamaz2ora par3a gae aura isa bAta meM matabheda karane lage ki apane-apane sthAnoM para bane raheM yA apanA sthAna chor3akara g2anImata kA mAla jamA karane laga jAe~, aura tumane hara hAla meM apane sthAnoM para bane rahane se saMbaMdhita rasUla ke Adeza kI avahelanA kI| tumase yaha mAmalA isake bAda ghaTita huA ki allAha ne tumheM tumhAre duzmanoM para vijaya ke dRzya dikhA die, jise tuma pasaMda karate the| tumameM se kucha loga duniyA kA lAbha cAhate the aura ye ve loga the jinhoMne apanA sthAna chor3a diyA| tathA tuma meM se kucha loga Aqhirata kA badalA cAhate the aura ye vahI loga the, jo allAha ke rasUla ke Adeza kA pAlane karate hue apane sthAnoM para bane rahe| phira allAha ne tumheM unase phera diyA aura tumhArI parIkSA lene ke lie unheM tuma para prabhutva pradAna kara diyA, tAki vipatti para dhairya rakhane vAlA momina usa vyakti se prakaTa ho jAe jisakA paira phisala gayA aura usakI AtmA kamajora ho gaI| allAha ne tumhAre usake rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke Adeza kA ullaMghana karane ko kSamA kara diyA hai| allAha mominoM para bar3A anugraha karane vAlA hai ki usane unheM ImAna kA mArga dikhAyA, unake pApoM ko kSamA kara diyA aura unheM unakI musIbatoM para badalA diyA|

(ai ImAna vAlo!) usa samaya ko yAda karo jaba uhuda ke yuddha ke dina, rasUla ke Adeza kA ullaMghana karane ke kAraNa viphalatA kA sAmanA karane para, tuma pRthvI meM tez2I se bhAge jA rahe the, aura tumameM se koI bhI kisI ko mur3akara nahIM dekha rahA thA| jabaki rasUla tumhAre aura bahudevavAdiyoM ke bIca khar3e tumhAre pIche se tumheM yaha kahate hue bulA rahe the: allAha ke baMdo! merI ora Ao, allAha ke baMdo! merI ora Ao| ataH allAha ne isapara tumheM badale meM darda aura saMkaTa se pIr3ita kiyA kyoMki tuma vijaya aura g2anImata ke dhana se vaMcita ho gae, jisake bAda eka aura darda aura saMkaTa thA, kyoMki tumhAre bIca nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI hatyA kI qhabara phailA dI gaI| aura allAha ne tumheM isa ApadA se isalie pIr3ita kiyA, tAki tuma vijaya aura g2anImata ke dhana se vaMcita hone para, tathA hatyA aura ghAva se pIr3ita hone para dukhI na ho| kyoMki jaba tumheM yaha patA cala gayA ki nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI hatyA nahIM huI hai, to tumhAre lie hara musIbata aura takalIfa AsAna ho gaI| allAha tumhAre kAryoM se avagata hai, tumhAre diloM kI sthitiyoM tathA tumhAre zArIrika aMgoM ke kAryoM meM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai|

phira usane darda aura saMkaTa ke bAda tumapara saMtuSTi aura vizvAsa utAra diyA| tumameM se eka samUha (jinheM allAha ke vacana para bharosA thA) ko unake diloM kI zAMti evaM sthiratA ke kAraNa U~gha Ane lagI| jabaki dUsarA samUha aisA thA, jo isa zAMti aura U~gha se vaMcita thA| ye munAfiqa lega the, jinheM kevala khuda kI surakSA kI ciMtA thI| cunA~ce ve ciMtita aura bhayabhIta the, ve allAha ke bAre meM burA soca rahe the ki allAha apane rasUla kI madada nahIM karegA aura apane baMdoM kA samarthana nahIM karegA| jisa taraha ki ajJAnatA kAla ke una logoM kI soca thI, jinhoMne allAha kI haisiyata ke samAna usa kA sammAna nahIM kiyA| ye munAfiqa loga allAha se anabhijJa hone ke kAraNa kahate haiM: yuddha meM nikalane ke saMbaMdha meM hamase rAya nahIM lI gaI| yadi hamase rAya aura mazavarA liyA gayA hotA, to hama yuddha ke lie bAhara na nikalate| (ai nabI) isakA uttara dete hue kaha deM: "niHsaMdeha sabhI mAmale kA adhikAra kevala allAha ke hAtha meM hai| vaha jo cAhatA hai, bhAgya nirdhArita karatA hai aura jo cAhatA hai phaisalA karatA hai| aura usI ne tumhAre bhAgya meM nikalanA likha rakhA thA| ye munAfiqa loga apane diloM meM saMdeha aura burI soca (durbhAvanA) chipAe hue haiM, jo Apake sAmane z2Ahira nahIM karate| ve kahate haiM: yadi lar3AI ke lie nikalane ke saMbaMdha meM hamArI bAta mAnI gaI hotI, to hama isa sthAna para na mAre jAte| (ai nabI) Apa unakA khaMDana karate hue kaha dIjie: yadi tuma hatyA aura mRtyu ke sthAnoM se dUra apane gharoM meM bhI hote; taba bhI allAha ne tumameM se jinakA maranA likha diyA hai, ve avazya apane marane ke sthAnoM kI ora nikala Ate| allAha ne yaha saba isalie anivArya kiyA hai, tAki vaha tumhAre diloM ke irAdoM aura uddezyoM kA parIkSaNa kare aura unameM jo vizvAsa aura pAkhaMDa hai use alaga kara de| allAha usa cIz2a ko bhalI-bhA~ti jAnane vAlA hai jo usake baMdoM ke sInoM meM hai, usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai|

(ai muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke sAthiyo!) jisa dina uhuda ke maidAna meM, muzrikoM ke eka giroha kI bhir3aMta musalamAnoM ke eka samUha se huI, usa dina jo loga parAjita hue, unheM zaitAna ne unake kucha apane hI kie hue pApoM ke kAraNa, g2alatI karane para ubhArA| aura allAha ne apanI ora se kRpA evaM dayA karate hue unheM kSamA kara diyA aura unakI pakar3a nahIM kI| vAstava meM allAha taubA karane vAloM ko kSamA karane vAlA aura sahanazIla hai jo jaldI saz2A nahIM detA|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! tuma loga munAfiqoM meM se una kAfiroM ke samAna na ho jAo, jo apane riztedAroM se kahate haiM jaba ve AjIvikA kI talAza meM yAtrA karate haiM, yA yuddha meM nikalate haiM, phira mara jAte haiM yA qatla kara die jAte haiM, ki: "yadi ve hamAre pAsa hote aura bAhara na nikalate aura yuddha meM na gae hote, to na ve marate aura na qatla kie jAte|" allAha ne unake diloM meM yaha vicAra isalie DAlA tAki unheM apane diloM meM adhika se adhika pachatAvA (afasosa) aura duHkha ho| tathA akelA allAha hI hai jo apanI icchA se jIvana aura mRtyu detA hai| na to baiThe rahane se usakA nirdhArita nirNaya ruka sakatA hai aura na nikalane se vaha jaldI A sakatA hai| aura allAha tumhAre saba kAryoM ko dekha rahA hai| tumhAre karma usase chipe nahIM haiM aura vaha tumheM unakA badalA degA|

aura yadi (ai ImAna vAlo) tuma allAha ke rAste meM mAra die jAo yA mara jAo, to allAha avazya tumheM mahAna kSamA pradAna karegA aura apanI ora se tumapara aisI dayA karegA, jo tumhAre lie isa duniyA se tathA isameM duniyA vAle jo kucha usakI nazvara nemateM ikaTThA kara rahe haiM, usase kahIM behatara hai|
yadi tuma mara jAo cAhe kisI bhI sthiti meM tumhArI mRtyu ho, yA tuma mAra die jAo; to tuma saba allAha hI kI ora lauTAe jAoge; tAki vaha tumheM tumhAre karmoM kA badalA de|

allAha kI mahAna dayA ke kAraNa - ai nabI - ApakA vyavahAra apane sAthiyoM ke sAtha vinamra thA| yadi Apa apane kathana evaM karma meM sakhta tathA kaThora dila vAle hote, to ve Apake pAsa se haTa jAte| ataH Apa apane saMbaMdha meM unakI kotAhiyoM ko kSamA kareM aura unake lie kSamA kI yAcanA kareM| aura jina mAmaloM meM parAmarza kI AvazyakatA ho, una mAmaloM meM unakI rAya leM| phira jaba parAmarza ke bAda kisI bAta kA pakkA irAdA kara leM, to use kara gujareM aura allAha para bharosA kareM| niHsaMdeha allAha una logoM ko pasaMda karatA hai jo usapara bharosA karate haiM| cunA~ce vaha unheM taufIka pradAna karatA hai aura unakA samarthana karatA hai|

yadi allAha apanI sahAyatA aura sahayoga se tumhArA samarthana kare, to koI tumheM parAjita nahIM kara sakatA, bhale hI pRthvI ke loga tumhAre viruddha ikaTThe ho jAe~| aura yadi vaha tumhArI sahAyatA chor3a de aura tumheM svayaM tumhAre havAle kara de, to phira usake bAda koI bhI tumhArI sahAyatA nahIM kara sakatA| ataH vijaya kevala usI (allAha) ke hAtha meM hai, aura ImAna vAloM ko kevala allAha hI para bharosA karanA cAhie, kisI aura para nahIM|

kisI nabI ke lie yaha saMbhava nahIM hai ki allAha ne usake lie jo kucha viziSTa kara diyA hai usake alAvA g2anImata ke dhana meM se kucha lekara qhayAnata kare| aura tuma meM se jo koI g2anImata ke dhana meM se kucha lekara qhayAnata karegA, use qiyAmata ke dina apamAnita karake daMDita kiyA jAegA| cunA~ce vaha qhayAnata kI huI cIz2a ko uThAe hue sabhI logoM ke sAmane AegA| phira pratyeka prANI ko usake kie hue kA binA kamI ke pUrA-pUrA badalA diyA jAegA| tathA unake bure karmoM ko bar3hAkara, yA unake acche kAmoM ko kama karake unapara atyAcAra nahIM kiyA jAegA|

jo vyakti allAha kI prasannatA prApta karane vAlI cIz2oM yAnI ImAna aura acche karma kA pAlana kare, vaha allAha ke nikaTa usa vyakti ke samAna nahIM hai, jisane allAha kA inakAra kiyA aura bure kArya kie| jisake kAraNa vaha allAha kA sakhta krodha lekara lauTA aura usakA ThikAnA jahannama hai| aura yaha bahuta burA ThikAnA hai|

allAha ke nikaTa duniyA aura Akhirata meM unake sthAna alaga-alaga haiM| aura ve jo kucha karate haiM allAha use dekha rahA hai| usase koI cIz2a chipI nahIM hai aura vaha hara eka ko usake karma kA badalA degA|

vastutaH allAha ne mominoM ko anugraha pradAna kiyA aura una para bar3A upakAra kiyA hai ki unake aMdara unhIM meM se eka rasUla bhejA, jo unheM quraAna par3hakara sunAtA hai aura unheM zirka (bahudevavAda) aura duSTa naitikatA (durAcAra) se zuddha karatA hai, tathA unheM quraAna aura sunnata kI zikSA detA hai, hAlA~ki ve isa rasUla ke avataraNa se pUrva saMmArga se dUra khulI gumarAhI meM par3e the|

kyA (ai ImAna vAlo) jaba tumheM uhuda ke dina parAjita hone ke samaya eka vipatti kA sAmanA karanA par3A aura tumameM se kucha loga zahIda ho gae, jabaki tumane badra ke yuddha meM apane zatruoM ke isake dogunA logoM ko qatla kiyA thA aura baMdI banAyA thA, to tuma kahane lage: hameM yaha vipatti kahA~ se pahu~ca gaI, jabaki hama ImAna vAle haiM aura allAha ke nabI hamAre bIca upasthita haiM? (ai nabI) Apa kaha dIjie: yaha vipatti jo tumheM pahu~cI hai, vaha tumhAre hI kAraNa se AI hai jaba tumane Apasa meM vivAda kiyA aura rasUla kI avajJA kI| niHsaMdeha allAha hara cIz2a para zaktimAna hai| ataH vaha jisakI cAhe sahAyatA kare aura jise cAhe asahAya chor3a de|

aura uhuda ke dina tumhAre giroha aura muzrikoM ke giroha ke bIca muThabher3a ke samaya tumheM jisa parAjaya kA sAmanA karanA par3A, aura tumameM se kucha loga ghAyala aura kucha loga zahIda kara die gae, yaha saba allAha kI anumati aura usake faisale (qaz2A va qadara) ke anusAra thA; jisameM eka bar3I hikamata yaha nihita thI ki sacce ImAna vAle pratyakSa ho jAe~|

aura tAki una munAfiqoM kI (bhI) pahacAna ho jAe, jinase jaba kahA gayA ki: allAha ke rAste meM yuddha karo, yA musalamAnoM kA saMkhyAbala bar3hAkara pratirakSA karo, to unhoMne uttara diyA: "yadi hama jAnate ki yuddha hogA, to avazya tumhArA sAtha dete| lekina hama yaha nahIM dekhate haiM ki tumhAre aura una logoM ke bIca koI yuddha hone vAlA hai|" ve usa samaya usa sthiti kI apekSA jo unake vizvAsa ko iMgita karatI thI, usa sthiti ke adhika nikaTa the jo unake avizvAsa (kufra) ko iMgita karatI thI| ve apane mu~ha se aisI bAta kaha rahe the jo unake dila meM nahIM thI| aura allAha unake diloM ke bhedoM ko qhUba janatA hai aura zIghra hI vaha unheM isakI saz2A degA|

ye vahI loga haiM jo yuddha se pIche rahe aura apane una riztedAroM ke bAre meM, jo uhuda ke dina zahIda ho gae, kahane lage: "yadi ve hamArI bAta mAna lete aura yuddha ke lie na nikalate, to ve mAre nahIM jAte|" ai nabI! Apa unheM uttara dete hue kaha dIjie ki: to tuma apane Apa se mauta ko TAlakara dikhAo, yadi tuma apane isa dAve meM sacce ho ki agara ve tumhArI bAta mAna lete, to mAre na jAte, aura yaha ki tumhAre mRtyu se baca jAne kA kAraNa allAha ke rAste meM jihAda se pIche baiTha rahanA thA|

(ai nabI) Apa yaha mata samajheM ki jo loga allAha kI khAtira jihAda meM mAre gae the, ve mara cuke haiM| balki ve apane pAlanahAra ke pAsa usake sammAna ke ghara meM eka vizeSa jIvana jI rahe haiM, unheM vibhinna prakAra kI aisI roz2I milatI rahatI hai, jisakA jJAna kevala allAha ko hai|

allAha ne apanI kRpA se jo kucha unheM pradAna kiyA hai usa para ve khuzI aura AnaMda se abhibhUta haiM| ve isa AzA aura pratIkSA meM haiM ki unake ve bhAI jo duniyA meM raha gae haiM, unase A mileMge, aura ve bhI agara allAha ke rAste meM yuddha karate hue mAre jAe~ge, to unheM bhI unhIM kI taraha allAha kA anugraha prApta hogA| tathA unheM na apane sAmane Aqhirata kA bhaya hogA aura na ve duniyA kI sukha-sAmagrI ke chUTane para dukhI hoMge|

allAha ne yahUdiyoM ke kathana ko sunA jaba unhoMne kahA: “allAha garIba hai kyoMki usane hamase RNa mAMgA hai, aura hamAre pAsa jo dhana hai usase hama samRddha haiM|” unhoMne apane pAlanahAra para jo mithyAropaNa kiyA hai, hama use tathA unake anAdhikAra apane nabiyoM kI hatyA karane ko bhI avazya likha leMge| aura hama unase kaheMge: lo, Aga meM jalA dene vAlI yAtanA kA maz2A cakho|

ye vahI loga haiM jinhoMne - jhUTha bolate aura Aropa lagAte hue - kahA: "allAha ne hameM apanI pustakoM meM tathA apane nabiyoM kI z2ubAnI vasIyata kI hai ki hama kisI rasUla para usa samaya taka ImAna na lAe~, jaba taka vaha apanI saccAI sAbita karane ke lie koI camatkAra na lAe| aura isakA tarIqA yaha hai ki allAha kI nikaTatA prApta karane ke lie vaha dAna kare, jise AkAza se utarane vAlI Aga jalA de|" daraasala, una logoM ne allAha kI ora vasIyata kI nisabata karane aura rasUloM kI saccAI ke pramANoM ko uparyukta cIz2a meM sImita karane ke bAre meM allAha para jhUTha gar3hA hai| isIlie allAha ne apane nabI muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko Adeza diyA ki Apa unase kaheM: mujhase pahale kaI rasUla tumhAre pAsa apanI saccAI ke spaSTa pramANa lekara Ae, aura vaha qurbAnI bhI lAe jo tumane kahA thA jise AkAza se utarane vAlI Aga ne jalAnA thA, to phira tumane unheM kyoM jhuThalAyA aura unakI hatyA kyoM kI, yadi tuma apanI bAta meM sacce ho?

ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hamane eka ImAna kI ora bulAne vAle ko sunA – aura vaha tere paig2aMbara muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama haiM - jo yaha kahakara bulA rahe the: (logo,) tuma apane pAlanahAra allAha para ImAna lAo, jo ki ekamAtra pUjya hai| to hama usapara ImAna le Ae jisakI ora vaha bulA rahe the aura unakI zarIyata kA pAlana kiyA| ataH tU hamAre pApoM ko chipAe rakha aura hameM benakAba na kara, tathA hamArI burAiyoM ko kSamA kara de aura unapara hamArI pakar3a na kara, aura hameM acche kAryoM ke karane aura burAiyoM ko chor3ane kI tauphIqa dekara hameM sadAcArI logoM ke sAtha mRtyu de|
