tathA (ai abhibhAvakoM) tuma anAthoM (jinake pitA unake bAliga hone se pahale mara gae) ko unakA dhana usa samaya pUrA kA pUrA de do, jaba ve bAlig2a aura samajhadAra ho jAe~| aura tuma halAla ke badale harAma mAla mata lo; isa prakAra ki tuma anAthoM ke acche-acche dhana svayaM le lo aura usake badale apane ghaTiyA aura qharAba dhana unheM de do| aura anAthoM kA dhana apane dhana ke sAtha milAkara har3apa na lo| aisA karanA allAha ke nikaTa bahuta bar3A pApa hai|

yadi tumheM Dara ho ki apane adhIna rahane vAlI anAtha lar3akiyoM se vivAha karake tuma nyAya nahIM kara pAoge; yA to isa Dara se ki tuma unake Avazyaka mahra ko kama kara doge, yA unake sAtha durvyavahAra karoge, to aisI sthiti meM tuma unheM chor3akara unake alAvA dUsarI acchI mahilAoM se vivAha kara lo| yadi tuma cAho to do, yA tIna, yA cAra se vivAha kara sakate ho| parantu yadi tumheM Dara ho ki tuma unake bIca nyAya nahIM kara sakoge, to eka hI taka sImita raho, yA phira una dAsiyoM se lAbhAnvita ho jinake tuma mAlika ho; kyoMki unake lie usa taraha ke adhikAra anivArya nahIM haiM jo patniyoM ke lie Avazyaka haiM| Ayata meM anAtha lar3akiyoM ke saMbaMdha meM, tathA eka hI mahilA se vivAha karane athavA dAsiyoM se lAbha uThAne ke saMbaMdha meM jo kucha varNita hai, vaha isa bAta ke adhika nikaTa hai ki tuma atyAcAra na karo aura kisI eka kI tarapha jhukAva na rakho|

striyoM ko unake mahra eka anivArya upahAra ke taura para adA karo| yadi ve binA kisI majabUrI ke apanI icchA se tumhAre lie mahra meM se kucha chor3a deM, to use halAla va pAka samajhakara (rUcikara) khAo|

aura (ai abhibhAvako!) una logoM ko dhana na do, jo acchI taraha se usakA prabaMdhana nahIM kara sakate haiM| kyoMki allAha ne isa dhana ko baMdo ke hitoM kI rakSA aura unakI AjIvikA kA sAdhana banAyA hai aura ye loga dhana kA prabhAra lene aura use saMrakSita karane ke yogya nahIM haiM| usa dhana se una para kharca karo aura unheM kapar3e pahanAo, tathA unase acchI bAta kaho aura unase acchA vAdA karo ki unake paripakva ho jAne aura dhana prabaMdhana meM kuzala ho jAne para tuma unheM unakA dhana de doge|

(ai abhibhAvako) jaba anAtha bacce vayaskatA kI Ayu ko pahu~ca jAe~, to unakI isa prakAra jA~ca karo ki unheM unake mAla kA kucha hissA de do ki ve use apanI marz2I se kAma meM lAeM| yadi ve usakA sadupayoga kareM aura tumhAre lie unakI samajhadArI (yogyatA) spaSTa ho jAe, to tuma unakA pUrA dhana binA kisI kamI ke unake havAle kara do| tathA unake dhana ko usa sImA se bar3hakara na khAo jo allAha ne tumhAre lie z2arUrata ke samaya unake dhana se vaidha ThaharAyA hai, aura use isa Dara se jaldI-jaldI na khAo ki ve bAliga hone ke bAda use le leMge| aura tumameM se jisake pAsa itanA dhana ho ki vaha use beniyAz2a kara de, to use anAtha kA dhana lene se bacanA cAhie| aura tumameM se jo garIba ho usake pAsa koI dhana na ho, to vaha apanI AvazyakatA ke anusAra khA sakatA hai| aura jaba tuma unake vayaska aura paripakva hone ke bAda unakA dhana unake havAle karo, to adhikAroM ko saMrakSita karane aura vivAda ke kAraNoM ko rokane ke lie usa supurdagI para gavAha banA lo| aura allAha usapara sAkSI aura apane baMdoM ke kAryoM kA hisAba lene ke lie kAphI hai|

puruSoM kA usa mAla meM hissA hai, jise mAtA-pitA aura riztedAroM jaise bhAiyoM aura cAcAoM ne marane ke bAda chor3A hai, yaha dhana kama ho yA adhika| isI prakAra ina logoM ke chor3e hue dhana meM striyoM kA bhI hissA hai| yaha ajJAnatA ke samaya kI usa rIti ke viparIta hai jisameM mahilAoM aura baccoM ko virAsata se vaMcita rakhA jAtA thA| yaha hissA eka aisA adhikAra hai jisakI rAzi sarvazaktimAna allAha kI ora se nizcita va nirdhArita hai|

jaba paitRka saMpatti ke baMTavAre ke samaya gaira-vArisa riztedAra, anAtha aura nirdhana upasthita hoM; to isa dhana meM se usake baMTavAre se pahale - aicchika rUpa se - jitanI tumhArI icchA ho unheM bhI do| kyoMki ve usakI Asa lagAte haiM, aura yaha dhana tumhAre pAsa binA kisI kaSTa ke AyA hai| tathA unase acchI bAta kaho jisameM koI abhadratA na ho|

aura una logoM ko DaranA cAhie jo agara mara jAte aura apane pIche kamaz2ora choTe bacce chor3a jAte, to unheM unake naSTa hone kA kaisA Dara hotA| ataH unheM allAha se Darate hue una anAthoM para atyAcAra nahIM karanA cAhie jo unake saMrakSaNa meM haiM| tAki allAha unakI mauta ke pazcAta unake lie aise logoM kA prabaMdha kare, jo unakI aulAda ke sAtha acchA vyavahAra kareM, jaisA ki unhoMne una anAthoM ke sAtha sadvyavahAra kiyA thA| tathA unheM usa vyakti kI aulAda ke haqa meM acchA vyavahAra karanA cAhie jisakI vasIyata ke samaya ve upasthita hote haiM, isa prakAra ki unase sahI va saccI bAta kaheM ki vaha apanI vasIyata meM apane vArisoM ke haqa para atyAcAra na kare, tathA vasIyata ko chor3akara khuda ko bhalAI se vaMcita na kare|

jo loga anAthoM kA dhana le lete haiM aura usameM anyAyapUrNa aura AkrAmaka tarIqe se apanA adhikAra calAte haiM, ve vAstava meM apane peTa meM dahakatI huI Aga DAla rahe haiM| aura yaha Aga unheM qayAmata (punarutthAna) ke dina jalAegI|

allAha tumheM tumhArI saMtAna kI paitRka saMpatti ke saMbaMdha meM Adeza detA hai ki paitRka saMpatti kA baMTavarA unake bIca isa taraha hogA ki eka beTe ko do beTiyoM ke samAna hissA milegA| yadi mRtaka ne kevala beTiyA~ chor3I hoM, koI beTA na ho, to do yA unase adhika beTiyoM ko virAsata kA do tihAI hissA milegA| aura yadi usakI kevala eka hI beTI ho, to use virAsata kA AdhA hissA milegA| tathA mRtaka ke mAtA-pitA meM se pratyeka ko chor3e hue dhana kA chaThavA~ hissA milegA, yadi usakI koI saMtAna ho, cAhe vaha nara ho yA nArI| aura yadi usakI koI aulAda na ho aura usake mAtA-pitA ke atirikta usakA koI vArisa na ho, to aisI sthiti meM usakI mA~ ko eka tihAI hissA milegA aura virAsata kA zeSa bhAga bApa kA hogA| aura yadi mRtaka ke do yA do se adhika bhAI-bahana hoM, sage hoM yA sautele, to pharz2a ke rUpa meM mA~ ko chaThavA~ hissA milegA, aura bAkI asabaha hone ke kAraNa bApa ke lie hogA aura bhAiyoM (aura bahanoM) ko kucha nahIM milegA| virAsata kA yaha baMTavArA usa vasIyata ke kAryAnvayana ke bAda hogA jo mRtaka ne kI thI, bazarte ki usakI vasIyata kI rAzi usake eka tihAI dhana se adhika na ho, tathA isa zarta ke sAtha ki usapara anivArya karz2a kA bhugatAna kara diyA jAe| allAha ne virAsata kA baMTavArA isa prakAra nirdhArita kiyA hai; kyoMki tuma nahIM jAnate ki tumhAre bApa aura beToM meM se isa duniyA aura Akhirata meM tumhAre lie kauna sabase adhika lAbhadAyaka hai| kyoMki aisA ho sakatA hai ki mRtaka apane kisI vArisa ke bAre meM acchA gumAna rakhe aura use apanA pUrA dhana de de, yA vaha usake bAre meM burA gumAna rakhe aura use virAsata se vaMcita kara de, jabaki ho sakatA hai ki mAmalA usake viparIta ho| hAlAMki jo yaha saba kucha jAnatA hai vaha allAha hai, jisase koI vastu chipa nahIM sakatI| isIlie usane virAsata kA baMTavArA ukta tarIqe para kiyA hai aura use apane baMdoM para anivArya kartavya ThaharAyA hai| ni:saMdeha allAha jAnane vAlA hai, jisapara usake baMdoM ke hitoM meM se koI bhI cIz2a gupta nahIM hai, tathA vaha apane vidhAna aura prabaMdhana meM hikamata vAlA hai|

tumheM (ai patiyo!) tumhArI patniyoM ke chor3e hue dhana kA AdhA hissA milegA; yadi unakI koI saMtAna (cAhe nara ho yA nArI) tumase yA kisI anya vyakti se na ho| yadi unakI koI saMtAna hai (cAhe nara ho yA nArI), to tumheM unake chor3e hue dhana kA cauthA hissA milegA| tumhAre lie isakA vitaraNa unakI vasIyata lAgU karane tathA unake z2imme anivArya qarz2a ko cukAne ke bAda kiyA jAegA| aura (ai patiyo!) tumhArI striyoM ko tumhAre chor3e hue dhana kA cauthA hissA milegA, yadi tumhArI koI saMtAna (cAhe nara ho yA nArI) unase yA unake alAvA kisI anya (patnI) se na ho| yadi tumhArI koI saMtAna hai (cAhe nara ho yA nArI), to aisI sthiti meM unheM tumhAre chor3e hue dhana kA AThavA~ hissA milegA| unake lie isakA vitaraNa tumhArI vasIyata ko lAgU karane aura tumhAre z2imme anivArya qarz2a kA bhugatAna karane ke bAda kiyA jAegA| yadi koI aisA AdamI mara jAe jisakA na bApa ho aura na saMtAna, yA aisI strI kA nidhana ho jAe jisakA na bApa ho aura na saMtAna, aura una donoM meM se mRtaka kA aqhyAfI bhAI yA aqhyAfI bahana ho (arthAta vaha bhAI bahana, jinake bApa alaga-alaga aura mA~ eka ho); to usa aqhyAfI bhAI yA aqhyAfI bahana meM se pratyeka ko farz2a ke rUpa meM chaThavA~ hissA milegA| aura yadi aqhyAfI bhAI yA aqhyAfI bahana eka se adhika hoM, to una sabhI ke lie farz2a ke rUpa meM eka tihAI hissA hai jisameM ve saba sAjhIdAra hoMge| isa mAmale meM mahilA evaM puruSa saba samAna hoMge| ve loga apane isa hisse ko mRtaka kI vasIyata lAgU karane aura usake z2imme anivArya qarz2a ko cukAne ke bAda hI prApta kareMge, bazarte ki usakI vasIyata se vArisoM ko koI nukasAna na pahu~catA ho; jaise ki vaha usake dhana ke eka tihAI se adhika kI vasIyata ho| yaha prAvadhAna jisa para yaha Ayata AdhArita hai vaha tumhAre lie allAha kI ora se eka vacana hai jise usane tumapara anivArya kiyA hai| aura allAha khUba jAnatA hai ki duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM baMdoM kI bhalAI va acchAI kisa cIz2a meM hai| vaha sahanazIla hai, avajJAkArI ko saz2A dene meM jaldI nahIM karatA|

ye anAthoM aura unake alAvA anya logoM ke saMbaMdha meM ullikhita prAvadhAna, allAha ke kAnUna haiM jo usane apane baMdoM ke lie nirdhArita kie haiM, tAki ve unapara amala kareM| aura jo bhI allAha aura usake rasUla kA AjJApAlana karegA, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usakI manA kI huI bAtoM se bacakara; allAha use aise bAg2oM meM dAqhila karegA, jinake mahaloM ke nIce nahareM baha rahI hoMgI| ve usI meM raheMge, unheM mauta nahIM AegI| yaha IzvarIya badalA hI vaha mahAna saphalatA hai, jisakI tulanA kisI bhI saphalatA se nahIM kI jA sakatI|

aura jo allAha aura usake rasUla kI avajJA karegA usake AdezoM ko nirasta karake aura unapara amala karanA tyAga karake, yA unake satya hone meM saMdeha karake, aura jo usake banAe hue kAnUna kI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karegA, allAha use jahannama kI Aga meM dAkhila karegA jisameM vaha hamezA rahegA aura usameM usake lie apamAnajanaka yAtanA hogI|

aura tumhArI mahilAe~ meM se jo vyabhicAra kara baiTheM, cAhe ve vivAhitA hoM athavA avivAhita, unake viruddha cAra vizvasanIya musalamAnoM ko gavAha lAo| yadi ve unake viruddha vyabhicAra kI gavAhI de deM, to unheM saz2A ke taura para gharoM meM baMda rakho, yahA~ taka ki mauta se unake jIvana kA aMta ho jAe athavA allAha unake lie qaida ke atirikta koI dUsarA rAstA nikAla de| phira allAha ne isake bAda unake lie rAstA nikAla diyA| cunAMce avivAhita vyabhicAriNI ko sau kor3e mArane aura eka sAla ke lie dezanikAlA dene, jabaki vivAhitA ko patthara mAra-mAra kara halAka karane kI saz2A nirdhArita kI gaI|

tathA puruSoM meM se jo do vyakti vyabhicAra kA pApa kara baiTheM - cAhe ve vivAhita hoM yA avivAhita - to unheM z2abAna aura hAtha se aisI saz2A do jisase unheM apamAna aura phaTakAra prApta ho| phira yadi ve donoM usa cIz2a ko chor3a deM jo kucha unhoMne kiyA thA aura unake kArya sudhara jAe~; to unheM kaSTa pahu~cAne se upekSA karo| kyoMki pApa se taubA karane vAlA nirdoSa vyakti ke samAna ho jAtA hai| niHsaMdeha allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM kI taubA kabUla karane vAlA aura unapara dayA karane vAlA hai| jJAta honA cAhie ki isa taraha kI saz2A kA prAvadhAna zurU-zurU islAma meM thA, lekina bAda meM ise nirasta karake avivAhita ko sau kor3e mArane aura eka sAla ke lie dezanikAlA dene, tathA vivAhita ko pattharoM se mAra-mAra kara mAra DAlane kA Adeza diyA gayA|

allAha kevala una logoM kI taubA kabUla karatA hai, jo pApa aura avajJA ko usake pariNAma aura durbhAgya se anabhijJa hone ke kAraNa karate haiM, (aura hara gunAha karane vAle kA yahI mAmalA hotA hai, cAhe vaha jAnabUjhakara kare yA anajAne meM) phira ve mRtyu ko dekhane se pahale pazcAtApa karate hue apane pAlanahAra kI ora lauTa Ate haiM, to allAha aise hI logoM kI taubA svIkAra karatA hai aura unake pApoM ko kSamA kara detA hai| allAha apanI maqhalUka kI sthitiyoM se avagata, apane faisale aura vidhAna meM hikamata vAlA hai|

allAha una logoM kI taubA kabUla nahIM karatA jo avajJA ke kAmoM para aDiga rahate haiM, aura unase taubA nahIM karate haiM yahA~ taka ki ve mRtyu kI vyathA kA avalokana kara lete haiM| to usa samaya unameM se eka kahatA hai: maiMne jo kucha pApa kiyA hai, aba maiM usase taubA karatA hU~| isI taraha allAha una logoM kI taubA - bhI - kabUla nahIM karatA, jo kufra para aDiga rahate hue mara jAte haiM| ye gunAhoM para aDiga rahane vAle avajJAkArI, tathA ve loga jo apane kufra (avizvAsa) para sthira rahate hue mara jAte haiM; hamane unake lie dardanAka saz2A taiyAra kara rakhI hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! tumhAre lie vaidha nahIM hai ki apane pitA aura riztedAroM kI patniyoM ke vArisa bana jAo jisa taraha ki dhana kA vArisa hote haiM aura unake bAre meM yaha ravaiyA apanAo ki unase khuda vivAha kara lo, yA unakA vivAha unase kara do jinheM tuma cAhate ho, yA unheM vivAha karane se (hI) roka do| tumhAre lie yaha bhI jAyaz2a nahIM hai ki apanI una patniyoM ko jinheM tuma nApasaMda karate ho nukasAna pahu~cAne ke lie roke rakho, tAki ve tumhArI dI huI mahara Adi kA kucha hissA tumhAre lie parityAga kara deM| sivAya isake ki ve koI spaSTa (ghora) azlIla kAma jaise vyabhicAra Adi kara baiTheM| yadi ve aisA karatI haiM to tumhAre lie unheM rokanA aura unheM taMga karanA jAyaz2a hai yahA~ taka ki ve tumhArI dI huI cIz2eM vApasa karake tumase Az2Ada ho jAe~| tathA tuma apanI striyoM ke sAtha acchI saMgati rakho, unase kaSTa ko dUra karake aura acchA vyavahAra karake| yadi tuma unheM kisI sAMsArika mAmale kI vajaha se nApasaMda karo to unapara dhairya se kAma lo; kyoMki saMbhava hai ki allAha usa cIz2a meM jo tuma nApasaMda karate ho, duniyA evaM Aqhirata kI bahuta-sI bhalAiyA~ rakha de|

aura (ai patiyo!) yadi tuma kisI patnI ko talAqa denA cAho aura usakI jagaha para dUsarI patnI lAnA cAho, to isameM tumhAre lie koI burAI nahIM hai| aura yadi tumane usa patnI ko, jise tumane talAqa dene kA irAdA kiyA hai, mahara ke taura para bahuta sArA dhana diyA thA; to tumhAre lie usameM se kucha bhI lenA jAyaz2a nahIM hai| kyoMki tumane unheM jo kucha diyA hai use lenA khulA mithyAropa aura spaSTa pApa samajhA jAegA|

bhalA tuma unheM diyA huA mahara kaise vApasa loge, jabaki tumhAre bIca eka riztA aura sneha sthApita ho cukA, tathA tuma eka-dUsare se lAbhAnvita aura eka-dUsare ke rahasyoM se avagata ho cuke ho| isake bAda unake hAthoM meM maujUda dhana kI lAlaca karanA bahuta burI aura ghRNita bAta hai, jabaki ve tumase dRr3ha aura pakkA vacana (bhI) le cukI haiM| aura vaha vacana allAha ke zabda aura usakI zarIyata ke dvArA unheM halAla ThaharAnA hai|

aura tuma una striyoM se nikAha na karo, jinase tumhAre pitAoM ne nikAha kiyA hai, kyoMki yaha harAma (niSiddha) hai| paraMtu jo islAma se pahale aisA ho cukA hai, usapara koI pakar3a nahIM hai| isake harAma hone kA kAraNa yaha hai ki beToM kA apane pitAoM kI patniyoM se vivAha karanA atyanta ghRNita bAta hai tathA aisA karane vAle para allAha ke krodha kA kAraNa hai aura yaha calane kA eka burA rAstA hai|

allAha ne tumhAre lie vivAha harAma kiyA hai, tumhArI mAtAoM se, cAhe ve kitanI hI dUra taka Upara calI jAe~; arthAt: mA~ kI mA~ aura usakI dAdI, cAhe pitA kI tarapha se ho yA mAtA| aura tumhArI beTiyoM se, cAhe ve kitanI hI dUra taka nIce calI jAe~; arthAt: usakI beTI aura usakI beTI kI beTI, isI taraha beTe kI beTiyA~ aura beTI kI beTiyA~ cAhe ve kitanI hI dUra taka nIce calI jAe~| aura tumhArI sagI bahanoM, yA bApa zarIka (allAtI) yA mA~ zarIka (aqhyAfI) bahanoM se| aura tumhArI phUphiyoM se, isI taraha tumhAre pitAoM aura mAtAoM kI phUphiyoM se, cAhe ve kitanI dUra taka Upara calI jAe~| aura tumhArI khAlAoM se, aura isI taraha tumhArI mAtAoM aura pitAoM kI khAlAoM se, cAhe ve kitanI dUra taka Upara calI jAe~| aura bhAI kI beTiyoM tathA bahana kI beTiyoM aura unakI beTiyoM se, cAhe ve kitanI dUra taka nIce calI jAe~| aura tumhArI una mAtAoM se jinhoMne tumheM dUdha pilAyA hai, aura tumhArI dUdha meM sAjhIdAra bahanoM se, aura tumhArI patniyoM kI mAtAoM se, cAhe tumhArA unase milana huA ho yA na huA ho| aura tumhArI patniyoM kI una beTiyoM se, jo tumhAre sivA kisI anya pati se hoM aura jo adhikatara tumhAre gharoM meM hI palatI bar3hatI haiM, isI taraha yadi ve tumhAre gharoM meM na palI hoM, agara tumane unakI mAtAoM se milana kara liyA ho| lekina yadi tumane unakI mAtAoM se milana na kiyA ho, to unakI beTiyoM se nikAha karane meM koI Apatti nahIM hai| tathA tumhAre lie tumhAre sage beToM kI patniyoM se vivAha karanA bhI harAma hai, yadyapi unakA unase milana na huA ho| aura isa hukma meM tumhAre dUdha meM sAjhIdAra beToM kI patniyA~ bhI zAmila haiM| tathA tumhAre lie do nasabI yA dUdha zarIka bahanoM ko eka sAtha nikAha meM rakhanA bhI harAma hai| hA~, ajJAnatA ke samayakAla meM jo ho cukA, so ho cukA| allAha ne use kSamA kara diyA| niHsaMdeha allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko mAfa karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai| isI taraha sunnata (hadIsa) se sAbita hai ki kisI mahilA aura usakI phUphI yA usakI khAlA ko eka sAtha (nikAha) meM rakhanA niSiddha hai|

zAdI-zudA striyoM se nikAha karanA tumhAre lie harAma kara diyA gayA hai| paraMtu jo striyA~ allAha kI rAha meM jihAda karate samaya, baMdI banakara tumhAre pAsa AeM, unase eka mAsika dharma ke pazcAta jaba yaha spaSTa ho jAe ki ve garbhavatI nahIM haiM, tumhAre lie saMbhoga karanA jAyaz2a hai| yaha (hukma) allAha ne tuma para farz2a kara diyA hai| tathA allAha ne inake alAvA dUsarI striyoM ko tumhAre lie halAla kiyA hai ki tuma apanA mAla kharca karake, halAla tarIqe se, apane satItva kI rakSA karo, tumhArA uddezya vyabhicAra kA na ho| phira jina striyoM se tuma nikAha karake lAbha uThAo, unheM unakA mahara cukA do, jo allAha ne tumhAre Upara farz2a kiyA hai| kintu vAjiba mahara ke nirdhAraNa ke bAda, usameM kucha vRddhi karane yA kucha mApha karane para tumhArI Apasa meM sahamati ho jAtI hai, to isameM tuma para koI pApa nahIM hai| allAha apanI sRSTi se avagata hai, unakI koI cIz2a usase chipI nahIM hai| vaha apane prabaMdhana aura vidhAna meM hikamata vAlA hai|

tathA - ai puruSo - tumameM se jo vyakti paise kI kamI ke kAraNa Az2Ada striyoM se vivAha karane meM sakSama na ho, usake lie kisI anya vyakti ke svAmitva meM maujUda dAsiyoM se nikAha karanA jAyaz2a hai, yadi ve tumheM ImAna vAlI dikhAI deM, jabaki tumhAre ImAna kI saccAI aura bhItarI sthiti ko allAha hI behatara jAnatA hai| tuma aura ve (dAsiyA~) dharma evaM mAnavatA meM barAbara haiM, isalie unase zAdI karane meM zarma mahasUsa na karo| so, tuma unase unake mAlikoM kI anumati se vivAha kara lo aura unakA mahara binA kisI kamI yA TAla-maTola ke unheM adA kara do| paraMtu yaha usa sthiti meM hai jaba ve pAkadAmana (niSkalaMka caritra) hoM, khullama khullA vyabhicAra karane vAlI na hoM, tathA gupta rUpa se vyabhicAra ke lie mitra rakhane vAlI na hoM| jaba ve zAdI kara leM, phira usake bAda vyabhicAra meM lipta ho jAeM, to unheM Az2Ada striyoM kA AdhA daMDa diyA jAegA| arthAt pacAsa kor3e lagAe jAeMge, lekina Az2Ada zAdIzudA striyoM kI taraha unheM saMgasAra nahIM kiyA jAegA| saccaritra ImAna vAlI dAsiyoM se nikAha karane kI yaha anumati, usake lie hai, jise vyabhicAra meM par3ane kA Dara ho aura vaha Az2Ada striyoM se nikAha karane kI zakti na rakhatA ho| jabaki dAsiyoM ke nikAha se dhairya karanA (arthAt ruka jAnA) behatara hai; tAki saMtAna dAsatA se surakSita rahe|allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko kSamA karane vAlA aura unapara dayA karane vAlA hai| aura yaha usakI dayA meM se hai ki usane unake lie, Az2Ada striyoM se nikAha karane meM asamartha hone kI sthiti meM, vyabhicAra meM par3ane ke Dara ke samaya dAsiyoM se nikAha karanA dharmasaMgata kara diyA hai|

allAha taAlA tumhAre lie ina prAvadhAnoM ko nirmita karake tumhAre lie apanI zarIyata aura dharma kI nizAniyoM evaM duniyA va Aqhirata meM tumhAre hitoM kI cIz2oM ko bayAna karanA cAhatA hai| tathA vaha tumhArA, halAla va harAma ThaharAne meM tumase pUrva nabiyoM ke tarIqoM, unake acche guNoM aura unake sarAhanIya AcaraNa kI ora, mArgadarzana karanA cAhatA hai, tAki tuma unakA anusaraNa karo| allAha yaha bhI cAhatA hai ki tumheM apanI avajJA se haTAkara apane AjJApAlana kI ora phera de| allAha usa cIz2a se avagata hai jisameM usake baMdoM kA hita hai, cunA~ce vaha use unake lie dharmasaMgata banA detA hai| vaha apane vidhAna aura unake mAmaloM ke prabaMdhana meM hikamAta vAlA hai|
allAha cAhatA hai ki tumhArI taubA qabUla kare aura tumhAre pApoM ko kSamA kara de, jabaki apanI icchAoM ke pIche calane vAle cAhate haiM ki tuma hidAyata ke mArga se bahuta dUra ho jAo|

allAha tumhAre lie apanI zarIyata meM AsAnI paidA karanA cAhatA hai| isI kAraNa vaha tumheM aisI cIz2a kA Adeza nahIM detA, jo tumhArI zakti se bAhara ho| kyoMki vaha manuSya kI apanI racanA evaM vyavahAra meM kamaz2orI se avagata hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! tuma eka dUsare kA mAla avaidha rUpa se na lo, jaise- jabarana qabz2A, corI aura rizvata Adi| paraMtu yadi vaha dhana donoM pakSoM kI ApasI sahamati se hone vAle vyavasAya kA dhana ho, to tumhAre lie usako khAnA aura usameM apanA adhikAra calAnA jAyaz2a hai| tathA tuma eka-dUsare kI hatyA na karo aura na tumameM se koI apane ApakI hatyA kare aura na khuda ko halAkata meM DAle| niHsaMdeha allAha tumapara bar3A dayAvAn hai aura yaha usakI dayA hI hai ki usane tumhArI jAnoM, tumhAre dhanoM aura tumhArI ijjata ko harAma qarAra diyA hai|

jo vyakti vaha kAma karegA jisase vaha manA kiyA gayA hai; cunA~ce vaha kisI kA dhana khAegA yA kisI kI hatyA karegA, vaha bhI anajAne yA bhUlavaza nahIM, balki jAna-bUjhakara aura z2yAdatI karate hue; to qiyAmata ke dina allAha use eka bar3I Aga meM jhoMka degA| vaha usakI garmI sahegA aura usakI yAtanA jhelegA| yaha kArya allAha ke lie bar3A AsAna hai, kyoMki vaha hara kArya kI tAqata rakhatA hai, use koI vastu vivaza nahIM kara sakatI|

- ai momino! - yadi tuma bar3e gunAhoM se bacate rahoge, jaise allAha kA sAjhI banAnA, mAtA-pitA kI avajJA karanA, kisI kI hatyA karanA aura byAja lenA, to hama tumhAre choTe gunAhoM ko kSamA kara deMge aura tumheM allAha ke pAsa eka sammAnita sthAna arthAta jannata meM praveza kA saubhAgya pradAna kareMge|

(ai momino!) allAha ne jisa cIz2a ke dvArA tumameM se kucha ko dUsaroM para zreSThatA pradAna kI hai, usakI kAmanA na karo; tAki aisA na ho ki yaha asaMtoSa aura IrSyA paidA kara de| ataH striyoM ke lie ucita nahIM hai ki allAha ne puruSoM ko jo viziSTatAe~ pradAna kI haiM, unakI AkAMkSA kareM| kyoMki pratyeka varga ke lie usake anurUpa pratiphala kA eka hissA hai|tathA allAha se prArthanA karo ki vaha tumheM apane anudAna se adhika pradAna kare| isameM koI zaka nahIM ki allAha hara vastu kA jJAna rakhatA hai; isalie usane hara varga ko vahI diyA hai jo usake anukUla hai|

hamane tumameM se hara eka ke haqadAra banA die haiM, jo mAtA-pitA aura nikaTavartI riztedAroM kI chor3I huI saMpatti ke vArisa hoMge| rahI bAta unakI jinase tumane qasameM khAkara ApasI ekatA evaM sahoga kA muAhadA kara rakhA hai, to unheM mIrAsa se unakA hissA do| bezaka allAha hara vastu se sUcita hai, aura isI meM usakA tumhArI ina qasamoM aura vacanoM se avagata honA bhI zAmila hai| ApasI ekatA evaM sahoga ke muAhadA ke dvArA virAsata kA niyama zurU islAma meM the, phira use nirasta kara diyA gayA|

puruSa gaNa striyoM kI dekhabhAla karate haiM aura unake mAmaloM kA prabaMdhana karate haiM, kyoMki allAha ne unheM striyoM para vizeSa pradhAnatA dI hai tathA isa kAraNa ki unapara kharca karanA aura unakI dekha-rekha karanA puruSoM para anivArya hai| sadAcArI striyA~ apane pAlanahAra kI AjJAkArI, apane patiyoM kI bAta mAnane vAlI aura allAha kI taufIqa se apane patiyoM kI anupasthiti meM unake adhikAroM kI rakSA karane vAlI hotI haiM| tathA - ai patiyo! - jina striyoM ke viSaya meM kisI bAta yA kArya meM apane patiyoM ke AjJApAlana se upekSA karane kA Dara ho, to pahale unheM samajhAo-bujhAo aura allAha kA bhaya dilAo| yadi ve na mAneM, to unheM bistara meM alaga rakho, jaise sote samaya unakI ora pITha kara lo aura unase saMbhoga na karo| yadi ve isapara bhI na mAneM to halkI mAra mAro| yadi ve AjJApAlana kI ora lauTa Ae~, to unapara kisI prakAra kA atyAcAra na karo yA unheM burA bhalA na kaho| allAha hara cIz2a se sarvocca aura apane vyaktitva aura guNoM meM mahAna hai, isalie usase Daro|

yadi tumheM - ai pati-patnI ke abhibhAvako! - isa bAta kA bhaya ho ki donoM ke bIca kA vivAda duzmanI aura paraspara saMbaMdha-viccheda kI sImA taka pahu~ca jAegA, to pati ke parivAra se eka nyAyI puruSa aura patnI ke parivAra se eka nyAyI puruSa ko bhejo; tAki ve donoM ke hitoM ko dhyAna meM rakhate hue unake bIca judAI athavA milApa kA nirNaya kareM|jabaki melamilApa hI z2yAdA priya aura behatara hai| yadi donoM madhyasthoM ne melamilApa cAhA aura usake lie behatarIna prayAsa kie, to allAha pati-patnI ke bIca milApa paidA kara degA aura unake bIca kA vivAda samApta ho jAegA| allAha para usake baMdoM kI koI bAta chipI nahIM hai aura vaha unake diloM ke nihita bhedoM se bhI avagata hai|

allAha ke prati adhInatA ke sAtha akele usI kI ibAdata karo aura usake sAtha kisI kI ibAdata na karo| tathA mAtA-pitA kA sammAna aura unake sAtha acchA vyavahAra karo| aura riztedAroM, anAthoM aura z2arUratamaMdoM ke sAtha acchA vyavahAra karo| tathA riztedAra par3osI evaM gaira-riztedAra par3osI ke sAtha bhalAI karo| tathA sAtha rahane vAle sAthI ke sAtha acchA vyavahAra karo| tathA usa anajAna yAtrI ke sAtha bhalAI karo jisakA rAstA kaTa gayA hai| tathA apane dAsa-dAsiyoM ke sAtha acchA vyavahAra karo| niHsaMdeha allAha aise vyakti se prema nahIM karatA, jo Atmamugdha ho, usake baMdoM ke samakSa apanI bar3AI dikhAtA ho aura logoM para garva karane ke lie svayaM kI prazaMsA karatA ho|

to qayAmata ke dina kyA hAla hogA, jaba hama hara samudAya ke nabI ko isa bAta kI gavAhI dene ke lie lAe~ge jo kucha unhoMne kiyA hai, aura - ai nabI! - hama Apako ApakI ummata para gavAha kI haisiyata se peza kareMge?

ai yahUdiyo aura IsAiyo, jinheM kitAba dI gaI hai, usa pustaka para ImAna lAo, jo hamane muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama para utArI hai, jo tumhAre pAsa maujUda taurAta evaM iMjIla kI puSTi karane hetu Ae haiM, isase pahale ki hama ceharoM meM maujUda iMdriyoM ko miTA deM, aura unheM unake pIche kI dizA meM banA deM, yA hama unheM allAha kI dayA se vaise hI niSkAsita kara deM, jaise hamane zanivAra vAloM ko usase niSkAsita kiyA thA, jinhoMne zanivAra ke dina zikAra se manAhI ke bAvajUda usameM zikAra kiyA thA| jisake kAraNa allAha ne unheM baMdara banA diyA| aura allAha kA Adeza aura usakA faisalA anivArya rUpa se pUrA hokara rahatA hai|

kyA Apa - ai rasUla! - una logoM ke mAmale se avagata nahIM haiM, jo khuda apanI aura apane kAryoM kI prazaMsA karate haiM? balki kevala allAha hI hai jo apane baMdoM meM se jisakI cAhe prazaMsA kare aura pavitra banAe, kyoMki vaha diloM kI gupta bAtoM ko jAnane vAlA hai| tathA unake satkarmoM ke savAba meM kucha bhI kamI nahIM kI jAegI, cAhe vaha khajUra kI guThalI ke dhAge ke barAbara hI kyoM na ho|
(ai rasUla!) dekhie to sahI ki ve loga svayaM kI prazaMsA karake kaise allAha para mithyA Aropa lagA rahe haiM! aura unakI gumarAhI ko spaSTa karane ke lie yahI gunAha kAfI hai|

(ai rasUla!) kyA Apa nahIM jAnate aura Apako una yahUdiyoM kI dazA para Azcarya nahIM hotA, jinheM allAha ne jJAna kA kucha hissA diyA hai, ki ve allAha ko chor3akara apane banAe hue mAbUdoM (devatAoM) para ImAna rakhate haiM aura - muzrikoM ke sAtha banAe rakhane aura unakI cATukAritA ke taura para - kahate haiM: ye (muzrika loga) muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke sAthiyoM se adhika hidAyata ke mArga para haiM?

jo loga isa bhraSTa vizvAsa ko mAnate haiM, vahI haiM jinheM allAha ne apanI dayA se niSkAsita kara diyA hai aura jise allAha (apanI dayA se) niSkAsita kara de, to Apa kadApi usakA koI sahAyaka nahIM pAe~ge,jo usakI madada kara sake|
unake pAsa rAjya kA koI hissA nahIM hai| yadi aisA hotA, to logoM ko usameM se kucha bhI nahIM dete, yadyapi khajUra kI guThalI ke Upara ke gaDDhe ke barAbara hI kyoM na ho|

balki ve muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama aura Apake sAthiyoM se isa binA para IrSyA karate haiM ki allAha ne unheM, nubuvvata (IzdUtatva), ImAna aura dharatI meM sattA pradAna kiyA hai| to ye loga unase IrSyA kyoM karate haiM, jabaki hamane isase pahale bhI ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ke vaMzaja ko AsamAnI kitAba pradAna kiyA aura kitAba ke alAvA bhI unakI ora vahya kI, tathA unheM logoM para vizAla rAjya pradAna kiyA!?

ahle kitAba meM se kucha loga usa cIz2a para ImAna lAe, jo allAha ne ibarAhIma alaihissalAma para aura unake vaMza ke nabiyoM para avatarita kiyA aura kucha logoM ne usa para ImAna lAne se upekSA kiyA| unakA yahI ravaiyA usake prati bhI hai jo muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama para avatirata kiyA gayA hai| tathA unameM se kufra karane vAloM ke lie Aga hI barAbara kI saz2A hai|

niHsaMdeha jina logoM ne hamArI AyatoM ke sAtha kufra kiyA, hama unheM qayAmata ke dina Aga meM dAqhila kareMge, jo unheM cAroM ora se ghere huI hogI| jaba bhI unakI khAleM jala jAe~gI, hama unheM dUsarI khAla pahanA deMge, tAki una para yAtanA jArI rahe| niHsaMdeha allAha prabhutvazAlI hai, usapara koI cIz2a hAvI nahIM ho sakatI, vaha jo kucha upAya karatA aura nirNaya letA hai, usameM hikamata vAlA hai|

jo loga allAha para ImAna lAe aura usake rasUla kA pAlana kiyA, tathA acche karma kie, hama unheM qayAmata ke dina aisI jannatoM meM dAqhila kareMge, jinake mahaloM ke nIce se nahareM pravAhita hoMgI, jinameM ve hamezA raheMge| unake lie una jannatoM meM hara gaMdagI se pavitra patniyA~ hoMgI| tathA hama unheM eka ghanI, vistArita chAyA meM rakheMge, jisameM garmI hogI na sardI|

allAha tumheM Adeza detA hai ki apane pAsa amAnata ke rUpa meM rakhI huI hara cIz2a ko usake mAlika taka pahu~cA do| tathA tumheM yaha Adeza detA hai ki jaba tuma logoM ke bIca phaisalA karo, to nyAya ke sAtha phaisalA karo| tathA phaisalA karate samaya pakSapAta athavA atyAcAra se kAma na lo| allAha tumheM kitanI acchI nasIhata karatA hai aura tumhArI sabhI paristhitiyoM meM usakI ora mArgadarzana karatA hai| niHsaMdeha allAha tumhArI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA aura tumhAre kAryoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura niSedhoM se bacakara allAha kA aura usake rasUla kA AjJApAlana karo| tathA apane zAsakoM kA pAlana karo jaba taka ki ve avajJA kA Adeza na deM| phira yadi kisI bAta meM tumhArA matabheda ho jAe, to usake saMbaMdha meM allAha kI kitAba aura usake rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI sunnata kI tarapha lauTo, yadi tuma allAha aura aMtima dina para ImAna rakhate ho| (tumhArA) yaha quraAna aura sunnata kI tarapha lauTanA, matabheda meM par3e rahane aura rAya ke AdhAra para koI bAta kahane se behatara hai aura tumhAre lie sabase acche pariNAma vAlA hai|

(ai rasUla!) kyA Apane una munAfiqa yahUdiyoM kA virodhAbhAsa nahIM dekhA, jo jhUThA dAvA karate haiM ki ve usapara ImAna rakhate haiM jo kucha Apa para avatarita kiyA gayA hai aura jo kucha Apase pUrva rasUloM para avatirata kiyA gayA thA| paraMtu ve apane vivAdoM meM phaisale ke lie allAha kI zarIyata ko chor3akara mAnava nirmita qAnUna ke pAsa jAnA pasaMda karate haiM| jabaki unheM Adeza diyA gayA thA ki ve usakA inakAra kareM| aura zaitAna to yaha cAhatA hai ki unheM satya se itanA dUra kara de ki ve usake calate mArgadarzana na pA sakeM|

jaba ina munAfiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) se kahA jAtA hai ki allAha ne apanI kitAba meM jo phaisalA utArA hai, usakI tarafa Ao aura rasUla ke pAsa Ao, tAki vaha tumhAre jhagar3oM meM tumhAre bIca faisalA kara deM, to - ai rasUla - Apa unheM dekheMge ki ve pUrNatayA Apase vimukha hokara phaisalA ke lie Apake alAvA kI ora jAte haiM|

usa samaya munAphiqoM kA kya hAla hotA hai jaba unake kie hue gunAhoM ke kAraNa unapara koI ApadA A par3atI hai, phira - ai rasUla - ve Apake pAsa mAfI mA~gane ke uddezya se Ate haiM aura allAha kI qasameM khAkara kahate haiM ki Apako chor3akara anya ke pAsa phaisalA ke lie jAne ke pIche hamArA uddezya kevala bhalAI aura paraspara virodhI pakSoM ke bIca mela karAnA thA| hAlA~ki ve apane isa dAve meM jhUThe haiM; kyoMki bhalAI to logoM ke bIca allAha kI zarIyata se phaisalA karAne meM hai|

ye vo loga haiM jinake diloM meM chipe nifAqa (pAkhaMDa) aura bure Azaya ko allAha bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai| ataH - ai paig2aMbara - unheM unake hAla para chor3a deM aura unakI upekSA kareM, tathA unheM protsAhita karate hue aura DarAte hue unake sAmane allAha kA hukma (phaisalA) spaSTa kara deM aura unase aisI bAta kaheM jo unake dila kI gaharAiyoM meM utara jAe|

hamane jo bhI rasUla bhejA, usakA uddezya yaha thA ki vaha allAha kI icchA aura taqadIra se jisa cIz2a kA Adeza deM usameM unakA pAlana kiyA jAe| aura yadi ve loga, jaba unhoMne pApa karake svayaM para atyAcAra kiyA thA, apane gunAhoM ko svIkArate aura pachatAvA va pazcAtApa prakaTa karate hue Apake jIvana meM (ai rasUla) Apake pAsa A jAte, aura allAha se mAphI mA~gate, aura Apa bhI unake lie mAfI mA~gate, to ve avazya allAha ko bahuta taubA qabUla karane vAlA aura apane Upara dayAlu pAte|

66-68 - yadi hamane unapara eka-dUsare ko qatla karanA yA apane gharoM se nikala jAnA anivArya kiyA hotA, to unameM se thor3e logoM ke sivA koI hamAre Adeza ko nahIM mAnatA| ataH unheM allAha kA dhanyavAda karanA cAhie ki usane unheM aise kArya ke lie bAdhya nahIM kiyA, jo unake lie kaThina ho| aura yadi unhoMne allAha kI AjJAkAritA kI hotI jisakI unheM nasIhata kI jAtI hai, to yaha avahelanA karane se behatara hotA aura unake ImAna ke lie adhika dRr3hatA kA kAraNa hotA| tathA hama unheM apanI ora se bar3A badalA dete aura unheM allAha evaM usakI jannata taka le jAne vAle rAste para calane kA sAmarthya pradAna karate|

jo vyakti allAha aura usake rasUla kA AjJApAlana karegA, vaha una logoM ke sAtha hogA, jinheM allAha ne jannata meM praveza ke puraskAra se sammAnita kiyA hai, arthAta nabI, aura siddIqa (satyavAdI) loga jinhoMne rasUloM ke lAe hue dharma ko pUrI taraha se satya jAnA aura usake anusAra kArya kiyA, aura zahIda loga jo allAha ke rAste meM qatla kie gae, aura sadAcArI loga jinake parokSa evaM pratyakSa vizuddha haiM, to pariNAma svarUpa unake kArya bhI vizuddha haiM| ye loga jannata ke kyA hI acche sAthI haiM!
yaha ukta savAba allAha kI ora se usake baMdoM para anugraha evaM kRpA hai aura allAha kAfI hai unakI sthitiyoM ko jAnane vAlA, aura vaha hara eka ko usake kArya kA badalA degA|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! apane duzmanoM se, unase jaMga karane para sahAyaka kAraNoM ko apanAkara, sAvadhAna raho| ataH unakI ora eka ke bAda eka guTa banAkara nikalo, yA saba ke saba ikaTThe hokara nikala par3o| yaha saba isa tathya ke adhIna hai ki kisa cIz2a meM tumhArA hita aura kisI cIz2a meM tumhAre duzmanoM kA parAjaya hai|

(ai musalamAno!) tumhAre aMdara kucha aise loga bhI haiM, jo apanI kAyaratA ke kAraNa tumhAre duzmanoM se lar3AI ke lie nikalane se pIche rahate haiM aura dUsaroM ko bhI pIche rakhate (rokate) haiM| ye munAfiqa aura kamaz2ora ImAna vAle loga haiM| phira yadi tuma zahIda ho jAo yA tumheM parAjaya kA sAmanA karanA par3e, to unameM se eka apanI surakSA para harSita hokara kahatA hai: allAha ne mujhapara kRpA kI hai, isalie maiM unake sAtha lar3AI meM zAmila nahIM huA, nahIM to merI bhI vahI hAlata hotI, jo inakI huI|

aura yadi tumheM - ai musalamAno! - vijaya athavA mAle g2anImata ke rUpa meM allAha kA anugraha prApta ho jAe, to jihAda se pIche rahane vAlA yahI vyakti avazya isa taraha kahegA mAno vaha tumameM se hai hI nahIM aura tumhAre aura usake bIca koI pyAra aura sAhacarya nahIM thA ki kAza! maiM bhI unake sAtha isa yuddha meM zAmila hotA, to unakI taraha maiM bhI bar3I saphalatA prApta kara letA!

ataH sacce ImAna vAle, jo sAMsArika jIvana ko usake prati aruci prakaTa karate hue, Aqhirata ke badale usakI icchA rakhate hue beca dete haiM, unheM cAhie ki allAha ke rAste meM yuddha kareM tAki allAha kA dharma sarvocca ho| aura jo allAha ke dharma ko sarvocca karane ke lie allAha ke rAste meM yuddha kare, phira vaha zahIda ho jAe yA duzmana para vijaya prApta kara le, to allAha use mahAna pratiphala pradAna karegA aura vaha jannata aura allAha kI prasannatA hai|

- ai momino! - tumheM allAha ke rAste meM, usake dharma ko U~cA karane aura besahArA puruSoM, striyoM tathA baccoM ko mukti dilAne ke lie jihAda karane se kauna-sI cIz2a rokatI hai, jo bebasI ke Alama meM allAha se duA kara raheM haiM ki ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hameM makkA se nikAla de, kyoMki usake vAsI allAha kA sAjhI banAkara aura usake baMdoM ko utpIr3ita karake atyAcAra karate haiM| tathA hamAre lie apanI ora se koI saMrakSaka banA de, jo hamArI dekhabhAla aura saMrakSaNa kare aura aisA sahAyaka banA de, jo hamase hara prakAra kI hAni ko dUra kara de|

sacce momina, allAha ke rAste meM usake dharma ko sarvocca karane ke lie lar3ate haiM, jabaki kAphira apane asatya pUjyoM (devatAoM) kI khAtira lar3ate haiM| ataH tuma zaitAna ke sahAyakoM se yuddha karo, kyoMki yadi tuma unase yuddha karoge, to unapara vijaya prApta kara loge| kyoMki zaitAna kI cAla kamaz2ora hotI hai| vaha sarvazaktimAna allAha para bharosA rakhane vAloM ko nuqasAna nahIM pahu~cA sakatA|

kyA (ai rasalU!) Apa apane una sAthiyoM ke hAla se avagata nahIM haiM, jinhoMne mA~ga kI ki unapara jihAda farz2a (anivArya) kara diyA jAe, to unase kahA gayA: apane hAthoM ko lar3AI se roke rakho, namAz2a qAyama karo aura z2akAta dete raho| (aura yaha jihAda ke anivArya hone se pahale kI bAta hai) phira jaba ve madInA hijarata kara gae, aura islAma ko maz2abUtI prApta ho gaI aura jihAda farz2a kara diyA gayA; to unameM se kucha logoM ko yaha Adeza bar3A kaThina mAlUma huA aura ve logoM se aise Darane lage, jaise allAha se Darate haiM athavA usase bhI adhika| aura kahane lage: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hamapara jihAda kyoM anivArya kara diyA? ise kucha dinoM ke lie vilaMba kyoM nahIM kara diyA ki hama duniyA kA kucha fAyadA uThA lete| (ai rasUla!) Apa unase kaha deM: duniyA kA sAmAna (AnaMda) cAhe jitanA prApta ho jAe, thor3A aura nazvara hai, jabaki Aqhirata allAha se Darane vAloM ke lie behatara hai, kyoMki usakI nemateM sadA bAqI raheMgI| aura tumhAre acche kAmoM meM kisI bhI taraha kI kamI nahIM kI jAegI, cAhe vaha usa dhAge ke barAbara hI kyoM na ho jo khajUra kI guThalI meM hotA hai|

tuma jahA~ kahIM bhI ho, tumhArA samaya Ane para mRtyu tumako pA legI, bhale hI tuma yuddha ke maidAna se dUra abhedya mahaloM meM ho| ina munAfiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) kA hAla yaha hai ki yadi inheM saMtAna aura Dhera sArI AjIvikA jaisI koI khuzI kI cIz2a milatI hai, to kahate haiM ki yaha allAha kI ora se hai| lekina yadi inheM saMtAna yA AjIvikA meM kaThora sthiti kA sAmanA hotA hai, to nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama se apazakuna lete haiM aura kahate haiM ki yaha burAI Apake kAraNa hai| (ai rasUla!) inakA khaMDana karate hue kaha deM: bhalAiyA~ aura burAiyA~, saba allAha ke faisale aura usakI taqadIra ke adhIna haiM| to isa taraha kI bAta kahane vAloM ko kyA ho gayA hai ki ve samajha hI nahIM pA rahe haiM ki Apa unase kyA kaha rahe haiM?!

(ai Adama ke beTo!) tujhe jo bhI khuzI kI cIz2eM jaise AjIvikA aura saMtAna Adi prApta hotI haiM, ve saba allAha kI ora se haiM, jinake dvArA allAha ne tujha para anugraha kiyA hai| tathA terI roz2I aura saMtAna ke bAre meM tujhe jo parezAnI AtI hai, vaha saba terI tarapha se tere dvArA kie gae pApoM ke kAraNa hai| aura - ai nabI! - hamane Apako samasta logo ke lie allAha kA rasUla banAkara bhejA hai, tAki Apa unheM apane pAlanahAra kA saMdeza pahu~cAe~| tathA Apa allAha kI tarapha se logoM ko jo kucha pahu~cA rahe haiM, usakI satyatA para allAha sAkSI ke taura para kAfI hai una sabUtoM aura pramANoM ke sAtha jo usane Apako pradAna kie haiM|

jisane rasUla kA, unake AdezoM kA anupAlana kara aura unakI manA kI huI cIz2oM se bacakara, AjJApAlana kiyA, to usane allAha ke Adeza kA pAlana kiyA aura jisane - ai rasUla! - Apake AjJApAlana se mu~ha pherA, to Apa usake lie dukhI na hoM| kyoMki hamane Apako usake Upara saMrakSaka banAkara nahIM bhejA hai ki Apa usake kAryoM ko saMrakSita kareM| balki usake kAryoM ko ginakara rakhane aura usakA hisAba lene kA kAma hamArA hai|

munAfiqa loga Apase apane mu~ha se kahate haiM ki hama Apake Adeza ko mAnate haiM aura usakA pAlana karate haiM| parantu, jaba ve Apake pAsa se nikalakara jAte haiM, to unakA eka samUha gupta rUpa se usake viparIta SaDyaMtra karatA hai jo unhoMne Apake sAmane z2Ahira kiyA hai| hAlA~ki allAha unake SaDyaMtra se avagata hai aura unakI isa cAla kA unheM badalA degA| ataH Apa unapara koI dhyAna na deM; ve Apako kucha bhI nuqasAna nahIM pahu~cA sakeMge| Apa apanA mAmalA allAha ke havAle kara deM aura usa para bharosA kareM aura allAha kAryasAdhaka ke taira para kAphI hai jisa para Apa bharosA kara sakate haiM|

ye loga quraAna para manana ciMtana aura usakA gahana adhyayana kyoM nahIM karate, tAki unake lie yaha sAbita ho jAe usameM koI aMtara (asaMgati) yA gar3abar3I nahIM hai?! aura tAki unheM Apake lAe hue dharma kI saccAI para vizvAsa ho jAe| yadi yaha (quraAna) allAha sarvazaktimAna ke alAvA kisI anya kI ora se hotA, to ve usake prAvadhAnoM meM gar3abar3I aura usake arthoM meM bahuta aMtara (asaMgita) pAte|

jaba ina munAfiqoM ke pAsa musalamAnoM kI surakSA aura qhuzI, yA unake Dara aura duHkha kI koI sUcanA AtI hai, to use phailA dete aura prakAzita kara dete haiM| yadi ve dhIraja dharate aura usa mAmale ko rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI ora tathA soca-vicAra, jJAna evaM zubhaciMtana vAle logoM kI tarafa lauTA dete, to soca-vicAra karane aura niSkarSa nikAlane vAle loga isa bAta ko avazya jAna lete ki use prakAzita karanA cAhie yA gopanIya rakhanA cAhie| aura - ai momino! - agara islAma ke sAtha tumapara allAha kI anukaMpA aura quraAna ke sAtha tumapara usakI dayA na hotI ki usane tumheM usa durdazA se surakSita rakhA jisase ina munAfiqoM ko pIr3ita kiyA hai; to tumameM se kucha ko chor3akara, saba zaitAna ke bahakAve meM A jAte|

ataH - ai rasUla! - Apa allAha ke rAste meM, usake dharma ko sarvocca karane ke lie yuddha kareM| Apase Apake alAvA kisI anya ke bAre meM nahIM pUchA jAegA aura na Apa usake lie bAdhya haiM| kyoMki Apa para kevala apane Apako yuddha para tatpara karane kI z2immedArI hai| tathA mominoM ko bhI yuddha ke lie protsAhita kareM aura usa para ubhAreM| saMbhava hai ki allAha tumhAre yuddha ke dvArA kAfiroM kA z2ora tor3a de| allAha adhika zaktizAlI aura adhika kaThora daMDa dene vAlA hai|

maiM unheM z2arUra tere sIdhe mArga se rokU~gA, unheM avazya unakI gumarAhI ko sajAne vAle jhUThe vAdoM ke sAtha ummIdeM dilAU~gA| allAha ke halAla kie hue jAnavaroM ko harAma karane ke lie, unheM jAnavaroM ke kAna kATane kA Adeza dU~gA| tathA unheM allAha kI racanA aura usakI prakRti ko badalane ke lie bhI z2arUra Adeza dU~gA| tathA jo zaitAna ko apanA sahAyaka va dosta banAkara, usase dostI nibhAtA aura usakI AjJA kA pAlana karatA hai, to vaha dhikkArita zaitAna se vaphAdArI karake eka spaSTa nuqasAna meM par3a gayA|
zaitAna unase jhUThe vAde karatA hai aura unheM jhUThI ummIdeM dilAtA hai| hAlA~ki, vAstava meM, vaha unase jhUThA vAdA karatA hai, jisakI koI saccAI nahIM hotI hai|
zaitAna ke nakzekadama aura usakI sikhAI huI bAtoM kA pAlana karane vAle logoM kA ThikAnA jahannama kI Aga hai, jisase bhAga nikalane kA koI sthAna nahIM pAe~ge jahA~ ve panAha le sakeM|

jaba allAha ne zaitAna ke anuyAyiyoM ke badale kA ullekha kiyA, to usane rasUloM ke anuyAyiyoM ke badale kA bhI ullekha kiyA| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
jo loga allAha para ImAna lAe aura usase qarIba karane vAle acche kArya kie, hama unheM aisI jannatoM meM dAqhila kareMge, jinake mahaloM ke nIce se nahareM bahatI hai| ve unameM hamezA ke lie raheMge| yaha allAha kA vacana hai aura usakA vacana saccA hai| kyoMki vaha vacana ko nahIM tor3atA hai aura allAha se bar3hakara vacana meM saccA koI nahIM|

mokSa aura saphalatA kA mAmalA - ai musalamAno! - tumhArI kAmanAoM para yA ahle kitAba kI kAmanAoM para nirbhara nahIM hai| balki, yaha mAmalA kAma se jur3A hai| isalie tumameM se jo bhI burA kAma karegA, qayAmata ke dina usakA badalA pAegA| use allAha ke sivA koI saMrakSaka nahIM milegA, jo use lAbha pahu~cA sake aura na use koI sahAyaka milegA, jo usase nuqasAna ko TAla sake|

jo bhI acche kArya karatA hai, cAhe nara ho yA nArI aura vaha allAha para saccA ImAna bhI rakhane vAlA hai, to aise loga jinhoMne ImAna ke sAtha satkarma bhI kiyA, jannata meM praveza kareMge| unake kAryoM ke pratiphala meM kucha bhI kamI nahIM kI jAegI, bhale hI vaha khajUra kI guThalI ke UparI bhAga ke gaDDhe jitanA kama kyoM na ho|

usa vyakti se behatara dharma kisI kA nahIM hai, jo bAharI aura AMtarika rUpa se allAha ke prati samarpita ho jAe, apanI nIyata ko usake lie vizuddha kara le, usakI zarIyata kA pAlanakara apane kArya ko acchA kara le aura zirka evaM kufra se kaTakara tauhIda aura ImAna kI ora ekAgra hokara, ibarAhIma alaihisassalAma ke dharma kA anusaraNa kare, jo muha़mmada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke dharma kA mUla hai| allAha ne apane nabI ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ko sAre logoM ke bIca pUrNa prema ke lie cuna liyA hai|
AsamAnoM aura z2amIna kI sArI cIz2oM kA rAjya akele allAha kA hai aura allAha apanI sRSTi kI hara cIz2a ko apane jJAna, zakti aura prabaMdhana ke sAtha ghere hue hai|

- ai rasUla - loga Apase striyoM ke mAmale meM tathA unake adhikAroM aura kartavyoM ke bAre meM pUchate haiM| Apa unase kaha deM: allAha tumhAre isa prazna kA uttara detA hai aura tumhAre lie kuraAna kI vaha AyateM bhI bayAna karatA haiM, jo una anAtha striyoM ke viSaya meM tumheM par3hakara sunAI jAtI haiM jo tumhArI abhibhAvakatA ke aMtargata hotI haiM aura tuma unheM allAha kI ora se unake lie nirdhArita kie gae mahara yA virAsata se vaMcita rakhate ho| tuma svayaM unase zAdI nahIM karanA cAhate aura unake dhana ke lAlaca meM unheM zAdI karane se bhI rokate ho| vaha tumhAre lie kamaz2ora baccoM ke adhikAroM ko bhI spaSTa karatA hai ki unheM virAsata meM unakA adhikAra do aura unake dhana para qabz2A jamAkara una para atyAcAra na karo| tathA tumhAre lie yaha dAyitva bhI bayAna karatA hai ki anAthoM ke mAmaloM kA nyAya ke sAtha isa taraha prabaMdhana karo, jisase duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM unakA bhalA ho| tuma anAthoM aura anya logoM ke lie jo bhI acchA karoge, allAha usase avagata hai aura tumheM usakA badalA degA|

yadi kisI strI ko apane pati se isa bAta kA bhaya ho ki vaha usakI upekSA kara rahA hai aura usameM ruci nahIM le rahA hai, to una donoM para Apasa meM samajhautA kara lene meM koI gunAha nahIM hai, isa prakAra ki vaha pati para apane kucha anivArya adhikAroM jaise- bharaNa-poSaNa evaM rAta guz2Arane kI bArI ke adhikAra, ko chor3a de| yahA~ sulaha karanA una donoM ke lie talAqa se behatara hai| hAlA~ki lobha aura kaMjUsI mAnava svabhAva meM zAmila haiM| isalie vaha apane adhikAroM ko chor3anA nahIM cAhatI hai| aise meM pati-patnI ko isa svabhAva kA upacAra, svayaM kA udArahRdayatA aura paropakAra para prazikSaNa karake karanA cAhie| yadi tuma apane sabhI mAmaloM meM upakAra kA rAstA apanAo aura allAha se, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usakI manA kI huI cIz2oM kA parityAga karake, Darate raho, to allAha tumhAre karmoM se avagata hai, usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai aura vaha tumheM usakA badalA degA|

- ai patiyo - tuma cAhate hue bhI, dilI lagAva ke mAmale meM patniyoM ke sAtha pUrI taraha se nyAya nahIM kara sakate| isake kucha kAraNa haiM, jo tumhAre niyaMtraNa se bAhara ho sakate haiM| isalie usa patnI se pUrI taraha vimukha na ho jAo, jo tumheM pasaMda nahIM hai| phira tuma use adhara meM laTakI huI kI taraha chor3a do; na to usakA koI pati hai, jo usakA haqa adA kare, aura na vaha binA pati vAlI hai ki zAdI kI apekSA kare| yadi tuma apane bIca ke mAmaloM ko sudhAra lo isa prakAra ki dila ke na cAhate hue bhI apane Apako patnI ke adhikAroM kA nirvAhana karane ke lie bAdhya kara lo aura patnI ke mAmale meM allAha se Darate raho, to allAha bar3A kSamA karane vAlA aura tuma para dayAvAna hai|

yadi talAqa yA qhulaa ke dvArA pati-patnI eka dUsare se alaga ho jAe~, to allAha unameM se pratyeka ko apane vyApaka anugraha se samRddha kara degA| allAha vyApaka anugraha evaM dayA vAlA, tathA apane prabaMdhana aura taqadIra (niyati) meM hikamata vAlA hai|

jo kucha AkAzoM aura dharatI meM tathA jo kucha una donoM ke bIca hai, una saba kA mAlika kevala allAha hai| hamane kitAba vAle yahUdiyoM aura IsAiyoM ko Adeza diyA thA aura tumheM bhI Adeza diyA hai ki allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karo aura usakI manA kI huI cIz2oM se baco| yadi tuma isa Adeza kA inakAra karoge, to kevala apane Apa ko nuqasAna pahu~cAoga|kyoMki allAha tumhArI AjJAkAritA se beparavAha hai| vaha to AsamAnoM aura z2amIna kI sArI cIz2oM kA mAlika hai, aura vaha apanI sArI racanAoM se beniyAz2a aura apane sabhI guNoM aura kAryoM para stuti ke yogya hai|
AsamAnoM aura z2amIna kI sArI cIz2eM kevala allAha kI haiM, jo AjJApAlana ke yogya hai aura allAha apanI racanA ke sabhI mAmaloM kA prabhAra lene ke lie paryApta hai|

yadi vaha cAhe, to - ai logo - vaha tumheM vinaSTa kara de aura tumhAre sthAna para dUsare logoM ko le Ae, jo allAha kI AjJA mAneM aura usakI avajJA na kareM| tathA allAha aisA karane meM sakSama hai|

- ai logo! - tumameM se jo vyakti apane kArya se kevala duniyA kA badalA cAhatA hai, vaha jAna le ki allAha ke pAsa duniyA aura Akhirata donoM kA badalA hai| isalie vaha allAha se donoM kA badalA mA~ge| allAha tumhArI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, tumhAre kAryoM ko dekhane vAlA hai aura vaha tumheM unakA badalA degA|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! apanI sabhI paristhitiyoM meM nyAya para jame rahane vAle, hara eka ke sAtha saccI gavAhI dene vAle bana jAo| bhale hI isake lie tumheM apane Apake, yA apane mAtA-pitA yA apane riztedAroM ke viruddha saca kA iqarAra karanA par3e| kisI kI g2arIbI yA amIrI tumheM gavAhI dene yA na dene ke lie bAdhya na kare| kyoMki allAha usa g2arIba aura amIra kA tumase adhika haqadAra hai aura unake hitoM ko tumase adhika jAnatA hai| isalie apanI gavAhI meM icchAoM kA pAlana na kareM tAki aisA na ho ki Apa usameM satya se haTa jAe~| yadi tuma gavAhI ko galata tarIqe se peza karake usameM hera-phera karoge yA gavAhI dene se upekSA karoge, to jAna lo ki allAha tumhAre sabhI kAryoM se avagata hai|

ai ImAna vAlo! allAha aura usake rasUla para apane ImAna, usa kuraAna para ImAna jise allAha ne apane rasUla (muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) para avatarita kiyA tathA una kitAboM para apane ImAna para sudRr3ha raho jinheM usane Apase pahale rUsalUoM para avatarita kiyA| jo allAha, usake fariztoM, usakI kitAboM, usake rasUloM aura qayAmata ke dina kA inakAra kare, to vaha sIdhe rAste se bahuta dUra ho gayA|

jo loga ImAna lAne ke bAda bAra-bAra kufra karate rahe, isa prakAra ki ve ImAna lAe, phira usase palaTa gae, isake bAda unhoMne phira se ImAna meM praveza kiyA, phira usase palaTa gae aura kufra para jame rahe aura usI hAla meM mara gae; to allAha unake pApoM ko kSamA nahIM karegA aura na hI unheM usa sIdhe rAste kA mArgadarzana karegA jo usa sarvazaktimAna taka pahu~cAne vAlA hai|
- ai rasUla! - munAfikoM ko, jo ImAna kA pradarzana karate haiM aura apane diloM meM kufra chipAe hote haiM, zubha-sUcanA sunA deM ki unake lie qayAmata ke dina allAha ke pAsa dardanAka yAtanA hai|

isa yAtanA kA kAraNa yaha hai ki unhoMne mominoM ko chor3akara kAfiroM ko apanA samarthaka aura sahAyaka banA liyA| yaha bAta Azcaryajanaka hai jisane unheM unakA vaphAdAra banA diyA| kyA ve unase zakti evaM bala-pratiSThA prApta karake apanA vaibhava bar3hAnA cAhate haiM?! to unheM yAda rakhanA cAhie ki sArI zakti evaM bala-pratiSThA kA mAlika kevala allAha hai|

- ai momino! - allAha ne tumhAre lie pavitra quraAna meM avatarita kiyA hai ki jaba tuma kisI sabhI meM baiTho aura vahA~ kisI ko allAha kI AyatoM kA inakAra karate hue aura unakA maz2Aqa ur3Ate hue suno; to unake sAtha na baiTho aura vahA~ se uThakara cala do, yahA~ taka ki ve allAha kI AyatoM kA inakAra aura unakA maz2Aqa chor3akara koI dUsarI bAta zurU kara deM| yadi tumane aisA nahIM kiyA aura saba kucha sunane ke bAvajUda baiThe rahe, to unhIM kI taraha allAha ke Adeza kA ullaMghana karane vAle bana jAoge| kyoMki tumane vahA~ baiThakara allAha kI avajJA kI hai, jisa taraha ki unhoMne kufra karake allAha kI avajJA kI hai| niHsaMdeha, allAha munAfiqoM ko jo ImAna ko pradarzita karate aura kufra ko gupta rakhate haiM, qayAmata ke dina kAfiroM ke sAtha jahannama meM ekatrita karegA|

jo tumheM pahu~cane vAlI acchAI yA burAI kI pratIkSA meM rahate haiM| yadi allAha kI ora se tumheM vijaya prApta hotA hai aura tumheM g2anImata kA dhana milatA hai, to ve tumase kahate haiM: kyA hama tumhAre sAtha nahIM the, jisa yuddha meM tuma upasthita hue hama bhI upasthita hue?! tAki ve g2anImata se hissA pA sakeM| aura yadi kAfiroM ko kucha hissA mila jAe, to unase kahate haiM: kyA hamane tumhAre mAmaloM kA dhyAna nahIM rakhA, tumhArI dekhabhAla aura samarthana nahIM kiyA, tathA tumhArI madada karake aura unakA atsAha bhaMga karake, mominoM se tumhArA bacAva nahIM kiyA?! ataH allAha tuma saba ke bIca qiyAmata ke dina nirNaya kara degA| cunA~ce mominoM ko jannata meM dAqhila karegA aura munAphiqoM ko jahannama ke sabase nicale kSetra meM dAqhila karegA| tathA allAha, apanI kRpA se, qiyAmata ke dina kAfiroM ko mominoM ke qhilApha tarka (hujjata) pradAna nahIM karegA, balki vaha aMtima pariNAma ImAna vAloM hI kA banAegA jaba taka ve sacce ImAna vAle, zarIyata ke anusAra kArya karane vAle hoMge|

munAfiqa loga islAma kA pradarzana karake aura avizvAsa ko gupta rakhakara allAha ko dhokhA dete haiM, hAlA~ki allAha hI unheM dhokhe meM DAla rahA hai| kyoMki usane unake avizvAsa se avagata hone ke bAvajUda unake khUna ko surakSita kara diyA hai aura Aqhirata meM unake lie sabase kaThora daMDa taiyAra kiyA hai| aura jaba ve namAz2a ke lie khar3e hote haiM, to AlasI hokara use nApasaMda karate hue khar3e hote haiM| unakA uddezya logoM ko dikhAnA aura unakA sammAna hotA hai, aura ve allAha ke lie niSThAvAna nahIM hote haiM tathA allAha ko kevala thor3A hI yAda karate haiM jaba ve mominoM ko dekhate haiM|

ye munAfiqa loga hairAnI aura asamaMjasa meM par3e hue haiM| cunA~ce ve pratyakSa evaM prokSa rUpa se na musalamAnoM ke sAtha haiM aura na kAfiroM ke sAtha| balki ve pratyakSa rUpa se musalamAnoM ke sAtha haiM, aura prokSa rUpa se kAfiroM ke sAtha haiM| aura jise allAha gumarAha kara de, to - ai rasUla! - Apa usake lie pathabhraSTatA se mArgadarzana para lAne kA haragiz2a koI rAstA nahIM pAe~ge|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! allAha ke sAtha kufra karanevAloM ko ghaniSTha mitra na banAo ki mominoM ko chor3akara unase dostI gA~Tho| kyA tuma apane isa kArya se allAha ko, apane yAtanA ke haqadAra hone kA spaSTa pramANa denA cAhate ho?
allAha taAlA qayAmata ke dina munAfiqoM ko naraka ke sabase nicale sthAna meM jagaha degA aura tuma unakA haragiz2a koI sahAyaka nahIM pAoge,jo unase yAtanA ko haTA sake|

paraMtu jo loga apane nifAqa (pAkhaMDa) se pazcAtApa karake allAha kI ora lauTa Ae, apane aMtaramana ko sudhAra liyA, allAha kI pratijJA kA pAlana kiyA aura apane kArya ko dikhAvA kie binA allAha ke lie vizuddha kara diyA, to ina guNoM vAle loga duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM mominoM ke sAtha hoMge, aura allAha mominoM ko bar3A pratiphala pradAna karegA|

yadi tuma allAha ke AbhArI bano aura usapara ImAna rakho, to use tumheM yAtanA dene kI koI z2arUrata nahIM hai| kyoMki vaha sarvazaktimAna bar3A upakArI atyaMta dayAvAna hai| vaha tumheM kevala tumhAre gunAhoM ke kAraNa yAtanA detA hai| yadi tumane apane kArya sudhAra lie, allAha ke prati usakI nematoM para AbhAra prakaTa karate rahe aura pratyakSa evaM prokSa rUpa se usapara ImAna lAe, to vaha tumheM haragiz2a yAtanA nahIM degA| allAha una logoM kA qadradAna (guNagrAhaka) hai jinhoMne usakI nematoM ko svIkAra kiyA, cunA~ce vaha unheM usapara bharapUra badalA pradAna karegA| vaha apane baMdoM ke ImAna se avagata hai aura hara eka ko usake karmoM kA badalA degA|

allAha burI bAta ke sAtha AvAz2a U~cI karanA pasaMda nahIM karatA, balki use nApasaMda karatA aura usa para saz2A kI dhamakI detA hai| paraMtu jisapara atyAcAra huA ho, use apane utpIr3aka ke bAre meM zikAyata karane, usapara bad-duA karane aura usase usI ke samAna zabdoM ke sAtha badalA lene ke lie, burI bAta ke sAtha AvAz2a U~cI karane kI anumati hai| lekina utpIr3ita kA dhairya se kAma lenA, burI bAta ke sAtha AvAz2a bulaMda karane se behatara hai| allAha tumhArI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, tumhAre irAdoM ko jAnane vAlA hai| isalie bure zabdoM yA irAdoM se sAvadhAna raho|

yadi tuma koI bhalI bAta yA bhalA kArya prakaTa karo, yA use chipAo, yA usa vyakti ko kSamA kara do, jisane tumase burA vyavahAra kiyA hai; to niHsaMdeha allAha bahuta mAfa karane vAlA, sarvazaktimAna hai| isalie kSamA karanA tumhAre AcaraNa kA hissA honA cAhie, zAyada allAha tumheM kSamA kara de|

jo loga allAha ke sAtha kufra karate aura usake rasUloM ke sAtha kufra karate haiM, tathA allAha aura usake rasUloM ke bIca aMtara karanA cAhate haiM; ki ve allAha para ImAna lAe~, paraMtu usake rasUloM kA inakAra kara deM| tathA ve kahate haiM: hama kucha rasUloM para vizvAsa karate haiM aura unameM se kucha para vizvAsa nahIM karate| isa prakAra ve kufra aura ImAna ke bIca kA rAstA apanAnA cAhate haiM, yaha bhrama rakhate hue ki yaha unheM bacA legA|

jo loga yaha rAstA apanAte haiM, vahI sacamuca kAfira haiM; kyoMki jisane samasta rasUloM yA unameM se kucha kA inakAra kiyA, usane daraasala allAha aura usake rasUloM ke sAtha kufra kiyA| aura hamane kAfiroM ke lie qiyAmata ke dina unheM apamAnita karane vAlI yAtanA taiyAra kara rakhI hai, jo unake allAha aura usake rasUloM para ImAna lAne se ahaMkAra karane kI saz2A ke rUpa meM hai|

jaba allAha ne kAfiroM ke pratiphala kA ullekha kiyA, to usake bAda mominoM ke pratiphala kA ullekha kiyA, cunA~ce usane pharamAyA:
jo loga allAha para ImAna lAe aura use eka mAnA, aura usake sAtha kisI ko sAjhI nahIM ThaharAyA, tathA usake sabhI rasUloM para ImAna lAe aura kAfiroM kI taraha unameM se kisI ke bIca aMtara nahIM kiyA, balki una sabhI para ImAna lAe; yahI loga haiM jinheM allAha unake ImAna tathA acche karmoM kA bar3A badalA pradAna karegA, aura allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko bahuta kSamA karane vAlA, unapara ati dayAlu hai|

(ai rasUla!) yahUdI Apase mA~ga karate haiM ki jaise mUsA ke sAtha huA, vaise hI Apa unake lie AkAza se eka hI bAra meM koI pustaka utAra lAe~, jo ApakI saccAI kI nizAnI ho| to Apa ise unakI ora se koI bar3A mA~ga na samajheM| kyoMki unake pUrvajoM ne mUsA alaihissalAma se isase kahIM bar3I mA~ga kI thI jo ina logoM ne Apase kI hai| unhoMne kahA thA ki "hameM allAha ko Amane-sAmane dikhA do", cunA~ce unheM saz2A ke taura para bijalI girA kara mAra diyA gayA| phira allAha ne unheM punarjIvita kiyA, to unhoMne allAha ko chor3akara bachar3e kI pUjA kI, hAlA~ki unake pAsa allAha ke ekatva aura usake ekamAtra raba (pAlanahAra) aura pUjya hone ko darzAne vAlI spaSTa nizAniyA~ A cukI thIM| phira hamane unheM kSamA kara diyA, tathA mUsA - alaihissalAma - ko unakI jAti ke viruddha spaSTa tarka pradAna kiyA|

tathA hamane unase dRr3ha vacana lene ke kAraNa, usake anusAra kAma karane ke lie unheM DarAne ke lie pahAr3a ko unake Upara uThA liyA, aura use uThAne ke bAda hamane unase kahA: baitula maqadisa ke dvAra meM sajadA karate hue sira jhukAkara praveza karo| paraMtu ve apanI pITha ke bala ghisaTate hue bhItara gae| tathA hamane unase kahA: zanivAra ko zikAra karake ati na karo| lekina unhoMne ati kiyA, so unhoMne zikAra kiyA| tathA hamane unase isa bAta kA kar3A vacana liyA, para unhoMne usa vacana ko tor3a diyA jo unase liyA gayA thA|

ataH hamane unheM apanI dayA se dUra kara diyA, kyoMki unhoMne usa dRr3ha vacana ko tor3a diyA, jo unase liyA gayA thA, tathA isa kAraNa ki unhoMne allAha kI nizAniyoM kA inakAra kiyA aura nabiyoM kI hatyA karane kA dussAhasa kiyA evaM muhammada - sallallAhu alaihi va sallama - se kahA ki: "hamAre dila eka AvaraNa meM haiM, isalie Apa jo kahate haiM use nahIM samajhate|" jabaki mAmalA aisA nahIM hai| balki allAha ne unake kufra ke kAraNa unake diloM para muhara lagA dI hai, isalie koI acchAI una taka nahIM pahu~catI| ataH ve bahuta kama ImAna lAte haiM, jisase unheM koI phAyadA nahIM hotA hai|
aura hamane unheM unake kufra ke kAraNa, tathA isa kAraNa dayA se nikAla diyA ki unhoMne marayama - alaihassalAma - para vyabhicAra kA jhUThA aura nirAdhAra Aropa lagAyA|

tathA hamane unapara unake garva karate hue jhUThamUTha yaha kahane ke kAraNa lAnata bhejI: niHsaMdeha hamane hI allAha ke rasUla marayama ke putra IsA masIha ko qatla kiyA| hAlA~ki na to unhoMne unheM qatla kiyA, jaisA ki unakA dAvA hai, aura na hI unheM sUlI para car3hAyA| balki unhoMne eka aise vyakti ko qatla kiyA, jise allAha ne IsA - alaihissalAma - kA sadRza banA diyA thA aura use sUlI para car3hAyA| isalie unhoMne socA ki qatla hone vAlA IsA alaihissalAma hI the| jina yahUdiyoM ne IsA alaihissalAma kI hatyA kA dAvA kiyA aura jina IsAiyoM ne unheM yahUdiyoM ke havAle kiyA, donoM hI unake mAmale meM bhrama aura saMdeha meM haiM| kyoMki unheM isakA koI jJAna nahIM hai| ve kevala anumAna kA pAlana karate haiM aura anumAna se saccAI kA kucha bhI lAbha nahIM hotA hai| unhoMne nizcita rUpa se IsA alaihissalAma ko na to qatla kiyA aura na unheM sUlI para car3hAyA|

balki allAha ne IsA alaihissalAma ko unakI sAz2iza se bacA liyA aura unheM unake zarIra evaM AtmA ke sAtha apanI ora uThA liyA| allAha sadA se apane rAjya meM prabhutvazAlI hai, koI use parAjita nahIM kara sakatA, apane prabaMdhana, faisale aura vidhAna meM pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai|

ahle kitAba (yahUdiyoM evaM IsAiyoM) meM se hara vyakti, IsA alaihissalAma para unake aMtima yuga meM utarane ke pazcAta aura unakI mRtyu se pahale avazya ImAna lAegA, tathA qiyAmata ke dina IsA alaihissalAma unake karmoM ke sAkSI hoMge; ki unameM se kyA zarIyata ke anusAra hai aura kyA usake qhilAfa|

yahUdiyoM ke atyAcAra ke kAraNa, hamane unapara kaI pAkIz2A khAne kI cIz2oM ko harAma kara diyA, jo unake lie halAla thIM| cunA~ce hamane unapara hara nAqhUna (paMje) se zikAra karane vAlA pakSI harAma kara diyA, tathA gAyoM aura bakariyoM meM se hamane unakI carbI ko unapara harAma kara diyA, sivAya usa (carbI) ke jo una donoM kI pIThoM se lagI huI ho| isakA eka kAraNa yaha bhI thA ki ve khuda ko aura dUsaroM ko allAha ke mArga se rokate the, yahA~ taka ki bhalAI se rokanA unakA svabhAva bana gayA thA|

tathA unake byAja kA lena-dena karane ke kAraNa, jabaki allAha ne unheM use lene se manA kiyA thA, tathA logoM ke dhana ko binA kisI ucita adhikAra ke lene ke kAraNa| aura hamane unameM se kAfiroM ke lie eka dardanAka az2Aba taiyAra kiyA hai|

kitAba vAloM kI burAiyoM kA ullekha karane ke bAda, unameM se ImAna vAloM kA ullekha karate hue pharamAyA:
paraMtu yahUdiyoM meM se Thosa jJAna rakhane vAle tathA ImAna lAne vAle loga, usa quraAna ko saccA mAnate haiM, jo allAha ne (ai rasUla!) Apapara utArA hai, tathA ve una kitAboM ko bhI satya mAnate haiM, jo Apase pahale ke rasUloM para utArI gaI thIM, jaise taurAta aura iMjIla, aura ve namAz2a qAyama karate aura apane dhana kI z2akAta dete haiM, tathA isa bAta para vizvAsa rakhate haiM ki allAha hI akelA pUjya hai, jisakA koI sAjhI nahIM, aura qiyAmata ke dina ko satya mAnate haiM; ye loga jinake pAsa ye guNa haiM hama unheM bahuta bar3A badalA pradAna kareMge|

hamane (ai rasUla!) ApakI ora vaise hI vaha़ya (prakAzanA) bhejI hai, jaise ki hamane Apase pahale ke nabiyoM kI ora vaha़ya bhejI thI| isalie Apa koI anokhe rasUla nahIM haiM| cunA~ce hamane nUha kI ora vaha़ya bhejI tathA unake bAda Ane vAle nabiyoM kI ora vaha़ya bhejI, aura hamane ibarAhIma kI ora, unake donoM suputroM isamAIla evaM isahAqa kI ora, tathA yAqUba bina isahAqa kI ora aura asabAta (yAnI yAqUba alaihissalAma ke beToM se nikalane vAle banI isarAIla ke bAraha vaMzoM meM hone vAle nabiyoM) kI ora vaha़ya bhejI| tathA hamane IsA, ayyUba, yUnusa, hArUna aura sulaimAna kI ora vaha़ya bhejI, aura hamane dAUda alaihissalAma ko z2abUra nAmI pustaka dI|

hamane kucha rasUla aise bheje, jinake vRttAMta hamane Apase quraAna meM bayAna kara die haiM, tathA kucha rasUla aise bheje jinake bAre meM hamane Apase usameM kucha bayAna nahIM kiyA aura kisI hikamata ke tahata usameM unakA ullekha karanA chor3a diyA| tathA allAha ne mUsA alaihissalAma se unake sammAna meM unheM nabI banAne ke saMbaMdha meM - binA madhyasthatA ke - vAstavika rUpa se bAta kI, jaisA usakI mahimA ke yogya hai|

hamane unheM allAha para ImAna lAne vAloM ko acche pratiphala kI zubha sUcanA dene vAlA tathA usake sAtha kufra karane vAloM ko dardanAka yAtanA se DarAne vAlA banAkara bhejA, tAki rasUloM ko bhejane ke bAda logoM ke lie allAha ke qhilAfa koI tarka na raha jAe, jise ve bahAnA banA sakeM| tathA allAha apane rAjya meM prabhutvazAlI, apane faisale meM hikamata vAlA hai|

yadi yahUda ApakA inakAra karate haiM, to allAha usa quraAna kI prAmANikatA ke saMbaMdha meM ApakI puSTi karatA hai, jo usane (ai rasUla!) ApakI ora utArA hai| allAha ne usameM apanA vaha jJAna utArA hai, jisase vaha apane baMdoM ko avagata karAnA cAhatA hai, ki vaha kina cIz2oM ko pasaMda karatA aura unase prasanna hotA hai yA kina cIz2oM ko nApasaMda karatA aura unase napharatA karatA hai| allAha kI gavAhI ke sAtha farizte bhI usakI saccAI kI gavAhI dete haiM jo Apa lekara Ae haiM| tathA allAha gavAha ke rUpa meM paryApta hai| kyoMki usakI gavAhI ke bAda kisI dUsare kI gavAhI kI z2arUrata nahIM|
niHsaMdeha jina logoM ne Apake nabI hone kA inakAra kiyA aura logoM ko islAma ke mArga se rokA, nizcaya ve satya se bahuta dUra jA par3e|

jina logoM ne allAha aura usake rasUloM ke sAtha kufra kiyA aura kufra para bane rahakara qhuda para z2ulma kiyA, allAha unake kufra para aTala rahane ko kabhI kSamA nahIM karegA, aura na hI unheM allAha kI yAtanA se bacAne vAlA mArga darzAegA|

sivAya usa rAste ke jo jahannama meM praveza kI ora le jAtA hai, jisameM ve sadA-sarvadA rahane vAle haiM| aura yaha kAma allAha ke lie bahuta hI AsAna hai, kyoMki koI bhI cIz2a use vivaza nahIM kara sakatI|

ai logo! rasUla muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama tumhAre pAsa mArgadarzana aura satya dharma ke sAtha allAha kI ora se Ae haiM| ataH vaha tumhAre pAsa jo kucha lAe haiM usapara ImAna le Ao, yaha duniyA tathA Aqhirata meM tumhAre lie behatara hogA| yadi tuma allAha ke sAtha kufra karate ho, to allAha tumhAre ImAna se beniyAz2a hai, tumhArA kufra karanA use nuqasAna nahIM pahu~cAegA| kyoMki jo kucha AkAzoM meM hai aura jo kucha dharatI meM tathA ina donoM ke bIca hai, saba usake adhikAra meM hai| tathA allAha usake bAre meM jAnane vAlA hai jo mArgadarzana kA pAtra hai, isalie usake lie mArgadarzana ko AsAna banA detA hai, aura jo usakA haqadAra nahIM hai, isalie use usase aMdhA kara detA hai| vaha apanI bAtoM, kAryoM, vidhAna aura niyati meM pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai|

(ai rasUla!) Apa iMjIla vAle IsAiyoM se kaha deM: tuma apane dharma meM sImA se pare mata jAo tathA IsA alaihissalAma ke bAre meM allAha para satya ke alAvA kucha bhI na kaho| marayama ke beTe IsA masIha alaihissalAma kevala allAha ke rasUla haiM, jinheM usane saccAI ke sAtha bhejA| allAha ne unheM apane usa zabda se paidA kiyA, jise usane jibarIla ke sAtha marayama ke pAsa bhejA| vaha zabda usakA 'kuna' (arthAt ho jA) kahanA thA, to vaha ho gae| yaha daraasala allAha kI ora se eka phU~ka thI, jo jibarIla ne allAha kI AjJA se (phU~ka) mArI thI| ataH allAha aura usake sabhI rasUloM para binA kisI bheda (aMtara) ke ImAna lAo aura yaha mata kaho ki pUjya tIna haiM| isa jhUThI aura bhraSTa bAta se bAz2a A jAo! tumhArA ise tyAganA tumhAre lie duniyA aura Aqhirata meM behatara hogA| allAha kevala eka hI pUjya hai| vaha sAjhI tathA saMtAna se sarvocca hai| kyoMki vaha hara cIz2a se beniyAz2a hai, jo kucha AkAzoM evaM dharatI tathA una donoM ke bIca meM hai, una sabakA mAlika vahI hai| tathA AkAzoM aura dharatI kI sArI cIz2oM ke saMrakSaka aura unake prabaMdhaka ke rUpa meM allAha kAfI hai|

IsA bina marayama alaihissalAma allAha kA baMdA hone se kadApi upekSA aura saMkoca nahIM kareMge, aura na hI ve farizte jinheM allAha ne apanA nikaTavartI banAyA aura unake pada ko U~cA kiyA hai, allAha ke baMde hone se upekSA karate haiM| to phira tuma IsA ko eka pUjya kaise banAte ho?! tathA zirka karane vAle loga fariztoM ko pUjya kaise banAte haiM?! jo koI bhI allAha kI ibAdata se upekSA kare aura apane ko usase U~cA samajhe, to (jJAta rahanA cAhie ki) allAha qiyAmata ke dina sabako apane pAsa ikaTThA karegA aura vaha hara eka ko vaha pratiphala degA, jisake vaha yogya hai|

jaba allAha ne yaha bayAna kiyA ki vaha saba logoM ko apane pAsa ikaTThA karegA, to usane unake pratiphala kA vivaraNa apane isa kathana meM prastuta kiyA:
jo loga allAha para ImAna lAe aura usake rasUloM ko saccA mAnA tathA vizuddha rUpa se allAha ke lie, usake batAe hue tarIqe ke anusAra acche kArya kie, to allAha unheM unake karmoM kA pratiphala binA kama kie degA, tathA apane anugraha aura upakAra se unheM usase adhika bhI degA| paraMtu jina logoM ne allAha kI ibAdata aura usakI AjJAkAritA se upekSA kiyA tathA ahaMkAra karate hue apane Apako usase U~cA samajhA, to vaha unheM dardanAka yAtanA degA| tathA ve allAha ke sivA kisI ko nahIM pAe~ge, jo unakA saMrakSaka banakara unheM lAbha pahu~cAe aura madadagAra banakara unheM nuqasAna se bacA sake|

ai logo! tumhAre pAsa tumhAre raba kI ora se eka spaSTa tarka AyA hai, jo bahAne ko kATa detA hai aura zaka ko dUra kara detA hai - aura vaha muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama haiM - tathA hamane tumhArI ora eka spaSTa prakAza utArA hai, jo ki yaha quraAna hai|

jo loga allAha para ImAna lAe aura usa quraAna ko maz2abUtI se pakar3a liyA, jo unake nabI para utArA gayA hai, to allAha unapara dayA karate hue unheM jannata meM dAkhila karegA| tathA unake pratiphala ko bar3hA degA aura unake darjoM ko U~cA karegA, tathA unheM sIdhe mArga para calane kA sAmarthya pradAna karegA, jisameM koI Ter3ha nahIM, jo ki vaha rAstA hai jo sadA nivAsa ke bAg2oM kI ora le jAne vAlA hai|

(ai rasUla!) loga Apase pUchate haiM ki Apa unheM 'kalAlA' kI virAsata ke viSaya meM zaraI hukma se sUcita kareM| 'kalAlA' usa vyakti ko kahA jAtA hai, jisakI mRtyu ho jAe aura usane pitA yA koI saMtAna na chor3I ho| Apa kaha dIjie: allAha usakA hukma bayAna karatA hai: yadi kisI vyakti kI mRtyu ho jAe aura usakA na pitA jIvita ho na koI saMtAna ho, jabaki usakI koI sagI athavA bApa zarIka bahana ho, to bahana ko farz2a (quraAna meM nirdiSTa hisse) ke rUpa meM chor3e hue dhana kA AdhA hissA milegA| tathA usakA sagA yA allAtI (bApa zarIka) bhAI 'asabA' (jisa kA hissA nirdiSTa na ho) ke taura para usake chor3e hue dhana kA vArisa hogA, yadi usake sAtha koI farz2a (nirdiSTa hisse) vAlA na ho| kiMtu yadi usake sAtha koI farz2a (nirdiSTa hisse) vAlA maujUda ho, to vaha usakA hissA nikAlane ke bAda zeSa dhana kA vArisa hogA| yadi sagI yA bApa zarIka bahaneM eka se adhika hoM, to farz2a (nirdiSTa hisse) ke rUpa meM unheM do-tihAI milegA| tathA yadi sage yA bApa zarIka bhAI aura bahana donoM hoM, to ve 'asabA' ke rUpa meM "puruSa ke lie do mahilAoM ke barAbara hissA hai|" ke niyama ke anusAra vArisa hoMge isa prakAra ki unameM se puruSa kA hissA mahilA ke hisse kA dogunA hogA| allAha tumhAre lie 'kalAlA' kA niyama tathA virAsata ke anya prAvadhAna spaSTa rUpa se bayAna karatA hai, tAki tuma usake mAmale meM pathabhraSTa na ho jAo, aura allAha hara cIz2a ko jAnane vAlA hai, usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai|

ai ImAna vAlo! tuma una sabhI vacanoM evaM pratijJAoM ko pUrA karo, jo tumane apane aura apane sraSTA ke bIca tathA apane aura usakI racanA ke bIca kie haiM| allAha ne tumapara dayA karate hue tumhAre lie pazudhana: (U~Ta, gAya tathA bakarI) ko halAla kiyA hai, sivAya una jAnavaroM ke jinakA harAma honA tumheM par3hakara sunAyA jAegA| isake atirikta hajja yA umrA kA eharAma bA~dhe hone kI sthiti meM tumapara jaMgalI jAnavaroM kA zikAra karanA bhI harAma hai| allAha apanI hikamata ke anusAra jo cAhatA hai halAla yA harAma hone kA phaisalA karatA hai| kyoMki use koI bAdhya karane vAlA nahIM aura na hI koI usake hukma para Apatti kara sakatA hai|

ai ImAna vAlo! allAha kI una hurmata vAlI (sammAnita) cIz2oM kA anAdara na karo, jinake sammAna kA usane tumheM Adeza diyA hai, tathA eharAma kI avasthA meM niSiddha cIz2oM: jaise sile hue kapar3e pahanane, tathA 'harama' (kI sImA) ke aMdara niSiddha cIz2oM, jaise ki zikAra karane se dUra raho| tathA sammAnita mahInoM arthAt z2ula-qAdA, z2ula-ha़ijjA, muharrama aura rajaba meM yuddha ko vaidha na ThaharAo| jina jAnavaroM ko allAha ke nAma para z2abaha karane ke lie harama bhejA jAtA hai, unheM hathiyAkara yA unheM kAbA jAne se rokakara unakA anAdara na karo| una jAnavaroM kA bhI apamAna na karo, jinake gale para Una Adi ke paTTe DAle gae hoM, tAki patA cala jAe ki ve (hajja kI) qurbAnI ke jAnavara haiM| tathA una logoM kA bhI anAdara na karo, jo vyApAra ke lAbha aura allAha kI prasannatA kI talAza meM allAha ke sammAnita ghara kI ora jAte haiM| aura jaba tuma ha़jja yA umrA ke eharAma se halAla ho jAo aura harama kI sImA se bAhara nikala jAo, to yadi cAho to zikAra karo| tathA jina logoM ne tumheM masjide-ha़rAma se rokA hai, unase duzmanI tumheM atyAcAra karane aura unake sAtha nyAya karanA chor3a dene para na ubhAre| tathA (ai momino!) allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karane aura usake niSedhoM se bacane meM eka-dUsare kA sahayoga karo| aura una pApoM meM jinakA karane vAlA gunahagAra hotA hai, tathA logoM para unake khUna, dhana aura satItva ke saMbaMdha meM z2yAdatI (AkramaNa) karane meM sahayoga na karo| tathA allAha kI AjJAkAritA para aDiga rahakara aura usakI avajJA se dUra rahakara, usase Daro| niHsaMdeha allAha use kaThora daMDa dene vAlA hai jo usakI avajJA karane vAlA hai| isalie usakI saz2A se sAvadhAna raho|

allAha ne tumapara vaha jAnavara harAma kiyA hai, jo zaraI tarIqe se z2abaha kie binA mara gayA ho| tathA usane tumapara harAma kiyA hai bahatA huA rakta, sUara kA mA~sa, vaha jAnavara jisapara z2abaha karate samaya allAha ke nAma ke alAvA kisI aura kA nAma pukArA jAe, tathA galA ghuTane se marA huA, coTa lagane se marA huA, U~ce sthAna se girakara marA huA, yA dUsare jAnavara ke sIMga mArane ke kAraNa marA huA, tathA vaha jAnavara jise zera, cIte aura bher3iye jaise kisI hiMsaka pazu (dariMde) ne phAr3a khAyA ho| paraMtu ukta jAnavaroM meM se jo tumheM jIvita mile aura tuma use z2abaha kara lo, to vaha tumhAre lie halAla hai| tathA usane tumapara vaha jAnavara bhI harAma kiyA hai jo mUrtiyoM ke lie z2abaha kiyA gayA ho| tathA usane tumapara tIroM ke dvArA apanA bhAgya mAlUma karanA bhI harAma kiyA hai| ye daraasala patthara yA tIra hote the, jinameM (karo) yA (mata karo) likhA hotA thA, cunA~ce bhAgya mAlUma karane vAlA usI ke anusAra kArya karatA thA, jo usake lie usase nikalatA thA| ullikhita varjanAoM ko karanA allAha kI AjJAkAritA se bAhara nikalanA hai| Aja kAfira loga islAma dharma kI zakti ko dekhakara, tumhAre islAma dharma ko tyAga dene se nirAza ho gae| isalie unase mata Daro, akele mujhase Daro| Aja maiMne tumhAre lie tumhAre dharma islAma ko paripUrNa kara diyA, tathA tumapara apanI khulI tathA chipI nemata pUrI kara dI aura tumhAre lie islAma ko dharma ke rUpa meM cuna liyA| isalie maiM usake sivA koI aura dharma svIkAra nahIM karu~gA| ataH jo vyakti saqhta bhUkha ke kAraNa mare hue jAnavara kA mA~sa khAne para majabUra kara diyA jAe jabaki usakA jhukAva pApa kI ora na ho, to usapara isameM koI pApa nahIM| niHsaMdeha allAha ati kSamAzIla, atyaMta dayAvAn hai|

jaba allAha taAlA ne una cIz2oM kA ullekha kiyA, jinakA khAnA harAma hai, to usake bAda una cIz2oM kA ullekha kiyA, jinake khAne kI usane anumati dI hai, cunA~ce pharamAyA:
ai rasUla! Apake sahAbA Apase pUchate haiM ki allAha ne unake lie kina-kina cIz2oM kA khAnA halAla kiyA hai? (ai rasUla!)
