qAbIla dvArA apane bhAI kI hatyA ke kAraNa, hamane banI isarAIla ko sUcita kiyA ki jisane kisI vyakti kI qisAsa (khUna ke badale khUna) yA kufra athavA vidroha dvArA dharatI meM bigAr3a paidA karane ke kAraNa ke binA hatyA kara dI, to mAno usane sabhI logoM kI hatyA kara dI, kyoMki usake nikaTa nirdoSa aura aparAdhI ke bIca koI aMtara nahIM hai| tathA jisane kisI prANI kI, jise allAha ne harAma ThaharAyA hai, yaha mAnate hue hatyA karane se parahez2a kiyA ki usakI hatyA karanA niSiddha (harAma) hai aura usakI hatyA nahIM kI; to mAno usane sabhI logoM ko jIvana pradAna kiyA; kyoMki usake isa vyavahAra meM sabhI logoM kI surakSA hai| niHsaMdeha hamAre rasUla banI isarAIla ke pAsa spaSTa pramANa aura khulI nizAniyA~ lekara Ae, lekina isake bAvajUda unameM se bahuta se loga pApa karake tathA apane rasUloM kA virodha karake allAha kI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karane vAle haiM|

jo loga allAha aura usake rasUla se yuddha karate haiM, aura unase khulI duzmanI karate hue hatyA, lUTamAra aura DakaitI ke dvArA dharatI meM utpAta macAte haiM, unakI saz2A yahI hai ki unheM sUlI para car3hAe binA qatla kara diyA jAe, yA unheM sUlI para car3hAkara qatla kara diyA jAe, yA unakA dAyA~ hAtha aura bAyA~ paira kATa diyA jAe, yadi vaha phira se aisI harakata kare, to usakA bAyA~ hAtha aura dAyA~ paira kATa diyA jAe, yA unheM deza se nikAla diyA jAe| yaha saz2A unake lie isa duniyA meM eka apamAna hai, tathA Aqhirata meM unake lie bahuta bar3I yAtanA hai|

paraMtu (ai adhikAra vAlo!) ina lar3AI karane vAloM meM se jo loga tumhArI pakar3a meM Ane se pahale taubA kara leM, to jAna lo ki allAha taubA ke bAda unheM kSamA karane vAlA aura unapara dayA karane vAlA hai| aura unapara usakI dayA meM se unase daMDa ko haTA denA hai|

ai ImAna vAlo! allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara usase Daro, tathA usane tumheM jisakA hukma diyA hai, use pUrA karake aura jisase usane tumheM manA kiyA hai, usase dUra rahakara usakI nikaTatA talAza karo, aura usakI prasannatA prApta karane ke lie kAfiroM se jihAda karo| tAki aisA karane para tumheM vaha cIz2a prApta ho jAe, jo tuma mA~gate ho aura usa cIz2a se bacA lie jAo, jisase tuma Darate ho|

jina logoM ne allAha aura usake rasUla ke sAtha kufra kiyA, yadi mAna liyA jAe ki unameM se hara eka dharatI kI sArI dhana-daulata kA mAlika ho jAe aura usake sAtha utanA hI aura bhI ho, phira ve qiyAmata ke dina apane Apako allAha kI yAtanA se mukta karane ke lie use peza kara deM, to vaha unase svIkAra nahIM kiyA jAegA, aura unake lie dardanAka yAtanA hai|

ve jahannama kI Aga meM praveza karane ke bAda usase bAhara nikalanA cAheMge, paraMtu ve aisA kaise kara sakate haiM?! ve usase hAbara haragiz2a nahIM nikaleMge, tathA unake lie usameM eka sthAyI yAtanA hai|

jaba allAha taAlA ne usake hukma kA ullekha kiyA jo sArvajanika rUpa se logoM kA paisA (lUTa) letA hai, to usakA bhI hukma spaSTa kara diyA, jo use gupta rUpa se letA hai, aura vaha cora hai| allAha ne pharamAyA:
jo corI karane vAlA (puruSa) aura jo corI karane vAlI (strI) hai (ai zAsako!) unameM se pratyeka ke dAhine hAtha ko kATa do, yaha unake lie allAha kI ora se usake badale evaM daMDa ke rUpa meM hai jo una donoM ne avaidha rUpa se logoM kA mAla liyA hai, tathA unheM aura dUsaroM ko DarAne ke lie hai| tathA allAha saba para prabhutvazAlI hai, usapara kisI kA z2ora nahIM calatA| vaha apanI (sabhI cIz2oM kI) pUrvaniyati (taqadIra) aura apane vidhAna meM hikamata vAlA hai|

jo vyakti corI se allAha ke samakSa taubA kara le aura apane kArya ko sudhAra le, to allAha apane anugraha se usakI taubA svIkAra kara legA; kyoMki allAha apane baMdoM meM se taubA karane vAloM ke pApoM ko kSamA karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai| lekina agara mAmalA zAsakoM ke pAsa pahu~ca gayA hai, to taubA karane se unakA zaraI ha़da samApta nahIM hogA|

(ai rasUla!) nizcaya Apako mAlUma hai ki allAha hI ke pAsa AkAzoM tathA dharatI kA rAjya hai| vaha unameM apanI icchAnusAra vyavahAra karatA hai| vaha jise cAhatA hai, apane nyAya se daMDita karatA hai aura jise cAhatA hai, apane anugraha se kSamA kara detA hai| niHsaMdeha allAha saba kucha karane meM sakSama hai, use koI cIz2a vivaza nahIM kara sakatI|

ai rasUla! ve loga Apako duHkhita na kareM jo Apako krodhita karane ke lie kufra ke kRtyoM ko prakaTa karane meM jaldabAz2I karate haiM, jo ki una munAfiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) meM se haiM, jo ImAna ko pradarzita karate haiM aura kufra ko chipAte haiM| isI taraha ve yahUdI bhI Apako dukhI na kareM jo apane bar3oM ke jhUTha ko sunate aura use svIkAra karate haiM, ve apane una netAoM kI naqala karate haiM, jo Apase upekSA karane ke kAraNa Apake pAsa nahIM Ae| ye loga taurAta meM maujUda allAha ke zabdoM ko apanI icchAoM ke anusAra badala dete haiM| ve apane anuyAyiyoM se kahate haiM: yadi muhammada kA phaisalA tumhArI icchAoM ke anusAra hai, to usakA anusaraNa karo aura yadi vaha usake viruddha ho, to usase sAvadhAna rahanA| tathA allAha logoM meM se jise pathabhraSTa karanA cAhe, to (ai rasUla!) Apa kisI aise vyakti ko nahIM pAe~ge, jo usase gumarAhI ko haTA sake aura use satya ke mArga para le jAe| ina vizeSatAoM se vizeSita yahUdI aura munAfiqa ve loga haiM, jinake diloM ko allAha ne kufra se pavitra karanA nahIM cAhA, unake lie isa duniyA meM apamAna aura tiraskAra hai aura Aqhirata meM unake lie bahuta bar3I yAtanA hai, jo ki Aga kI yAtanA hai|

ye yahUdI jhUThI bAteM bahuta sunate haiM, sUda kI taraha harAma dhana bahuta khAte haiM| ataH yadi ve (ai rasUla!) Apake pAsa faisalA karavAne ke lie Ae~, to agara Apa cAheM, to unake bIca nirNaya kara deM, yA agara Apa cAheM, to unake bIca faisalA na kareM| Apake pAsa donoM ke bIca eka vikalpa hai| yadi Apa unake bIca phaisalA na kareM, to ve Apako kucha bhI nuqasAna nahIM pahu~cA pAe~ge, aura yadi Apa unake bIca nirNaya kareM, to unake bIca nyAya ke sAtha nirNaya kareM, bhale hI ve atyAcArI aura duzmana hoM| niHsaMdeha allAha aise logoM se prema karatA hai, jo apane faisale meM nyAya karane vAle haiM, bhale hI faisale ke lie Ane vAle faisalA karane vAle ke duzmana hoM|

ina logoM kA mAmalA nizcaya Azcaryajanaka hai| ve Apapara vizvAsa nahIM rakhate haiM, phira bhI apane mAmale kA faisalA karAne ke lie Apake pAsa isa AzA meM Ate haiM ki ApakA faisalA unakI icchAoM ke anusAra ho jAe| jabaki unake pAsa taurAta hai, jisapara ve ImAna rakhane kA dAvA karate haiM, jisameM allAha kA Adeza (faisalA) maujUda hai| phira ve Apake faisale se mu~ha mor3a lete haiM, yadi vaha unakI icchAoM se mela nahIM khAtA hai| isa taraha unhoMne apanI kitAba meM maujUda hukma kA inakAra kiyA hai aura Apake faisale se mu~ha pherA hai| inakA yaha vyavahAra ImAna vAloM kA vyavahAra nahIM hai| isalie ve Apapara aura ApakI lAI huI zarIyata para ImAna rakhane vAle nahIM haiM|

niHsaMdeha hamane mUsA alaihissalAma para taurAta utArI, jisameM bhalAI kA mArgadarzana aura aisA prakAza hai jisake dvArA rauzanI hAsila kI jAtI hai| usake anusAra banI isarAIla ke ve nabI jo allAha ke AjJAkArI the, faisalA karate haiM| tathA usI ke anusAra ve vidvAna aura dharmazAstrI (phuqahA) bhI faisalA karate haiM jo logoM kA prazikSaNa karate haiM, kyoMki allAha ne unheM apanI pustaka kA nirIkSaka aura saMrakSaka banAyA hai, jo use vikRti aura parivartana se bacAte haiM| tathA ve isa bAta ke gavAha haiM ki yaha pustaka satya hai| aura loga isa (pustaka) se saMbaMdhita mAmale meM unhIM kI tarapha lauTate haiM| ataH (ai yahUdiyo!) logoM se na Daro, kevala mujhase Daro| tathA allAha kI utArI huI kitAba ke anusAra faisalA karane kI bajAya saradArI, pada-pratiSThA yA dhana kI eka choTI sI qImata na lo| aura jo allAha kI utArI huI vaha़ya ke anusAra faisalA na kare, use halAla (anumeya) samajhate hue, yA usake alAvA ko usapara varIyatA dete hue, yA use usake sAtha barAbara ThaharAte hue, to vahI loga vAstava meM kAfira haiM|

hamane taurAta meM yahUdiyoM para anivArya kara diyA ki jo koI jAna-bUjhakara kisI AtmA ko binA haqa ke qatla karegA, to vaha usake badale meM qatla kara diyA jAegA, aura jo koI jAna-bUjhakara A~kha nikAlegA, usakI A~kha nikAla dI jAegI, aura jo koI jAna-bUjhakara nAka kATegA, usakI nAka kATa dI jAegI, aura jo koI jAna-bUjhakara kAna kATegA, usakA kAna kATa diyA jAegA, aura jo koI jAna-bUjhakara dA~ta nikAlegA, usakA dA~ta nikAla nikAla diyA jAegA| aura hamane unapara yaha bhI anivArya kara diyA ki ghAvoM ke mAmale meM aparAdhI ko usake aparAdha ke samAna hI daMDita kiyA jAegA| tathA jo koI bhI svecchA se aparAdhI ko kSamA kara de, to usakI kSamA usake pApoM kA prAyazcita hai; kyoMki usane usa vyakti ko kSamA kara diyA, jisane usapara atyAcAra kiyA hai| aura jo usake anusAra faisalA na kare jau allAha ne 'qisAsa' ke bAre meM tathA usake alAvA cIz2oM ke bAre meM utArA hai, to vaha allAha kI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karane vAlA hai|

aura hamane banI isarAIla ke nabiyoM ke pada-cinhoM para marayama ke putra IsA ko bhejA, jo usapara ImAna rakhane vAle the jo kucha taurAta meM thA aura usI ke anusAra phaisalA karane vAle the| tathA hamane unheM iMjIla pradAna kI, jisameM satya ke lie mArgadarzana zAmila hai, tathA usameM aise pramANa haiM, jo saMdehoM ko dUra karate haiM aura aise prAvadhAna haiM jo samasyAoM kA samAdhAna karate haiM, tathA vaha usase pahale utarane vAlI pustaka taurAta ke anukUla hai, sivAya usake kucha niyamoM meM, jinheM usane nirasta kara diyA hai| tathA hamane iMjIla ko saMyamiyoM (parahez2agAroM) ke lie pathapradarzaka aura usa cIz2a ko karane se rokane vAlA banA diyA jise usane unapara niSiddha kiyA thA|

IsAiyoM ko cAhie ki usapara vizvAsa kareM, jo allAha ne iMjIla meM utArA hai tathA (muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke unake bIca nabI banAkara bheje jAne se pahale usameM jo saccAI AI) usake anusAra faisalA kareM| aura jo usake anusAra faisalA na kare, jo allAha ne utArA hai, to vahI loga allAha kI avajJA karane vAle, satya ko chor3ane vAle tathA asatya kI ora jhukane vAle haiM|

allAha ne taurAta va iMjIla kA ullekha aura unakI prazaMsA karane ke bAda, quraAna kA ullekha kiyA aura usakI prazaMsA karate hue pharamAyA:
(ai rasUla!) hamane ApakI ora quraAna ko saccAI ke sAtha utArA hai, jisake allAha kI ora se hone meM koI zaka evaM saMdeha nahIM hai| jo isase pahale utarI huI pustakoM kI puSTi karane vAlA tathA unakA saMrakSaka hai| ataH unameM se jo kucha isake mutAbiqa hai, vaha satya hai aura jo kucha isake viruddha hai, vaha asatya hai| isalie Apa logoM ke bIca usake anusAra faisalA kareM, jo allAha ne isa (quraAna) meM Apapara utArA hai, tathA Apake Upara jo saMdeha rahita satya avatirata kiyA gayA hai use chor3akara unakI una icchAoM kA pAlana na kareM, jo unhoMne grahaNa kI haiM| hamane hara samudAya ke lie vyAvahArika niyamoM kA eka kAnUna aura eka spaSTa tarIqA banAyA hai jisake dvArA ve mArgadarzana prApta karate haiM| yadi allAha sArI zarIyatoM ko eka karanA cAhatA, to vaha unheM eka kara detA| paraMtu usane pratyeka samudAya ke lie eka (sthAyI) zarIyata banAI hai, tAki vaha sabakI parIkSA le, aura AjJApAlana karane vAlA avajJAkArI se pragaTa ho jAe| ataH acche kAma karane aura bure kAma chor3ane meM jaldI karo| kyoMki qiyAmata ke dina tuma sabako akele allAha hI kI ora lauTanA hai, aura vaha tumheM usase sUcita karegA, jisake bAre meM tuma matabheda kiyA karate the, tathA vaha tumheM tumhAre dvArA kie gae kAmoM kA badalA degA|

(ai rasUla!) unake bIca usake anusAra nirNaya kareM, jo allAha ne ApakI ora avatirata kiyA hai aura unake una vicAroM kA pAlana na kareM jo icchAoM kA pAlana karane se utpanna hue haiM, tathA unase sAvadhAna raheM ki aisA na ho ki ve Apako kisI aisI cIz2a se bhaTakA deM, jo allAha ne Apapara avatarita kiyA hai| kyoMki ve aisA karane meM koI kasara na chor3eMge| yadi ve allAha ke dvArA Apapara utArI gaI zarIyata ke anusAra faisalA ko svIkAra karane se inakAra kareM, to Apa jAna leM ki allAha unheM unake kucha pApoM kI saz2A duniyA hI meM denA cAhatA hai| jabaki una sabhI para unheM Aqhirata meM daMDita karegA| aura saccAI yaha hai ki bahuta-se loga allAha ke AjJApAlana se nikala jAne vAle haiM|

kyA ve Apake faisale ko chor3akara mUrtipUjA karane vAle jAhiliyyata (pUrva-islAmika kAla) ke logoM kA faisalA cAhate haiM, jo apanI icchAoM ke anusAra faisalA karate haiM?! vizvAsa rakhane vAloM ke nikaTa, jo allAha ke bAre meM usa cIz2a ko samajhate haiM jo usane apane rasUla para utArI hai, allAha se behatara faisalA karane vAlA koI nahIM hai| na ki ajJAnatA aura icchAoM ke pIche calane vAle loga, jo kevala vahI svIkAra karate haiM jo unakI icchAoM se mela khAtA hai, bhale hI vaha g2alata ho|

ai logo jo allAha tathA usake rasUla para ImAna lAe ho! yahUdiyoM tathA IsAiyoM ko sahayogI evaM khAsa mitra banAkara unase dilI dostI (vafAdArI) na rakho, kyoMki yahUdI apane dharma vAloM se dostI (vafAdArI) rakhate haiM aura IsAI apane dharma vAloM se dostI (vafAdArI) rakhate haiM aura donoM samUha tumhArI duzmanI meM ekajuTa haiM| ataH tumameM se jo unase dostI rakhegA, vaha unhIM meM ginA jAegA| niHsaMdeha allAha kAfiroM se dostI (vafAdArI) rakhakara apane Upara atyAcAra karane vAle logoM ko sIdhA mArga nahIM dikhAtA|

ImAna vAle, ina munAfiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) kI sthiti se cakita hokara kahate haiM: kyA yahI loga haiM jinhoMne apanI qasamoM kI puSTi karate hue yaha qasama khAI thI: niHsaMdeha ve ImAna, samarthana aura niSThA (vafAdArI) meM (ai ImAna vAlo!) tumhAre sAtha haiM?! unake kArya vyartha ho gae| ataH ve apane uddezya ko kho dene aura unake lie taiyAra kie jAne vAle az2Aba ke kAraNa ghATA uThAne vAle ho gae|

ai ImAna vAlo! tumameM se jo koI apane dharma ko chor3akara kufra kI ora palaTa jAe, to allAha unake badale aise logoM ko lAegA, jinase vaha unake sIdhe mArga para calane ke kAraNa prema karegA tathA ve usase prema kareMge, ve ImAna vAloM ke prati dayAlu tathA kAfiroM para bahuta saqhta hoMge| ve apane mAloM aura apanI jAnoM ke sAtha (allAha ke mArga meM) jihAda kareMge, tAki allAha kA vacana sarvocca ho| ve niMdA karane vAloM kI niMdA se nahIM DareMge, kyoMki ve allAha kI prasannatA ko prANiyoM kI prasannatA se Upara rakhane vAle hoMge| yaha allAha kA pradAna hai, jise allAha apane baMdoM meM se use detA hai, jise vaha cAhatA hai| allAha vistRta anugraha aura upakAra vAlA hai| use mAlUma hai ki kauna usake anugraha ke yogya hai, to vaha use pradAna karatA hai, tathA kauna usake lAyaqa nahIM hai, to use vaMcita kara detA hai|

jaba allAha ne yahUdiyoM, IsAiyoM aura anya kAphiroM se maitrI karane se manA kara diyA, to yaha bhI batA diyA ki ImAna vAloM ko kinase dostI rakhanI hai| allAha ne pharamAyA:
yahUdI, IsAI tathA anya kAphira tumhAre mitra nahIM haiM, balki tumhAre mitra aura sahAyaka kevala allAha, usake rasUla aura ve ImAna vAle haiM, jo pUrI taraha se namAz2a adA karate haiM, aura apane dhana kI z2akAta dete haiM tathA ve allAha ke prati vinIta aura vinamra hote haiM|

jo koI allAha, usake rasUla tathA mominoM se dostI rakhe aura unakA samarthana kare, vaha allAha ke dala meM se hai| aura allAha kA dala hI ve loga haiM, jo vijayI rahane vAle haiM, kyoMki allAha unakA sahAyaka hai|

ai ImAna vAlo! una yahUdiyoM aura IsAiyoM ko jo tumase pahale kitAba die gae tathA muzrikoM ko sahayogI aura dilI dosta na banAo, jo tumhAre dharma kA maz2Aka ur3Ate haiM aura usake sAtha khilavAr3a karate haiM| tathA allAha se usa cIz2a se bacakara Daro, jo usane tumheM unakI dostI se manA kiyA hai, yadi tuma allAha para tathA usapara ImAna rakhane vAle ho, jo usane tumapara utArA hai|

isI taraha, ve usa samaya (bhI) maz2Aka ur3Ate aura khelate haiM, jaba tuma namAz2a ke lie az2Ana dete ho, jo ki allAha kI nikaTatA kA sabase mahAna kArya hai| aisA isalie hai kyoMki ve aise loga haiM jo allAha kI upAsanA ke artha aura una vidhAnoM ko nahIM samajhate jo usane logoM ke lie banAe haiM|

(ai rasUla!) Apa ahle kitAba ke upahAsa karane vAloM se kaha deM: kyA tuma hameM kevala isa bAta kA doSa dete ho ki hama allAha para ImAna lAe, aura usapara jo hamArI ora utArA gayA aura usapara bhI jo hamase pahale ke logoM para utArA gayA, tathA isa bAta para ImAna lAe ki tumameM se adhikAMza loga ImAna aura AdezoM kA pAlana chor3akara allAha kI AjJAkAritA se bAhara haiM?! isa taraha tuma hameM jisa cIz2a kA doSa dete ho, vaha hamAre lie prazaMsA kI bAta hai, niMdanIya nahIM|

(ai rasUla!) mAdaka padArthoM tathA jue ko suMdara banAkara zaitAna kA irAdA to sirpha diloM ke bIca duzmanI aura napharata paidA karanA, tathA allAha ke smaraNa se aura namAz2a se dhyAna bhaTakAnA hai| to kyA tuma (ai momino!) ina bure kAmoM ko chor3ane vAle ho? isameM koI saMdeha nahIM ki yahI tumhAre lie upayukta hai, isalie bAz2a A jAo|

zarIyata ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se dUra rahakara allAha kA AjJApAlana karo aura rasUla kA AjJApAlana karo tathA avajJA se sAvadhAna raho| phira yadi tuma usase mu~ha mor3o, to jAna lo ki hamAre rasUla kA dAyitva kevala usa saMdeza ko pahu~cA denA hai, jisakA allAha ne unheM pahu~cAne kA Adeza diyA hai aura vaha use pahu~cA cuke haiM| isalie yadi tuma mArgadarzana apanA lo, to isameM tumhArA hI lAbha hai, aura yadi bure karma karo, to tumhArA hI nuqasAna hogA|

jaba zarAba ke harAma hone kA Adeza utarA, to kucha mominoM ne apane una bhAiyoM kI sthiti jAnanA cAhA, jo zarAba ke niSiddha hone se pahale musalamAna hone kI avasthA meM mara gae the| to nimnalikhita Ayata utarI:
jo loga allAha para ImAna lAe, tathA usakI nikaTatA prApta karane ke lie acche karma kie, unapara usameM koI pApa nahIM jo unhoMne zarAba kA usake niSiddha hone se pahale sevana kiyA thA, yadi ve niSiddha cIz2oM se parahez2a karate the, apane Upara allAha ke krodha se Darane vAle, usapara ImAna rakhane vAle, acche karma karane vAle the, phira allAha ke prati unakA dhyAna bar3ha gayA yahA~ taka ki ve usakI isa taraha ibAdata karane lageM, mAno ki ve use dekha rahe hoM, aura allAha una logoM se prema karatA hai jo usakI isa taraha ibAdata karate haiM ki mAno ve use dekha rahe hoM; kyoMki ve usameM hamezA allAha ke nirIkSaNa kA AbhAsa karane vAle hote haiM| aura yaha sthiti momina ko apane kAma ko acchI taraha aura pUrNa rUpa se karane ke lie prerita karatI hai|

ai ImAna vAlo! allAha tumhArI isa taraha parIkSA legA ki vaha jaMgalI zikAra meM se kucha tumhAre pAsa le AegA, jabaki tuma eharAma kI avasthA meM hoge| unameM se choTe zikAra ko tuma apane hAthoM se pakar3oge aura bar3e zikAra ko apane bhAloM se, tAki allAha jAna le (pratyakSa rUpa se jAnanA jisapara baMdoM kI pakar3a hotI hai) ki kauna allAha ke jJAna para pUrNa ImAna rakhane kI vajaha se usase bina dekhe DaratA hai| isalie vaha apane usa sraSTA ke Dara se zikAra karane se ruka jAtA hai, jisase usakA kArya chipA nahIM rahatA hai| ataH jo hada se Age bar3he aura ha़jja yA umrA ke eharAma kI hAlata meM zikAra kare, to usake lie qiyAmata ke dina dardanAka az2Aba hai; kyoMki usane vaha kArya kiyA hai jisase allAha ne manA kiyA thA|

ai ImAna vAlo! hajja yA umrA ke eharAma kI sthiti meM jaMgalI zikAra na mAro| tathA tumameM se jo vyakti jAna-bUjhakara zikAra mAre, to usane jo zikAra mArA hai usI ke samAna usapara U~Ta, yA gAya, yA bakarI meM se badalA (daMDa) anivArya hai, jisakA nirNaya musalamAnoM meM se do nyAyapriya vyakti kareMge| aura jisa pazu kA ve nirNaya kara deM, usake sAtha vahI kiyA jAegA jo hajja kI qurbAnI ke jAnavara ke sAtha kiyA jAtA hai| arthAt use makkA bhejA jAegA aura harama meM z2abaha kiyA jAegA, yA usa jAnavara kI qImata ke barAbara khAdya padArtha harama ke nirdhanoM ko diyA jAegA, hara nirdhana ko AdhA sA'| yA hara Adhe sA' khAdya padArtha ke badale eka dina roz2A rakhanA hogA| yaha saba isalie ki zikAra karane vAlA apane kie ke pariNAma kA svAda cakha le| allAha ne use kSamA kara diyA, jo atIta meM harama kA zikAra mArA gayA aura eharAma kI sthiti meM jo bhUmi kA zikAra mArA gayA usake harAma ThaharAe jAne se pahale| jo vyakti harAma ghoSita hone ke bAda bhI aisA karegA, allAha use usapara yAtanA dekara usase badalA legA| allAha bahuta zaktizAlI, tAqata vAlA hai aura usakI zakti meM se eka yaha hai ki vaha usase badalA letA hai jo usakI avajJA karatA hai, yadi vaha cAhe, use koI aisA karane se roka nahIM sakatA|

allAha ne tumhAre lie jalIya jAnavaroM kA zikAra karanA tathA usa jAnavara ko halAla kara diyA hai, jo samudra tumhAre lie pheMka detA hai, cAhe vaha jIvita ho yA mRta, yaha tumameM se usake lAbha ke lie hai jo nivAsI hai yA yAtrI hai jisake sAtha vaha khuda kI ApUrti karatA hai, tathA usane tumapara bhUmi kA zikAra karanA harAma kara diyA hai jaba taka ki tuma hajja yA umrA ke eharAma kI sthiti meM ho| tathA allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara, usase Daro| kyoMki usI akele kI ora tuma qiyAmata ke dina lauTAe jAoge, phira vaha tumheM tumhAre karmoM kA badalA degA|

allAha ne sammAnita ghara kAbA ko logoM ke lie sthApanA kA sAdhana banAyA hai, jisake sAtha unake dhArmika hitoM jaise namAz2a, roz2A, ha़jja evaM umrA kI, tathA unake sAMsArika hitoM kI sthApanA hotI hai, jaise harama meM surakSA evaM zAMti aura vahA~ hara cIz2a ke phaloM kA pahu~canA| tathA usane sammAnita mahInoM arthAt: z2ula-qA'dA, z2ula-ha़ijjA, muharrama aura rajaba ko unake lie sthApanA kA kAraNa banAyA hai ki ve unameM dUsaroM ki ora se lar3AI se surakSita rahate haiM, isI taraha ha़jja kI qurbAnI ke jAnavaroM tathA una paTToM ko jo yaha iMgita karate haiM ki ve harama ke lie le jAe gae haiM, unake lie sthApanA kA sAdhana banAyA hai, kyoMki ve apane svAmiyoM ko hAni pahu~cAe jAne se bacAte haiM| allAha ne tumapara yaha upakAra isalie kiyA tAki tuma jAna lo ki allAha jAnatA hai jo kucha AkAzoM meM tathA jo kucha dharatI meM hai, aura yaha ki allAha hara cIz2a ko qhUba jAnane vAlA hai| kyoMki usakA - tumhAre lie hitoM ko lAne aura tumase nuqasAna ko unake Ane se pahale dUra karane ke lie - ina niyamoM ko banAnA, isa bAta kA pramANa hai ki vaha baMdoM ke hitoM kI cIz2oM ko jAnatA hai|
(ai logo!) yaha jAna lo ki niHsaMdeha allAha use bahuta kaThora daMDa dene vAlA hai, jo usakI avajJA kare, tathA taubA karane vAle ko bahuta kSamA karane vAlA, usapara bar3A dayAlu hai|

rasUla kA dAyitva kevala yaha hai ki usa upadeza ko pahu~cA de, jisako pahu~cAne kA allAha ne use Adeza diyA hai, usakI yaha z2immedArI nahIM ki logoM ko hidAyata kI tauphIqa de, kyoMki yaha kevala allAha ke hAtha meM hai, tathA allAha use jAnatA hai jo kucha tuma mArgadarzana yA pathabhraSTatA meM se prakaTa karate aura chipAte ho| aura vaha tumheM usakA badalA degA|

(ai rasUla!) Apa kaha deM ki koI bhI apavitra (burI) cIz2a kisI bhI pavitra (acchI) cIz2a ke barAbara nahIM hai, yadyapi apavitra (burI) cIz2a kI bahutAyata Apako bhalI lage| kyoMki usakI bahutAyata usakI zreSThatA kA saMketa nahIM detI hai| ataH (ai buddhi vAlo!) apavitra ko chor3akara aura pavitra ko karake allAha se Daro, tAki tumheM jannata prApta ho|

ai ImAna vAlo! apane rasUla se una cIz2oM ke saMbaMdha meM prazna na karo, jinakI tumheM koI z2arUrata nahIM hai, aura jo tumhAre dharma ke mAmale meM tumhArI madada nahIM karatI haiM| yadi ve tumhAre lie prakaTa kara dI jAe~, to unameM pAI jAne vAlI kaThinAI ke kAraNa tumheM burI lageMgI| yadi tuma ina cIz2oM ke bAre meM jinake bAre meM pUchane se tumheM manA kiyA gayA hai usa samaya prazna karoge jaba rasUla para vaha़ya utArI jAtI hai, to ve tumhAre lie spaSTa kara dI jAe~gI, aura yaha allAha ke lie bar3A AsAna hai| allAha ne una cIz2oM ko naz2araaMdAz2a kara diyA hai jinake bAre meM quraAna khAmoza hai| ataH unake bAre meM prazna na karo, kyoMki agara tuma unake bAre meM prazna karoge, to tumheM unake Adeza kA bAdhya kara diyA jAegA| tathA allAha apane baMdoM ke pApoM ko kSamA karane vAlA hai yadi ve taubA karate haiM, atyaMta sahanazIla hai unheM unapara daMDita nahIM karatA hai|

tumase pahale bhI kucha logoM ne isI taraha kI bAtoM ke bAre meM prazna kie the, phira jaba unheM unakA bAdhya kara diyA gayA, to unhoMne unake anusAra kArya nahIM kiyA| isalie ve usake kAraNa kAfira ho gae|

allAha ne caupAyoM ko halAla kiyA hai| cunA~ce usane unameM se una jAnavaroM ko harAma nahIM kiyA hai, jinheM muzrikoM ne apanI mUrtiyoM ke lie apane Upara harAma ThaharA liyA hai| jaise ki bahIrA, jo usa U~TanI ko kahA jAtA hai, jisake kAna eka nizcita saMkhyA meM bacce janane ke bAda kATa die jAte the| tathA sAibA, jo usa U~TanI ko kahA jAtA hai, jo eka nizcita umra taka pahu~cane para unakI mUrtiyoM ke lie chor3a dI jAtI thI| tathA vasIlA, jo usa U~TanI ko kahA jAtA hai, jisane lagAtAra do mAdA bacce jane hoM| tathA hAmI, jo usa nara U~Ta ko kahA jAtA hai, jisakI puzta se kaI U~Ta janma le cuke hoM| (allAha ne inheM harAma nahIM kiyA), paraMtu kAfiroM ne jhUTha-mUTha aura mithyAropaNa karate hue yaha dAvA kiyA ki allAha ne ukta jAnavaroM ko harAma kiyA hai, tathA adhikAMza kAfira satya aura asatya, halAla aura harAma ke bIca aMtara nahIM karate haiM|

jaba allAha para kucha caupAyoM ko harAma ThaharAne kA jhUThA Aropa lagAne vAle ina logoM se kahA jAtA hai: allAha ke utAre hue quraAna kI ora Ao, tathA rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI sunnata kI ora Ao, tAki tuma halAla aura harAma ko pahacAna sako, to ve kahate haiM: hamane jina vizvAsoM, kathanoM aura kAryoM ko apane pUrvajoM se liyA hai aura hameM virAsata meM milA hai, vahI hamAre lie kAfI haiM| unake lie yaha kaise kAfI hai jabaki unake pUrvaja kucha nahIM jAnate the, aura na to unheM satya kA mArgadarzana prApta thA?! isalie unakA anusaraNa vahI karegA, jo unase adhika ajJAnI aura unase adhika mArga se bhaTakA huA hogA| ataH ve ajJAnI aura pathabhraSTa haiM|

ai ImAna vAlo! tuma apanI ciMtA karo| ataH apane Apako aisA kArya karane ke lie pratibaddha karo, jisase tumhArA sudhAra ho| yadi tuma svayaM mArgadarzana pA cuke, to logoM meM se jo vyakti gumarAha ho gayA aura usane tumhArI bAta nahIM mAnI, vaha tumheM koI hAni nahIM pahu~cAegA| tathA tumhAre mArgadarzana prApta hone kI apekSA yaha ki tuma bhalAI kA Adeza do aura burAI se roko| qiyAmata ke dina tumheM akele allAha hI kI ora lauTakara jAnA hai, phira vaha tumheM batAegA ki tuma duniyA meM kyA kiyA karate the aura tumheM usakA badalA degA|

ai ImAna vAlo! yadi tumameM se kisI kI mRtyu kA samaya mauta kI kisI nizAnI ke prakaTa hone ke sAtha nikaTa A jAe, to vaha apanI vasIyata para musalamAnoM meM se do nyAyapriya vyaktiyoM ko, yA musalamAnoM kI anupasthiti ke kAraNa z2arUrata par3ane para kAfiroM meM se do AdamiyoM ko gavAha banA de, yadi tuma yAtrA kara rahe ho aura tumapara mRtyu A pahu~ce| yadi tumheM una donoM kI gavAhI ke viSaya meM saMdeha ho, to kisI namAz2a ke bAda unheM roka lo aura ve donoM allAha kI qasama khAe~ ki: ve donoM allAha kI ora se mile hue apane hisse (yAnI apanI qasama) ko kisI muAvaz2e ke badale nahIM beceMge, aura na usake sAtha kisI saMbaMdhI kA pakSa leMge (lAbha pahu~cAe~ge), tathA ve donoM apane pAsa maujUda allAha kI kisI gavAhI ko nahIM chipAe~ge, aura yadi unhoMne aisA kiyA to ve donoM allAha kI avajJA karane vAle pApiyoM meM se hoMge|

yadi qasama khilAne ke bAda yaha spaSTa ho jAe ki una donoM ne gavAhI athavA qasama meM jhUTha bolA hai, yA una donoM kI qhayAnata (vizvAsaghAta) prakaTa ho jAe; to unake sthAna para mare hue vyakti ke nikaTatama saMbaMdhiyoM meM se do vyakti khar3e hokara satya kI gavAhI deM yA qasama khAe~| ve donoM allAha kI qasama khAte hue kaheM: nizcaya unake jhUTha aura qhayAnata para hamArI gavAhI, una donoM kI apanI saccAI aura amAnata para gavAhI se adhika saccI hai, aura hamane jhUThI qasama nahIM khAI hai| yadi hamane jhUThI gavAhI dI hai, to nizcaya hama una atyAcAriyoM meM se hoMge jo allAha kI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karane vAle haiM|

donoM gavAhoM kI gavAhI meM saMdeha hone para unheM namAz2a ke bAda qasama khilAne aura unakI gavAhI ko radda karane kA jo ullekha kiyA gayA hai, yaha isa bAta ke adhika qarIba hai ki ve donoM gavAhI kA niSpAdana usake zaraI tarIqe ke anusAra kareM| ataH ve gavAhI ko vikRta na kareM yA usameM badalAva na kareM yA qhayAnata (vizvAsaghAta) na kareM| tathA yaha isa tathya ke adhika qarIba hai ki ve isa bAta se DareM ki vArisoM kI qasama una donoM kI qasama ko qhArija kara degI, cunA~ce ve loga una donoM kI gavAhI ke viparIta qasama khA leMge, isa taraha ve donoM benaqAba ho jAe~ge| gavAhI aura qasama meM jhUTha aura qhayAnata (vizvAsaghAta) ko tyAgakara allAha se Daro, tathA tumheM jisa bAta kA Adeza diyA gayA hai use suno aura svIkAra karo| aura allAha una logoM ko sAmarthya pradAna nahIM karatA, jo usake AjJApAlana se nikala jAne vAle haiM|

ai lego! qiyAmata ke dina ko yAda karo, jaba allAha sabhI rasUloM ko ikaTThA karegA| phira unase kahegA: tumhAre una samudAyoM ne, jinakI ora tumheM bhejA gayA thA, tumheM kyA javAba diyA? ve usakA javAba allAha ko sauMpate hue kaheMge: hameM kucha jJAna nahIM| balki sArA jJAna - ai hamAre pAlanahAra! - kevala tujhe hI hai, niHsaMdeha tU hI eka akelA hai jo anadekhI cIz2oM ko jAnatA hai|

tathA yAda karo, jaba allAha (qiyAmata ke dina) IsA alaihissalAma ko saMbodhita karate hue kahegA: ai marayama ke putra IsA! tuma apane Upara mere anugraha ko yAda karo jaba maiMne tumheM binA pitA ke banAyA thA, aura apanI mAtA marayama alaihassalAma ke Upara mere anugraha ko yAda karo, jaba maiMne use usake samaya kI mahilAoM ke Upara cuna liyA| tathA apane Upara merI usa nemata ko yAda karo jo maiMne tumheM usa samaya pradAna kI, jaba maiMne tumheM jibarIla (alaihissalAma) dvArA zakti pradAna kI, tuma logoM se bAta karate the - jabaki tuma dUdha pIte bacce the - unheM allAha kI ora bulAte the, tathA tuma apanI adher3a Ayu meM unase usa cIz2a ke bAre meM bAta karate the jisake sAtha maiMne tumheM unakI ora bhejA thA| maiMne tumapara eka anugraha yaha kiyA ki tumheM likhanA sikhAyA aura usa taurAta kA jJAna pradAna kiyA jo mUsA (alaihissalAma) para utArI gaI thI aura usa iMjIla kI zikSA dI jo tumapara utArI gaI, aura maiMne tumheM zarIyata ke rahasya, usake fAyade tathA usakI hikamateM batAIM| tumhAre Upara merI nematoM meM se eka yaha hai ki tuma miTTI se pakSI ke rUpa samAna AkRti banAte the, phira usameM phU~ka mArate the, to vaha pakSI bana jAtI thI| tathA tuma janma se aMdhe ko usakI aMdhatA se caMgA kara dete the aura kor3hI ko rogamukta kara dete the, to usakI tvacA svastha ho jAtI thI| tathA tuma murdoM ko allAha se unheM punarjIvita karane kI duA karake unheM punarjIvita kara dete the| yaha saba merI anumati se saMpanna hotA thA| maiMne tumapara jo upakAra kiyA, unameM se eka yaha bhI hai ki maiMne banI isarAIla ko usa samaya tumase dUra kara diyA jaba ve tumheM mAra DAlane hI vAle the, jaba tuma unake pAsa spaSTa camatkAra lekara Ae the| to unhoMne unakA inakAra kara diyA, aura kahA: yaha IsA jo kucha lekara Ae haiM eka spaSTa jAdU ke sivA kucha nahIM|

tathA tuma apane Upara mere isa upakAra ko bhI yAda karo ki maiMne tumheM kucha sahAyaka pradAna kie jaba maiMne havAriyoM (sAthiyoM) ke dila meM yaha bAta DAla dI ki ve mujha para aura tuma para ImAna lAe~| to unhoMne AjJA mAnI aura javAba dete hue kahA: hama ImAna lAe, aura - ai hamAre raba! - tU gavAha raha ki hama tere AjJAkArI aura adhIna haiM|

usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba havAriyoM ne kahA ki kyA ApakA pAlanahAra, yadi Apa usase duA kareM, to hamapara AkAza se eka thAla (bhojana sahita dastara-qhvAna) utAra sakatA hai? to IsA (alaihissalAma) unheM allAha se Darane aura jo kucha unhoMne mA~gA thA, use tyAgane kA Adeza dekara unheM uttara diyA| kyoMki ho sakatA hai usameM unakI koI parIkSA ho, aura unase kahA: jIvikA kI talAza meM apane raba para bharosA karo, yadi tuma momina ho|

havAriyoM ne IsA se kahA: hama cAhate haiM ki isa dastara-qhvAna se khAe~, aura hamAre dila allAha kI zakti kI pUrNatA se aura isa bAta se Azvasta ho jAe~ ki Apa usake rasUla haiM, tathA hama nizcita rUpa se jAna leM ki Apa allAha ke pAsa se jo kucha lekara Ae haiM, usameM Apane hamase saca kahA hai, aura hama una logoM ke lie isa bAta ke sAkSI bana jAe~, jo yahA~ maujUda nahIM haiM|

IsA alaihissalAma ne unake anurodha kA uttara diyA aura allAha se yaha kahate hue duA kI: he hamAre raba! hamapara khAne kA eka dastara-qhvAna utAra de, jisake utarane ke dina ko hama eka parva banAkara tere lie AbhAra prakaTa karate hue usakA sammAna kareM, tathA vaha tere ekatva (ekamAtra pUjya hone) kI nizAnI aura pramANa, tathA jisa cIz2a ke sAtha maiM bhejA gayA hU~ usakI saccAI kA pramANa ho| tathA hameM aisI jIvikA pradAna kara, jo terI ibAdata karane meM hamArI madada kare, aura - ai hamAre raba! - tU sabase uttama jIvikA pradAna karane vAlA hai|

allAha ne IsA alaihissalAma kI duA qabUla kara lI aura pharamAyA: maiM yaha dastara-qhvAna utArane vAlA hU~, jo tumane apane Upara utArane kI mA~ga kI hai| ataH jo koI bhI usake utarane ke bAda kuphra kare, vaha kevala khuda ko doSI ThaharAe| kyoMki maiM use aisI kar3I yAtanA dU~gA, jo kisI aura ko nahIM dU~gA| kyoMki usane prakAzamAna (spaSTa) nizAnI dekhI, isalie usakA kufra haTha kA kufra hai| tathA allAha ne unase apanA vacana pUrA kiyA, so use unapara utAra diyA|

yadi hama unheM javAba dete hue unakI prastAvita cIz2a ko le Ate, cunA~ce hama unake pAsa farizte utAra dete aura ve unheM apanI A~khoM se dekha lete, tathA mare hue loga unase bAteM karate aura Apa jo kucha lekara Ae haiM usameM unheM ApakI saccAI kI qhabara dete, evaM hama unake lie vaha saba kucha ikaTThA kara dete, jo unhoMne sujhAva diyA thA, jinheM ve Amane-sAmane dekha lete; to bhI ve usa cIz2a para ImAna na lAte jo Apa lekara Ae haiM, paraMtu yaha ki allAha unameM se jise mArgadarzana dikhAnA cAhe| lekina unameM se adhikatara loga isa bAta se anajAna haiM| isalie ve allAha kA sahArA nahIM lete tAki vaha unheM mArgadarzana kA sAmarthya pradAna kare|

jisa prakAra hamane ina bahudevavAdiyoM kI zatrutA ke sAtha ApakI parIkSA lI, usI prakAra hamane Apase pahale ke hara nabI kI parIkSA lI| cunA~ce hamane unameM se pratyeka nabI ke lie sarakaza manuSyoM meM se kucha duzmana evaM sarakaza jinnoM meM se kucha duzmana banA die, jo eka-dUsare ke dila meM burI bAteM DAlate haiM, cunA~ce ve unheM dhokhA dene ke lie unake lie jhUTha ko suzobhita karake prastuta karate haiM| aura yadi allAha cAhatA ki ve aisA na kareM, to ve aisA nahIM karate| lekina allAha ne parIkSaNa ke taura para unake lie aisA cAhA thA| ataH Apa unheM aura jo kucha ve kufra aura jhUTha gar3hate haiM, use chor3a deM aura unakI paravAha na kareM|

aura tAki una logoM ke dila jo Aqhirata para ImAna nahIM rakhate usa (burI) bAta kI ora jhuka jAe~, jo ve eka-dUsare ke diloM meM DAlate haiM, aura tAki ve loga use apane lie svIkAra kara leM aura use apane lie pasaMda kara leM, aura tAki ve bhI vahI avajJA aura pApa karane laga jAe~, jo ye loga karane vAle haiM|

yadi mAna liyA jAe ki (ai rasUla!) niHsaMdeha (ai rasUla!) ApakA pAlanahAra use sabase adhika jAnatA hai jo usake mArga se bhaTaka jAtA hai, tathA vaha una logoM ko bhI sabase adhika jAnane vAlA hai jo usake mArga para nirdezita haiM, unameM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai|

(ai logo!) pratyakSa rUpa se aura gupta rUpa se pApa karanA chor3a do| niHsaMdeha jo loga gupta rUpa se yA khule rUpa se pApa karate haiM, zIghra hI allAha unheM unake kie hue pApa kA badalA degA|

(ai musalamAno!) usa jAnavara kA mAMsa na khAo, jisapara allAha kA nAma nahIM liyA gayA hai, cAhe usapara allAha ke sivA kisI aura kA nAma liyA gayA hai yA nahIM| kyoMki usameM se khAnA nizcita rUpa se allAha kI AjJAkAritA se nikalakara usakI avajJA meM prasthAna hai| niHsaMdeha zaitAna apane dostoM ke mana meM saMzaya DAlate rahate haiM, tAki ve tumase mRta mAMsa khAne ke bAre meM bahasa kareM| aura yadi (ai musalamAno!) tumane - mRta mAMsa ko anumeya karane hetu - unake DAle jAne vAle saMdehoM ko svIkAra kara liyA, to tuma aura ve bahudevavAda meM samAna haiM|

kyA vaha vyakti, jo allAha ke use hidAyata dene se pahale murdA thA (kyoMki vaha kufra, ajJAnatA aura pApoM meM lipta thA), phira hamane usako ImAna, jJAna aura AjJAkAritA kA mArgadarzana pradAna karake jIvita kiyA: usa AdamI ke barAbara hai, jo kufra, ajJAnatA aura pApoM ke aMdheroM meM par3A hai jinase vaha bAhara nahIM nikala sakatA, usake lie sAre rAste bhramita aura aMdhere ho gae haiM?! jisa prakAra ina muzrikoM ke lie unakA zirka para qAyama rahanA tathA mRta jAnavara kA mAMsa khAnA aura jhUTha ke sAtha bahasa karanA suMdara banA diyA gayA hai, usI prakAra kAphiroM ke lie una pApoM ko suMdara banA diyA gayA hai, jo ve kiyA karate the, tAki qiyAmata ke dina unheM unake badale meM dardanAka yAtanA dI jAe|

jisa prakAra makkA meM huA ki bahudevavAdiyoM ke pramukhoM ne allAha ke rAste se rokane kA kAma kiyA, usI taraha hamane hara bastI meM saradAra aura mahApuruSa banAe, jo zaitAna ke mArga kI ora bulAne tathA rasUloM aura unake anuyAyiyoM se lar3ane kI khAtira apanI cAleM calate haiM| hAlA~ki tathya yaha hai ki unakI cAleM khuda unhIM para lauTa AtI haiM, lekina ve apanI ajJAnatA aura icchAoM kA anusaraNa karane ke kAraNa ise mahasUsa nahIM karate haiM|

jaba kAfiroM ke pramukhoM ke pAsa allAha dvArA usake nabI para utArI huI nizAniyoM meM se koI nizAnI AtI hai, to ve kahate haiM: hama kadApi ImAna nahIM lAe~ge, yahA~ taka ki allAha hameM bhI usI jaisA pradAna kara de, jo usane nabiyoM ko nubuvvata tathA risAlata pradAna kI hai| to allAha ne unheM uttara diyA ki vaha use adhika jAnane vAlA hai jo risAlata (paig2aMbarI) ke lie yogya hai aura usake bojha ko uThA sakatA hai| isalie vaha use nubuvvata tathA risAlata ke lie viziSTa kara letA hai| zIghra hI ina sarakazoM ko unake satya se abhimAna ke kAraNa apamAna aura tiraskAra, tathA unakI cAlabAz2I (chala) ke kAraNa kar3I yAtanA kA sAmanA karanA par3egA|

jisa vyakti ko allAha hidAyata ke mArga para le jAnA cAhatA hai, usake sIne ko khola detA hai tathA use islAma svIkAra karane ke lie taiyAra kara detA hai| aura jise vaha viphala karanA cAhatA hai aura use hidAyata kI taufIqa nahIM denA cAhatA, usake sIne ko saccAI ko svIkAra karane se bahuta saMkIrNa kara detA hai, tAki usake hRdaya meM satya kA praveza asaMbhava ho jAe| jisa taraha ki usakA AsamAna kI ora car3hanA asaMbhava hai aura vaha svayaM aisA karane meM asamartha hai| tathA jaise allAha ne pathabhraSTa vyakti kI sthiti ko isa taraha kI gaMbhIra saMkaTa kI sthiti banA dI hai, usI taraha vaha una logoM ko yAtanA se grasta karatA hai, jo usapara ImAna nahIM lAte|

yaha dharma jo hamane (ai rasUla!) Apake lie nirdhArita kiyA hai, allAha kA vaha sIdhA mArga hai, jisameM koI Ter3hApana nahIM| hamane usake lie nizAniyA~ spaSTa kara dI haiM, jisake pAsa samajha-bUjha hai jisake dvArA vaha allAha ke bAre meM samajha sakatA hai|
unake lie eka ghara hai, jisameM ve hara nuqasAna se surakSita raheMge| yaha ghara jannata hai| tathA allAha unakA sahAyaka aura samarthaka hai, unake una acche kAmoM ke badale jo ve kiyA karate the|

aura (ai rasUla!) yAda kareM, jisa dina allAha mAnava jAti aura jinnoM ko ikaTThA karegA, phira allAha kahegA: ai jinnoM ke samUha! tumane inasAnoM ko khUba gumarAha kiyA tathA unheM allAha ke mArga se roka diyA| isapara inasAnoM meM se unake anuyAyI apane raba ko javAba dete hue kaheMge: ai hamAre raba! hamameM se pratyeka ne apane sAthI se lAbha uThAyA hai| cunA~ce jinna ne inasAna kI AjJAkAritA kA lAbha uThAyA, aura inasAna ne apanI icchAoM kI pUrti kA lAbha uThAyA| aura hama usa avadhi taka pahu~ca gae, jo tUne hamAre lie niyata kara rakhI thI| to aba yaha qiyAmata kA dina hai| allAha kahegA: Aga hI tumhArA ThikAnA hai, jisameM tuma hamezA rahoge, sivAya usake jo allAha cAhe, jo ki unake qabroM se uThane se lekara unake apane gaMtavya jahannama kI ora jAne ke bIca kI avadhi hai| yahI vaha avadhi hai, jisako allAha ne unake hamezA jahannama meM rahane se alaga kiyA hai| nizcaya hI ApakA raba (ai rasUla!) apanI taqadIra tathA prabaMdhana meM pUrNa hikamata vAlA, apane baMdoM aura unameM se una logoM ke bAre meM saba kucha jAnane vAlA hai jo yAtanA ke yogya haiM|

jisa prakAra hamane sarakaza jinnoM ko kucha inasAnoM kA dosta banA diyA aura unheM unapara hAvI kara diyA, tAki ve unheM pathabhraSTa karate raheM, usI prakAra hama pratyeka atyAcArI ko eka atyAcArI kA dosta banA dete haiM, jo use burAI karane para ubhAratA aura usake lie prerita karatA hai, tathA use bhalAI se napharata dilAtA aura usake prati usameM aruci paidA karatA hai| yaha daraasala una pApoM ke pratiphala ke rUpa meM hai, jo ve kamAyA karate the|

hama qiyAmata ke dina unase kaheMge: ai inasAnoM aura jinnoM ke samUha! kyA tumhAre pAsa tumhAre hI varga (mAnava jAti) se rasUla nahIM Ae, jo tumheM vaha par3hakara sunAte hoM jo allAha ne unapara avatarita kiyA hai, aura tumheM isa dina ke bheMTa arthAt qiyAmata ke dina se DarAte hoM? ve kaheMge: bilakula Ae the| Aja hama apane viruddha iqarAra karate haiM ki tere rasUloM ne hameM saMdeza pahu~cA diyA, tathA hama isa dina ke bheMTa kA bhI iqarAra karate haiM| paraMtu hamane tere rasUloM ko jhuThalA diyA thA tathA isa dina ke bheMTa ke bAre meM unakI bAta ko asvIkAra kara diyA thA| daraasala, isa duniyA ke jIvana ne unheM apane alaMkaraNa, zobhA aura kSaNabhaMgura AnaMda ke sAtha dhokhA diyA, tathA ve svayaM hI svIkAra kareMge ki ve duniyA meM allAha tathA usake rasUloM kA inakAra karane vAle the| hAlA~ki isa svIkArokti aura ImAna se unheM kucha bhI lAbha nahIM hogA, kyoMki usakA samaya samApta ho cukA|

inasAnoM tathA jinnoM kI ora rasUla bhejakara isalie hujjata tamAma kara dI gaI, tAki kisI ko usake gunAha kI saz2A isa hAla meM na dI jAe ki usakI ora koI rasUla na bhejA gayA ho aura usake pAsa dharma kA saMdeza na pahu~cA ho| ataH hamane kisI samudAya ko usake pAsa rasUla bhejane ke bAda hI daMDita kiyA|

unameM se pratyeka ke lie apane karmoM ke anusAra daraje haiM| ataH thor3I-bahuta burAI karane vAlA aura adhika burAI karane vAlA, donoM barAbara nahIM ho sakate tathA anusaraNa karane vAlA aura jisakA anusaraNa kiyA gayA hai, donoM barAbara nahIM ho sakate| jaise ki sabhI acche kArya karane vAloM kA badalA barAbara nahIM ho sakatA| tathA ApakA pAlanahAra usase anajAna nahIM hai jo kucha ve kara rahe the, balki vaha usake bAre meM jAnatA hai, usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai, aura vaha unheM unake kAryoM kA badalA degA|

aura (ai rasUla!) ApakA raba apane baMdoM se beniyAz2a hai| use na unakI AvazyakatA hai, na unakI ibAdata kI, aura na hI unake inakAra se use koI nuqasAna hotA hai| vaha unase apanI isa beniyAz2I ke bAvajUda, unapara dayA karatA hai| yadi vaha (ai avajJAkArI baMdo!) tumheM naSTa karanA cAhe, to apanI yAtanA bhejakara tumheM jar3a se ukhAr3a pheMke aura tumheM vinaSTa karane ke bAda apanI icchA ke anusAra aise logoM ko le Ae, jo usapara ImAna rakheM aura usakI AjJA mAneM| jaisA ki usane tumheM anya logoM ke vaMza se paidA kiyA jo tumase pahale the|

(ai kAfiro!) tumase jisa punarjIvana, dobArA uThAe jAne, hisAba-kitAba aura saz2A kA vAdA kiyA jA rahA hai, vaha anivArya rUpa se Ane vAlA hai aura tuma apane pAlanahAra kI pakar3a se bhAgakara nahIM nikala sakate| kyoMki vaha tumhAre mAthe kI laTa ko pakar3e hue hai aura tumheM apanI yAtanA se daMDita karane vAlA hai|

(ai rasUla!) Apa kaha dIjie: ai mere samudAya ke logo! apane mArga para aura jisa kufra tathA pathabhraSTatA meM par3e ho, usa para aDiga raho| maiMne spaSTa rUpa se saMdeza pahu~cAkara tumapara hujjata tamAma kara dI aura pramANa sthApita kara diyA| ataH mujhe tumhAre kufra tathA pathabhraSTatA kI koI paravAha nahIM hai| balki maiM jisa satya para qAyama hU~ usapara aDiga rahU~gA| phira tumheM zIghra hI mAlUma ho jAegA ki kise duniyA meM vijaya prApta hotI hai, kauna dharatI kA vArisa hotA hai tathA kise Aqhirata kI khuziyA~ prApta hotI haiM| nizcita rUpa se bahudevavAdiyoM ko na to isa duniyA meM saphalatA prApta hogI, aura na hI Aqhirata meM| balki unakA pariNAma ghATA evaM nuqasAna hai, bhale hI ve saMsAra meM jo kucha bhI bhogate haiM usakA Ananda leM|

allAha ke sAtha zirka karane vAloM ne yaha tarIqA nikAlA ki allAha kI paidA kI huI phasaloM aura maveziyoM meM se usake lie eka hissA nirdhArita kara diyA aura yaha dAvA kiyA ki vaha (hissA) allAha kA hai, aura dUsarA hissA unakI mUrtiyoM aura thAnoM ke lie hai| phira unhoMne jo hissA apane sAjhiyoM ke lie AvaMTita kiyA hai, vaha una masarafoM taka nahIM pahu~catA, jinameM qharca karanA allAha ne dharmasaMgata banAyA hai, jaise g2arIba aura misakIna loga| tathA unhoMne jo hissA allAha ke lie nirdhArita kiyA hai, vaha unake sAjhiyoM yAnI mUrtiyoM ko pahu~ca jAtA hai, vaha unake hitoM meM kharca kiyA jA sakatA hai| unakA yaha nirNaya aura vibhAjana bahuta burA hai|

jisa taraha zaitAna ne bahudevavAdiyoM ke lie isa anyAyapUrNa nirNaya ko suMdara banA diyA hai, usI taraha bahuta-se bahudevavAdiyoM ke lie unake sAjhI zaitAnoM ne yaha suzobhita kiyA hai ki ve garIbI ke Dara se apane baccoM kI hatyA kara deM; tAki vaha unase usa AtmA kI hatyA karAkara unheM naSTa kara de, jisakI nAhaqa hatyA karanA allAha ne niSiddha ThaharAyA hai, aura tAki vaha unapara unake dharma ko gaDDamaDDa kara de, phira ve yaha na jAna sakeM ki kyA vaidha hai aura kyA avaidha| aura yadi allAha cAhatA ki ve aisA na kareM, to ve aisA nahIM karate, paraMtu allAha ne apanI vyApaka hikamata ke tahata aisA hI cAhA| ataH (ai rasUla!) Apa ina bahudevavAdiyoM tathA allAha para inake mithyAropaNa ko chor3a deM| kyoMki isase Apako koI nuqasAna nahIM hogA, aura unakA mAmalA allAha ko sauMpa deM|

tathA bahudevavAdiyoM ne kahA: ye pazudhana aura phasaleM niSiddha haiM, jinameM se kevala vahI khA sakate haiM, jinheM ve cAheM, jaise mUrtiyoM ke sevaka Adi| yaha unakA apanA qhayAla aura ghar3I huI bAta hai| aura (unhoMne yaha bhI kahA ki) ye aise mavezI haiM jinakI pITheM harAma (varjita) haiM; na unakI savArI kI jAegI aura na hI unapara bojha lAdA jAegA| ina jAnavaroM se murAda bahIrA (vaha U~TanI jisake pA~ca bacce ho jAe~ aura usakA kAna cIrakara use chor3a diyA jAe), sAibA (vaha U~TanI jise mUrtiyoM ke lie chor3a diyA jAe) aura hAmI (vaha nara U~Ta jisakI nasla se dasa bacce paidA ho jAe~ aura use Az2Ada kara diyA jAe) haiM| ina jAnavaroM ko z2abaha karate samaya ve allAha kA nAma lene ke bajAya apanI mUrtiyoM kA nAma lete the| unhoMne yaha saba allAha ke viruddha yaha jhUTha gar3hate hue kiyA ki yaha usakI ora se hai| allAha zIghra hI unheM apanI yAtanA se daMDita karegA, kyoMki ve allAha para jhUThe Aropa lagAte the|

ve loga naSTa ho gae, jinhoMne apanI nAsamajhI evaM ajJAnatA ke kAraNa apanI saMtAna kI hatyA kI aura allAha ke die hue jAnavaroM ko, jhUThe taura para allAha kI ora nisabata karake harAma ThaharA liyA| nizcaya ve sIdhe rAste se dUra ho gae aura ve usa para nirdezita nahIM the|

aura hamane yahUdiyoM para una tamAma jAnavaroM ko harAma kara diyA thA, jinakI uMgaliyA~ alaga-alaga na hoM, jaise U~Ta tathA zuturamurg2a Adi| tathA hamane unapara gAya aura bakarI kI carbI ko bhI harAma kara diyA thA, sivAya usake jo unakI pITha yA A~ta se lagI ho, yA jo haDDiyoM ke sAtha mizrita ho, jaise nitaMba aura pahalU kI carbI| hamane unake atyAcAra ke badale ke taura para, ina cIz2oM ko unapara harAma kiyA thA| niHsaMdeha hama jo kucha bhI batAte haiM, nizcaya usameM sacce haiM|

jaba jannata vAle jannata meM aura jahannama vAle jahannama meM cale jAe~ge, to jannata ke nivAsI jahannama vAloM ko AvAz2a deMge: hamAre raba ne hamase jisa jannata kA vAdA kiyA thA, nizcaya hamane use saccA va siddha pAyA aura hama usameM praveza pA cuke haiM| to kyA (ai kAfiroM!) allAha ne tumheM jisa jahannama kI dhamakI dI thI tumane usako saccA va siddha pAyA? kAphira kaheMge: vAstava meM, hamane bhI use saccA pAyA jo usane hameM jahannama kI dhamakI dI thI| phira eka AvAz2a dene vAlA allAha se duA karate hue AvAz2a degA ki allAha z2AlimoM ko apanI dayA se dUra kara de| kyoMki usane duniyA ke jIvana meM unake lie apanI dayA ke dvAra khola die, paraMtu unhoMne usase mu~ha phera liyA|

ye z2Alima vahI haiM, jo khuda bhI allAha kI rAha se dUra rahate the aura dUsaroM ko bhI usase dUra kara rahe the, aura AzA karate the ki satya kA rAstA Ter3hA ho jAe, tAki loga usapara na caleM, tathA ye loga Aqhirata kA inakAra karane vAle haiM, usake lie taiyArI karane vAle nahIM haiM|

ina do samUhoM: jannata ke nivAsiyoM tathA doz2akha ke nivAsiyoM ke bIca eka U~cI Ar3a hogI, jisakA nAma 'ArAfa' hai, aura isa U~cI Ar3a para ve loga hoMge jinake acche aura bure karma barAbara hoMge| ve jannatiyoM ko unake lakSaNoM, jaise ki unake cehare kI saphedI se, tathA jahannamiyoM ko unake lakSaNoM, jaise ki unake ceharoM ke kAlepana se pahacAna leMge| ye loga jannata vAloM ko unake sammAna meM AvAz2a dekara kaheMge: "tuma para zAMti ho"| 'ArAfa' vAle abhI jannata meM dAkhila nahIM hue hoMge aura ve allAha kI dayA se usameM praveza karane kI AzA rakhate hoMge|

kAfira loga kevala usa dardanAka yAtanA ke Ane kI pratIkSA kara rahe haiM, jisake bAre meM unheM batAyA gayA hai aura jo Aqhirata meM unakA aMjAma hone vAle hai| jisa dina vaha yAtanA A jAegI jisake bAre meM unheM batAyA gayA hai aura vaha pratiphala bhI sAmane A jAegA jisake bAre meM ImAna vAloM ko batAyA gayA hai, to ve loga jinhoMne isa duniyA meM quraAna ko bhulA diyA aura usake nirdezoM ke anusAra kAma nahIM kiyA, kaheMge: nizcaya hamAre raba ke rasUla usa saccAI ke sAtha Ae the jisameM koI saMdeha nahIM, aura isameM koI saMdeha nahIM ki yaha allAha kI ora se hai| to kAza! hamAre lie koI madhyastha hote jo hamAre lie allAha ke pAsa sifAriza karate ki vaha hameM yAtanA se mukta kara de, yA kAza! hama duniyA ke jIvana meM vApasa bheja die jAte tAki hama una bure kAmoM ke bajAya jo hama kiyA karate the, acche karma karake mokSa prApta kara lete| ina kAfiroM ne apane kufra ke kAraNa apane Apako vinAza ke saMsAdhanoM para lAkara khuda ko ghATe meM DAla diyA, aura jinakI ve allAha ko chor3akara pUjA karate the, ve unase lupta ho gae, isalie ve unake kucha bhI kAma na Ae|

niHsaMdeha (ai logo!) tumhArA raba vaha allAha hai, jisane AkAzoM tathA dharatI ko binA kisI pUrva udAharaNa ke chaH dinoM meM banAyA| phira vaha sarvazaktimAna apanI mahimA ke anurUpa arza para bulaMda huA, jisakI kaifiyata (vivaraNa) hama nahIM jAnate| vaha dina ke ujAle se rAta ke a~dhere ko aura rAta ke a~dhere se dina ke ujAle ko dUra karatA hai| rAta aura dina meM se pratyeka dUsare ke pIche isa taraha tez2I se pahu~ca jAtA hai ki usase vilaMba nahIM hotA| eka gayA ki dUsarA A gayA| tathA usa mahimAvAna ne sUraja banAyA, cA~da banAyA aura sitAre banAe, isa hAla meM ki ve usake Adeza ke adhIna kie hue haiM| suna lo! sArI cIz2oM kA paidA karanA kevala allAha hI kA kAma hai, to kyA usake alAvA bhI koI paidA karane vAlA hai?! tathA kevala usI kA kAma hai Adeza denA| usakI bhalAI mahAna aura usakA upakAra bahuta adhika hai| kyoMki vaha aizvarya aura pUrNatA ke guNoM se vizeSita hai, jo sAre saMsAroM kA pAlanahAra hai|

(ai ImAna vAlo!) apane raba ko pUrI vinamratA ke sAtha aura gupta rUpa se pukAro, niSThAvAna hokara kevala usI se duA karo, dikhAvA karane vAle yA duA meM usake sAtha kisI ko sAjhI karane vAle na ho| niHsaMdeha vaha una logoM ko pasaMda nahIM karatA, jo duA meM usakI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karane vAle haiM, aura duA meM usakI sImAoM kA sabase bar3A ullaMghana usake sAtha kisI anya ko pukAranA hai, jaisA ki bahudevavAdI karate haiM|

phira unhoMne ahaMkAra meM Akara allAha ke Adeza kI avahelanA karate hue, usa U~TanI kA vadha kara diyA, jise sAleha alaihissalAma ne koI nuqasAna pahu~cAne se unheM manA kiyA thA| tathA sAleha alaihissalAma ne unheM jisa cIz2a kI dhamakI dI thI, usakA maz2Aqa ur3Ate hue aura use khArija karate hue unhoMne kahA: ai sAleha! yadi tU vAstava meM allAha ke rasUloM meM se hai, to vaha dardanAka yAtanA hamapara le A, jisakI tUne hameM dhamakI dI thI|
