sAleha - alaihissalAma - apanI jAti ke svIkaraNa se nirAza hokara, unase mu~ha phera lie aura bole: ai merI jAti ke logo! niHsaMdeha maiM tumheM vaha saMdeza pahu~cA cukA, jise allAha ne mujhe tuma taka pahu~cAne kA Adeza diyA thA, aura tumheM kabhI prerita karake aura kabhI bhayabhIta karake nasIhata kI, lekina tuma aise loga ho ki una nasIhata karane vAloM ko pasaMda nahIM karate, jo tumheM bhalAI ke lie mArgadarzana karane aura burAI se dUra rakhane ke icchuka haiM|

aura lUta ko yAda karo, jaba unhoMne apanI jAti kI niMdA karate hue kahA: kyA tuma puruSoM ke sAtha saMbhoga kA yaha ghinaunA aura niMdanIya kAma karate ho?! yaha kArya jo tumane AviSkAra kiyA hai, tumase pahale ise kisI ne nahIM kiyA!

tuma kAma-vAsanA ko pUrA karane ke lie puruSoM ke pAsa Ate ho, una mahilAoM ko chor3akara jinheM ise pUrA karane ke lie banAyA gayA hai| ataH tumane apane isa kArya meM buddhi, yA dharma, yA mAnava prakRti kA pAlana nahIM kiyA| balki, tuma mAnava saMyama kI sImA se nikalakara aura svastha buddhi aura acchI prakRti kI apekSAoM se vicalita hokara, allAha kI sImAoM kA ullaMghana karane vAle ho|

jaba lUta - alaihissalAma - ne apanI jAti ke isa anaitika kAma karane vAloM kA khaMDana kiyA, to unakA uttara isake sivA kucha na thA ki unhoMne satya se mu~ha mor3ate hue kahA: lUta aura usake parivAra ko apane gA~va se nikAla do| ye aise loga haiM jo hamAre isa kAma se bar3e pAka banate haiM| isalie unakA hamAre bIca rahanA hamAre lie ucita nahIM hai|

so hamane unheM aura unake parivAra ko bacA liyA, kyoMki hamane unheM rAta hI meM usa gA~va se nikala jAne kA Adeza de diyA thA, jisapara yAtanA Ane vAlI thI| unakI patnI ko chor3akara, jo apanI jAti ke bAkI logoM ke sAtha ho gaI thI, ataH vaha bhI usa yAtanA se pIr3ita huI, jo unapara AI thI|

aura hamane unapara eka bhISaNa bAriza barasAI| hamane una para miTTI ke patthara (kaMkar3a) barasAe aura gA~va ko ulaTa diyA| cunA~ce usake UparI hisse ko nIce kara diyA| ataH (ai rasUla!) vicAra kareM ki lUta kI jAti ke aparAdhiyoM kA pariNAma kaisA huA? nizcaya unakA pariNAma vinAza aura anaMta apamAna thA|

hamane madayana ke gotra kI ora unake bhAI zuaiba alaihissalAma ko bhejA| unhoMne unase kahA: ai merI jAti ke logo! akele allAha kI ibAdata karo| usake sivA tumhArA koI pUjya nahIM, jo ibAdata ke yogya ho| maiM apane raba kI ora se tumhAre pAsa jo kucha lekara AyA hU~ usakI saccAI kA allAha kI ora se tumhAre pAsa eka spaSTa pramANa A cukA hai| ataH nApa aura taula pUre karake logoM ko unake adhikAra do| tathA logoM kA unake sAmAna meM doSa nikAlakara aura usake prati aruci jagAkara, yA unake mAlikoM ko dhokhA dekara ghATA na karo| isase pahale nabiyoM ke dvArA dharatI para sudhAra hone ke bAda, kufra aura pApa karake usameM bigAr3a na phailAo| yadi tuma momina ho, to jo kucha ullekha kiyA gayA hai tumhAre lie behatara aura adhika lAbhakArI hai| kyoMki isameM allAha ke niSedhoM se bacane hetu pApoM kA parityAga karanA zAmila hai, aura kyoMki isameM allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake usake qarIba AnA zAmila hai|

aura pratyeka mArga para isa kAraNa na baiTho ki usapara calane vAle logoM ko dhamakAo tAki unakA dhana lUTa lo, tathA usa vyakti ko allAha ke dharma se roka do jo usase mArgadarzana prApta karanA cAhe| tumhArI icchA hai ki allAha kA mArga Ter3hA ho tAki loga usapara na caleM| tathA apane Upara allAha kI nemata ko yAda karo, tAki tuma usapara usakA zukra adA karo| kyoMki tumhArI saMkhyA kama thI, to usane tumheM adhika kara diyA| tathA vicAra karo ki tumase pahale gharatI meM bigAr3a paidA karane vAloM kA pariNAma kaisA huA| nizcaya unakA pariNAma tabAhI aura vinAza thA|

aura yadi tuma meM se eka samUha usapara ImAna lAyA hai, jo maiM apane raba kI ora se lAyA hU~ aura dUsarA samUha usapara ImAna nahIM lAyA, to (ai jhuThalAne vAlo!) pratIkSA karo ki allAha tumhAre bIca kyA nirNaya karatA hai| vaha nirNaya karane vAloM meM sabase acchA aura nyAya karane vAloM meM sabase adhika nyAyazIla hai|

zuaiba alaihissalAma kI qauma ke ghamaMDI pramukhoM aura bar3e logoM ne zuaiba alaihissalAma se kahA: (ai zuaiba!) hama tujhe aura tere sAtha terI bAta mAnane vAloM ko apane isa gA~va se avazya nikAla deMge, yA tuma avazya hI hamAre dharma meM vApasa A jAoge| to zuaiba alaihissalAma ne inakAra karate hue aura Azcarya vyakta karate hue kahA: kyA hama tumhAre dharma para calane lageM, agarace hama use nApasaMda hI karate hoM, kyoMki hama jAnate haiM ki tumhArA dharma asatya hai?!

yadi hama bhI tumhArI hI taraha zirka va kufra kA aqIdA rakhane lageM, jabaki allAha ne hameM apanI kRpA se usase bacA liyA hai, to hama allAha para jhUTha gar3hane vAle ThahareMge| aura hamase yaha bhI nahIM ho sakatA ki tumhAre asatya dharma kI ora lauTa Ae~| paraMtu yaha ki hamArA pAlanahAra allAha aisA cAhe| kyoMki saba usI ke irAde ke adhIna haiM| hamAre pAlanahAra ne pratyeka vastu ko apane jJAna ke dAyare meM le rakhA hai| usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai| kevala allAha hI para hamArA bharosA hai ki vaha hameM sIdhe rAste para sudRr3ha rakhegA aura jahannama ke rAstoM se bacAegA| ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hamAre aura hamArI kAfira jAti ke bIca nyAya ke sAtha nirNaya kara de| ataH satyavAdI maz2alUma ko haThI z2Alima ke viruddha vijaya pradAna kara| kyoMki tU hI (ai hamAre pAlanahAra!) sabase uttama nirNaya karane vAlA hai|

unakI jAti ke kAfira evaM tauhIda ke AhvAna ko ThukarAne vAle pramukhoM tathA saradAroM ne zuaiba alaihissalAma aura unake dharma se sAvadhAna karate hue kahA: (ai hamArI jAti ke logo!) agara tumane zuaiba kA dharma apanA liyA tathA apanA aura apane bApa-dAdA kA dharma chor3a diyA, to nizcita rUpa se tumhArA sarvanAza ho jAegA|
cunA~ce unheM bhayaMkara bhUkaMpa ne pakar3a liyA, to ve apane gharoM meM vinaSTa ho gae, isa hAla meM ki apane ghuTanoM aura ceharoM ke bala apane gharoM meM mRta aura bejAna par3e hue the|

jina logoM ne zuaiba alaihissalAma ko jhuThalAyA, ve saba ke saba vinaSTa ho gae, aura ve aise ho gae jaise ve apane gharoM meM base hI na the aura unhoMne isakA AnaMda hI nahIM liyA thA| jina logoM ne zuaiba alaihissalAma ko jhuThalAyA, vahI loga ghATe meM rahe; isalie ki unhoMne apanA aura apanI dhana-saMpatti kA vinAza kiyA| jabaki unakI jAti ke mominoM kA koI ghATA nahIM huA, jaisA ki ina jhuThalAne vAle kAfiroM ne dAvA kiyA thA|

jaba unakA vinAza ho gayA, to unake paigaMbara zuaiba alaihissalAma unase vimukha ho gae aura unheM saMbodhita karate hue bole: ai merI jAti ke logo! maiMne tumheM vaha saMdeza pahu~cA diyA thA jisakA mere pAlanahAra ne mujhe tumako pahu~cAne kA Adeza diyA thA, tathA maiM tumhArA hitaiSI va zubha ciMtaka banA rahA, kiMtu tumane merI qhaira-qhvAhI (zubhaciMtana) ko svIkAra nahIM kiyA aura mere mArgadarzana para calane ko taiyAra na hue| to bhalA maiM aise logoM para zoka kaise karU~, jo allAha ke sAtha kufra karane vAle haiM aura apane kufra para aDiga haiM?

tathA hamane kisI bastI meM apanA jo bhI rasUla bhejA, phira usake vAsiyoM ne nabI ko jhuThalA diyA aura kuphra kA mArga apanAyA, to hamane unheM kaThinAI, g2arIbI aura bImArI se pIr3ita kara diyA, tAki ve allAha ke sAmane apanI vinamratA prakaTa kareM| jisake pariNAmasvarUpa ve apane kufra aura ahaMkAra ko chor3a deM| yaha jhuThalAne vAle samudAyoM ke bAre meM allAha kI paraMparA kA ullekha karake quraiza ke lie tathA sabhI inakAra karane aura jhuThalAne vAloM ke lie eka cetAvanI hai|

phira hamane taMgI aura bImArI se grasta karane ke bAda unheM acchAI, vistAra aura surakSA pradAna kI, yahA~ taka ki unakI saMkhyA adhika ho gaI tathA unakI dhana-saMpatti meM vRddhi ho gaI aura ve kahane lage: hameM jo burAI aura acchAI pahu~cI hai, vaha eka niyamita Adata hai, jo pahale hamAre pUrvajoM ko bhI pahu~ca cukI hai| unheM isa bAta kA ehasAsa nahIM huA ki ve jisa durdazA se pIr3ita hue the, usase unheM sIkha lenA cAhie thA, tathA unheM jo nemateM prApta huI thIM, unakA uddezya DhIla denA thA| ataH hamane acAnaka unheM yAtanA dvArA pakar3a liyA aura unheM yAtanA kA ehasAsa bhI nahIM huA aura na hI ve isakI kalpanA karate the|

aura yadi ina bastiyoM ke vAsI, jinakI ora hamane apane rasUloM ko bhejA thA, una bAtoM para vizvAsa karate jo unake rasUla unake pAsa lekara Ae the, tathA apane pAlanahAra se, kufra aura gunAhoM ko chor3akara aura usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake, Darate, to hama unake lie cAroM ora se bhalAI ke dvAra khola dete, lekina unhoMne na to vizvAsa kiyA aura na Dare, balki apane rasUloM ke lAe hue saMdeza ko jhuThalAyA| ataH hamane unheM unake kie hue gunAhoM aura pApoM ke kAraNa acAnaka yAtanA se grasta kara diyA|
to kyA ina jhuThalAne vAlI bastiyoM ke loga isa bAta se nizciMta ho gae haiM ki unapara hamArI yAtanA rAta ke samaya A jAe aura ve apane ArAma aura zAMti meM lIna hokara so rahe haiM?
aura kyA ve isa bAta se nizciMta ho gae haiM ki unapara hamArI yAtanA dina kI zuruAta meM A jAe aura ve apanI duniyA meM vyasta hone kI vajaha se beparavAha aura g2Afila hoM?!

dekho, allAha ne unhe kisa qadara mohalata dI hai, aura DhIla dete hue zakti tathA vistRta jIvikA pradAna kI hai; to kyA ina nagaroM ke ye jhuThalanAne vAle loga allAha kI cAla aura usake gupta upAya se nizciMta ho gae haiM? to (yAda rakho!) allAha ke gupta upAya se nizciMta kevala vahI loga hote haiM, jinake bhAgya meM vinAza likhA ho| rahI bAta taufIqa vAle logoM kI, to ve usake gupta upAya se Darate haiM| yahI kAraNa hai ki usakI nematoM se dhokhA nahIM khAte, balki usake ehasAna ke AbhArI rahate haiM aura usakA zukriyA adA karate haiM|

to kyA una logoM ke sAmane yaha tathya spaSTa nahIM huA, jo apane pUrvajoM ke bAda dharatI ke vArisa hue, jinheM unake gunAhoM ke kAraNa vinaSTa kara diyA gayA thA, phira unhoMne unapara utarane vAlI yAtanA se zikSA grahaNa nahIM kI, balki unhIM jaise karma karate rahe| kyA ina logoM ke sAmane yaha tathya spaSTa nahIM huA ki agara allAha unheM unake gunAhoM ke kAraNa pakar3anA cAhe, to apanI rIti ke anusAra pakar3a le aura unake diloM para muhara lagA de, phira unheM na kisI upadeza se lAbha ho, na kisI yAda-dahAnI se fAyadA?!

ye pichalI bastiyA~ haiM (arthAta nUha, hUda, sAleha, lUta aura zuaiba alaihimussalAma kI bastiyA~), jinakI khabareM aura unake jhuThalAne tathA haThadharmI kI dAstAneM aura unake vinAza kA vivaraNa hama Apako sunA rahe haiM, tAki yaha zikSA prApta karane vAloM ke lie eka zikSA aura nasIhata hAsila karane vAloM ke lie eka nasIhata ho| ina bastiyoM vAloM ke pAsa unake rasUla apane sacce rasUla hone ke spaSTa pramANa lekara Ae the, paraMtu unase yaha na ho sakA ki jaba rasUla A gae, to unheM mAna lete, kyoMki yaha bAta pahale hI se allAha ke jJAna meM thI ki ve unheM jhuThalA deMge| jisa taraha ina bastiyoM vAloM ke diloM para allAha ne muhara lagA dI thI, vaise hI allAha muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko jhuThalAne vAloM ke diloM para bhI muhara lagA degA, phira ve ImAna kI rAha prApta nahIM kara sakeMge|

jina samudAyoM kI ora rasUla bheje gae the, unameM se adhikAMza meM hamane allAha ke AdezoM ke prati pratibaddhatA aura pratijJA pAlana nahIM pAyA, tathA hamane unheM usakI AjJAoM kA pAlana karate hue nahIM pAyA| balki hamane unameM se adhikAMza ko allAha kI avajJA karate hue hI pAyA|

phira hamane una rasUloM ke bAda mUsA alaihissalAma ko apane tarkoM aura spaSTa pramANoM ke sAtha, jo unake sacce nabI hone ko spaSTa kara rahe the, firaauna aura usake pramukhoM ke pAsa bhejA| paraMtu unhoMne una AyatoM kA inakAra kara diyA aura unapara vizvAsa nahIM kiyA| to (ai rasUla!) Apa g2aura kareM ki firaauna aura usakI jAti kA pariNAma kaisA rahA?! allAha ne unheM Dubokara naSTa kara diyA aura duniyA tathA Aqhirata meM unake pIche lAnata lagA diyA|

jaba allAha ne mUsA alaihissalAma ko firaauna ke pAsa bhejA aura vaha usake pAsa Ae, to kahA: ai firaauna! niHsaMdeha maiM sArI sRSTi ke racayitA, unake svAmI aura unake mAmaloM ke vyavasthApaka kI ora se bhejA huA rasUla hU~|

mUsA ne kahA: cU~ki maiM allAha kI ora se bhejA gayA hU~, isalie maiM usake bAre meM satya ke alAvA kucha bhI kahane ke yogya nahIM hU~| nizcaya maiM tamhAre pAsa eka spaSTa pramANa lekara AyA hU~, jo mere sacce hone aura mere apane pAlanahAra kI ora se tumhAre pAsa bheje hue (rasUla) hone ko darzAtA hai| ataH banI isarAIla ko qaida tathA utpIr3ana se Az2Ada karake mere sAtha jAne de|
firaauna ne mUsA alaihissalAma se kahA: yadi tuma koI pramANa (camatkAra) lekara Ae ho, jaisA ki tumhArA dAvA hai, to use prastuta karo, yadi tuma apane dAve meM sacce ho|
phira mUsA alaihissalAma ne apanI lAThI pheMkI, to vaha eka mahAna sA~pa meM badala gaI, jo use dekhane vAloM ke lie pratyakSa thA|

tathA unhoMne apane sIne ke pAsa se apanI kamIz2a kI cheda se, yA apane bag2ala ke nIce se apanA hAtha nikAlA, to vaha barasa (safeda kuSTha roga) ke binA bilakula safeda nikalA, jo itanA safeda thA ki dekhane vAloM ke lie camaka rahA thA|

firaauna kI jAti ke bar3oM aura pramukhoM ne jaba mUsA alaihissalAma kI lAThI kA sA~pa bana jAnA aura unake hAtha kA barasa ke binA safeda ho jAnA dekhA, to bola uThe: mUsA eka dakSa jAdUgara ke alAvA kucha nahIM hai|

vaha cAhatA hai ki apane jAdU ke bala se tumheM, tumhArI isa dharatI misra se nikAla de| phira firaauna ne unase mUsA alaihissalAma ke bAre meM parAmarza karate hue kahA: tuma mujhe kyA salAha dete ho?
unhoMne firaauna se kahA: mUsA tathA usake bhAI ke mAmale ko sthagita kara de aura misra ke zaharoM meM jAdUgaroM ko ikaTThA karane ke lie kisI ko bheja de|
ye loga jinheM tUne zaharoM se jAdUgaroM ko ikaTThA karane ke lie bhejA hai, ve hara kuzala aura dakSa jAdUgara ko tere pAsa le Ae~|

cunA~ce firaauna ne jAdUgaroM ko jamA karane ke lie harakAre bheja die| phira jaba jAdUgara phiraauna ke pAsa Ae, to unhoMne usase pUchA: kyA unheM koI inAma milegA yadi unhoMne mUsA ko apane jAdU se harA diyA aura usa para jIta hAsila kI?
to phiraauna ne javAba diyA ki hA~, tumheM usakA badalA aura puraskAra milegA aura tumheM aise pada bhI die jAe~ge ki mere nikaTavartI bana jAoge|

jAdUgaroM ne mUsA para apanI jIta ke bAre meM Azvasta hokara, ghamaMDa aura ahaMkAra se kahA: (ai mUsA!) Apa jo cAheM cuna leM, ki Apa usa cIz2a ko pheMkane kI zuruAta kareMge jo Apa pheMkanA cAhate haiM, yaha hama hI usakI zuruAta kareM|

mUsA (alaihissalAma) ne apane pAlanahAra kI madada para bharosA karate hue, unakI paravAha na karate hue, unheM javAba diyA: tumhIM apanI rassiyA~ aura lAThiyA~ pheMko| to jaba unhoMne rassiyA~ aura lAThiyA~ pheMkIM, to logoM kI A~khoM ko, unheM zuddha bodha se vicalita karake, maMtramugdha kara diyA aura unheM bhayabhIta kara diyA tathA ve dekhane vAloM kI A~khoM meM zaktizAlI jAdU lekara Ae|

to allAha ne apane nabI tathA kalIma mUsA alaihissalAma ko vaha़ya kI ki apanI lAThI pheMko| cunA~ce unhoMne apanI lAThI pheMkI| aura dekhate hI dekhate lAThI sA~pa banakara unakI rassiyoM tathA lAThiyoM! ko nigalane lagI, jinakA prayoga ve tathyoM ko badalane aura logoM ko isa bhrama meM DAlane ke lie karate the ki ye daur3ate hue sA~pa haiM|
ataH satya prakaTa ho gayA tathA mUsA alaihissalAma jo kucha lekara Ae the, usakI saccAI spaSTa ho gaI aura jAdUgaroM ne jo jAdU banAyA thA, usakA jhUThA honA jaga-z2Ahira ho gayA|
aMtataH ve usa avasara para parAjita hue aura hAra gae tathA mUsA alaihissalAma ko unapara vijaya prApta huA| aura ve loga apamAnita aura mag2alUba hokara lauTe|
jaba jAdUgaroM ne allAha kI mahAna zakti aura spaSTa nizAniyoM ko dekhA, to be-sAkhtA pavitra allAha ke sAmane sajade meM gira gae|
jAdUgaroM ne kahA: hama sArI sRSTi ke pAlanahAra para ImAna lAe|
mUsA tathA hArUna alaihimassalAma ke pAlanahAra para, kyoMki vahI upAsanA kA haqadAra hai| usake sivA anya tathAkathita pUjya upAsanA ke haqadAra nahIM haiM|

jaba ve eka allAha para ImAna le Ae, to firaauna ne unheM dhamakI dete hue kahA: merI anumati se pahale hI tumane mUsA ko saccA mAna liyA? nizcaya tumhArA mUsA para ImAna lAnA aura usake lAe hue dharma ko satya mAnanA eka dhokhA aura sAz2iza hai, jo tumane aura mUsA ne isa nagara ke nivAsiyoM ko yahA~ se nikAlane ke lie racI hai| to (ai jAdUgaro!) tumheM zIghra hI patA cala jAegA ki tumheM kaisI saz2A aura yAtanA kA sAmanA karanA par3atA hai|

maiM avazya tumameM se pratyeka vyakti kA dAhinA hAtha aura bAyA~ paira, yA usakA bAyA~ hAtha aura dAhinA paira kATa dU~gA| phira maiM tuma sabhI ko khajUra ke per3a ke tane para laTakA dU~gA| aisA tumheM bhayaMkara saz2A dene aura isa sthiti meM tumheM dekhane vAle sabhI logoM ko DarAne ke lie kiyA jAegA|
jAdUgaroM ne phiraauna kI dhamakI ke javAba meM kahA: nizcaya hama akele apane pAlanahAra hI kI ora lauTane vAle haiM| isalie hameM tumhArI dhamakI kI paravAha nahIM hai|

aura tumhAre nikaTa (ai phiraauna!) hamArA doSa kevala yaha hai ki hamane apane raba kI nizAniyoM ko satya mAna liyA, jaba ve mUsA alaihisallAma ke hAtha para hamAre pAsa AIM| yadi yaha koI doSa diyA jAne vAlA pApa hai, to yaha hamArA pApa hai| phira ve vinayapUrvaka apane raba se duA karane lage: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hamapara dhairya ur3ela de, tAki hama satya para aDiga raheM| tathA hameM isa hAla meM mauta de ki hama tere prati samarpita hoM, tere Adeza kA pAlana karane vAle tathA tere rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAle hoM|

firaauna kI jAti ke pramukhoM aura bar3e logoM ne, use mUsA tathA unake sAtha mominoM ke khilApha bhar3akAte hue kahA: kyA (ai firaauna!) tuma mUsA aura usakI jAti ko chor3e rakhoge ki ve deza meM bigAr3a phailAe~, tathA ve tumase aura tumhAre pUjyoM se kinArA kara leM aura (logoM ko) akele allAha kI ibAdata kI ora bulAe~?! firaauna ne kahA: hama banI isarAIla ke beToM ko mAra DAleMge, aura unakI striyoM ko sevA karane ke lie bAqI rakheMge| aura nizcaya hameM unapara z2ora, g2alabA aura prabhutva prApta hai|

mUsA alaihissalAma ne apanI jAti ke logoM ko vasIyata karate hue kahA: ai logoM! kevala eka allAha se sahAyatA mA~go ki vaha tumhArI musIbata dUra kara de tathA tumheM lAbha pahu~cAe, aura jisa Az2amAiza se tuma pIr3ita ho, usapara dhairya rakho| kyoMki yaha dharatI akele allAha kI hai| firaauna yA usake sivA kisI aura kI nahIM ki vaha usameM jo cAhe, karatA phire| allAha apanI icchA anusAra logoM ko bArI-bArI usameM avasara detA rahatA hai| lekina dharatI para acchA pariNAma kevala una ImAna vAloM ke lie hai, jo apane pAlanahAra ke AdezoM kA pAlana karate haiM aura usakI manA kI huI cIz2oM se bacate haiM| aMtataH yaha unhIM ke lie hai, yadyapi unheM kucha Az2amAizoM aura parIkSAoM se guz2aranA par3e|

mUsA alaihissalAma kI jAti banI isarAIla ne unase kahA: hama tumhAre Ane se pahale bhI firaauna ke hAthoM satAe gae| vaha hamAre putroM ko mAra detA aura hamArI striyoM ko jIvita rahane detA thA| aura tumhAre Ane ke pazcAt bhI satAe jA rahe haiM! mUsA alaihissalAma ne unheM samajhAte hue aura musIbata se chuTakAre kI khuzaqhabarI dete hue kahA: nikaTa hai ki tumhArA pAlanahAra tumhAre zatru phiraauna tathA usakI jAti ko vinaSTa kara de aura unake bAda dharatI meM tumhArA Adhipatya qAyama kara de, aura phira dekhe ki tuma usake bAda kyA karate ho, zukra yA nAzukrI?

hamane firaauna kI jAti ko sUkhe aura akAla se daMDita kiyA, tathA hamane unakA dharatI ke phaloM aura usakI paidAvAra kI kamI ke sAtha parIkSaNa kiyA| isa AzA meM ki ve sIkha aura upadeza grahaNa kareM ki unake sAtha yaha jo kucha ghaTita huA hai, vaha unake kufra kI saz2A ke taura para hai, isalie ve allAha ke sAmane taubA kara leM|

jaba firaauna kI jAti para urvaratA, acche phaloM aura saste dAmoM ke rUpa meM sukhada sthiti AtI, to ve kahate: hameM yaha isalie diyA gayA kyoMki hama isake haqadAra haiM aura yaha hamAre hI lie viziSTa hai| aura agara unapara akAla, sUkhe, bImAriyoM kI adhikatA tathA anya vipattiyoM ke rUpa meM koI musIbata AtI, to ve mUsA alaihissalAma aura unake sAtha maujUda banI isarAIla se apazakuna lete| jabaki saccAI yaha hai ki unheM isa taraha kI jo bhI cIz2a pahu~catI hai, vaha kevala allAha kI niyati (taqadIra) ke anusAra pahu~catI hai| isase unakA aura mUsA alaihissalAma kA koI lenA denA nahIM hai, sivAya mUsA alaihissalAma ke unapara bad-duA karane ke| lekina unameM se adhikatara loga nahIM jAnate, isalie ve ise allAha ke alAvA kisI aura se saMbaddha karate haiM|

firaauna kI jAti ne mUsA alaihissalAma se, satya se duzmanI ke kAraNa kahA: tuma hamAre pAsa jo nizAnI bhI le Ao, aura hameM hamAre dharma se pherane ke lie use g2alata sAbita karane aura apane dharma kI saccAI siddha karane ke lie jo bhI tarka aura pramANa le Ao, hama tumapara kabhI vizvAsa nahIM kareMge|

aMtataH hamane unake jhuThalAne aura haTha para saz2A ke rUpa meM unapara bahuta sArA pAnI bhejA, jisane unakI phasaloM aura phaloM ko Dubo diyA| aura hamane una para TiDDiyA~ bhejIM, jo unakI phasaleM khA gaIM| aura hamane unapara jue~ bhejIM, jo khetiyoM ko laga jAtI haiM yA inasAna ke bAla meM rahakara use kaSTa detI haiM, aura hamane una para meMDhaka bheje, jo unake bartanoM meM bhara gae, unake khAne-pIne kI cIz2oM ko kharAba kara die aura unakI nIMdeM ur3A dIM| aura hamane unapara rakta bhejA, jisase unake kue~ aura unakI nahareM raktamaya ho gaIM| hamane ye saba alaga-alaga aura spaSTa nizAniyA~ bhejIM, jo eka ke bAda eka AtI rahIM| paraMtu ye sArI saz2Ae~ Ane ke bAvajUda ve allAha para ImAna lAne aura mUsA alaihissalAma ke lAe hue saMdeza ko mAnane se abhimAna karate rahe| aura ve aise loga the jo pApa kiyA karate the, ve na asatya se dUra rahate the aura na satya kI rAha pakar3ate the|

aura jaba unapara ye sArI yAtanAe~ A par3IM, to ve mUsA alaihissalAma ke pAsa pahu~ce aura kahane lage: ai mUsA! tuma apane pAlanahAra se, usa nubuvvata ke havAle se jo usane tumheM pradAna kI hai aura usake havAle se jo usane taubA ke dvArA yAtanA dUra karane kA tumaheM vacana diyA hai, hamAre lie duA karo ki hamAre Upara AI huI yAtanA ko hamase dUra kara de| agara tumane hamase yaha yAtanA dUra kara dI, to avazya hI hama tumapara ImAna le Ae~ge aura banI isarAIla ko Az2Ada karake tumhAre sAtha bheja deMge|

phira jaba hama unheM sAgara meM Dubokara vinaSTa karane se pahale, eka nizcita avadhi ke lie unase yAtanA ko dUra kara dete, to acAnaka ve mUsA alaihissalAma para ImAna lAne aura banI isarAIla ko bhejane kA apanA kiyA huA vAdA tor3a deta| cunA~ce ve apane kufra hI para qAyama rahate aura banI isarAIla ko mUsA alaihissalAma ke sAtha bhejane se mukara jAte|

phira jaba unake vinAza kA nizcita samaya A gayA, to hamane unheM samudra meM Dubokara unapara apanI saz2A utAra dI, kyoMki unhoMne allAha kI nizAniyoM ko jhuThalAyA aura unase iMgati hone vAle usa satya se upekSA kiyA thA, jisameM koI saMdeha nahIM|

hamane banI isarAIla ko, jinheM phiraauna aura usakI jAti ke loga kamaz2ora samajha rahe the, dharatI ke pUrva aura pazcima ke bhUbhAgoM kA vArisa banA diyA| isa dharatI se abhiprAya zAma ke deza (levaMta) haiM, ye ve deza haiM jinameM allAha ne unakI phasaloM aura phaloM ko pUrI taraha se paidA karake barakata rakhI hai| aura isa prakAra (ai nabI!) Apake pAlanahAra kI sarvazreSTha bAta pUrI ho gaI| vaha bAta allAha sarvazaktimAna ke isa kathana meM ullikhita hai: {وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةً وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ الْوَارِثِينَ} (القصص: ٥) ''hama cAhate haiM ki una logoM para upakAra kareM, jo dharatI meM kamaz2ora samajha lie gae the aura unheM 'imAma' banA deM aura unheM vArisa banA deM|'' (sUratula-qasasa: 5)| ataH allAha ne unheM firaauna aura usakI jAti kI ora se pahu~cane vAle kaSTa para dhairya ke kAraNa dharatI meM prabhutva pradAna kara diyA| tathA hamane firaauna ke banAe hue khetoM tathA gharoM aura unake dvArA nirmita mahaloM ko dhvasta kara diyA|

aura hamane banI isarAIla ko samudra pAra karA diyA, jaba mUsA ne usameM apanI lAThI mArI aura vaha phaTa gayA| cunA~ce use pAra karane ke bAda ve aisI jAti ke pAsa se guz2are, jo apanI kucha mUrtiyoM kI pUjA meM lagI huI thI, jinheM vaha allAha ko chor3akara pUjatI thI| use dekhakara banI isarAIla ne mUsA alaihissalAma se kahA: ai mUsA! hamAre lie eka aisI mUrti banA dIjie jisakI hama pUja kareM, jaise ki ina logoM ke pAsa kucha mUrtiyoM haiM, jinakI ve allAha ke sivA pUjA karate haiM| to mUsA alaihissalAma ne unase kahA: ai merI jAti ke logo! nizcaya tuma aise loga ho jo isa bAta se anabhijJa ho ki allAha ke lie kyA sammAna aura ekezvaravAda anivArya hai, aura usake lie kyA cIz2a azobhanIya hai jaise ki zirka aura usake alAvA kI pUjA|

ye loga jo apanI mUrtiyoM kI pUjA meM lage hue haiM, ve allAha ke alAvA kI pUjA ke jisa kAma meM lage hue haiM, vaha naSTa kiyA jAne vAlA hai aura ve jo kucha nekI ke kArya karate cale A rahe haiM, vaha vyartha (amAnya) hai, kyoMki unhoMne ibAdata meM allAha ke sAtha dUsaroM ko sAjhI banAyA hai|

mUsA alaihissalAma ne apanI jAti se kahA: maiM tumhAre lie bhalA allAha ke sivA koI pUjya kaise talAza karU~, jisakI tuma ibAdata karo, jabaki tumane allAha kI bar3I-bar3I nizAniyA~ dekhI haiM, aura allAha ne tumhAre duzmanoM ko vinaSTa karake aura tumheM dharatI kA uttarAdhikArI banAkara aura usameM tumheM prabhutva pradAna karake, tumheM tumhAre samaya ke sAre saMsAra vAsiyoM para zreSThatA pradAna kI hai?!

tathA (ai banI isarAIla!) vaha samaya yAda karo, jaba hamane tumheM firaauna aura usakI jAti ke apamAnajanaka vyavahAra se bacAkara tumheM mukti dilAI, kyoMki ve tumheM taraha-taraha se satAte the; tumhAre putroM ko burI taraha qatla kara dete the aura tumhArI striyoM ko apanI sevA ke lie jIvita rahane dete the| tathA tumheM firaauna aura usakI jAti ke caMgula se mukta karane kI isa ghaTanA meM tumhAre pAlanahAra kI ora se bahuta bar3I parIkSA hai, jisake lie tumheM AbhAra prakaTa karane kI AvazyakatA hai|

jaba mUsA alaihissalAma apane pAlanahAra se bAta karane ke lie usake lie nirdhArita samaya para arthAt cAlIsa rAteM pUrI hone ke bAda Ae, aura unake pAlanahAra ne unase AdezoM, niSedhoM aura anya cIjoM ke bAre meM bAta kI, to mUsA alaihissalAma ke mana meM apane pAlanahAra ko dekhane kI lAlasA paidA huI aura usase apanA darzana karAne kA anurodha kara diyA| to allAha ne use javAba diyA: tuma duniyA ke jIvana meM mujhe kadApi nahIM dekhoge| kyoMki tumhAre pAsa isakI kSamatA nahIM hai| lekina pahAr3a ko dekho, jaba maiM khuda ko usake sAmane prakaTa karU~| agara vaha apane sthAna para sthira rahA, prabhAvita nahIM huA, to tuma mujhe dekha loge| aura agara vaha dharatI ke sAtha samatala ho gayA, to tuma mujhe isa saMsAra meM haragiz2a nahIM dekha sakoge| cunA~ce jaba allAha ne svayaM ko pahAr3a para prakaTa kiyA, to use dharatI ke sAtha samatala kara diyA, aura mUsA alaihissalAma behoza hokara gira par3e| phira jaba hoza meM Ae to kahane lage: (ai mere pAlanahAra!) maiM tujhe una sabhI cIz2oM se pavitra mAnatA hU~, jo tere lie zobhanIya nahIM haiM| dekha, maiM duniyA meM tere darzana kI mA~ga karane kI bhUla se taubA karatA hU~ aura maiM apanI jAti kA prathama momina vyakti hU~|

allAha ne kahA: ai mUsA! maiMne tumheM cuna liyA aura apane saMdezoM ke sAtha logoM para tumheM zreSThatA pradAna kI jaba maiMne tumheM unake pAsa bhejA, aura maiMne tumheM binA kisI madhyastha ke apanI vArtA kA saubhAgya pradAna kiyA| ataH hamAre die hue isa udAra sammAna ko le lo aura isa mahAna pradAna para allAha kA zukriyA adA karane vAloM meM se ho jAo|

hamane mUsA ke lie lakar3I athavA anya kisI vastu se banI taqhtiyoM meM, hara vaha cIz2a likha dI, jisakI banI isarAIla ko unake dharma aura duniyA ke mAmaloM meM z2arUrata thI, tAki unameM se upadeza grahaNa karane vAloM ke lie upadeza aura una niyamoM kA vivaraNa ho jAe, jinake vivaraNa kI AvazyakatA ho| aba (ai mUsA!) isa taurAta ko pUrI zakti se thAma lo, aura apanI jAti banI isarAIla ko Adeza do ki ve isakI uttama cIz2oM ko pakar3a leM, jinakA badalA bahuta bar3A hai, jaise AdezoM kA saMpUrNa tarIke se pAlana karanA, aura jaise ki dhairya rakhanA aura mAfa karanA| maiM zIghra hI tumheM una logoM kA pariNAma dikhAU~gA, jinhoMne mere Adeza kA ullaMghana kiyA aura merI AjJAkAritA se nikala gae, tathA unheM kisa taraha ke vinAza aura tabAhI kA sAmanA karanA par3egA|

maiM saMsAra evaM inasAna ke aMdara maujUda apanI nizAniyoM se sIkha grahaNa karane aura merI kitAba kI AyatoM ko samajhane se una logoM ko vicalita kara dU~gA, jo allAha ke baMdoM para aura satya para nAhaqa abhimAna karate haiM| aura jinakA hAla yaha hai ki yadi ve hara prakAra kI nizAniyA~ dekhate haiM, to bhI unheM nahIM mAnate haiM; kyoMki ve unapara Apatti karate aura unase mu~ha pherate haiM, tathA isalie bhI ki ve allAha aura usake rasUla kA virodha karate haiM| aura yadi ve satya kA mArga dekhate haiM, jo allAha kI prasannatA kI ora le jAtA hai, to ve usakA pAlana nahIM karate haiM aura na usameM koI dilacaspI rakhate haiM| aura agara ve allAha ke krodha kI ora le jAne vAle gumarAhI ke rAste ko dekhate haiM, to usakA anusaraNa karate haiM| yaha musIbata jo unapara AI, kevala isa kAraNa AI ki unhoMne rasUloM ke lAe hue saMdeza kI saccAI ko darzAne vAlI allAha kI mahAna nizAniyoM ko jhuThalAyA, aura isalie ki unhoMne unapara soca-vicAra karane se upekSA kI|

jaba mUsA alaihissalAma apane pAlanahAra se bAta karane ke lie gae, to unakI jAti ke logoM ne apane gahanoM se bachar3e kI eka mUrti banA lI, jisameM koI AtmA nahIM thI, jabaki usakI eka AvAz2a thI| kyA unheM patA nahIM ki yaha bachar3A na to unase bAta karatA hai, na kisI pratyakSa yA apratyakSa bhalAI kA mArga dikhAtA hai aura na unheM koI lAbha pahu~cAtA hai yA unase koI hAni dUra karatA hai?! unhoMne use pUjya banA liyA tathA aisA karake ve apane Upara atyAcAra karane vAle the|

aura jaba ve (apane kie para) lajjita aura cakita hue tathA samajha gae ki ve allAha ke sAtha bachar3e ko pUjya banAne ke kAraNa sahI mArga se bhaTaka gae haiM, to allAha se vinayapUrvaka prArthanA karate hue kahane lage: yadi hamAre pAlanahAra ne apane AjJApAlana kI taufIqa dekara hamapara dayA nahIM kI, aura hamane bachar3e kI pUjA karake jo pApa kiyA hai, use kSamA nahIM kiyA, to hama nizcita rUpa se una logoM meM se ho jAe~ge jinhoMne apanI duniyA aura Aqhirata donoM kA ghATA kiyA|

mUsA ne apane pAlanahAra se prArthanA karate hue kahA: ai mere pAlanahAra! mujhe tathA mere bhAI hArUna ko kSamA kara de aura hameM apanI dayA meM dAkhila kara de aura use isa taraha kara de ki hara tarafa se hameM ghere hue ho| aura tU (ai hamAre pAlanahAra!) hamapara hara dayA karane vAle se adhika dayA karane vAlA hai|

jina logoM ne bachar3e ko pUjya banAkara usakI pUjA zurU kara dI, ve apane pAlanahAra ko kruddha karane aura isake dvArA usakA apamAna karane ke kAraNa, zIghra hI apane pAlanahAra kI ora se saqhta krodha aura isa sAMsArika jIvana meM apamAna se pIr3ita hoMge| aura hama allAha para jhUTha gar3hane vAloM ko isI taraha kA badalA dete haiM|

jina logoM ne bure karma kie, jaise allAha ke sAtha zirka aura pApa karanA Adi, phira allAha kI ora lauTa Ae, arthAt usapara ImAna le Ae aura jo pApa kiyA karate the usase ruka gae, to (ai nabI!) nizcaya ApakA pAlanahAra isa taubA aura zirka se ImAna kI ora tathA pApoM se AjJAkAritA kI ora vApasI ke bAda avazya unake gunAhoM ko mAfa karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

phira jaba mUsA alaihissalAma kA krodha zAMta ho gayA, to usane una taqhtiyoM ko uThA liyA, jinheM usane krodha meM Akara pheMka diyA thA| ye taqhtiyA~ pathabhraSTatA se mArgadarzana aura satya ke bayAna para AdhArita thIM, tathA una logoM ke lie dayA para AdhArita thIM, jo apane pAlanahAra kA bhaya rakhate aura usakI yAtanA se Darate haiM|

aura mUsA alaihissalAma ne apanI jAti ke sattara neka logoM ko cuna liyA, tAki ve apane pAlanahAra se usa gunAha kI kSamA mA~geM, jo unake mUrkhoM ne bachar3e kI pUjA kI hai| aura allAha ne unase eka nirdhArita samaya kA vAdA kiyA jisameM ve upasthita hoM| lekina jaba ve upasthita hue, to allAha para dussAhasa kara baiThe aura mUsA alaihissalAma se mutAlabA kiyA ki unheM A~khoM se (khullama-khullA) allAha kA darzana karAe~| isapara unheM bhUkaMpa ne apanI capeTa meM le liyA aura ve usakI bhayAvahatA se behoza hokara mara gae| aise meM mUsA ne apane pAlanahAra se vinayapUrvaka vinatI karate hue kahA: ai mere pAlanahAra! agara tU unheM tathA unake sAtha mujhe unake yahA~ Ane se pahale hI vinaSTa karanA cAhatA, to vinaSTa kara detA| kyA tU hameM usake kAraNa vinaSTa karatA hai jo hamameM se alpa buddhi vAle logoM ne kiyA hai? daraasala merI jAti ke logoM kA bachar3e kI pUjA meM laganA eka Az2amAiza aura parIkSA hai, jisake dvArA tU jise cAhatA hai, mArga se haTA detA hai aura jise cAhatA hai, sIdhe rAste para lagA detA hai| tU hI hamAre mAmale kA saMrakSaka hai| ataH hamAre gunAhoM ko kSamA kara de, aura apanI vyApaka dayA ke sAtha hama para dayA kara| tU hI sabase behatara pApa ko kSamA karane vAlA aura gunAha ko mAfa karane vAlA hai|

jo loga muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kA anusaraNa karate haiM, jo ki ummI nabI haiM, par3hanA evaM likhanA nahI jAnate, balki unapara unake pAlanahAra kI ora se vaha़ya kI jAtI hai, aura vaha vahI haiM jinake nAma, vivaraNa aura nubuvvata kA ullekha ve mUsA alaihissalAma para utarane vAlI taurAta tathA IsA alaihissalAma para utarane vAlI iMjIla meM pAte haiM; jo unheM una bAtoM kA Adeza dete haiM jinakA acchA aura bhalA honA sarvajJAta hai, aura unheM una bAtoM se rokate haiM, jinake bure hone kI puSTi zuddha buddhi aura sahI prakRti bhI karatI hai, aura unake lie khAne-pIne aura auratoM se saMbaMdhita una AnaMdadAyaka cIjoM ko vaidha ThaharAte haiM, jinameM koI nuqasAna nahIM hai aura unapara unameM se una cIz2oM ko niSiddha ThaharAte haiM, jo gaMdI aura apavitra haiM, aura unase una kaSTadAyaka AdezoM kA bojha haTAte haiM, jo unapara DAle jAte the, jaise hatyAre kI hatyA kara denA, hatyA cAhe jAna-bUjhakara ho yA g2alatI se| ataH jo banI isarAIla tathA anya loga unapara ImAna lAe, unakA Adara evaM sammAna kiyA, aura unase duzmanI rakhane vAle kAfiroM ke viruddha unakI madada kI, aura usa quraAna kA anusaraNa kiyA, jo unapara mArgadarzaka prakAza ke rUpa meM utArA gayA hai; to vahI loga saphala hone vAle haiM, jo apanI apekSita cIz2oM ko prApta kareMge aura apane bhaya kI cIz2oM se mukti pAe~ge|

(ai rasUla!) aura hamane banI isarAIla ko bAraha gotroM meM bA~Ta diyA, aura hamane mUsA kI ora vaha़ya bhejI, jaba unakI jAti ne unase allAha se yaha duA karane ke lie kahA ki vaha unheM pAnI pilAe: (ai mUsA!) apanI lAThI ko isa patthara para mAro| cunA~ce mUsA ne usapara lAThI mArI, to usameM se unake bAraha qabIloM kI saMkhyA ke anusAra bAraha srota phUTa nikale| unameM se pratyeka qabIle ne apane pAnI pIne kA vizeSa sthAna jAna liyA| isalie koI bhI anya qabIlA usake sAtha usameM sAjhI nahIM hotA thA| aura hamane unapara bAdaloM kI chAyA kara dI, jo unake calane ke sAtha calate the aura unake rukane se ruka jAte the| aura unapara zahada kI taraha eka mIThA peya tathA baTera ke samAna svAdiSTa mA~sa vAlA eka choTA pakSI utArA| aura hamane unase kahA: ina pavitra cIz2oM meM se, jo hamane tumheM pradAna kI haiM, khAo| aura unhoMne atyAcAra aura nematoM kI nAzukrI karake aura yathocita unakA Adara na karake hamArA kucha bhI ghATA nahIM kiyA| paraMtu ve svayaM apane hitoM kA ghATA karake apane Apa hI para atyAcAra karate the, jaba unhoMne allAha ke Adeza kA ullaMghana karake aura usakI nematoM kI avamAnanA karake apane Apako vinAza ke ghATa lagA diyA|

jise allAha satya kI ora hidAyata se viphala kara de aura use sIdhe rAste se bhaTakA de, to usake lie koI mArgadarzaka nahIM hai, jo usakI ora usakA mArgadarzana kara sake|aura allAha unheM unakI gumarAhI aura kufra meM chor3a detA hai ki ve bhaTakate phirate haiM, unheM koI rAstA sujhAI nahIM detA|

(ai nabI!) ye haThI jhuThalAne vAle Apase qiyAmata ke bAre meM pUchate haiM ki vaha kisa samaya ghaTita hogI aura usakA saTIka jJAna kaba hogA? Apa kaha deM ki usakA jJAna na to mere pAsa hai aura na mere alAvA kisI aura ke pAsa hai| usakI jAnakArI kevala allAha ke pAsa hai| use usake nirdhArita samaya para kevala allAha hI prakaTa karegA| usake prakaTa hone kA mAmalA AkAza vAloM tathA dharatI vAloM se chipA hai| vaha tumhAre pAsa acAnaka hI AegI| ve Apase qiyAmata ke bAre meM aise pUcha rahe haiM, jaise ki Apa usake bAre meM jAnane ke lie utsuka haiM| hAlA~ki unheM yaha patA hI nahIM ki Apa apane raba se pUrI taraha avagata hone ke kAraNa usase qiyAmata ke bAre meM nahIM pUchate haiM| (ai muhammada!) unase kaha deM ki qiyAmata kI jAnakArI kevala allAha hI ke pAsa hai, lekina adhikatara loga isa bAta se avagata nahIM haiM|

(ai muhammada!) Apa kaha deM: maiM na apane lie koI bhalAI prApta kara sakatA hU~ aura na apane Apase koI burAI dUra kara sakatA hU~, sivAya isake ki allAha cAhe| yaha kAma kevala allAha kA hai| maiM kevala vahI jAnatA hU~, jo allAha ne mujhe sikhAyA hai| cunA~ce maiM g2aiba kI bAta nahIM jAnatA| agara maiM g2aiba kI bAta jAnatA hotA, to cIz2oM ko unake hone se pahale jAnane aura unake pariNAma se avagata hone kI vajaha se avazya una kAraNoM ko apanAyA hotA, jinheM maiM jAnatA hU~ ki ve mere hitoM kI pUrti karate aura mujhase burAiyoM ko dUra karate haiM| maiM to kevala allAha kI ora se bhejA huA eka rasUla hU~| usakI dukhadAyI yAtanA se DarAtA hU~ aura una logoM ko usake udAra pratiphala kI zubha sUcanA detA hU~, jo isa bAta para vizvAsa rakhate haiM ki maiM allAha kA rasUla hU~ aura maiM jo kucha lekara AyA hU~, use saccA mAnate haiM|

vahI allAha hai, jisane tumheM (ai puruSo aura mahilAo!) eka hI jAna arthAt Adama alaihissalAma se paidA kiyA aura Adama alaihissalAma se unakI patnI ha़vvA ko paidA kiyA| ha़vvA ko Adama alaihissalAma kI pasalI se paidA kiyA, tAki Adama alaihissalAma unase sukUna hAsila kareM aura saMtuSTa raheM| phira jaba eka pati ne apanI patnI ke sAtha saMbhoga kiyA, to use halkA sA garbha Thahara gayA, jise vaha mahasUsa nahIM karatI thI| kyoMki vaha apanI zuruAta meM thA| vaha apanI isa garbhAvasthA para rahate hue apanI z2arUrata ke kAma-kAja karatI rahI, use koI bojha mahasUsa nahIM hotA thA| phira usake peTa meM garbha ke bar3A hone para, use bhArIpana mahasUsa huA, to pati-patnI ne milakara allAha se duA karate hue kahA: (ai hamAre pAlanahAra!) agara tUne hameM eka svastha baccA pradAna kiyA, to hama terI nematoM kA zukriyA adA karane vAloM meM se hoMge|

jaba allAha ne una donoM kI prArthanA svIkAra karake unheM eka svastha baccA pradAna kara diyA, to unhoMne allAha kI dI huI saMtAna meM usake sAjhIdAra banA lie| cunA~ce unhoMne apane beTe ko allAha ke alAvA anya kA baMdA banA diyA aura usakA nAma abdula ha़Arisa (hArisa kA baMdA) rakha diyA| to allAha hara sAjhI va zarIka se bahuta U~cA hai| kyoMki vaha pAlanahAra aura pUjya hone meM akelA hai|

kyA ve ina mUrtiyoM aura inake sivA anya cIz2oM ko ibAdata meM allAha kA sAjhI banAte haiM, jabaki ve jAnate haiM ki ye mUrtiyA~ kucha paidA nahIM karatIM, ki pUjA kI haqadAra hoM| balki, ve svayaM paidA kI gaI haiM| to phira ve inheM kaise allAha kA sAjhI ThaharAte haiM?
ye pUjya na apane pUjakoM kI sahAyatA kara sakate haiM aura na khuda apanI sahAyatA kara sakate haiM, to phira ve inakI ibAdata kaise karate haiM?!

aura agara tuma (ai muzriko!) ina mUrtiyoM ko, jinheM tuma allAha ko chor3akara pUjya banAte ho, hidAyata kI ora bulAo, to ve tumheM usakA javAba nahIM deMgI jinakI ora tumane unheM bulAyA hai aura na hI ve tumhArA anusaraNa kareMgI| ataH unake nikaTa tumhArA unheM pukAranA yA tumhArA cupa rahanA donoM barAbara hai| kyoMki ve mAtra nirjIva vastueM haiM; jo na samajhatI haiM, na sunatI haiM aura na bolatI haiM|

niHsaMdeha jina logoM kI tuma (ai muzriko!) allAha ke sivA ibAdata karate ho, ve allAha hI ke paidA kie hue haiM aura unakA mAlika bhI vahI hai| isa taraha ve isa bAre meM tumhAre hI jaise haiM| balki tuma unase uttama sthiti meM ho| kyoMki tuma z2iMdA ho, bolate ho, calate-phirate ho, sunate ho aura dekhate ho| jabaki tumhArI mUrtiyoM ke pAsa ye zaktiyA~ nahIM haiM| ataH tuma unako pukAro aura ve tumhArI pukAra kA javAba deM, yadi tuma unake bAre meM apane dAve meM sacce ho|

kyA ina mUrtiyoM ke, jinheM tumane pUjya banA rakhA hai, pA~va haiM, jinase ve calatI haiM, ki tumhArI z2arUrateM pUrI kareM? yA unake hAtha haiM, jinase ve tumhArA pUrI zakti se bacAva kareM? yA unakI A~kheM haiM, jinase ve una cIz2oM ko dekhatI haiM, jinheM tuma nahIM dekha sakate ki tumheM unase avagata karA sakeM? yA unake kAna haiM, jinase ve una bAtoM ko suna letI haiM, jinheM tuma nahIM suna sakate, to ve tumheM unase sUcita kara detI haiM? agara ve ina sArI cIz2oM se khAlI haiM, to phira tuma unheM lAbha prApta karane yA hAni se bacane kI AzA meM kaise pUjate ho?! (ai rasUla!) Apa ina muzrikoM se kaha deM: una logoM ko pukAro, jinheM tumane allAha ke barAbara banA rakhA hai, phira tuma mujhe nuqasAna pahu~cAne kA upAya karo aura mujhe koI mohalata na do|

vAstava meM, merA madadagAra aura sahAyaka allAha hai, jo merA saMrakSaNa karatA hai| ataH maiM usake alAvA kisI aura se AzA nahIM rakhatA, aura mujhe tumhArI mUrtiyoM se kucha bhI Dara nahIM hai| kyoMki vahI (allAha) hai jisane mujhapara quraAna ko logoM ke mArgadarzana ke lie utArA hai aura vahI apane satkarmI baMdoM ke sAre kAma saMbhAlatA hai| cunA~ce unakA saMrakSaNa karatA aura unakI sahAyatA karatA hai|

aura ina mUrtiyoM meM se jinheM (ai muzriko!) tuma pukArate ho, ve na tumhArI sahAyatA karane meM sakSama haiM, aura na hI ve svayaM kA samarthana karane meM sakSama haiM| kyoMki ve asahAya haiM| to phira tuma allAha ko chor3akara unheM kaise pukArate ho?!

aura (ai muzriko!) yadi tuma apanI mUrtiyoM ko, jinheM tuma allAha ke sivA pUjate ho, sIdhI rAha kI ora bulAo, to ve tumhAre bulAve ko nahIM suneMgI| aura tuma unheM dekhoge ki ve tumhArI ora tumhArI hI banAI huI A~khoM se dekha rahI haiM, hAlA~ki ve nirjIva cIz2eM haiM, jo nahIM dekhatI haiM| daraasala muzrika loga manuSyoM yA jAnavaroM ke rUpa meM mUrtiyA~ banAte the, jinake hAtha, paira aura A~kheM hotI thIM| lekina ve bejAna hotI thIM, na unake aMdara jIvana hotA thA na harakata|

(ai rasUla!) Apa logoM ke una kAryoM aura vyavahAroM ko svIkAra kareM, jo ve khuzI mana se kareM aura jo unake lie AsAna hoM| unapara aise kArya aura vyavahAra kA bojha na DAleM jinakI unake svabhAva anumati nahIM dete haiM| kyoMki yaha unheM Apase dUra karane kA kAraNa banegA| aura Apa hara suMdara bAta tathA acche kArya kA Adeza deM aura ajJAnI logoM se upekSA kareM| isalie unakI ajJAnatA kA javAba ajJAnatA se na deM| cunA~ce jo Apako kaSTa de, Apa use kaSTa na deM aura jo Apako vaMcita kare, Apa use vaMcita na kareM|

aura yadi (ai rasUla!) Apa mahasUsa kareM ki zaitAna Apake dila meM koI g2alata qhayAla DAla rahA hai yA Apako satkarma se rokane kA prayAsa karatA hai, to allAha kA zaraNa leM aura use maz2abUtI se pakar3a leM| kyoMki vaha ApakI bAta ko sunane vAlA aura Apake zaraNa lene ko jAnane vAlA hai| ataH vaha zaitAna se ApakI rakSA karegA|

vAstava meM, jo loga allAha se, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usakI manA kI huI bAtoM se dUra rahakara, Darate haiM, jaba ve zaitAna kI ora se kisI bure qhayAla se pIr3ita hokara gunAha kara baiThate haiM; to ve allAha kI mahAnatA, avajJAkAriyoM ke lie usakI saz2A aura AjJAkAriyoM ke lie usake pratiphala ko yAda karate haiM| isalie ve apane gunAhoM se taubA karake apane pAlanahAra kI ora lauTa jAte haiM| phira kyA dekhate haiM ki ve satya mArga para jama gae, g2afalata se jAga gae aura gunAha se bAz2a A gae|

durAcAriyoM aura kAfiroM jaise zaitAna ke bhAiyoM ko, zaitAna eka ke bAda eka pApa meM lipta karake unheM gumarAhI meM bar3hAte jAte haiM| ve rukane kA nAma hI nahIM lete, na zaitAna bahakAne aura gumarAha karane se aura na hI durAcArI loga unakI bAta mAnane aura burAI karane se|

jaba (ai rasUla!) Apa koI Ayata (nizAnI) lAe~, to ve Apako jhuThalA dete haiM aura usase mu~ha phera lete haiM| aura agara Apa unake pAsa koI Ayata na lAe~, to ve kahate haiM: Apane apanI ora se koI Ayata kyoM na gar3ha lI? Apa (ai rasUla!) aise logoM se kaha deM: mujhe yaha adhikAra nahIM ki maiM apanI ora se koI Ayata le AU~| maiM to kevala usI kA anusaraNa karatA hU~, jo allAha merI ora vaha़ya (prakAzanA) karatA hai| yaha quraAna jo maiM tumhAre sAmane par3hatA hU~, allAha kI ora se, jo tumhArA racayitA aura tumhAre saba kAma saMbhAlane vAlA hai, pramANa aura dalIla hai, tathA usake momina baMdoM ke lie mArgadarzana aura dayA hai| rahI bAta g2aira mominoM kI, to ve gumarAha aura durbhAgya vAle loga haiM|
aura jaba quraAna par3hA jAe, to usakI tilAvata ko dhyAnapUrvaka suno tathA na bAta karo aura na kisI anya kAma meM vyasta ho, ummIda hai allAha tumapara dayA kare|

aura (ai nabI!) allAha ko, jo ApakA pAlanahAra hai, vinayapUrvaka aura Darate hue yAda kareM, aura duA ke samaya apanI AvAz2a madhyama rakheM, na bahuta U~cI, na bahuta nIcI, dina ke prathama aura usake aMtima bhAga meM| kyoMki ina donoM samaya kI bar3I faz2Ilata hai| aura Apa una logoM meM se na hoM, jo allAha kI yAda se g2Afila rahate haiM|

niHsaMdeha jo farizte (ai rasUla!) Apake pAlanahAra ke pAsa haiM, ve usakI ibAdata (vaMdanA) se abhimAna nahIM karate, balki usake AjJApAlana meM samarpita rahate haiM, usase thakate nahIM haiM| tathA ve dina-rAta allAha ko una bAtoM se pavitra ThaharAte rahate haiM, jo usake lAyaqa nahIM haiM aura kevala usI ke Age sajadA karate haiM|

(ai rasUla!) Apake sAthI Apase g2anImatoM (yuddha meM prApta hone vAle dhana) ke viSaya meM pUchate haiM ki unheM kaise vibhAjita kiyA jAegA? aura kina logoM meM vitaraNa kiyA jAegA? (ai rasUla!) unake prazna kA uttara dete hue kaha deM: g2anImateM (yuddha meM prApta dhana) allAha aura usake rasUla ke lie haiM aura unheM kharca karane aura bA~Tane ke viSaya meM nirNaya kA adhikAra allAha aura usake rasUla kA hai| tumhArA kAma kevala mAna lenA aura AjJApAlana karanA hai| ataH (ai momino!) tuma allAha se, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usakI manA kI huI bAtoM se dUra rahakara, Daro| tathA tumhAre bIca jo saMbaMdha-viccheda aura viyoga hai, use ApasI prema, paraspara saMparka (saMyoga), acche ziSTAcAra aura kSamA ke dvArA sudhAra lo| aura agara tuma saca meM ImAna vAle ho, to allAha aura usake rasUla kI AjJA kA pAlana karo| kyoMki ImAna AjJApAlana karane aura gunAhoM se dUra rahane kI preraNA detA hai| yaha prazna badra ke yuddha ke bAda kiyA gayA thA|

vAstava meM, ImAna vAle vahI loga haiM ki jaba allAha kA varNana kiyA jAe, to unake dila kA~pa uThate haiM, aura unake dila aura zarIra AjJApAlana kI ora AkarSita ho jAte haiM, aura jaba unake sAmane allAha kI AyateM par3hI jAtI haiM, to unapara ciMtana karate haiM, jisake phalasvarUpa unakA ImAna bar3ha jAtA hai, tathA ve apane hitoM ko prApta karane aura apanI burAiyoM ko dUra karane meM kevala apane pAlanahAra hI para bharosA karate haiM|
jo loga samaya para pUrNa rUpa se namAz2a adA karate haiM aura hamAre die hue dhana se una jagahoM meM kharca karate haiM, jahA~ kharca karanA vAjiba yA mustahaba hai|

inhIM vizeSatAoM ke mAlika loga sacce ImAna vAle haiM; kyoMki unake aMdara ImAna aura islAma kI z2AhirI vizeSatAe~ maujUda haiM| aura unakA badalA unake pAlanahAra ke pAsa U~ce-U~ce ghara, unake gunAhoM kI kSamA aura sammAnita (uttama) jIvikA hai| ye vahI nemateM haiM, jo allAha ne unake lie taiyAra kara rakhI haiM|

jisa prakAra allAha pAka ne, yuddha meM prApta dhana ko vibhAjita karane kA mAmalA, usake vibhAjana ke bAre meM tumhArI asahamati aura vivAda ke bAda, tumhAre hAtha se le liyA aura use allAha evaM usake rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke adhikAra meM de diyA, usI taraha Apake pAlanahAra ne (ai rasUla!) Apapara vaha़ya utArakara, bahudevavAdiyoM se yuddha karane ke lie Apako madInA se nikalane kA Adeza diyA hai, hAlA~ki mominoM ke eka giroha ko yaha pasaMda nahIM thA|

(ai rasUla!) mominoM kA yaha samUha bahudevavAdiyoM se yuddha karane ke bAre meM Apake sAtha bahasa kara rahA thA, jabaki unake lie yaha spaSTa ho cukA thA ki yuddha honI hI hai| aisA mAlUma ho rahA thA ki ve mauta kI ora hA~ke jA rahe haiM aura ve use apanI A~khoM se dekha rahe haiM| aisA isalie thA ki unheM yuddha ke lie nikalanA saqhta nApasaMda thA; kyoMki unhoMne usake lie koI taiyArI nahIM kI thI|

aura ai (jhagar3ane vAle momino!) usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba allAha tumheM vacana de rahA thA ki tumheM bahudevavAdiyoM ke do girohoM meM se eka para vijaya z2arUra prApta hogI| yaha giroha yA to kAfilA kI zakla meM hogA, jisapara qabz2A karake tuma usake sAtha maujUda dhana ko g2anImata ke dhana ke taura para prApta kara loge, yA makkA se Ae hue jatthe kI zakla meM hogA, jisase lar3AI karake usapara vijaya prApta karoge| aura tuma cAhate the ki tumhArA sAmanA qAfile hI se ho, kyoMki use binA kisI lar3AI ke apane niyaMtraNa meM karanA AsAna thA| aura allAha cAhatA thA ki tumheM lar3ane kA Adeza dekara satya ko satya kara dikhAe; tAki tuma bahudevavAdiyoM ke saradAroM ko qatla karo, aura unameM se bahutoM ko baMdI banA lo, aura isa taraha islAma kI zakti kA pradarzana ho|

tAki allAha islAma aura musalamAnoM ko vijaya pradAna karake satya ko satya kara dikhAe, isa prakAra ki usakI satyatA ke sabUta pradarzita kara de| tathA asatya ke asatya hone ke pramANa sAmane lAkara usakI asatyatA ko sAbita kara de| yadyapi kAfiroM ko yaha burA lage, lekina allAha ise prakaTa hI karane vAlA thA|

badra ke dina ko yAda karo, jaba tumane allAha se apane duzmana ke viruddha sahAyatA mA~gI, to allAha ne tumhArI duA qabUla kara lI ki vaha eka haz2Ara fariztoM ke dvArA (ai momino!) tumhArI madada karane vAlA hai, jo eka-dUsare ke pIche Ae~ge|

allAha ne fariztoM ke dvArA sahAyatA ko tumhAre lie (ai momino!) kevala isa bAta kI zubha sUcanA banAyA hai ki vaha tumhAre duzmanoM ke viruddha tumhArI madada karane vAlA hai, aura tAki madada ke yaqIna ke sAtha tumhAre diloM ko saMtoSa prApta ho jAe| aura (daraasala) vijaya saMkhyAoM kI adhikatA aura upakaraNoM kI pracuratA ke AdhAra para prApta nahIM hotI, balki vijaya allAha kI ora se milatI hai| niHsaMdeha allAha apane rAjya meM prabhutvazAlI hai, usapara kisI kA z2ora nahIM calatA| apane vidhAna aura nirNaya (niyati) meM hikamata vAlA hai|

(ai momino!) usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba allAha tumheM apane duzmana se hone vAle bhaya ko dUra karane ke lie tumapara U~gha DAla rahA thA, tathA tumapara AkAza se jala barasA rahA thA; tAki tumheM malinatA se pavitra kara de, aura tAki tumase zaitAna ke bure qhayAloM ko dUra kara de, aura tAki usake dvArA tumhAre diloM ko sudRr3ha kara de, tAki muThabher3a ke samaya tumhAre zarIra sthira raheM, aura tAki usakI vajaha se retIlI z2amIna ko Thosa karake tumhAre qadamoM ko jamA de tAki usameM tumhAre pA~va na dha~seM|

(ai nabI!) jaba ApakA pAlanahAra una fariztoM kI ora vaha़ya kara rahA thA, jinheM badra ke dina mominoM kI sahAyatA ke lie bhejA thA ki (ai farizto!) maiM madada aura samarthana ke dvArA tumhAre sAtha hU~| ataH apane duzmanoM se lar3ane meM mominoM ke saMkalpa ko maz2abUta karo| maiM zIghra hI kAfiroM ke diloM meM atyadhika bhaya DAla dU~gA| isalie tuma (ai momino!) kAfiroM kI garadaneM ur3Ate jAo, tAki unakA kAma tamAma ho jAe, aura unake jor3oM aura zarIra ke aMgoM para vAra kie jAo, tAki tumase yuddha karane se asamartha ho jAe~|

kAfiroM ke qatla kie jAne aura unake aMgoM ke bhaMga kie jAne kA kAraNa yaha hai ki unhoMne allAha aura usake rasUla kA virodha kiyA| cunA~ce unheM jo Adeza diyA gayA thA, usakA unhoMne pAlana nahIM kiyA, aura unheM jisa cIz2a se manA kiyA gayA thA, usase nahIM ruke| tathA jo koI bhI allAha aura usake rasUla kA virodha kare, to allAha use duniyA meM qatla aura qaida, tathA Aqhirata meM jahannama kI Aga ke dvArA, kaThora yAtanA dene vAlA hai|

(ai allAha aura usake rasUla kA virodha karane vAlo!) yaha ukta saz2A tumhAre lie hai| to ise duniyA ke jIvana meM agrima hI cakho, aura Aqhirata meM tumhAre lie Aga kI yAtanA hai, yadi tuma apane kufra aura haTha kI avasthA meM mara gae|

ai allAha para ImAna lAne aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! jaba yuddha ke maidAna meM muzrikoM se AmanA sAmanA ho jAe to unase hAra na mAno aura unase pITha pherakara na bhAgo, balki unake sAmane DaTa jAo aura dhairya ke sAtha unakA muqAbalA karo| kyoMki allAha apanI madada aura samarthana ke dvArA tumhAre sAtha hai|

aura jo vyakti unase bhAgate hue apanI pITha phere, jabaki vaha unase lar3AI ke lie mur3ane vAlA nahIM hai ki vaha cAla ke taura para unase bhAgane kA dikhAvA kare, jabaki vaha palaTakara unapara hamalA karanA cAhatA ho, yA vaha madada lene ke lie musalamAnoM ke kisI upasthita samUha meM zAmila hone vAlA nahIM hai, to nizcaya vaha allAha ke prakopa ke sAtha lauTA aura usakA haqadAra ho gayA, aura Aqhirata meM usakA ThikAnA jahannama hai aura usakA vaha ThikAnA bahuta burA hai aura usake palaTane kI vaha jagaha bahuta burI hai|

(ai momino!) tumane badra ke dina muzrikoM ko apanI tAqata aura zakti se nahIM mArA, balki allAha ne isameM tumhArI madada kI| aura (ai nabI!) jaba Apane muzrikoM kI ora miTTI pheMkI, to Apane miTTI nahIM pheMkI, balki allAha hI ne pheMkI, jaba ApakI pheMkI huI miTTI ko unake pAsa pahu~cA diyA| aura tAki vaha mominoM ko apane isa upakAra ke sAtha Az2amAe ki usane unheM saMkhyAbala aura upakaraNoM kI kamI ke bAvajUda unake duzmana para vijaya pradAna kiyA tAki ve usakA zukriyA adA kareM| nizcaya allAha tumhArI duAoM aura bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, tathA tumhAre karmoM aura hitoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|

yaha ullikhita bAteM, jaise muzrikoM ko qatla karanA, unakI ora miTTI pheMkanA yahA~ taka ki ve parAjita ho gae aura pITha pherakara bhAga gae, tathA musalamAnoM ko unake duzmana para vijaya pradAna karanA; yaha saba allAha kI ora se hai| aura allAha kAfiroM kI usa cAla ko kamaz2ora kara dene vAlA hai, jo ve islAma ke khilAfa cala rahe haiM|

(ai bahudevavAdiyo!) agara tuma yaha cAhate ho ki allAha aparAdhiyoM va atyAcAriyoM para apanI yAtanA utAra de, to allAha ne tumapara vaha yAtanA utAra dI hai, jo tumane mA~gI thI| kyoMki vaha tumheM aisI saz2A de cukA hai, jo tumhAre lie zikSAprada aura allAha kA bhaya rakhane vAloM ke lie nasIhata (ibarata) kA kAraNa hai| aura yadi tuma isakI mA~ga se bAz2a A jAo, to yaha tumhAre lie uttama hai| kyoMki ho sakatA hai ki allAha tumheM mohalata de de aura tumase badalA lene meM jaldI na kare| aura agara tuma dobArA usakI mA~ga karane aura musalamAnoM se yuddha karane kI ora lauTa Ae, to hama phira se tumheM yAtanA meM DAleMge aura mominoM ko vijaya pradAna kareMge| aura tumhArA jatthA aura tumhAre sahAyaka, cAhe ve bahuta adhika saMkhyA evaM upakaraNa vAle hoM aura ImAna vAloM kI saMkhyA kama ho, tumhAre kucha kAma na Ae~ge| aura isalie ki nizcaya allAha kI sahAyatA aura samarthana mominoM ke sAtha hai| aura jisake sAtha allAha ho, use koI parAjita nahIM kara sakatA|

ai allAha para ImAna lAne aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! allAha kI AjJA kA pAlana aura usake rasUla kI AjJA kA pAlana, usake AdezoM para amala karake aura usakI manA kI huI cIz2oM se dUra rahakara, karo| tathA usake Adeza kI avahelanA karake aura usake manA kie hue kArya ko karake, usase mu~ha na phero, jabaki tuma allAha kI AyatoM ko sunate ho, jo tumhAre sAmane par3hI jAtI haiM|

aura (ai momino!) tuma una munAfiqoM aura muzrikoM kI taraha na ho jAo, jinake sAmane hamArI AyateM par3hI jAtI haiM to ve kahate haiM: hamane apane kAnoM se vaha quraAna sunA, jo hamAre sAmane par3hA jAtA hai, hAlA~ki ve ciMtana karane aura upadeza grahaNa karane ke uddezya se nahIM sunate, ki jo kucha unhoMne sunA hai usase lAbha uThAe~|

allAha ke nikaTa dharatI para calane vAlI sArI maqhalUqa meM sabase bure ve bahare haiM, jo satya ko svIkAra karane ke lie nahIM sunate, ve gU~ge haiM, jo bola nahIM pAte| kyoMki ve aise loga haiM jo allAha ke AdezoM aura niSedhoM ko nahIM samajhate|

aura agara allAha jAnatA ki ina jhuThalAne vAle bahudevavAdiyoM ke aMdara koI bhalAI hai, to unheM avazya isa taraha sunA detA ki ve usase lAbha uThAte aura usake tarkoM aura pramANoM ko samajhate, lekina use patA hai ki unake aMdara koI bhalAI nahIM hai| aura agara (mAna liyA jAe ki) allAha unheM sunA detA, to bhI ve haTha ke kAraNa ImAna se phira jAte, isa hAla meM ki ve mu~ha pherane vAle hote|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! allAha aura usake rasUla kI pukAra kA, unake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura unake niSedhoM se bacakara javAba do, jaba rasUla tumheM usa satya ke lie bulAe~, jisameM tumhArA jIvana hai| aura isa bAta se sunizcita ho jAo ki allAha hara cIz2a kI zakti rakhatA hai| cunA~ce vaha isa bAta kI zakti rakhatA hai ki yadi tuma satya ko asvIkAra karane ke bAda use mAnanA cAho to vaha tumhAre aura satya ko mAnane ke bIca rukAvaTa bana jAe| isalie satya ko svIkAra karane meM jaldI karo| aura isa bAta kA yaqIna rakho ki tuma qiyAmata ke dina akele allAha hI ke pAsa ekatra kie jAoge| phira vaha tumheM tumhAre duniyA meM kie hue karmoM kA badalA degA|

aura (ai ImAna vAlo!) usa yAtanA se baco, jo tumameM se kevala usI para nahIM AegI, jo pApI hai, balki usake sAtha-sAtha dUsare loga bhI usakI capeTa meM Ae~ge| yaha usa samaya hogA, jaba atyAcAra prakaTa hogA aura use dUra nahIM kiyA jAegA| aura yaqIna mAno ki allAha apanI avajJA karane vAle ko saqhta saz2A dene vAlA hai| ataH usakI avajJA se baco|

tathA (ai ImAna vAlo!) usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba tuma makkA meM bahuta kama saMkhyA meM the, makkA vAle tumheM kamaz2ora samajhe hue the aura tumheM dabAe hue the| tumheM Dara thA ki tumhAre duzmana tumheM ucaka le jAe~ge| to allAha ne tumheM madInA ke rUpa meM eka zaraNa sthala diyA aura yuddha ke sthAnoM meM tumhAre duzmanoM para tumheM vijaya pradAna karake tumheM zakti pradAna kI, jaise ki badra ke dina huA, aura tumheM pavitra cIz2oM se jIvikA pradAna kI, jinameM yuddha ke maidAna meM tumhAre zatruoM se prApta kiyA huA g2anImata kA dhana bhI zAmila hai, tAki tuma allAha kI nematoM kA zukriyA adA karo, jisake kAraNa vaha tumheM aura nemateM pradAna karegA, tathA unakI nAzukrI na karo ki allAha tumase ve nemateM chIna le aura tumheM yAtanA se grasta kara de|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! allAha aura usake rasUla ke sAtha, unake AdezoM kA pAlana na karake aura unake niSedhoM se na bacakara, vizvAsaghAta na karo, tathA tumhAre pAsa jo amAnata rakhI jAe usameM qhayAnata na karo, jabaki tuma jAna rahe ho ki tumhArA yaha kAma qhayAnata hai, anyathA tuma qhayAnata karane vAloM meM se ho jAoge|

cU~ki dhana aura saMtAna kA pyAra manuSya ko qhayAnata karane ke lie prerita karatA hai, isalie allAha ne batAyA ki ve donoM cIz2eM fitanA (parIkSaNa) haiM| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
aura (ai ImAna vAlo!) jAna lo ki tumhAre dhana aura tumhArI saMtAna tumhAre lie allAha kI ora se Az2amAiza aura parIkSaNa haiM| kyoMki ye cIz2eM tumheM Aqhirata ke lie kArya karane se roka sakatI haiM aura tumheM qhayAnata para AmAdA kara sakatI haiM| tathA jAna lo ki allAha ke pAsa bahuta bar3A savAba hai| ataH apane dhana aura apane baccoM ko dhyAna meM rakhakara aura unakI khAtira qhayAnata karake, yaha savAba apane hAtha se na jAne do|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! jAna lo ki agara tuma allAha se, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara, Daroge, to vaha tumheM satya aura asatya ke bIca aMtara karane kI zakti pradAna karegA, jisase tumhAre lie donoM gaDDa-maDDa nahIM hoMge| tathA jo kucha tumane bure kArya kie hoMge, vaha unheM tumase miTA degA aura tumhAre pApoM ko kSamA kara degA| aura allAha bahuta bar3e anugraha vAlA hai| aura usakA eka bar3A anugraha usakI jannata hai, jise usane apane Darane vAle baMdoM ke lie taiyAra kI hai|

aura (ai rasUla) usa samaya ko yAda kareM, jaba saba muzrikoM ne milakara Apako qaida karane, mAra DAlane yA apane nagara se kisI aura nagara kI ora nikAla dene kA SaDyaMtra kiyA| ve Apake viruddha SaDyaMtra kara rahe the aura allAha unake SaDyaMtra ko unhIM para lauTA rahA thA tathA usase Apako bacAne kA upAya kara rahA thA aura allAha hI sabase attama upAya karane vAlA hai|

aura jaba unake sAmane hamArI AyateM par3hI jAtI haiM, to ve satya se baira aura ahaMkAra ke kAraNa kahate haiM: hamane pahale bhI aisA kucha sunA hai| agara hama isa quraAna jaisA kahanA cAheM, to nizcaya hama kaha sakate haiM| yaha quraAna jo hamane sunA hai, pahale logoM kI jhUThI kahAniyoM ke sivA kucha nahIM hai| isalie hama isapara haragiz2a vizvAsa nahIM kareMge|

aura (ai rasUla!) usa samaya ko yAda kareM, jaba bahudevavAdiyoM ne kahA: ai allAha! yadi muhammada kA lAyA huA dharma satya hai, to hamapara AkAza se patthara girA de jo hameM naSTa kara de, athavA hamapara koI gaMbhIra yAtanA le A| unhoMne yaha bAta inakAra meM atizayokti ke taura para kahI thI|

aura allAha ApakI ummata ko (cAhe vaha una logoM meM se ho jinhoMne Apake nimaMtraNa ko svIkAra kiyA yA una logoM meM se ho jo Apake nimaMtraNa ko svIkAra karane ke lie bAdhya haiM), aisI yAtanA se grasta nahIM karegA, jo unheM jar3a se miTA de, jabaki (ai muhammada!) Apa unake bIca jIvita maujUda haiM| kyoMki unake bIca ApakI upasthiti unake lie yAtanA se surakSA hai| tathA allAha unheM yAtanA se grasta karane vAlA nahIM hai, jabaki ve apane pApoM ke lie allAha se kSamA mAMgate hoM|

bhalA unako yAtanA kyoM na dI jAe, jabaki unhoMne logoM ko 'masjide ha़rAma' (kAbA) kA tavAfa karane yA usameM namAz2a adA karane se rokakara aisA kArya kiyA hai jo unheM yAtanA kA pAtra banAtA hai? tathA ye muzrika allAha ke dosta nahIM haiM, allAha ke dosta to kevala usake Darane vAle baMde haiM, jo usakI AjJAoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara usase Darate haiM| paraMtu adhikatara muzrika isa bAta ko nahIM jAnate, yahI kAraNa hai ki ve kahate haiM ki ve allAha ke dosta haiM, jabaki ve allAha ke dosta nahIM haiM|

masjide ha़rAma ke pAsa muzrikoM kI namAz2a sITI bajAne aura tAlI bajAne ke alAvA aura kucha nahIM thI| ataH (ai muzriko!) allAha kA inakAra karane aura usake rasUla ko jhuThalAne ke kAraNa badra ke dina qatla aura qaida kI yAtanA cakho|

nizcaya jina logoM ne allAha ke sAtha kuph़ra kiyA, ve apanA dhana logoM ko allAha ke dharma se rokane ke lie qharca karate haiM| cunA~ce ve isI taraha kharca karate raheMge aura unakI manokAmanA kabhI pUrI nahIM hogI| phira unake dhana kharca karane kA pariNAma pachatAvA hogA; kyoMki dhana bhI calA gayA aura usake kharca karane kA uddezya bhI prApta nahIM huA| phira ve ImAna vAloM ke unapara vijaya se parAjita ho jAe~ge| aura jina logoM ne allAha ke sAtha kufra kiyA, ve qiyAmata ke dina jahannama kI ora hA~kakara le jAe jAe~ge| phira ve usameM praveza kareMge aura hamezA ke lie usI meM raheMge|

ina kAfiroM ko, jo allAha ke mArga se rokane ke lie apanA dhana kharca karate haiM, jahannama kI Aga kI ora le jAyA jAegA, tAki allAha kAfiroM ke apavitra (duSTa) samUha ko mominoM ke pavitra (acche) samUha se alaga kara de, tathA apavitra vyaktiyoM, kAryoM aura dhanoM ko eka-dUsare para rakhakara Dhera banA de| phira use jahannama meM DAla de| yahI loga ghATA uThAne vAle haiM; kyoMki unhoMne qiyAmata ke dina apanA aura apane ghara vAloM kA nuqasAna kiyA|

(ai rasUla!) Apa apanI jAti ke una logoM se kaha deM, jinhoMne allAha aura usake rasUla ke sAtha kufra kiyA: yadi ve allAha aura usake rasUla ke sAtha kufra karane se, tathA ImAna lAne vAloM ko allAha ke mArga se rokane se bAz2a A jAe~; to allAha unake pichale gunAhoM ko mAfa kara degA| kyoMki islAma apane se pahale jo kucha huA, use miTA detA hai| aura agara ve apane kufra kI ora lauTa gae, to pahale logoM ke bAre meM allAha kI rIti guz2ara cukI hai| vaha yaha hai ki jaba unhoMne jhuThalAyA aura apane kufra para ar3e rahe, to allAha ne unheM avilaMba saz2A de dI|

aura (ai momino!) apane kAphira duzmanoM se yuddha karo, yahA~ taka ki na zirka rahe aura na hI musalamAnoM ko allAha ke dharma se rokanA, tathA dharma aura AjJAkAritA ekamAtra allAha ke lie raha jAe, jisameM usakA koI sAjhI na ho| phira yadi kAfira apane zirka aura allAha ke mArga se rokane se bAz2a A jAe~, to unheM chor3a do| kyoMki allAha unake karmoM ko jAnatA hai, usase koI bAta chipI nahIM hai|

aura agara ve, kufra aura allAha ke mArga se rokane se bAz2a Ane kA jo unheM Adeza diyA gayA hai, usase mu~ha phereM, to (ai momino!) nizcita ho jAo ki allAha unake viruddha tumhArA madadagAra hai| vaha usake lie bahuta acchA saMrakSaka hai, jisakA vaha saMrakSaka ho, tathA vaha usake lie bahuta acchA sahAyaka hai, jisakA vaha sahAyaka ho| ataH vaha jisakA saMrakSaka ho gayA, vaha saphala huA aura vaha jisakA madadagAra ho gayA, vaha vijayI huA|

aura (ai ImAna vAlo!) jAna lo ki tumane allAha ke mArga meM kAfiroM se jihAda karate hue jo g2anImata kA dhana hAsila kiyA hai, use pA~ca bhAgoM meM vibhAjita kiyA jAegA| unameM se cAra bhAga mujAhidoM meM bA~Ta die jAe~ge, jabaki zeSa pA~caveM bhAga ko phira pA~ca hissoM meM vibhAjita kiyA jAegA: usakA eka hissA allAha aura usake rasUla kA hogA, jise musalamAnoM ke sArvajanika hitoM meM kharca kiyA jAegA, tathA eka hissA nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke nikaTa-saMbaMdhiyoM arthAt banU hAzima evaM banU muttaliba ke lie, eka hissA anAthoM ke lie, eka hissA garIboM evaM misakInoM ke lie, tathA eka hissA aise yAtriyoM ke lie hai, jo rAste meM pha~se hue hoM| yadi tuma allAha para tathA usa cIz2a para ImAna rakhate ho, jo hamane apane baMde muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama para badra ke dina utArI, jisake dvArA allAha ne satya aura jhUTha ke bIca aMtara kara diyA jaba usane tumheM tumhAre duzmanoM para jIta dilAI| aura allAha, jisane tumhArI madada kI, hara cIz2a kA sAmarthya rakhatA hai|

tathA usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba tuma ghATI ke usa kinAre para the jo madInA se sabase nikaTa hai, tathA bahudevavAdI usI ghATI ke dUra vAle kinAre para the, jo makkA se karIba hai, aura qAfilA tumase nIce kSetra meM lAla sAgara ke taTa ke nikaTa thA| yadi tumane aura bahudevavAdiyoM ne badra meM milane kA vAdA kiyA hotA, to tuma nirdhArita samaya (para pahu~cane) ke bAre meM eka-dUsare se asahamata hote| paraMtu allAha ne tumheM binA pUrvanirdhArita avadhi ke badra meM ekatra kara diyA| tAki allAha vaha kAma pUrA kara de, jo kiyA jAne vAlA thA, arthAt ImAna vAloM kI jIta aura kAfiroM kI viphalatA, apane dharma (islAma) kA sammAna aura bahudevavAda kA apamAna; tAki unameM se jo mare, vaha ImAna vAloM kI saMkhyAbala aura upakaraNoM kI kamI ke bAvajUda kAfiroM para jIta ke dvArA usapara tarka sthApita hone ke bAda mare, tathA jo jIvita rahe, vaha usa sabUta aura tarka ko dekhakara jIvita rahe, jo allAha ne usake lie prakaTa kiyA hai| tAki kisI ke lie allAha ke viruddha koI tarka bAqI na rahe, jise vaha prastuta kara sake| niHsaMdeha allAha sabhI kI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, unake kAryoM ko jAnane vAlA hai| usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai aura vaha unheM unakA badalA degA|

tathA (ai rasUla!) Apa, apane aura mominoM ke Upara allAha kI nemata ko yAda kareM, jaba allAha ne Apako sapane meM muzrikoM kI saMkhyA kama karake dikhAI, aura Apane ImAna vAloM ko isake bAre meM batAyA, to ve isa zubha samAcAra se AnaMdita hue aura apane duzmana se milane aura usase lar3ane kA unakA saMkalpa aura bhI maz2abUta ho gayA| yadi allAha Apako muzrikoM kI saMkhyA adhika dikhAtA, to avazya hI Apake sAthiyoM ke saMkalpa kamaz2ora par3a jAte aura ve lar3ane se bhaya khAne lagate| paraMtu allAha ne isase surakSita rakhA aura unheM asaphalatA se bacAyA| isalie unheM apane rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI naz2ara meM kama kara diyA| niHsaMdeha vaha sInoM kI bAtoM se bhalI-bhA~ti avagata, tathA diloM ke bhedoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|

tathA (ai ImAna vAlo!) usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba allAha bahudevavAdiyoM ko lar3AI ke samaya tumhArI A~khoM meM thor3A karake dikhA rahA thA| isa taraha usane tumheM unase lar3ane kA sAhasa diyA| tathA unakI A~khoM meM tumheM thor3A karake dikhA rahA thA, isalie ve bhI tumase lar3AI ke lie Age bar3he aura vApasa jAne ke bAre meM nahIM socA| tAki allAha usa kAma ko pUrA kara de, jo hokara rahanA thA, yAnI bahudevavAdiyoM se (unheM) mArakara aura baMdI banAkara badalA lenA aura ImAna vAloM ko duzmanoM para jIta evaM saphalatA dvArA puraskRta karanA| tathA sabhI mAmale allAha hI kI ora lauTAe jAte haiM, phira vaha kukarma karane vAle ko usake kukarma kA, aura sukarma karane vAle ko usake sukarma kA badalA detA hai|

ai allAha para ImAna lAne vAlo evaM usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karane vAlo! jaba tuma kAfiroM ke kisI samUha kA sAmanA karo, to unase milate samaya dRr3ha raho aura kAyaratA na dikhAo| tathA allAha ko bahuta yAda karo aura usase prArthanA karo| kyoMki vahI tumheM unapara vijaya dilAne meM samartha hai; AzA hai ki vaha tumheM vaha cIz2a pradAna kare jo tuma mA~gate ho aura tumheM usa cIz2a se bacAe, jisakA tumheM Dara hai|

(ai ImAna vAlo!) apane Upara allAha kI nemata ko yAda karo ki zaitAna ne bahudevavAdiyoM ke lie unake karma suMdara banA die| isa taraha usane unheM musalamAnoM kA sAmanA karane aura unase lar3ane ke lie protsAhita kiyA aura unase kahA: Aja tumapara koI vijaya pAne vAlA nahIM, nizcaya maiM tumhArI sahAyatA karU~gA aura tumhAre zatruoM se tumhArI rakSA karU~gA| phira jaba donoM giroha Amane-sAmane hue: eka tarafa ImAna vAloM kA giroha, jinake sAtha unakI madada ke lie farizte the, aura dUsarI tarafa bahudevavAdiyoM kA giroha, jinake sAtha zaitAna thA, jo zIghra hI unakA sAtha chor3ane vAlA thA; aisI paristhiti meM zaitAna pITha pherakara bhAga khar3A huA aura bahudevavAdiyoM se kahA: maiM tumase barI hU~| maiM una fariztoM ko dekha rahA hU~, jo mominoM kI sahAyatA ke lie Ae haiM| mujhe Dara hai ki kahIM allAha mujhe naSTa na kara de, aura allAha bahuta kaThora saz2A dene vAlA hai| isalie koI bhI usakI saz2A sahana karane meM sakSama nahIM hai|

tathA (vaha samaya yAda karo) jaba munAfiqa tathA kamaz2ora ImAna vAle loga kaha rahe the: ina musalamAnoM ko inake dharma ne dhokhA diyA hai, jo inase inakI kama saMkhyA aura kamaz2ora upakaraNa ke bAvajUda, inase adhika saMkhyA aura maz2abUta upakaraNa vAle inake duzmanoM para jIta kA vAdA kara rahA hai| lekina ina logoM ko isa bAta kA ehasAsa nahIM thA ki jo vyakti eka allAha para bharosA karatA aura usake madada ke vAde para vizvAsa rakhatA hai, to nizcaya allAha usakI sahAyatA karane vAlA hai aura vaha use kabhI asahAya nahIM chor3egA, cAhe vaha kitanA bhI kamaz2ora kyoM na ho| allAha saba para prabhutvazAlI hai, koI bhI use parAsta nahIM kara sakatA, vaha apanI niyati aura vidhAna meM pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai|

aura yadi (ai rasUla!) mahilAoM, baccoM, bImAroM, buz2urgoM, aMdhoM aura una garIboM para jinake pAsa yuddha kI taiyArI meM kharca karane ko kucha nahIM hotA, ina sabhI logoM para jihAda meM nikalane se pIche rahane meM koI gunAha nahIM hai; kyoMki unake pAsa ucita bahAne maujUda haiM, jabaki ve allAha aura usake rasUla ke prati niSThAvAna hoM aura usakI zarIyata para amala kareM| ina bahAne vAloM meM se bhalAI karane vAloM ko daMDita karane ke lie koI rAstA nahIM hai| aura allAha bhalAI karane vAloM ke pApoM ko kSamA karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

isI taraha Apase pIche rahane vAle una logoM para bhI koI pApa nahIM hai, ki jaba ve (ai rasUla!) Apake pAsa yaha anurodha lekara Ae ki Apa unake lie savArI kA prabaMdha kara deM, aura Apane unase kahA ki maiM tumhAre lie savArI kI vyavasthA karane ke lie kucha nahIM pAtA; to ve Apake pAsa se isa dazA meM vApasa hue ki unakI A~khoM se A~sU baha rahe the, unheM isa bAta kA aphasosa thA ki unheM khuda apane pAsa se yA Apake pAsa se vaha nahIM milA jo ve kharca kareM|

jaba allAha ne yaha spaSTa kara diyA ki bahAne vAle logoM ko daMDita karane kA koI rAstA nahIM hai, to una logoM kA ullekha kiyA, jo daMDa aura pakar3a ke yogya haiM| cunA~ce pharamAyA: saz2A aura pakar3a ke haqadAra ve loga haiM, jo (ai rasUla!) Apase yuddha se pIche rahane kI anumati mA~gate haiM| hAlA~ki unake pAsa yuddha kI taiyArI ke sAdhana maujUda haiM| ve gharoM meM pIche rahane vAlI striyoM ke sAtha rahakara apane lie apamAna aura rusavAI se saMtuSTa ho gae, tathA allAha ne unake diloM para muhara lagA dI| ataH koI upadeza unapara asara nahIM karatA| aura isa muhara lagane ke kAraNa unheM patA hI nahIM hai ki kauna-sA kAma unake hita meM hai tAki use apanAe~ aura kisameM unakA ahita hai tAki usase dUra raheM|

jihAda se pIche raha jAne vAle munAphiqa, musalamAnoM ke jihAda se lauTane ke samaya, unake sAmane kamaz2ora aura betuke bahAne peza kareMge| aise meM, allAha apane nabI aura mominoM ko unheM yaha javAba dene kA nirdeza detA hai: jhUThe bahAne mata karo, jo kucha tumane hameM batAyA hai hama kadApi usapara vizvAsa nahIM kareMge| allAha ne hameM tumhAre diloM kI kucha bAteM batA dI haiM| allAha aura usake rasUla dekheMge: kyA tuma loga taubA karate ho, tAki allAha tumhArI taubA svIkAra kara le, yA tuma apane nifAqa hI para jame rahate ho? phira tuma allAha kI ora lauTAe jAoge, jo hara cIz2a kA jJAna rakhatA hai| to vaha tumheM batAegA jo kucha tuma kiyA karate the aura tumheM usakA badalA degA| ataH tuma taubA aura satkarma meM jaldI karo|

ye pIche raha jAne vAle loga, jaba (ai ImAna vAlo!) tuma unakI ora vApasa jAoge to apane jhUThe bahAnoM kI puSTi ke lie, allAha kI qasameM khAe~ge; tAki tuma unakI bhartsanA aura niMdA karane se ruka jAo| ataH Apa unheM unakI hAlata para chor3a deM, krodhita vyakti ke chor3ane kI taraha| nizcaya ye azuddha aura duSTa hRdaya vAle haiM aura inakA ThikAnA jahA~ ye zaraNa leMge, jahannama hai| yaha badalA hai usa pAkhaMDa aura pApa kA, jo ve kamAyA karate the|

(ai ImAna vAlo!) ye pIche raha jAne vAle loga, tumhAre Age qasameM khAe~ge; tAki tuma unase khuza ho jAo aura unake bahAne svIkAra kara lo| para tuma unase khuza na honA| yadi tuma unase khuza ho gae, to tuma apane pAlanahAra kI avahelanA karane vAle Thaharoge| kyoMki allAha kufra aura nifAqa ke dvArA usakI AjJAkAritA se nikala jAne vAle logoM se khuza nahIM hotA| ataH (ai musalamAno!) aise logoM se khuza hone se sAvadhAna raho, jinase allAha prasanna nahIM hotA|

dehAta ke rahane vAle yadi avizvAsa yA pAkhaMDa ke mArga para cala par3eM, to unakA kuphra anya zaharI kSetra ke logoM ke kufra se adhika gaMbhIra aura unakA pAkhaMDa una logoM kI tulanA meM adhika saqhta hogA| tathA ye loga isa bAta ke adhika yogya haiM ki dharma se anabhijJa hoM aura inake bAre meM isa bAta kI adhika saMbhAvanA hai ki dhArmika kartavyoM, sunnatoM tathA una AdezoM ke niyamoM ko na jAneM, jinheM allAha ne apane rasUla para utArA hai| kyoMki ve ujaDDapana, akkhar3apana aura logoM ke sAtha mela-milApa aura saMparka ke abhAva se pIr3ita haiM| allAha unakI sthitiyoM ko jAnane vAlA hai| unakI koI bAta usase chipI nahIM hai| vaha apane prabaMdhana aura apane vidhAna meM hikamata vAlA hai|

dehAta meM rahane vAle pAkhaMDiyoM meM kucha loga aise bhI haiM, jo allAha ke mArga meM kharca kie hue dhana ko ghATA aura jurmAnA samajhate haiM, kyoMki unakA bhrama hai ki yadi unhoMne kharca kiyA to unheM pratiphala nahIM milegA aura agara kharca nahIM kiyA to allAha unheM daMDita nahIM karegA| kiMtu isake bAvajUda kabhI-kabhI dikhAvA aura apane bacAva ke lie kharca kara dete haiM| ve isa bAta kI pratIkSA meM rahate haiM ki (ai ImAna vAlo!) tumapara koI burAI utara par3e aura unheM tumase chuTakArA mila jAe| ve jisa burAI aura gaMbhIra pariNAma vAle kAlacakra ke musalamAnoM para utarane kI kAmanA kara rahe haiM, allAha use ImAna vAloM ke bajAya, svayaM unhIM para utAra de| ve jo kucha kahate haiM allAha use sunane vAlA aura jo kucha chipAte haiM use jAnane vAlA hai|

dehAta meM rahane vAloM meM se kucha aise bhI haiM, jo allAha para tathA qiyAmata ke dina para ImAna rakhate haiM aura allAha ke rAste meM jo dhana kharca karate haiM, use allAha kI nikaTatA prApta karane kA z2ariyA tathA rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI duA aura kSamAyAcanA kI prApti kA sAdhana samajhate haiM| suna lo, usakA allAha ke rAste meM kharca karanA aura rasUla kA usake lie duA karanA, nizcaya hI usake lie allAha ke pAsa nikaTatA prApta karane kA sAdhana hai, jisakA allAha ke pAsa use yaha pratiphala milegA ki allAha use apanI vizAla dayA meM praveza karegA, jisameM usakI kSamA aura usakI jannata zAmila hai| niHsaMdeha allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko kSamA karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

jina logoM ne sabase pahale ImAna lAne meM jaldI kI, cAhe ve muhAjirIna hoM, jo apanA ghara aura deza chor3akara allAha kI ora nikala par3e, yA aMsAra, jinhoMne allAha ke nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI madada kI, tathA ve loga jinhoMne aqIdA, kathanoM aura karmoM meM acchAI ke sAtha ImAna kI ora pahala karane vAle muhAjirIna aura aMsAra kA anusaraNa kiyA - allAha ina sabhI logoM se khuza ho gayA aura unakI AjJAkAritA ko svIkAra kara liyA, tathA ve loga bhI usase prasanna ho gae, kyoMki usane unheM apanA mahAna pratiphala pradAna kiyA aura unake lie aisI jannateM taiyAra kara rakhI haiM, jinake mahaloM ke nIce nahareM bahatI haiM, jinameM ve sadaiva rahane vAle haiM| yaha badalA hI mahAna saphalatA hai|

dehAta ke vAsiyoM meM se jo loga madInA ke Asa-pAsa haiM, unameM se kucha loga munAfiqa haiM aura madInA vAloM meM se bhI kucha loga munAfiqa haiM, jo niphAqa para qAyama aura usapara jame hue haiM| (ai rasUla!) Apa unheM nahIM jAnate, allAha hI unheM bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai| zIghra hI allAha unheM do bAra yAtanA degA: eka bAra duniyA meM unake pAkhaMDa ko ujAgara karake tathA unheM qatla kie jAne aura baMdI banAe jAne ke dvArA, tathA dUsarI bAra Aqhirata meM qabra kI yAtanA dekara| phira ve qiyAmata ke dina jahannama ke pAtAla meM eka bar3I yAtanA kI ora lauTAe jAe~ge|

tathA madInA vAloM meM se kucha anya loga bhI haiM, jo binA kisI kAraNa (bahAne) ke yuddha se pIche raha gae| lekina unhoMne jhUThe bahAne banAne ke bajAya, svayaM svIkAra kara liyA ki unake pAsa (yuddha meM zAmila na hone kA) koI kAraNa (bahAnA) nahIM thA| unhoMne apane pichale acche karmoM, jaise allAha kI AjJAkAritA karane, usake niyamoM kA pAlana karane aura usake mArga meM jihAda karane ke sAtha eka bure kAma ko milA diyA| unheM AzA hai ki allAha unake pazcAtApa ko svIkAra karegA aura unheM kSamA kara degA| niHsaMdeha allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdo ko kSamA karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

(ai rasUla!) Apa unake mAloM meM se z2akAta leM, jisake dvArA Apa unheM avajJA aura pApoM kI gaMdagI se zuddha kareM aura usake sAtha unake acche karmoM ko vikasita kareM| tathA use unase lene ke bAda, unake lie duA kareM| niHsaMdeha ApakI duA unake lie dayA aura saMtoSa kA kAraNa hai| allAha ApakI duA ko sunane vAlA, unake kAryoM aura irAdoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|

jihAda se pIche raha jAne vAloM aura pazcAtApa karake allAha kI ora lauTane vAloM ko patA honA cAhie ki allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM kI taubA qabUla karatA hai, aura yaha ki vaha dAna ko svIkAra karatA hai, jabaki use usakI koI AvazyakatA nahIM hai, tathA dAna karane vAle ko usake dAna kA savAba detA hai| niHsaMdeha pavitra allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdo kI taubA qabUla karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

tathA (ai rasUla!) Apa ina jihAda se pIche raha jAne vAloM aura apane pApa se taubA karane vAloM se kaha dIjie: jo cIz2a tumase chUTa gaI hai, usake nuqasAna kI bharapAI karo, apane kAryoM ko allAha ke lie qhAlisa (vizuddha) rakho aura use prasanna karane vAle kArya karo| allAha, usake rasUla aura ImAna vAle tumhAre kAryoM ko dekheMge| tathA qiyAmata ke dina tuma apane pAlanahAra kI ora lauTAe jAoge, jo hara cIz2a kA jJAna rakhatA hai| vaha jAnatA hai jo kucha tuma gupta rakhate ho aura jo kucha tuma pradarzita karate ho| phira vaha tumheM batA degA jo kucha tuma duniyA meM kiyA karate the aura tumheM usakA badalA degA|

tabUka kI lar3AI se pIche rahane vAloM meM se kucha dUsare loga bhI haiM, jinake pAsa koI bahAnA nahIM thA| inakA mAmalA allAha kA faisalA aura inake bAre meM usakA Adeza Ane taka sthagita kara diyA gayA hai| allAha unake bAre meM jo cAhe, phaisalA kare: yA to vaha unheM daMDita kare yadi ve taubA na kareM, yA unakI taubA svIkAra kare agara ve taubA kara leM| allAha acchI taraha jAnatA hai ki kauna usake daMDa kA haqadAra hai aura kauna usakI kSamA ke yogya hai| vaha apane vidhAna aura prabaMdhana meM hikamata vAlA hai| ye loga: murArA bina rabI', kaaba bina mAlika aura hilAla bina umaiyA the|

tathA munAfiqo meM se ve loga bhI haiM, jinhoMne eka masjida banAI para allAha kI AjJAkAritA ke lie nahIM, balki musalamAnoM ko nuqasAna pahu~cAne ke lie, munAfiqoM ko maz2abUta karake kufra kA pradarzana karane ke lie, ImAna vAloM ke bIca phUTa DAlane ke lie aura una logoM ko taiyArI kA sthAna tathA ghAta sthala pradAna karane ke lie, jinhoMne masjida ke nirmANa se pUrva allAha aura usake rasUla se lar3AI kI| nizcaya ye munAfiqa tumase avazya hI qasameM khAkara kaheMge: hamArA maqasada to kevala musalamAnoM ke sAtha AsAnI (dayAlutA) kA thA| jabaki allAha gavAhI detA hai ki nizcaya ve apane isa dAve meM jhUThe haiM|

(ai nabI!)
