kyA jisane apane bhavana kI AdhArazilA allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara usake taqvA tathA adhika se adhika nekI ke kArya karake allAha kI prasannatA para rakhI hai, vaha usake barAbara hai, jisane musalamAnoM ko nuqasAna pahu~cAne, kufra ko maz2abUta karane aura ImAna vAloM ke bIca vibheda paidA karane ke lie masjida banAI?! donoM kabhI barAbara nahIM ho sakate| pahale vyakti kA bhavana zaktizAlI aura maz2abUta hai, jisake girane kA Dara nahIM hai| jabaki dUsare vyakti kA udAharaNa usa vyakti kI taraha hai, jisane kisI gaDDhe ke kinAre eka bhavana banAyA, para vaha Dhaha gayA aura gira gayA aura usake sAtha hI usakA bhavana jahannama kI gaharAI meM jA girA| saccAI yaha hai ki allAha kufra aura nifAqa vag2airaha ke z2arie atyAcAra karane vAle logoM ko sIdhA mArga nahIM dikhAtA|

unakI yaha masjida, jise unhoMne (musalamAnoM ko) nuqasAna pahu~cAne ke lie banAyA hai, sadA unake diloM meM saMdeha aura nifAqa ke rUpa meM basI rahegI, yahA~ taka ki mauta se athavA talavAra ke dvArA vadha se unake dila Tukar3e-Tukar3e ho jAe~| allAha apane baMdoM ke kAmoM ko jAnane vAlA, unake acche yA bure karma kA badalA dene meM hikamata vAlA hai|

jaba allAha ne jihAda se pIche raha jAne vAle munAfiqoM kI apakIrtiyoM kA varNana kiyA, to apane mArga meM jihAda karane vAloM ke pratiphala kA bhI ullekha kiyA| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
niHsaMdeha allAha ne (apanI kRpA se) ImAna vAloM se unake prANoM ko eka ucca qImata arthAta jannata ke badale meM qharIda liyA hai, (hAlA~ki ve allAha hI kI saMpatti haiM)| kyoMki ve kAfiroM se lar3ate haiM tAki allAha kA vacana sarvocca ho| cunA~ce ve kAfiroM ko qatla karate haiM aura kAfira unheM qatla karate haiM| allAha ne isakA saccA vAdA mUsA alaihissalAma kI pustaka taurAta, IsA alaihissalAma kI pustaka iMjIla aura muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI pustaka quraAna meM kiyA hai, tathA allAha se bar3hakara apanA vAdA pUrA karane vAlA koI nahIM hai| ataH (ai ImAna vAlo!) apane isa saude se prasanna ho jAo, jo tumane allAha se kiyA hai| kyoMki tumane isameM bahuta lAbha kamAyA hai aura yaha saudA hI bahuta bar3I saphalatA hai|

yaha pratiphala prApta karane vAle loga ve haiM, jo allAha ko pasaMda na Ane vAlI aura use krodhita karane vAlI cIz2oM kI upekSAkara use pasaMda Ane vAlI tathA prasanna karane vAlI cIz2oM kI ora lauTane vAle haiM, jo allAha ke bhaya aura vinamratA ke kAraNa vinayazIla hokara usakI AjJAkAritA meM bahuta parizrama karate haiM, jo hara paristhiti meM apane raba kI stuti karane vAle, roz2e rakhane vAle, namAz2a par3hane vAle, allAha ne yA usake rasUla ne jisakA Adeza diyA hai usakA Adeza dene vAle, allAha aura usake rasUla ne jisase manA kiyA hai usase manAhI karane vAle, tathA allAha ke AdezoM kI, unakA anupAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM kI, unase bacakara rakSA karane vAle haiM| (ai rasUla!) Apa ina guNoM se vizeSita mominoM ko usa cIz2a kI sUcanA de deM, jo unheM duniyA aura Akhirata meM prasanna kara degI|

nabI ke lie ucita nahIM hai aura na hI ImAna vAloM ke lie ucita hai ki ve muzrikoM ke lie allAha se kSamA yAcanA kareM, bhale hI ve unake riztedAra hoM, jabaki unake lie yaha spaSTa ho gayA ki ve zirka kI avasthA meM marane ke kAraNa jahannamiyoM meM se haiM|

ibarAhIma alaihissalAma kA apane pitA ke lie kSamAyAcanA karanA kevala isa kAraNa thA ki unhoMne apane pitA se vAdA kiyA thA ki vaha unake lie avazya kSamAyAcanA kareMge; isa AzA meM ki vaha islAma svIkAra kara leMge| paraMtu jaba ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ke lie yaha spaSTa ho gayA ki unakA pitA allAha kA duzmana hai, kyoMki use unake upadeza se koI phAyadA nahIM huA, yA isalie ki unheM vaha़ya ke dvArA mAlUma ho gayA thA ki usakI mRtyu eka kAfira ke rUpa meM hogI, to vaha usase alaga ho gae| unakA apane pitA ke lie kSamAyAcanA karanA unakA apanA ijatihAda thA, kisI Adeza kA ullaMghana nahIM thA jisakI allAha ne unakI ora vaha़ya kI thI| niHsaMdeha ibarAhIma alaihissalAma allAha ke sAmane atyadhika gir3agir3Ane vAle aura apanI atyAcArI qauma ko bahuta mAfa karane vAle the|

allAha kisI jAti ko mArgadarzana pradAna karane ke bAda usake lie pathabhraSTatA kA faisalA nahI karatA, jaba taka ki vaha unake lie una niSedhoM ko spaSTa nahIM kara detA jinase bacanA anivArya hai| phira yadi ve niSedha kI vyAkhyA karane ke bAda usa kArya ko kareM jo unake lie niSiddha ThaharAyA gayA hai, to unapara pathabhraSTatA kA phaisalA kara detA hai| niHsaMdeha allAha saba kucha jAnane vAlA hai, usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai| aura usane tumheM vaha sikhAyA hai jo tuma nahIM jAnate the|

aura (ai rasUla!) aura ApakA pAlanahAra (ai rasUla) aisA nahIM hai ki vaha bastiyoM meM se kisI bastI ko vinaSTa kara de, jabaki usake vAsI dharatI meM sudhAra kA karane vAle hoM| balki vaha use usI samaya vinaSTa karatA hai, jaba usake vAsI kuphra, atyAcAra aura gunAhoM ke dvArA bigAr3a paidA karane vAle hoM|

(ai rasUla) yadi ApakA pAlanahAra cAhatA ki sabhI logoM ko satya ke patha para calane vAlA eka samudAya banA de, to aisA kara sakatA thA| parantu usane aisA nahIM cAhA| ataH ve icchAoM ke pIche calane aura atyAcAra ke kAraNa satya ke bAre meM hamezA matabheda karate raheMge|

parantu jinheM allAha sIdhe mArga kA sAmarthya pradAnakara unapara dayA kare, to ve allAha mahimAvAna ke ekezvaravAda meM vibheda nahIM kareMge| aura isI vibheda ke dvArA parIkSaNa ke lie allAha ne unheM paidA kiyA hai| cunA~ce unameM se kucha abhAge haiM aura kucha bhAgyazAlI| aura (ai rasUla) Apake pAlanahAra kI vaha bAta pUrI huI, jisakA nirNaya usane anAdikAla meM kiyA thA ki vaha jahannama ko jinnoM aura inasAnoM meM se zaitAna ke anuyAyiyoM se bhara degA|

(ai rasUla) Apase pUrva nabiyoM kI qhabaroM meM se jo bhI qhabara hama Apako sunA rahe haiM, usakA uddezya yaha hai ki hama usake dvArA Apake hradaya ko satya para sudRढ़ kara deM aura use maz2abUta kara deM| tathA isa sUrata meM Apake pAsa vaha satya A gayA, jisameM koI saMdeha nahIM hai| aura isameM Apake pAsa kAphiroM ke lie upadeza aura una mominoM ke lie smaraNa AyA hai, jo smaraNa se lAbha uThAte haiM|

aura (ai rasUla!) Apa una logoM se, jo na allAha para ImAna rakhate haiM aura na use eka mAnate haiM, kaha dIjie ki: tuma satya se mu~ha pherane aura usase rokane ke apane rAste para kAma karo, hama apane satya para sudRr3ha rahane, usakI ora logoM ko bulAne aura usapara sabra karane ke rAste para kAma kara rahe haiM|
aura tuma hamapara Ane vAle az2Aba kI pratIkSA karo, niHsaMdeha hama bhI pratIkSA karate haiM ki tumapara kyA kucha AtA hai|

aura kevala allAha hI ke pAsa AkAzoM tathA dharatI kI chipI cIz2oM kA jJAna hai| usase inameM se kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai| tathA akele usI kI ora qiyAmata ke dina sabhI mAmale lauTAe jAe~ge| ataH (ai rasUla) Apa akele usI kI ibAdata kareM aura apane sabhI mAmaloM meM usI para bharosA kareM| ApakA pAlanahAra usase anajAna nahIM hai jo kucha tuma karate ho, balki vaha usase avagata hai aura hara eka ko usake karmoM kA badalA degA|

{alifa, lAma, rA|} yaha aura isa prakAra ke akSaroM ke saMbaMdha meM sUratula baqarA ke prAraMbha meM bAta guz2ara cukI hai| isa sUrata meM jo AyateM utArI gaI haiM, ve usa quraAna kI AyateM haiM jo apane viSayoM (sAmagriyoM) meM spaSTa hai|
hamane kuraAna ko arabI bhASA meM utArA hai, tAki (ai araba vAsiyo!) tuma usakA artha samajha sako|

(ai rasUla) hama Apa para yaha quraAna utArakara, Apako saccAI, zabdoM kI zuddhatA aura usakI balAg2ata se bharI sabase acchI kahAnI sunA rahe haiM| jabaki isake utAre jAne se pahale Apa isa kahAnI se anajAna the, Apako isakA koI jJAna nahIM thA|

(ai rasUla) hama Apako sUcanA de rahe haiM ki jaba yUsufa ne apane pitA yAqUba se kahA: ai mere pitA! maiMne sapane meM gyAraha sitAre dekhe, tathA maiMne sUrya aura caMdramA ko dekhA, maiMne una sabhI ko mujhe sajadA karate hue dekhA hai| yaha dRSTi (svapna) yUsufa alaihissalAma ke lie eka agrima zubhasUcanA thI|

yAqUba ne apane putra yUsufa se kahA: ai mere putra! apanA sapanA apane bhAiyoM ko na batAnA| anyathA ve use samajha jAe~ge aura tumase IrSyA kareMge| tathA ve IrSyA karate hue tumhAre lie SaDayaMtra raceMge| niHsaMdeha zaitAna manuSya kA khulA zmana hai|

aura jisa taraha tUne vaha svapna dekhA hai, vaise hI (ai yUsufa!) terA pAlanahAra tujhe cuna legA aura tujhe sapanoM kI vyAkhyA kA jJAna pradAna karegA| tathA tujhapara nubuvvata ke dvArA apanI nemata pUrI karegA| jaise ki tujhase pUrva usane apanI nemata tere bApa-dAdA: ibarAhIma aura isahAqa para pUrI kI thI| niHsaMdeha terA pAlanahAra apanI sRSTi kA jJAna rakhane vAlA aura apane prabaMdhana meM hikamata vAlA hai|
nizcita rUpa se yUsufa alaihissalAma aura unake bhAiyoM kI kahAnI meM una logoM ke lie sIkha aura upadeza haiM, jo unake samAcAra ke bAre meM pUchane vAle haiM|

jaba unake bhAiyoM ne Apasa meM kahA: yUsufa aura usakA sagA bhAI hamAre pitA ke nikaTa hamase adhika priya haiM| hAlA~ki hama eka acchI saMkhyA vAle giroha haiM, to Aqhira kaise hamAre pitA ne una donoM ko hamapara zreSThatA de rakhI hai? hama samajhate haiM ki binA kisI spaSTa kAraNa ke una donoM ko hamapara zreSThatA dekara ve spaSTa bhUla kara rahe haiM|

yUsufa kI hatyA kara do athavA dUra kisI dharatI meM feMka Ao, tumhAre pitA kA dhyAna pUrNa rUpa se tumhArI ora ho jAegA aura vaha tumase pUrI taraha se pyAra karane lageMge| phira usakI hatyA karane athavA use g2Ayaba karane ke bAda, apane gunAhoM se taubA karake, tuma acche loga bana jAo|

eka bhAI ne kahA: yUsufa ko mata mAro| balki yadi usake sAtha vahI kucha karanA cAhate ho jo tumane kahA hai, to use kisI gahare kue~ meM feMka do ki vahA~ se guz2arane vAle kucha yAtrI use uThA le jAe~| yaha usakI hatyA karane kI tulanA meM kama hAnikAraka hai|

aura jaba ve loga yUsufa alaihissalAma ko dUra karane (haTAne) para sahamata ho gae, to unhoMne apane pitA yAkUba se kahA: ai hamAre pitA! Apa yUsufa ke saMbaMdha meM hamapara vizvAsa kyoM nahIM karate? jabaki usake prati hamArA ravaiyA snehapUrNa rahatA hai, hama hara kaSTa se use bacAte haiM| aura jaba taka vaha Apake pAsa surakSita rUpa se vApasa nahIM A jAtA hai, taba taka hama usakI rakSA karane aura usakI dekhabhAla karane meM usake prati zubhaciMtaka haiM| phira Apako use hamAre sAtha bhejane se kauna-sI cIz2a roka rahI hai?
Apa hameM anumati deM ki kala hama use apane sAtha le jAe~, vaha khAe-piegA aura AnaMda legA aura hama use hara pahu~cane vAle kaSTa se use surakSita rakheMge|

yAqUba ne apane beToM se kahA: tumhArA use apane sAtha le jAnA mere lie dukha kA kAraNa hai, kyoMki maiM usake alagAva ko bardAzta nahIM kara sakatA| sAtha hI yaha bhI Dara hai ki use bher3iyA khA jAe aura tuma loga khAne aura khelane meM vyasta hokara usase asAvadhAna ho jAo|

unhoMne apane pitA se kahA: yadi bher3iye ne yUsufa ko khA liyA, jabaki hama eka giroha haiM, to isa sthiti meM hamameM koI bhalAI nahIM hai| ataH hama bar3e ghATe vAle haiM kyoMki hama bher3iye se usakI rakSA nahIM kara sake|

phira yAqUba ne use unake sAtha bheja diyA| jaba ve use lekara dUra cale gae aura use kue~ ke tala meM pheMkane kA nizcaya kara liyA, to usa vaqta hamane yUsufa kI ora vaha़ya kI: tuma avazya unheM unake isa karatUta ke bAre meM batAoge aura usa samaya ve tumheM pahacAna bhI nahIM pAe~ge|
aura yUsufa ke bhAI apane fareba ko calAne ke lie rone kA DhoMga karate hue izA ke samaya apane pitA ke pAsa Ae|

unhoMne kahA: ai hamAre pitA! hama daur3ane aura tIra pheMkane meM pratispardhA karane lage aura yUsufa ko apane kapar3oM aura sAmAnoM ke pAsa unakI hifAz2ata ke lie chor3a gae| phira use bher3ie ne khA liyA| aura Apa to hamArA vizvAsa karane vAle nahIM haiM, bhale hI hama vAstava meM apanI bAta meM sacce hI kyoM na hoM|

unhoMne apanI qhabara kI puSTi eka cAla ke dvArA kI| ve yUsufa ke kurte para kisI aura cIz2a kA khUna lagAkara lAe, yaha bhrama paidA karane ke lie ki yaha bher3ie ke unako khAne kA nizAna hai| lekina yAqUba alaihissalAma - isa tathya ke sAtha ki qamIz2a phaTI nahIM thI - unakA jhUTha samajha gae| cunA~ce unase kahA: mAmalA vaisA nahIM hai, jaisA tuma ne batAyA hai| balki tumhAre mana ne eka bure kAma ko suMdara banAkara peza kiyA hai, jise tumane banA liyA hai| aba merA kAma behatara sabra karanA hai, jisameM koI ghabarAhaTa nahIM| aura yUsufa kA jo mAmalA tuma batA rahe ho, usapara allAha hI se sahAyatA apekSita hai|

udhara se guz2arane vAlA eka qAfilA AyA aura unhoMne eka vyakti ko pAnI lAne ke lie bhejA| usane jaise hI kue~ meM apanA Dola DAlA, yUsufa rassI pakar3akara laTaka gae| jaba Dola DAlane vAle vyakti ne unheM dekhA, to prasanna hokara pukAra uThA: are, kitanI khuzI kI bAta hai! yaha to eka lar3akA hai| phira usane aura usake kucha sAthiyoM ne milakara, use vyApArika mAla samajhakara qAfile ke dUsare logoM se chipA liyA| aura ve yUsufa ke sAtha apamAna tathA qharIda-faroqhta kA jo mAmalA kara rahe the, allAha use khUba jAnane vAlA hai| unake karatUtoM meM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai|

pAnI lAne vAle vyakti tathA usake sAthiyoM ne unheM misra ke bAz2Ara meM saste dAma meM beca diya| ve mAtra kucha dirahama the, jo kama hone ke kAraNa AsAnI se gine jA sakate the| aura ve unheM maha~ge dAma meM becane ke icchuka bhI nahIM the, kyoMki ve unase jaldI se chuTakArA pAne ke lie utsuka the| unheM unakI sthiti se patA cala gayA thA ki vaha koI gulAma nahIM haiM aura ve unake parivAra vAloM kI tarafa se apane Upara Dara mahasUsa karate the| yaha yUsufa para allAha kI anaMta kRpA thI, tAki vaha unake sAtha laMbe samaya taka na raheM|

aura misra ke jisa vyakti ne unheM qharIdA thA, usane apanI patnI se kahA: isake sAtha acchA vyavahAra karo, aura hamAre sAtha isake Thaharane kA acchA prabaMdha karo| ho sakatA hai yaha hamArI kucha AvazyakatAoM ko pUrA karane meM madadagAra sAbita ho athavA hama ise mu~ha bolA beTA banA leM| aura jisa taraha hamane yUsufa ko hatyA se bacAyA, kue~ se nikAlA aura az2Iz2a ke dila ko usake prati dayAlu kara diyA; usI taraha hamane use misra meM sthApita kiyA aura tAki hama use svapna kI vyAkhyA sikhAe~| aura allAha apane mAmale para hAvI hai| usakA Adeza lAgU hokara rahatA hai| use koI majabUra karane vAlA nahIM| parantu adhikatara loga - aura ve kAfira loga haiM - isa bAta ko nahIM jAnate|

aura jaba yUsufa zarIra kI maz2abUtI kI Ayu ko pahu~ca gae, to hamane unheM samajha aura jJAna pradAna kiyA| aura isI prakAra kA pratiphala jo hamane unheM diyA, hama una sadAcAriyoM ko dete haiM, jo bhalI-bhA~ti allAha kI ibAdata karate haiM|

az2Iz2a kI patnI ne namratA se aura chala kA sahArA lekara yUsufa alaihissalAma ko kukarma para AmAdA karanA cAhA aura unheM bilakula ekAMta meM lene ke lie dvAra baMda kara lie aura unase kahA: "A jAo, mere pAsa Ao|" to yUsufa ne usase kahA: tU mujhe jisa cIz2a ke lie bulA rahI hai, maiM usase allAha kI zaraNa meM AtA hU~| mere svAmI ne mujhe apane pAsa behatara DhaMga se ThaharAyA hai| ataH maiM kabhI usake sAtha vizvAsaghAta nahIM karU~gA| yadi maiMne usake sAtha vizvAsaghAta kiyA, to maiM atyAcArI ho jAU~gA| niHsaMdeha atyAcArI loga kabhI saphala nahIM hote|

usa mahilA kA mana kukarma ke lie icchuka thA| aura yUsufa ke mana meM bhI aisI hI icchA utpanna ho gaI hotI, yadi vaha allAha kI una nizAniyoM ko na dekha lete, jo unheM burAI se rokane tathA dUra rakhane kA kAraNa banIM| aura hamane unheM yaha saba isalie dikhAyA, tAki hama unase burAI ko dUra kara deM aura unheM vyabhicAra tathA vizvAsaghAta se dUra rakheM| yUsufa hamAre una baMdoM meM se haiM, jinheM hamane nubuvvata aura risAlata ke lie cuna liyA hai|

ve donoM daravAz2e kI ora bhAge: yUsufa khuda ko bacAne ke lie aura vaha aurata unheM bAhara jAne se rokane ke lie| isalie usane unheM bAhara jAne se rokane ke lie unakA kurtA pakar3a liyA aura use usake pIche se phAr3a diyA| aura donoM ne usa (mahilA) ke pati ko daravAz2e para pAyA| az2Iz2a kI patnI ne cAla calate hue az2Iz2a se kahA: (ai az2Iz2a!) jisa vyakti ne terI patnI ke sAtha kukarma kA irAdA kiyA, usakI saz2A isake sivA aura kucha nahIM ho sakatI ki use qaida kara diyA jAe, yA use dardanAka saz2A dI jAe|

yUsufa alaihissalAma ne kahA: isI ne mujhe kukarma karane ko kahA thA| maiMne usase aisA nahIM cAhA thA| aise meM usake parivAra meM se eka sAkSI uTha khar3A huA aura usane yaha kahakara gavAhI dI: yadi yUsufa kA kurtA Age se phaTA hai, to yaha usa strI ke saccI hone kA saMketa hai, kyoMki vaha use khuda se roka rahI thI, ataH vaha (yUsufa) jhUThA hai|
aura yadi yUsufa kA kurtA usake pIche se phAr3A gayA hai, to yaha unake sacce hone kA sabUta hai; kyoMki vaha unheM phusalA rahI thI aura vaha usase bhAga rahe the| isalie vaha jhUThI hai|

cunA~ce jaba az2Iz2a ne dekhA ki yUsufa alaihissAma kA kurtA pIche kI ora se phaTA huA hai, to usake sAmane yUsufa kI saccAI spaSTa ho gaI| usane kahA: tumhArA yUsufa para lagAyA gayA yaha Aropa tuma auratoM ke chala aura fareba kA hissA hai| yaqInana tumhArA chala aura fareba bar3A zaktizAlI hotA hai|

aura usane yUsufa se kahA: ai yUsufa! isa mAmale ko jAne do aura isakI carcA kisI se na karanA| aura tU apane pApa ke lie kSamA mA~ga| kyoMki yUsufa ko phusalAne ke kAraNa nizcita rUpa se tU hI pApiyoM meM se hai|

aura usa (az2Iz2a kI patnI) kI khabara zahara meM phaila gaI aura mahilAoM ke eka samUha ne niMdA ke taura para kahA: ajIja kI patnI apane naukara ko rijhA rahI hai aura usakA pyAra usake dila ke aMdara taka pahuMca gayA hai| hama to samajhate haiM ki vaha usako rijhAne aura usake prati sneha aura pyAra ke kAraNa - jabaki vaha usakA naukara hai - spaSTa gumarAhI meM par3a cukI hai|

jaba az2Iz2a kI patnI ko una striyoM kI usakI niMdA karane aura usakI anupasthiti meM usakI burAI karane kI bAta pahu~cI, to usane una striyoM ko bulavA bhejA, tAki ve yUsufa ko dekheM, phira ve use mA'z2Ura (kSamya) samajheM| usane unake lie baiThane kI jagaha taiyAra kI, jahA~ bistara aura gAva-takie lagavA die| phira usane AmaMtrita auratoM meM se hara eka ko khAnA kATane ke lie eka-eka cAqU diyA aura yUsufa alaihissalAma se kahA: inake sAmane A jAo| cunA~ce jaba una striyoM ne unakI ora dekhA, to unheM bahuta bar3A samajhA aura unakI suMdaratA para cakita raha gaIM aura unakI qhUbasUratI ko dekhakara unake hoza ur3a gae aura - unake sAtha AkarSaNa kI tIvratA se - unhoMne khAnA kATane ke lie taiyAra cAqU se apane hAthoM ko ghAyala kara diyA aura bola uThIM: allAha pavitra hai, yaha lar3akA manuSya nahIM hai, kyoMki isameM jo suMdaratA hai vaha kisI inasAna meM dekhI nahIM gaI| vaha aura kucha nahIM balki sammAnanIya fariztoM meM se eka sammAnita fariztA hai|

az2Iz2a kI patnI ne una mahilAoM se kahA ki jaba usane dekhA ki unake sAtha kyA huA hai: yaha vahI naujavAna hai, jisake prema ke kAraNa tumane mujhe tAnA mArA thA| maiMne hI use cAhA thA aura use pralobhita karane ke lie cAla calI thI, para vaha baca nikalA| lekina aba yadi usane vaha nahIM kiyA jo maiM use karane ke lie kahU~gI, to vaha avazya jela meM praveza karegA aura nizcaya hI vaha z2arUra apamAnita hogA|

yUsufa alaihissalAma ne apane pAlanahAra se prArthanA karate hue kahA: ai mere pAlanahAra! jisa jela kI isane mujhe dhamakI dI hai, vaha mere nikaTa usa kukarma ko karane se adhika priya hai, jisakI ora ye striyA~ mujhe bulA rahI haiM| yadi tUne inake chala ko mujhase dUra nahIM kiyA, to maiM inakI ora jhuka jAU~gA, aura yadi maiM inakI ora jhuka gayA aura usa cIz2a meM unakA pAlana kiyA jo ve mujhase cAhatI haiM, to maiM ajJAniyoM meM se ho jAU~gA|

cunA~ce allAha ne unakI prArthanA svIkAra kara lI aura az2Iz2a kI patnI ke chala aura nagara kI striyoM ke chala ko unase dUra kara diyA| niHsaMdeha vaha mahimAvAna va gauravazAlI allAha yUsufa kI duA ko tathA hara duA karane vAle kI duA ko sunane vAlA, tathA anakI sthiti aura unake sivA anya kI sthiti ko jAnane vAlA hai|
phira jaba az2Iz2a aura usake samudAya ke logoM ne unakI begunAhI kA sabUta dekhA, to unakI yaha rAya banI ki unheM eka ajJAta avadhi ke lie jela meM DAla deM| (tAki vaha mAmalA khula na jAe)|

cunA~ce unheM jela meM DAla diyA gayA| unake sAtha jela meM do yuvaka bhI dAqhila hue the| donoM yuvakoM meM se eka ne yUsufa se kahA: maiMne sapane meM dekhA hai ki maiM aMgUra nicor3akara zarAba banA rahA hU~ aura dUsare ne kahA: maiMne dekhA ki maiM apane sira ke Upara roTI uThAe hue hU~ jisase pakSI khA rahe haiM| ai yUsufa! hameM hamAre svapna kA artha batAeM| hama dekhate haiM ki Apa bar3e neka inasAna haiM|

yUsufa alaihissalAma ne kahA: tumhAre lie rAjA yA kisI anya kI ora se jo khAnA AtA hai, usake tumhAre pAsa Ane se pahale hI maiM tumheM batA dU~gA ki usakI saccAI kyA hai aura kaise hai| yaha vyAkhyA jo maiM jAnatA hU~, una bAtoM meM se hai, jo allAha ne mujhe sikhAI hai| yaha aTakala bhaviSyavANI se yA jyotiSa se nahIM hai| niHsaMdeha maiMne aise logoM kA dharma chor3a diyA, jo allAha para ImAna nahIM rakhate aura ve Aqhirata kA inakAra karate haiM|

maiMne apane bApa-dAdAoM: ibarAhIma, isaha़Aqa aura yAqUba ke dharma kA pAlana kiyA hai| aura vaha allAha ke prati ekezvaravAda (arthAta allAha ko ekamAtra pUjya mAnane) kA dharma hai| hamAre lie sahI nahIM hai ki hama allAha ke sAtha kisI ko sAjhI ThaharAe~, jabaki vaha ekezvaravAda meM akelA hai| yaha 'tauha़Ida' aura ImAna jisapara maiM aura mere bApa-dAdA qAyama haiM, vaha hamapara allAha kI kRpA hai ki usane hameM usakA sAmarthya pradAna kiyA| tathA sabhI logoM para usakI kRpA hai ki usane unake pAsa usa (tauha़Ida) ke sAtha nabiyoM ko bhejA| lekina jyAdAtara loga allAha kA usakI nematoM para zukriyA adA nahIM karate, balki usakI nAzukrI karate haiM|

phira yUsufa alaihissalAma ne jela ke aMdara donoM yuvakoM ko saMbodhita karate hue kahA: kyA kaI devI-devatAoM kI pUjA acchA hai yA eka allAha kI ibAdata karanA, jisakA koI sAjhI nahIM, jo saba para prabhutvazAlI hai, jise parAjita nahI kiyA jA sakatA|

tuma allAha ke sivA jinakI ibAdata karate ho, ve kevala nAma haiM, unakI koI vAstavikatA nahIM hai| tumane aura tumhAre bApa-dAdA ne unheM pUjyoM kA nAma de diyA hai| unakA ulUhiyata (devatva) meM koI hissA nahIM hai| allAha ne tumhAre unheM pUjyoM kA nAma dene kA koI pramANa nahIM utArA hai, jo usakI vaidhatA ko iMgita karatA ho| sabhI prANiyoM meM kevala allAha kA Adeza calatA hai, ina nAmoM kA nahIM jo tumane aura tumhAre pUrvajoM ne rakha lie haiM| allAha sarvazaktimAna ne Adeza diyA hai ki tuma kevala usI kI ibAdata karo aura isa bAta se manA kiyA hai ki usake sAtha kisI ko sAjhI banAo| yaha tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) hI vaha sIdhA dharma hai, jisameM koI Ter3hApana nahIM hai| lekina adhikatara loga isa bAta ko nahIM jAnate| isalie ve allAha ke sAtha zirka karate haiM aura usake kucha prANiyoM kI pUjA karate haiM|

ai mere jela ke donoM sAthiyo! jahA~ taka usakI bAta hai, jisane yaha dekhA ki vaha zarAba banAne ke lie aMgUra nicor3a rahA hai, vaha jela se bAhara nikala jAegA aura apane kAma para lauTa AegA aura rAjA ko zarAba pilAegA| aura jahA~ taka usakI bAta hai, jisane yaha dekhA ki usake sira ke Upara roTI hai, jise pakSI khA rahe haiM, to use qatla kara diyA jAegA aura sUlI para car3hA diyA jAegA| phira pakSI usake sira kA mAMsa khAe~ge| tumane jisa mAmale ke bAre meM pUchA thA, usakA phaisalA ho cukA hai| isalie vaha anivArya rUpa se hokara rahegA|

yUsufa ne una donoM yuvakoM meM se jisake bAre meM samajhA thA ki vaha rihA ho jAegA (aura vaha rAjA ko zarAba pilAne vAlA thA) usase kahA: rAjA ke pAsa merI kahAnI aura mere mAmale kA z2ikra karanA; zAyada vaha mujhe jela se nikAla de| kintu zaitAna ne zarAba pilAne vAle ko rAjA ke pAsa yUsufa kA ullekha karanA bhulA diyA| isalie usake bAda yUsufa ko kaI varSoM taka jela meM rahanA par3A|

rAjA ne kahA: maiMne sapane meM dekhA hai ki sAta moTI gAe~ haiM, jinheM sAta kamaz2ora gAe~ khA rahI haiM| isI taraha maiMne sAta harI bAliyA~ aura sAta sUkhI bAliyA~ dekhI haiM| ai pramukho aura gaNamAnya logo! mujhe mere isa sapane kA artha batAo, yadi tuma sapane kA artha jAnane vAle ho|
una logoM ne kahA: ApakA sapanA, ulajhe hue sapanoM kA mizraNa hai| aura jo aisA ho usakI koI vyAkhyA nahIM hai aura hama mizrita sapanoM kI vyAkhyA se avagata nahIM haiM|

aura donoM qaidI yuvakoM meM se rihAI pAne vAle sAqI (zarAba pilAnevAle vyakti) ne, jise eka avadhi ke bAda yUsufa alaihissalAma aura unake sapane ke artha kA jJAna rakhane ke bAre meM yAda AyA, to kahA: maiM Apa logoM ko rAjA ke sapane kA artha eka aise vyakti se pUchane ke bAda batA sakatA hU~, jisake pAsa sapanoM ke artha kA jJAna hai| isalie - ai rAjA - mujhe yUsufa ke pAsa bhejeM, tAki vaha Apake sapane kA artha batAe~|

cunA~ce jaba rihAI pAne vAlA vyakti yUsufa ke pAsa pahu~cA, to unase kahA: ai yUsufa! ai sacce inasAna! hameM aise vyakti ke sapane kA artha batAeM, jisane dekhA ki sAta moTI gAyoM ko sAta dubalI gAe~ khA rahI haiM, tathA usane sAta harI bAliyoM aura sAta sUkhI bAliyoM ko dekhA hai| tAki maiM rAjA aura usake sAthiyoM ke pAsa vApasa jAU~ aura ve rAjA ke sapane kA artha jAna sakeM| tathA ve ApakI pratiSThA aura ApakI sthiti jAna sakeM|

yUsufa alaihissalAma ne isa sapane kI vyAkhyA karate hue kahA: tuma lagAtAra sAta sAloM taka pUrI mehanata ke sAtha khetI karoge| ataH sAta sAloM meM se hara sAla jo bhI fasala kATo, use kIr3A lagane se bacAne ke lie usakI bAliyoM meM rahane do| sivAya thor3e se anAja ke jise tumheM khAne ke lie z2arUrata par3e|

phira una sAta upajAU varSoM ke bAda, jinameM tuma khUba khetI karoge, sAta akAla vAle varSa Ae~ge, jinameM loga upajAU sAloM meM kATI hue sArI fasaloM ko khA jAe~ge| sivAya thor3e se hisse ke jise tuma bIja ke taura para surakSita kara loge|

phira una akAla vAle sAloM ke bAda eka aisA sAla AegA jisameM qhUba bAriza hogI aura khetiyA~ ugeMgI, aura loga una cIz2oM kA rasa nicor3eMge, jinakA rasa nicor3ane kI AvazyakatA hotI hai, jaise ki aMgUra, z2aitUna aura Ikha Adi|

jaba rAjA ko patA calA ki yUsufa ne usake sapane kA artha batAyA hai, to usane apane sahayogiyoM se kahA: use jela se bAhara nikAlo aura mere pAsa lAo| lekina jaba rAjA kA dUta yUsufa ke pAsa AyA, to unhoMne usase kahA: tuma apane svAmI rAjA ke pAsa vApasa jAo aura usase una mahilAoM kI kahAnI ke bAre meM pUcho, jinhoMne apane hAtha ghAyala kara lie the, tAki jela se nikalane se pahale unakI begunAhI spaSTa ho jAe| niHsaMdeha, unhoMne mujhe rijhAne kA jo prayAsa kiyA thA, use merA pAlanahAra jAnatA hai| vaha usase chipA nahIM hai|

rAjA ne striyoM ko saMbodhita karate hue kahA: usa samaya tumhArA kyA mAmalA thA, jaba tumane chala ke dvArA yUsufa ko apane sAtha kukarma karane ke lie prerita karane kI koziza kI thI? striyoM ne rAjA ke javAba meM kahA: allAha na kare ki yUsufa para Aropa lagAyA jAe, allAha kI qasama! hamane usameM koI burAI nahIM dekhI| isapara az2Iz2a kI patnI ne jo kucha kiyA thA, usako svIkArate hue kahA: aba saccAI sAmane A gaI hai, maiMne hI use bahakAne kI koziza kI thI, usane mujhe phusalAne kI koziza nahIM kI| niHsaMdeha usane mere lagAe hue Aropa se nirdoSa hone kA jo dAvA kiyA hai, usameM vaha bilkula saccA hai|

az2Iz2a kI strI ne kahA: maiMne isa bAta kA iqarAra ki maiMne hI use rijhAyA thA aura vaha saccA hai, isa uddezya se kiyA hai ki yUsufa jAna le ki maiMne usakI anupasthiti meM usapara Aropa nahIM mar3hA hai| kyoMki jo kucha aba taka huA, usase mere lie yaha spaSTa ho gayA ki ki allAha jhUTha bolane vAle aura fareba karane vAle ko saphala nahIM karatA|

aura az2Iz2a kI strI ne apanI bAta jArI rakhate hue kahA: maiM khuda ko burAI kI icchA se pAka nahIM ThaharAtI aura na isase merA uddezya apanI pavitratA sAbita karanA thA| kyoMki inasAna ke mana kA mAmalA yaha hai ki vaha icchAoM kI ora jhukAva rakhane aura unase bacanA kaThina hone ke kAraNa, burAI kA bahuta z2yAdA Adeza dene vAlA hai| sivAya usake jisapara allAha dayA kare aura use burAI kA Adeza dene se surakSita rakhe| nizcaya merA pAlanahAra apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko kSamA karane vAlA aura unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

jaba yUsufa kI begunAhI spaSTa ho gaI aura rAjA ko usakA jJAna ho gayA, to usane apane sahayogiyoM se kahA: unheM mere pAsa lAo| maiM unheM apane lie qhAsa kara lU~gA| cunA~ce unheM rAjA ke pAsa lAyA gayA| phira jaba rAjA ne unase bAta kI aura unakA jJAna aura buddhi usake lie spaSTa ho gaI, to usane unase kahA: nizcaya (ai yUsufa!) Apa Aja hamAre yahA~ eka pada-pratiSThA vAle aura vizvasanIya vyakti bana gae haiM|

yUsufa ne rAjA se kahA: mujhe misra ke deza meM dhana evaM anAja ke qhaz2AnoM ke saMrakSaNa para niyukta kara dIjie, kyoMki maiM eka vizvasanIya koSAdhyakSa hU~ aura jo z2immedArI le rahA hU~ usakA jAnakAra aura samajha rakhane vAlA hU~|

jisa taraha hamane yUsufa para nirdoSatA aura jela se mukti ke dvArA upakAra kiyA, usI taraha hamane unheM misra kI dharatI meM sazakta banAkara unapara upakAra kiyA| vaha jahA~ cAheM jAe~ aura jahA~ cAheM raheM| hama isa duniyA meM apane baMdoM meM se jise cAhate haiM, apanI dayA pradAna karate haiM, aura hama acche karma karane vAloM kA savAba barbAda nahIM karate, balki unheM use binA kamI ke pUrA dete haiM|

nizcaya allAha kA badalA, jo usane Aqhirata meM taiyAra kiyA hai, una logoM ke lie duniyA ke badale se behatara hai, jo allAha para ImAna lAe aura usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara, usase Darate rahe|

aura yUsufa ke bhAI apane sAmAna lekara misra Ae| jaba ve unake pAsa gae to vaha pahacAna gae ki ve unake bhAI haiM, jabaki ve pahacAna nahIM sake ki vaha unakA bhAI (yUsufa) hai, kyoMki kAfI samaya bIta cukA thA aura unakI zakla-sUrata bhI badala cukI thI| kyoMki jaba unhoMne yUsufa ko kue~ meM DAlA thA, to vaha bacce the|

aura jaba yUsufa ne unako vaha anAja aura khAdya-sAmagrI de dI, jo unhoMne mA~gI aura jaba unhoMne batAyA ki unakA eka bApa-zarIka (sautelA) bhAI hai, jise ve usake pitA ke pAsa chor3a Ae haiM, to kahA: tuma apane bApa zarIka bhAI ko mere pAsa le AnA, maiM tumheM eka U~Ta ke bhAra kA g2allA adhika dU~gA| kyA tuma nahIM dekhate ki maiM pUrI mApa detA hU~, usameM kamI nahIM karatA aura maiM sabase acchA mehamAna navAz2a hU~|

yadi tuma use mere pAsa nahIM lAe, to tumhArA apane isa dAve meM jhUThA honA spaSTa ho jAegA ki tumhArA eka bApa zarIka bhAI hai| phira maiM tumheM kabhI bhojana nahIM dU~gA aura tuma mere deza kA rukha nahIM karanA|

to unake bhAiyoM ne unheM uttara dete hue kahA: hama usake pitA se isake lie anurodha kareMge aura isake lie bharapUra prayAsa kareMge| tathA Apane hameM jo Adeza diyA hai, hama nizcita rUpa se use kisI lAparavAhI ke binA avazya karane vAle haiM|

aura yUsufa ne apane kAryakartAoM se kahA: ina logoM kA dhana inheM lauTA do, tAki ve apanI vApasI para jAna sakeM ki hamane unase yaha nahIM kharIdA hai| aura yaha unheM apane bhAI ke sAtha phira se lauTane ke lie majabUra karegA, tAki ve yUsufa ke sAmane apanI saccAI sAbita kareM aura yUsufa unase unakA dhana svIkAra kara leM|

jaba ve apane pitA ke pAsa lauTe, aura unheM batAyA ki yUsufa ne unakA kisa taraha sammAna kiyA hai, to unhoMne kahA: he hamAre pitA! hamAre apane bhAI ko apane sAtha na lAne para hamase g2alle kI ApUrti roka dI gaI hai| isalie use hamAre sAtha bhejeM| kyoMki yadi Apa use hamAre sAtha bhejate haiM, to hameM g2alle kA mApa milegA| aura hama Apase usakI taba taka rakSA karane kI pratijJA karate haiM jaba taka ki vaha Apake pAsa surakSita rUpa se vApasa na A jAe|

unake pitA ne unase kahA: kyA maiM usake bAre meM tumapara usI taraha vizvAsa karU~, jisa taraha isase pahale usake sage bhAI yUsufa ke bAre meM tumapara vizvAsa kiyA thA?! maiMne usake bAre meM tumapara bharosA kiyA thA, aura tumane usakI rakSA karane kI pratijJA kI thI| lekina tumane jo pratijJA kI thI, use pUrA nahIM kiyA| isalie mujhe usakI rakSA karane kI tumhArI pratijJA kA koI bharosA nahIM hai, balki merA bharosA kevala allAha para hai| kyoMki vaha jisakI rakSA karanA cAhe, usakA sabase acchA rakSaka hai aura jisapara dayA karanA cAhe, usapara sabase adhika dayA karane vAlA hai|

jaba unhoMne apane lAe hue anAja kI boriyA~ kholIM, to dekhA ki usakA dAma vApasa kara diyA gayA hai| yaha dekhakara unhoMne apane pitA se kahA: isa sammAna ke bAda hameM isa az2Iz2a se aura kyA cAhie? yaha hamAre anAja kA dAma hai, jise az2Iz2a ne apane anugraha se hameM vApasa kara diyA hai| hama apane ghara vAloM ke lie anAja le Ae~ge aura apane bhAI kI usase rakSA kareMge jisakA Apako bhaya hai, aura use sAtha le jAne ke kAraNa eka U~Ta ke bojhabhara g2allA adhika lAe~ge| kyoMki az2Iz2a ke lie eka U~Ta kI mApa bar3hAnA bahuta AsAna hai|

unake pitA ne unase kahA: maiM use tumhAre sAtha haragiz2a nahIM bhejU~gA, yahA~ taka ki tuma mujhe allAha kA dRr3ha vacana do ki use mere pAsa vApasa lAoge, sivAya isa sthiti ke ki tuma saba ko vinAza ghera le aura tumameM se koI na bace, aura tuma use na rokane meM sakSama ho aura na hI vApasa lauTane meM| jaba unhoMne yAqUba alaihissalAma ko allAha kA dRr3ha vacana de diyA, to unhoMne kahA: hama jo kucha kaha rahe haiM, usapara allAha gavAha hai| isalie usakI gavAhI hamAre lie paryApta hai|

aura unake pitA ne unheM vasIyata karate hue kahA: tuma loga misra meM eka sAtha eka hI dvAra se praveza na karanA, balki alaga-alaga daravAz2oM se praveza karanA| yaha surakSA ke dRSTikoNa se adhika uttama hai, ki yadi koI tumheM hAni pahu~cAnA cAhe to saba usake zikAra na ho| maiM yaha bAta tumase isalie nahIM kaha rahA hU~ ki tumase koI aisA nukasAna dUra kara dU~, jisase allAha tumheM pIr3ita karanA cAhatA hai, yA tumheM koI aisA lAbha pahu~cA dU~, jo allAha nahIM cAhatA hai| kyoMki faisalA to kevala allAha kA hai aura Adeza to kevala usI kA calatA hai| maiMne apane sabhI mAmaloM meM akele usI para bharosA kiyA hai, aura bharosA karane vAloM ko akele usI para bharosA karanA cAhie|

cunA~ce ve cala par3e| unake sAtha yUsufa kA sagA bhAI bhI thA| jaba ve apane pitA ke AdezAnusAra alaga-alaga daravAjoM se praveza kie, to unakA alaga-alaga daravAjoM se praveza karanA unase allAha kI unapara niyata kI huI koI cIz2a TAlane vAlA nahIM thA| yaha to kevala yAqUba alaihissalAma kA apane beToM ke prati sneha thA, jise unhoMne prakaTa kara diyA aura unheM usakI vasIyata kara dI| hAlA~ki unheM khUba patA thA ki allAha ke phaisale ke alAvA koI phaisalA nahIM hai| kyoMki hamane unheM taqadIra (bhAgya) para ImAna rakhane aura kAraNoM ko apanAne kI jo zikSA dI the, usakA vaha jJAna rakhate the| lekina adhikAMza loga yaha nahIM jAnate haiM|

jaba yUsufa ke bhAI yUsufa ke pAsa Ae, aura unake sAtha yUsufa kA sagA bhAI bhI thA, to unhoMne apane sage bhAI ko apane sAtha kara liyA aura cupake se usase kahA: maiM tumhArA sagA bhAI: yUsufa hU~| ataH una dhRSTa aura avivekapUrNa kAryoM se duHkhI na ho, jo tumhAre bhAI karate Ae haiM, jaise kaSTa denA, hamase IrSyA karanA aura mujhe kue~ meM pheMkanA|

phira jaba yUsufa ne apane sevakoM ko apane bhAiyoM ke U~ToM para g2allA lAdane kA Adeza diyA, to rAjA ke mApane ke bartana ko jisase g2allA lene vAloM ko mApakara diyA karate the, unake jJAna ke binA apane sage bhAI kI borI meM DAla diyA, tAki vaha use apane pAsa rakha sakeM|| phira jaba ve apane parivAra kI ora vApasa lauTane ke lie nikalane par3e, to pIche se eka AvAz2a dene vAle ne AvAz2a dI: ai anna se lade hue U~ToM vAlo! nizcaya tuma cora ho|
yUsufa ke bhAiyoM ne pIche se AvAz2a dene vAle aura usake sAthiyoM kI ora mutavajjeha hokara kahA: tumhArI kyA cIz2a kho gaI hai ki hamapara corI kA Aropa lagA rahe ho?

AvAz2a lagAne vAle aura usake sAthiyoM ne yUsufa ke bhAiyoM se kahA: hamase rAjA kA mApaka kho gayA hai, jisase mApakara dete haiM| jo vyakti talAzI se pahale rAjA kA mApaka le AegA, use puraskAra diyA jAegA aura vaha eka U~Ta ke bojhabhara g2allA hai| aura maiM usake lie isakI gAraMTI detA hU~|

yUsufa ke bhAiyoM ne unase kahA: allAha kI qasama! nizcaya tuma hamArI ImAnadArI aura begunAhI ko jAna cuke ho, jaisA ki tumane hamArI sthitiyoM se dekhA hai| yaqIna mAno hama misra meM bigAr3a paidA karane ke lie nahIM Ae haiM, aura hama apane jIvana meM kabhI cora nahIM the|
AvAz2a dene vAle aura usake sAthiyoM ne kahA: tumhAre yahA~ usakI corI karane vAle kA kyA daMDa hai, yadi tuma corI se barI hone ke apane dAve meM jhUThe nikale?

yUsufa ke bhAiyoM ne unase kahA: hamAre yahA~ corI kA daMDa yaha hai ki jisake sAmAna meM corI kA mAla mile, usakI garadana usa vyakti ke havAle kara dI jAtI hai, jisakA mAla corI huA hai aura vaha use apanA g2ulAma banA letA hai| isa taraha g2ulAma banAne ke daMDa ke sAtha hama coroM ko daMDita karate haiM|

cunA~ce ve unakI boriyoM kI talAzI ke lie unheM yUsufa ke pAsa vApasa le Ae| yUsufa ne yojanA ko gupta rakhane ke lie, apane sage bhAI kI borI kA nirIkSaNa karane se pahale apane sautele bhAiyoM kI boriyoM kI talAzI lenI zurU kI| phira aMta meM apane sage bhAI kI borI kI talAzI lI aura usameM se rAjA kA mApaka nikAlA| hamane jisa taraha yUsufa ko apane bhAI kI borI meM mApaka rakhane kA upAya sujhAyA, usI taraha hamane usake lie eka aura upAya kiyA ki usake bhAiyoM ne cora ko dAsa banAne ke apane deza ke daMDa saMhitA ko apanAyA| hAlA~ki aisA saMbhava nahIM hotA, yadi cora ke lie rAjA ke daMDa ko lAgU kiyA jAtA, jo ki piTAI karanA aura jurmAnA lagAnA thA| sivAya isake ki allAha koI aura upAya cAhatA, kyoMki vaha usakA sAmarthya rakhatA hai| hama apane baMdoM meM se jisake bhI cAhate haiM, pada U~ce kara dete haiM, jaise ki hamane yUsufa kA pada U~cA kara diyA| aura hara jJAna vAle vyakti ke Upara, usase adhika jJAna vAlA maujUda hai| aura sabhI logoM ke jJAna ke Upara allAha kA jJAna hai, jo saba kucha jAnatA hai|

yUsufa ke bhAiyoM ne kahA: yadi isane corI kI hai, to koI Azcarya nahIM hai| kyoMki isakI isa corI se pahale isake eka sage bhAI ne bhI corI kI thI| unakA abhipreta yUsufa alaihissalAma the| kiMtu yUsufa ne unakI isa bAta se apane Ahata hone ko gupta rakhA, aura ise unake sAmane prakaTa nahIM kiyA| unhoMne apane dila meM unase kahA: tuma jo IrSyA rakhate ho aura pahale jo durvyavahAra kara cuke ho, isa sthAna para svayaM vahI burAI hai| aura tuma jo yaha mithyAropaNa kara rahe ho, allAha use sabase adhika jAnatA hai|

yUsufa ke bhAiyoM ne yUsufa se kahA: ai az2Iz2a! isakA eka bahuta bUr3hA bApa hai, jo isase bahuta prema karatA hai| isalie hamameM se kisI ko isake sthAna para rakha lIjie| hama dekhate haiM ki Apa hamAre mAmale tathA hamAre sivA anya logoM ke mAmale meM upakAra karane vAle haiM| isalie hamapara yaha upakAra kara dIjie|

yUsufa alaihissalAma ne kahA: isa bAta se allAha kI zaraNa cAhate haiM ki hama eka atyAcArI ke aparAdha ke kAraNa eka nirdoSa para atyAcAra kareM aura usake alAvA kisI anya vyakti ko pakar3a le, jisakI borI meM hamane rAjA kA mApaka pAyA hai! yadi hamane aisA kiyA to nizcaya hama atyAcArI ThahareMge| kyoMki hamane eka nirdoSa ko daMDita kiyA aura aparAdhI ko chor3a diyA|

jaba ve yUsufa ke unake anurodha ko svIkAra karane se nirAza ho gae, to parAmarza karane ke lie logoM se alaga ho gae| unake bar3e bhAI ne kahA: maiM tumheM yAda dilAtA hU~ ki tumhAre pitA ne tumase allAha kA dRr3ha vacana liyA hai ki tuma unake beTe ko vApasa le Aoge, sivAya isake ki tumheM koI aisI vipatti ghera le, jise rokane meM tuma asamartha ho| tathA isase pahale tumane yUsufa ke bAre meM kotAhI kI aura usake bAre meM apane pitA kI pratijJA pUrI nahIM kI| isalie maiM misra kI dharatI taba taka nahIM chor3U~gA, jaba taka ki mere pitA mujhe apane pAsa lauTane kI anumati na pradAna kara deM, yA allAha mere lie mere bhAI ko lene kA phaisalA na kara de| aura allAha saba phaisalA karane vAloM se behatara hai| kyoMki vaha satya aura nyAya ke anusAra phaisalA karatA hai|

aura bar3e bhAI ne kahA: apane pitA ke pAsa vApasa jAo aura unase kaho: Apake beTe ne corI kI hai| isalie az2Iz2a -e- misra ne corI kI saz2A ke taura para use dAsa banA liyA hai| hama to vahI kaha rahe haiM, jo hamane jAnA hai| kyoMki hamane dekhA hai ki paimAnA usI kI borI se nikAlA gayA thA| hameM kyA patA thA ki vaha corI karegA| yadi patA hotA, to hama Apako use vApasa lAne kA vacana nahIM dete|

aura hamArI satyatA ko satyApita karane ke lie (ai hamAre pitA!) misra vAsiyoM se pUcha leM, jahA~ hama the aura usa qAfile vAloM se pUcha leM, jisake sAtha hama Ae haiM| ve saba Apako vahI batAe~ge, jo hamane batAyA hai| niHsaMdeha hamane Apako usake corI karane kI jo bAta batAI hai, usameM hama bilakula sacce haiM|

unake pitA ne unase kahA: tumane usake corI karane kI jo bAta batAI hai, vAstava meM mAmalA vaisA nahIM hai| balki tumhAre diloM ne tumhAre lie isa bAta ko zobhita kara diyA hai ki tuma usake viruddha bhI usI taraha cAla calo, jisa taraha isase pahale usake bhAI yUsufa ke viruddha cAla cala cuke ho| isalie merA kAma uttama sabra karanA hai, jisameM kevala allAha hI se zikAyata hai| ummIda hai ki allAha yUsufa, usake sage bhAI aura unake bar3e bhAI, saba ko mere pAsa vApasa le Ae| niHsaMdeha vahI pavitra allAha mere hAla se avagata hai aura mere mAmale ke prabaMdhana meM hikamata vAlA hai|

vaha unase mu~ha pherate hue dUra haTa gae aura kahA: hAya mere duHkha kI tIvratA yUsufa kI judAI para! aura yUsufa kI judAI para rote-rote unakI A~khoM ke kAle bhAga safeda ho cuke the| cunA~ce unakA dila zoka tathA duHkha se bharA huA thA, vaha apane duHkha ko logoM se chipAte the|

yUsufa ke bhAiyoM ne apane pitA se kahA: allAha kI qasama! (ai hamAre pitA!) Apa hamezA yUsufa ko yAda karate raheMge aura usake lie zoka manAte raheMge, yahA~ taka ki Apa saqhta bImAra ho jAe~, yA prANa hI tyAga deM|

unake pitA ne unase kahA: maiM jisa zoka aura duHkha se pIr3ita hU~ usakI zikAyata kevala allAha se karatA hU~| aura maiM allAha kI dayA, usake upakAra, parezAna hAla kI duA qabUla karane aura pIr3ita ko badalA dene ke bAre meM jo jAnatA hU~, vaha tuma nahIM jAnate|

unake pitA ne unase kahA: ai mere beTo! jAo aura yUsufa tathA usake bhAI kI khabara ke bAre meM patA karo| aura allAha ke apane baMdoM kI parezAnI ko dUra karane aura rAhata dene se nirAza na ho| vAstava meM, kevala kAfira loga hI allAha ke parezAnI ko dUra karane aura rAhata dene se nirAza hote haiM| kyoMki ve allAha kI mahAna zakti aura usake apane baMdoM para gupta anugraha se anabhijJa hote haiM|

unhoMne apane pitA ke Adeza kA pAlana kiyA aura yUsufa tathA unake bhAI ko DhU~Dhane ke lie nikala par3e| cunAMce jaba yUsufa ke pAsa pahu~ce to kahA: hama kaThinAI aura garIbI se pIr3ita haiM aura thor3A-sA tuccha dhana lekara Ae haiM| ataH hameM bharapUra mApa dIjie, jaise isase pahale hameM dete Ae haiM| aura usase kucha bar3hAkara yA hamAre tuccha dhana ko naz2ara aMdAz2a karake, hameM dAna dIjie| niHsaMdeha allAha dAna karane vAloM ko uttama badalA pradAna karatA hai|

yUsufa ne jaba unakI bAta sunI to unapara dayA A gaI aura dila pasIja gayA aura unase apanI pahacAna karA dI| unase pharamAyA: tuma jAnate ho ki tumane yUsufa aura usake sage bhAI ke sAtha kyA kiyA thA, jaba tuma usake pariNAma se anabhijJa the jo tumane una donoM ke sAtha kiyA thA?!

ve Azcaryacakita ho gae aura bole: kyA nizcaya Apa hI yUsufa haiM?! to yUsufa ne unase kahA: hA~, maiM yUsufa hU~ aura yaha, jise tuma mere sAtha dekha rahe ho, merA sagA bhAI hai| allAha ne hamapara anugraha kiyA hai ki hameM usa cIz2a se mukti dilAI hai, jisameM hama the aura hamAre pada ko U~cA kara diyA| niHsaMdeha jo allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara, usase DaratA hai aura vipatti para dhairya rakhatA hai, to usakA yaha kArya sadAcAra meM se hai, aura allAha sadAcAriyoM kA badalA naSTa nahIM karatA, balki vaha unake lie use surakSita rakhatA hai|

unake bhAiyoM ne unake sAtha jo kucha kiyA thA usake lie kSamAyAcanA karate hue kahA: allAha kI qasama! allAha ne Apako pUrNatA ke guNa pradAna karake hamapara zreSThatA pradAna kiyA hai| aura hamane Apake sAtha jo kucha kiyA thA, usameM hama doSI aura atyAcArI the|

yUsufa alaihissalAma ne unakI kSamAyAcanA ko svIkAra kara liyA aura kahA: Aja tumapara koI doSa nahIM hai jisake lie tumheM daMDita karane yA phaTakAra lagAne kI AvazyakatA ho| maiM allAha se prArthanA karatA hU~ ki vaha tumheM kSamA kare| vaha pavitra allAha dayA karane vAloM meM sabase adhika dayA karane vAlA hai|

cunA~ce jaba yUsufa ke bhAiyoM ne unheM batAyA ki unake pitA kI A~khoM kI rozanI calI gaI hai, to unheM apanA kurtA de diyA aura kahA: mere isa kurte ko le jAo aura ise mere pitA ke cehare para DAla do, unakI A~khoM kI rozanI lauTa AegI| phira apane tamAma ghara vAloM ko mere pAsa le Ao|

aura jaba qAfilA misra se cala par3A aura usakI AbAdiyoM se nikala gayA, to yAqUba alaihissalAma ne apane beToM aura apane pAsa maujUda logoM se kahA: nizcaya mujhe yUsufa kI sugaMdha A rahI hai, yadi tuma mujhe nAsamajha na samajho aura yaha na kahane lago ki yaha bahakA huA bUr3hA hai| aisI bAta karatA hai, jo khuda nahIM jAnatA|
unake pAsa maujUda unake beToM ne kahA: allAha kI qasama! Apa abhI bhI apane nikaTa yUsufa kI sthiti aura unheM phira se dekhane kI saMbhAvanA ke bAre meM apane pichale bhrama meM haiM|

phira jaba yAqUba ke lie qhuziyoM bharI qhabara lAne vAlA vyakti AyA, usane yUsufa kA kurtA unake cehare para DAla diyA, to vaha dekhane lage| taba unhoMne apane beToM se kahA: kyA maiMne tumase kahA nahIM thA ki mujhe allAha kI dayA aura upakAra kI jo bAteM mAlUma haiM, tuma unheM nahIM jAnate?

yAqUba alaihissalAma ke beToM ne yUsufa aura unake bhAI ke sAtha jo kucha kiyA thA usake lie apane bApa se mAfI mA~gate hue kahA: ai hamAre pitA! allAha se hamAre pichale pApoM ke lie kSamA mA~ge| nizcita rUpa se hamane yUsufa aura unake sage bhaI ke sAtha jo kucha kiyA thA, usameM hama gunahagAra aura doSI the|
unake pitA ne unase kahA: maiM apane pAlanahAra se tumhAre lie kSamA mA~gU~gA| niHsaMdeha vahI apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ke pApoM ko mAfa karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

yAqUba alaihissalAma aura unakA parivAra misra meM yUsufa ke pAsa jAne ke lie nikala par3A| jaba ve yUsufa ke pAsa pahu~ce, to yUsufa ne apane mAtA-pitA ko apane se qarIba kara liyA aura apane bhAiyoM tathA unake parijanoM se kahA: allAha kI icchA se surakSita va nizciMta misra meM praveza karo, tumheM yahA~ koI kaSTa nahIM hogA|

tathA unhoMne apane mAtA-pitA ko usa siMhAsana para biThAyA, jisa para vaha baiThate the| aura unako unake mAtA-pitA evaM gyAraha bhAiyoM ne sajadA karake salAma peza kiyA| jJAta ho ki yaha sammAna kA sajadA thA, ibAdata kA nahIM| yaha allAha ke Adeza kI pUrti ke rUpa meM thA jaisA ki svapna meM dikhAyA gayA thA| isIlie yUsufa alaihissalAma ne apane pitA se kahA: Apa logoM kA yaha mujhe sajadA karake abhivAdana karanA, mere usa sapane kA sAkAra rUpa hai, jise maiMne pahale dekhA thA aura Apako batAyA thA| Aja mere raba ne usake ghaTita hone se use saca kara diyA| nizcaya mere pAlanahAra ne mujhapara upakAra kiyA, jaba mujhe qaidakhAne se nikAlA aura jaba Apako dehAta se yahA~ le AyA, jabaki zaitAna ne mere aura mere bhAiyoM ke bIca bigAr3a paidA kara diyA thA| niHsaMdeha merA pAlanahAra jo cAhe, usakA upAya karane meM atyaMta sUkSma hai| niHsaMdeha vaha apane baMdoM ke hAlAta se pUrI taraha avagata, apane prabaMdhana meM pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai|

phira yUsufa ne apane pAlanahAra se duA kI| kahA: ai mere raba! tUne mujhe misra kA rAjya pradAna kiyA aura mujhe sapnoM kA artha sikhAyA| ai AkAzoM aura dharatI ke paidA karane vAle tathA unheM kisI pUrva namUne ke binA banAne vAle! tU hI sAMsArika jIvana meM mere sabhI mAmaloM kA saMrakSaka hai, tathA Aqhirata meM bhI mere sabhI mAmaloM kA saMrakSaka hai| mere jIvana ke aMta meM, mujhe eka musalamAna ke rUpa meM uThA aura mujhe jannata ke sabase ucca sthAna meM mere bApa-dAdAoM tathA anya logoM meM se sadAcArI nabiyoM ke sAtha milA de|

yUsufa aura unake bhAiyoM kI yaha ullikhita kahAnI, hama isakI (ai rasUla) ApakI ora vaha़ya kara rahe haiM| Apako isakI jAnakArI nahIM thI| kyoMki Apa yUsufa ke bhAiyoM ke pAsa maujUda nahIM the, jaba unhoMne yUsufa ko kue~ ke aMdara DAlane kA nirNaya kiyA thA aura isake lie eka bar3I cAla calI thI| lekina hamane ApakI ora isakI vaha़ya kI|
aura adhikAMza loga haragiz2a ImAna lAne vAle nahIM haiM, cAhe (ai rasUla) Apa unake ImAna ke lie hara saMbhava prayAsa kara leM| isalie Apa unapara afasosa na kareM|

yadi ve samajha-bUjha se kAma lete to Apa para ImAna le Ate| kyoMki (ai rasUla) Apa unase quraAna tathA dharma pracAra para koI pArizramika nahIM mA~gate| quraAna to kevala sabhI logoM ke lie eka upadeza (yAdadehAnI) hai|

allAha pAka ke ekala pUjya hone ko darzAne vAlI bahuta-sI nizAniyA~ haiM, jo AkAzoM tathA dharatI meM phailI huI haiM, jinapara se ve guz2arate haiM, paraMtu ve una para vicAra karane aura unase sIkha lene se upekSA karane vAle hote haiM, unapara koI dhyAna nahIM dete haiM|

adhikAMza loga allAha para yaha ImAna nahIM rakhate ki vaha paidA karane vAlA, roz2I dene vAlA, jIvana evaM mRtyu dene vAlA hai, paraMtu isa hAla meM ki ve usake sAtha anya mUrtiyoM aura butoM kI pUjA karate haiM aura yaha dAvA karate haiM ki allAha kA koI beTA hai, allAha isase bahuta pavitra hai|

to kyA ye muzrika loga isa bAta se nizciMta ho gae haiM ki unapara duniyA meM koI saz2A A jAe, jo unheM DhA~ka le aura ve use TAla na sakeM, yA unapara acAnaka qiyAmata A jAe, aura unheM usake Ane kI bhanaka taka na lage ki usake lie taiyArI kara leM| kyA isI (nirbhaya hone ke) kAraNa ye loga ImAna nahIM lAe?

(ai rasUla!) Apa usase kaha dIjie jise Apa AmaMtrita karate haiM: yahI merA mArga hai jisakI ora maiM logoM ko AmaMtrita karatA hU~| maiM isakI ora spaSTa tarka ke sAtha AmaMtrita karatA hU~, tathA merA anusaraNa karane vAle, mere mArgadarzana ko grahaNa karane vAle aura merI sunnata (tarIqe) kA pAlana karane vAle (bhI) isI kI ora AmaMtrita karate haiM| tathA allAha pavitra hai usa cIz2a se jisakI usakI ora nisbata kI gaI hai jo usakI mahimA ke yogya nahIM hai, yA usakI pUrNatA ke viparIta hai aura maiM allAha kA sAjhI ThaharAne vAloM meM se nahIM hU~| balki, maiM usake ekezvaravAdiyoM meM se hU~|

(ai rasUla!) hamane Apase pahale mAnava jAti meM se puruSoM hI ko (nabI banAkara) bheje, phariztoM ko nahIM| hama unakI ora vaha़ya karate the, jaise hamane ApakI ora vaha़ya kI hai| ve zaharoM ke logoM meM se the, dehAta vAloM meM se nahIM| unake samudAyoM ne unheM jhuThalAyA, to hamane unheM naSTa kara diyA| to kyA Apako jhuThalAne vAle ye loga dharatI meM nahIM cale-phire ki vicAra karate ki inase pahale jhuThalAne vAloM kA aMta kaisA rahA aura unase sIkha prApta karate?! aura Aqhirata kI nemateM una logoM ke lie uttama haiM, jo duniyA meM allAha se Darate rahe| to kyA tuma nahIM samajhate ki yaha uttama hai, isalie (tuma bhI) allAha se, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake (jinameM sabase mahAna ImAna hai) aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara (jinameM sabase bar3A zirka hai), Darane lago|

hama ina rasUloM ke duzmanoM ko mohalata dete rahate haiM aura isI DhIla ke kAraNa unheM az2Aba dene meM jaldI nahIM karate| yahA~ taka ki jaba unheM vinAza karane meM derI ho gaI aura rasUla unake vinAza se nirAza ho gae aura kAfiroM ko yaqIna ho gayA ki unake rasUloM ne unase jhuThalAne vAloM ke az2Aba aura mominoM kI mukti kA jo vAdA kiyA thA, vaha jhUThA thA; to rasUloM ke pAsa hamArI madada A gaI aura rasUloM tathA mominoM ko jhuThalAne vAloM para Ane vAle vinAza se bacA liyA gayA| aura hamArA az2Aba jaba aparAdhiyoM para A jAtA hai, to use haTAyA nahIM jAtA hai|

rasUloM kI kahAniyoM aura unake samudAyoM kI kahAniyoM meM, tathA yUsufa alaihissalAma aura unake bhAiyoM kI kahAniyoM meM bar3I sIkha aura upadeza hai, jisase sadbuddhi vAle upadeza grahaNa karate haiM| ina kathAoM para AdhArita quraAna koI gar3hA huA kalAma nahIM hai, jo jhUTha-mUTha allAha kI ora manasUba kara diyA gayA ho| balki yaha allAha kI ora se utarane vAlI divya pustakoM kI puSTi karane vAlA, jina zaraI prAvadhAnoM aura niyamoM ke vistRta hone kI AvazyakatA hai unakA vistRta vivaraNa, hara bhalAI ke lie mArgadarzana aura usapara ImAna rakhane vAloM ke lie dayA hai| kyoMki vahI usakI zikSAoM se lAbha uThAte haiM|

{alifa॰ lAma॰ mIma॰ rA॰|} sUratula-baqarA ke AraMbha meM isa prakAra ke akSaroM ke bAre meM bAta guz2ara cukI hai| isa sUrata kI ye ucca AyateM aura quraAna jise allAha ne (ai rasUla!) Apapara utArA hai, vaha satya haiM, jisameM koI saMzaya nahIM hai, aura isameM koI saMdeha nahIM hai ki yaha allAha kI ora se hai| kiMtu adhikAMza loga haTha aura ahaMkAra ke kAraNa isapara ImAna nahIM lAte|

allAha vaha hai, jisane khaMbhoM ke binA AkAzoM ko U~cA banAyA, jinheM tuma dekhate ho| phira arza (siMhAsana) para bulaMda huA, jaisA usakI mahimA ke yogya hai| hama usake bulaMda hone kI koI dazA evaM sthiti nahIM nirdhArita karate aura na use kisI cIz2a ke samAna qarAra dete haiM| usane sUrya evaM caMdramA ko apanI sRSTi ke lAbhoM ke lie vazIbhUta kara diyA| sUrya aura caMdramA meM se pratyeka allAha ke jJAna meM eka viziSTa avadhi ke lie cala rahA hai| vaha pAka allAha AsamAnoM aura dharatI meM pUrNa mAmale kA jaise cAhatA hai, saMcAlana karatA hai| vaha apanI zakti ko darzAne vAlI nizAniyA~ khola-kholakara bayAna karatA hai, tAki tuma qiyAmata ke dina apane raba se milane para vizvAsa kara lo, phira usake lie acche kAryoM ke sAtha taiyArI karane lago|

to kyA jo sabhI sRSTi kI jIvikA ke saMrakSaNa kA z2immedAra, hara prANI ke kAryoM kI nigarAnI karane vAlA hai, cunA~ce vaha use usake kAryoM kA badalA degA, vaha upAsanA kie jAne ke adhika yogya hai, yA ye mUrtiyA~ jinheM isa bAta kA koI adhikAra nahIM ki unakI pUjA kI jAe? hAlA~ki kAfiroM ne unheM anyAyapUrvaka aura jhUThamUTha allAha kA sAjhI banA liyA hai| (ai rasUla!) Apa unase kaha deM: tuma hameM una sAjhiyoM ke nAma batAo, jinakI tumane allAha ke sAtha pUjA kI hai, yadi tuma apane dAve meM sacce ho| yA kyA tuma allAha ko aise sAjhiyoM ke bAre meM batA rahe ho, jinheM vaha dharatI meM nahIM jAnatA? yA phira tuma use eka UparI bAta batA rahe ho, jisameM koI saccAI nahIM hai? balki, zaitAna ne inakAra karane vAloM kI naz2ara meM unake chala ko suMdara banA diyA hai, jisake kAraNa ve allAha kA inakAra kara baiThe haiM aura zaitAna ne unheM hidAyata ke rAste se haTA diyA hai| aura jise allAha hidAyata ke mArga se dUra kara de, usake lie koI mArgadarzaka nahIM, jo usakA mArgadarzana kara sake|

isa sAMsArika jIvana hI meM unake lie yAtanA hai ki unheM mominoM ke hAthoM qatla evaM qaida kA sAmanA karanA par3egA| jabaki Aqhirata kI yAtanA jo unakI pratIkSA kara rahI hai, unake lie duniyA kI yAtanA se adhika kaThora aura bhArI hai| kyoMki usameM tIvratA aura nirbAdha sthAyitva hogA| aura unheM qiyAmata ke dina allAha kI yAtanA se koI bacAne vAlA bhI na hogA|

usa jannata kI vizeSatA jisakA allAha ne una logoM se vAdA kiyA hai, jo usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara usase Darane vAle haiM, yaha hai ki usake mahaloM aura per3oM ke nIce se nahareM bahatI haiM, usake phala, duniyA ke phaloM ke viparIta, sthAyI haiM, jo kabhI khatma nahIM hoMge aura usakI chAyA bhI sthAyI hai, jo na kabhI samApta hogI aura na choTI hogI| yahI una logoM kA pariNAma hai, jo allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara usase Darate rahe| aura kAfiroM kA pariNAma Aga hai, jisameM ve praveza kareMge aura hamezA ke lie usI meM raheMge|

jina yahUdiyoM ko hamane taurAta dI aura jina IsAiyoM ko hamane iMjIla dI, ve usa (quraAna) se prasanna hote haiM, jo (ai rasUla!) Apapara utArA gayA hai; kyoMki vaha unakI pustakoM kI kucha bAtoM se sahamati rakhatA hai| tathA yahUdiyoM aura IsAiyoM ke saMpradAyoM meM se kucha loga ApakI ora avatirata pustaka ke kucha bhAga kA inakAra karate haiM, jo unakI icchAoM se mela nahIM khAtA, yA jo unake parivartana aura vikRti ko ujAgara karatA hai| (ai rasUla!) Apa unase kaha deM: allAha ne mujhe Adeza diyA hai ki maiM kevala usI kI ibAdata karU~ aura usake sAtha usake alAvA ko sAjhI na banAU~| maiM kevala usI kI ora bulAtA hU~ aura usake alAvA kisI aura kI ora nahIM bulAtA| aura kevala usI kI ora merA lauTanA hai| taurAta aura iMjIla ne bhI yahI zikSA dI hai|

aura jaise hamane pichalI pustakoM ko unake samudAyoM kI bhASA meM utArA thA, usI prakAra hamane (ai rasUla!) Apapara quraAna ko arabI bhASA meM saccAI ko spaSTa karane vAlA eka nirNAyaka faramAna banAkara utArA hai| aura yadi (ai rasUla!) Apane apane pAsa usa jJAna ke A jAne ke pazcAta jo allAha ne Apako sikhAyA hai, kitAba vAloM kI icchAoM kA pAlana kiyA unake usa cIz2a ko haTAne kI saudebAz2I meM jo unakI icchAoM se mela nahIM khAtI, to allAha ke muqAbale meM ApakA koI saMrakSaka nahIM hogA, jo Apake mAmale ko saMbhAle aura Apake duzmanoM ke khilAfa ApakI sahAyatA kare, aura na hI Apako allAha kI yAtanA se koI bacAne vAlA hogA|

(ai rasUla!) hamane Apase pahale rasUloM ko manuSyoM hI meM se bheje| isalie Apa (dUsare) rasUloM se alaga koI (anokhe) rasUla nahIM haiM| tathA hamane anya sabhI manuSyoM kI taraha unake lie patniyA~ aura bacce banAe| hamane unheM firizte nahIM banAe,jo na zAdI karate haiM aura na bacce janate haiM| aura Apa bhI unhIM rasUloM meM se haiM, jo manuSya the, zAdI-byAha karate the aura bacce paidA karate the, to phira Apake aisA hone para ina muzrikoM ko Azcarya kyoM hotA hai?! tathA kisI rasUla ke basa kI bAta nahIM hai ki allAha kI anumati ke binA apanI ora se koI nizAnI le Ae| hara mAmale ke lie jisakA allAha ne faisalA kiyA hai eka kitAba hai, jisameM vaha ullikhita hai aura usakA eka nirdhArita samaya hai, jo Age-pIche nahIM ho sakatA|

allAha jisa bhalAI, yA burAI, yA saubhAgya, yA durbhAgya ko cAhatA hai, miTA detA hai aura unameM se jise cAhatA hai bAqI rakhatA hai| aura usI ke pAsa 'lauha़ -e- mahafUz2a' hai| vaha una saba kA saMdarbha hai, aura jo kucha bhI miTAyA jAtA yA bAqI rakhA jAtA hai, usI ke anusAra hotA hai, jo usameM aMkita hai|

(ai nabI!) yadi hama ApakI mRtyu se pahale Apako usa yAtanA kA kucha bhAga dikhA deM jisakA hama unase vAdA karate haiM, to yaha hamArA kAma hai, yA use Apako dikhAne se pahale hI Apako mauta de deM, to ApakA kAma kevala usako pahu~cA denA hai, jise pahu~cAne kA hamane Apako Adeza diyA hai| ApakA kAma unheM badalA denA yA unakA hisAba lenA nahIM hai| kyoMki yaha hamArA kAma hai|

kyA ina kAfiroM ne yaha nahIM dekhA ki hama kufra kI dharatI para Ate haiM, islAma kA prasAra kara aura musalamAnoM ko usapara vijaya pradAna karake use usake kinAroM se kama kara dete haiM| aura allAha jo kucha cAhatA hai, Adeza detA hai aura apane baMdoM ke bIca faisalA karatA hai| usake faisale ko koI TAlane vAlA, yA usameM saMzodhana karane vAlA, yA use badalane vAlA nahIM hai| vaha mahimAvAna bahuta zIghra hisAba lene vAlA hai, vaha agale aura pichale sabhI logoM kA eka hI dina meM hisAba le legA|

pichale samudAyoM ne apane nabiyoM ke sAtha chala kiyA, cAleM calIM aura unakI lAI haI bAtoM ko jhuThalAyA| paraMtu unhoMne unake qhilAfa upAya (sAz2iza) karake kyA kara liyA? kucha nahIM; kyoMki prabhAvI upAya kevala allAha kA upAya hai, kisI aura kA nahIM| tathA vaha mahimAvAn (allAha) hI hai, jo sArI sRSTi ke sabhI karmoM ko jAnatA hai, unameM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai| aura usa samaya ina jhuThalAne vAloM ko patA cala jAegA ki ve allAha para ImAna na lAne meM kitane galata the aura ImAna vAle loga kitane sahI the| isalie unhoMne jannata aura acchA pariNAma prApta kiyA|

jina logoM ne kufra kI nIti apanAI, ve kahate haiM: (ai muhammada!) Apa allAha dvArA bheje nahIM gae haiM| (ai rasUla!) Apa unase kaha deM: mere aura tumhAre bIca, isa bAta para allAha gavAha ke rUpa meM kAfI hai ki maiM apane pAlanahAra kI ora se tumhArI tarafa rasUla banAkara bhejA gayA hU~, tathA unakI bhI gavAhI kAfI hai, jinake pAsa AkAzIya graMthoM kA jJAna hai, jinameM merI vizeSatAe~ varNita haiM| aura jisakI satyatA kA sAkSI allAha hai, use kisI ke jhuThalAne se koI nukasAna nahIM pahu~catA|

{alifa॰ lAma॰ rA॰|} sUratula-baqarA ke AraMbha meM isa prakAra ke akSaroM ke bAre meM bAta guz2ara cukI hai| yaha quraAna eka kitAba hai, jise hamane (ai rasUla!) ApakI ora utArA hai, tAki Apa allAha kI icchA aura usakI madada se logoM ko kufra, ajJAnatA aura gumarAhI se nikAlakara ImAna, jJAna aura hidAyata kI ora arthAt islAma dharma kI ora le Ae~, jo usa prabhutvazAlI allAha kA rAstA hai, jise koI parAjita nahIM kara sakatA, jo hara cIz2a meM prazaMsita hai|

vaha allAha, jo akele AkAzoM kI sArI vastuoM kA mAlika hai aura akele vahI dharatI kI sArI vastuoM kA mAlika hai| isalie vahI isa bAta kA haqadAra hai ki akele usI kI ibAdata kI jAe aura usakI sRSTi meM se kisI bhI cIz2a ko usakA sAjhI na banAyA jAe| aura jina logoM ne kufra kiyA, ve saqhta yAtanA kA sAmanA kareMge|

jina logoM ne kufra kiyA, ve duniyA ke jIvana aura usake kSaNabhaMgura AnaMda ko Aqhirata aura usake sthAyI AnaMda para pradhAnatA dete haiM, tathA logoM ko allAha ke rAste se vicalita karate haiM aura usake rAste ke lie satya se vikRti aura vicalana tathA sIdha se Ter3ha aura jhukAva DhU~Dhate haiM, tAki koI bhI usapara na cale| ina guNoM se vizeSita loga satya evaM sIdhe mArga se bahuta dUra kI gumarAhI meM haiM|

hamane jo bhI rasUla bhejA, use usake samudAya kI bhASA meM bAta karane vAlA banAkara bhejA| tAki rasUla allAha ke yahA~ se jo kucha lekara Ae, unake lie use samajhanA AsAna ho jAe| hamane use logoM ko allAha para ImAna lAne ke lie bAdhya karane ke lie nahIM bhejA| kyoMki allAha jise cAhatA hai, apane nyAya ke anusAra gumarAha kara detA hai, aura jise cAhatA hai, apanI kRpA se hidAyata kA sAmarthya pradAna karatA hai| vaha prabhutvazAlI hai, jisapara kisI kA z2ora nahIM calatA, apanI racanA aura prabaMdhana meM pUrNa ha़ikamata vAlA hai|

hamane mUsA ko nabI banAkara bhejA aura unakI satyatA ko iMgita karane vAlI aura unake apane pAlanahAra kI ora se bheje hue (rasUla) hone ko darzAne vAlI nizAniyoM ke sAtha unakA samarthana kiyA| aura hamane unheM apanI jAti ko kufra evaM ajJAnatA se ImAna aura jJAna kI ora nikAla lAne kA Adeza diyA| aura hamane unheM una dinoM kI yAda dilAne kA Adeza diyA jinameM allAha ne unapara anugraha kiyA thA| niHsaMdeha una dinoM meM allAha ke ekatva, usakI mahAna zakti aura ImAna vAloM para anugraha karane ke spaSTa pramANa haiM| aura isase vahI loga lAbhAnvita hote haiM, jo allAha ke AjJApAlana para dhairya rakhane vAle aura usakI nematoM para hamezA zukra karane vAle haiM|

(ai rasUla) usa samaya ko yAda kIjie, jaba mUsA ne apane pAlanahAra ke Adeza kA pAlana karate hue apanI jAti banI isarAIla ko allAha kI ora se prApta hone vAlI nematoM kA smaraNa karAte hue kahA: ai mere samudAya ke logo! allAha kI nemata ko yAda karo jaba usane tumheM firaauniyoM se bacAyA aura unakI yAtanA se surakSA pradAna kI| ve tumheM ghora yAtanA dete the| tumhAre beToM kA vadha kara dete the tAki tumhAre bIca koI aisA baccA na paidA ho jo firaauna ke rAjya para qabz2A jamA sake| tathA ve tumhArI mahilAoM ko unheM apamAnita aura beiz2z2ata karane ke lie jIvita rakhate the| unake ina kRtyoM meM tumhAre dhairya kI eka mahAna parIkSA hai| cunA~ce isa Az2amAiza para dhairya ke badale meM allAha ne tumheM firaauniyoM kI pratAr3anA se chuTakArA pradAna kara diyA|

aura mUsA ne unase kahA: usa samaya ko yAda karo, jaba tumhAre pAlanahAra ne tumheM acchI taraha sUcita kara diyA: yadi tuma allAha kI dI huI ina nematoM para usakA zukriyA adA karoge, to vaha tumheM inake atirikta aura bhI nematoM aura anugrahoM se sammAnita karegA, aura yadi tuma usakI nematoM kA inakAra karoge aura unakA zukriyA adA na karoge, to usakI yAtanA usake lie bahuta saqhta hai, jo usakI nematoM kA inakAra karatA hai aura unakA zukriyA adA nahIM karatA hai|

aura mUsA ne apane samudAya ke logoM se kahA: yadi tuma kufra karo aura tumhAre sAtha dharatI ke sabhI loga kufra kara baiTheM, to tumhAre kuphra kA nuqasAna tumheM hI uThAnA par3egA| kyoMki allAha svayaM meM beniyAz2a hai, svayaM meM prazaMsA ke yogya hai| ImAna vAloM kA ImAna use lAbha nahIM detA, aura na kAfiroM kA kufra use nuqasAna pahu~cAtA|

(ai kAfiro!) kyA tumhAre pAsa tumase pahale ke jhuThalAne vAle samudAyoM ke vinAza kI qhabara nahIM AI? nUha kI jAti, hUda kI jAti Ada, sAleha kI jAti samUda aura unake bAda Ane vAle samudAyoM kI, jinakI saMkhyA bahuta adhika hai, jinheM allAha ke sivA koI nahIM jAnatA| unake rasUla unake pAsa spaSTa pramANoM ke sAtha Ae| lekina unhoMne rasUloM se krodha ke kAraNa apanI u~galiyoM ko kATate hue apane hAtha apane mu~hoM meM DAla lie aura apane rasUloM se kahA: hama usakA inakAra karate haiM, jisake sAtha tuma bheje gae ho| aura niHsaMdahe hama usa cIz2a ke bAre meM jisakI ora tuma hameM AmaMtrita karate ho, asamaMjasa meM DAlane vAle saMdeha meM par3e hue haiM|

unake rasUloM ne unake javAba meM kahA: kyA allAha ke ekezvaravAda aura ibAdata ke lie usake ekala hone ke bAre meM koI saMdeha hai, jabaki vaha AkAzoM kA racayitA tathA dharatI kA racayitA aura binA kisI namUne ke unakI utpatti karane vAlA hai?! vaha tumheM ImAna kI ora bulAtA hai, tAki tumhAre pichale gunAhoM ko mAfa kara de aura tumheM tumhAre sAMsArika jIvana meM nirdhArita samaya sImA ko pUrA karane taka ke lie mohalata de| unake samudAyoM ne unase kahA: tuma to hamAre hI jaise inasAna ho| tumheM hamapara koI viziSTatA prApta nahIM hai| tuma hameM usakI pUjA karane se rokanA cAhate ho, jisakI hamAre bApa-dAdA pUjA karate the| isalie hamAre pAsa koI spaSTa pramANa lAo, jo tumhAre isa dAve meM tumhArI saccAI kA saMketa de ki tuma allAha kI ora se hamAre lie rasUla banAkara bheje gae ho|

unake rasUloM ne unheM javAba dete hue kahA: hama to tumhAre jaise inasAna hI haiM| isalie hama isameM ApakI samAnatA se inakAra nahIM karate haiM| paraMtu isa samAnatA se yaha z2arUrI nahIM hai ki hama hara cIz2a meM samAna hoM| kyoMki allAha apane baMdoM meM se jina para cAhatA hai, vizeSa kRpA karatA hai aura unheM logoM kI ora saMdezavAhaka ke rUpa meM cuna letA hai| tathA allAha kI icchA ke binA hamAre lie sahI nahIM hai ki hama tumhAre pAsa vaha pramANa lekara Ae~ jisakI tumane mA~ga kI hai| kyoMki usako lAnA hamArI kSamatA meM nahIM hai|balki kevala allAha hI aisA karane meM sakSama hai| aura ImAna vAloM ko apane sabhI mAmaloM meM akele allAha hI para bharosA karanA cAhie|

kauna-sI bAdhA aura kauna-sA bahAnA hai jo hameM usa (allAha) para bharosA karane se rokatA hai? jabaki usane hameM sabase sIdhA aura sabase spaSTa rAstA dikhAyA hai| tathA tumhAre jhuThalAne aura upahAsa ke mAdhyama se hameM kaSTa pahu~cAne para hama avazya sabra kareMge| tathA ImAna vAloM ko apane sabhI mAmaloM meM akele allAha hI para bharosA karanA cAhie|

rasUloM ke samudAyoM meM se jinhoMne kufra kiyA, jaba ve apane rasUloM ke sAtha bahasa karane meM asamartha ho gae, to unhoMne kahA: nizcaya hama tumheM avazya apanI bastI se nikAla deMge yA avazya tuma apane dharma se hamAre dharma meM lauTa Aoge| to allAha ne rasUloM kI ora unheM sazakta karate hue vaha़ya kI: nizcaya hama una atyAcAriyoM ko avazya naSTa kara deMge, jinhoMne allAha aura usake rasUloM kA inakAra kiyA|

unakA vinAza karane ke bAda, hama (ai rasUlo) tumheM (aura tumhAre anuyAyiyoM ko) usa dharatI meM AbAda kara deMge| yaha jhuThalAne vAle kAfiroM kA vinAza karane aura unakA vinAza karane ke bAda rasUloM aura ImAna vAloM ko dharatI meM AbAda karane kI ukta bAta usake lie hai, jisane merI mahAnatA aura mere usakA nirIkSaNa karane ko apane mana meM upasthita rakhA, aura merI use yAtanA kI cetAvanI kA bhaya rakhA|

rasUloM ne apane pAlanahAra se apane duzmanoM ke viruddha vijaya aura sahAyatA mA~gI aura pratyeka abhimAnI, satya se baira rakhane vAlA, jo satya ke spaSTa hone ke bAvajUda use nahIM mAnatA, asaphala rahA|

qiyAmata ke dina isa abhimAnI ke Age jahannama hai| cunA~ce jahannama usake ghAta meM hai| tathA use usake aMdara jahannamiyoM ke zarIra se bahane vAlI pIpa pilAI jAegI| isalie vaha usakI pyAsa ko nahIM bujhAegI| cunA~ce use pyAsa aura anya prakAra kI yAtanAoM ke dvArA niraMtara pratAr3ita kiyA jAegA|

vaha usakI kar3avAhaTa, garmI aura badabU ke kAraNa use bAra-bAra pIne kA prayAsa karegA, lekina vaha use nigalane meM sakSama nahIM hogA| tathA jisa yAtanA se vaha pIr3ita hogA, usakI gaMbhIratA ke kAraNa hara tarafa se mauta usake pAsa AegI| hAlA~ki vaha marane vAlA nahIM ki ArAma pA jAe| balki vaha z2iMdA rahegA aura pIr3A jhelegA| aura usake sAmane eka aura kaThora yAtanA hai, jo usakI pratIkSA kara rahI hai|

kAfira loga jo nekI ke kArya karate haiM, jaise dAna, upakAra aura kamaz2oroM para kRpA Adi, unakI misAla usa rAkha kI taraha hai, jisa para A~dhI vAle dina meM tez2a havA cale aura use pUrI zakti se ur3A le jAe aura alaga-alaga sthAnoM meM isa taraha bikhera de ki usakA nizAna taka bAqI na rahe| yahI hAla kAfiroM ke acche kAryoM kA hai, jinapara kufra kI A~dhI cala cukI hai| qiyAmata ke dina kAfiroM ko unakA koI lAbha nahIM hogA| vaha kArya jisakI buniyAda ImAna para na ho, vaha satya ke mArga se dUra kI gumarAhI hai|

(ai inasAna) kyA tU nahIM jAnatA ki allAha ne AsamAnoM aura z2amIna ko satya ke sAtha paidA kiyA hai| cunA~ce usane unheM vyartha meM nahIM banAyA| yadi vaha (ai logo!) tumheM vinaSTa karanA aura tumhAre sthAna para eka anya maqhalUqa lAnA cAhe, jo usakI ibAdata aura AjJApAlana kare, to vaha tumheM vinaSTa karake eka anya maqhalUqa lA sakatA hai, jo usakI ibAdata aura AjJApAlana karane vAlI ho| kyoMki yaha usake lie bahuta AsAna kAma hai|

tumheM vinaSTa karake tumhAre sthAna para anya maqhalUqa ko lAnA allAha sarvazaktimAna ko vivaza karane vAlA kArya nahIM hai| kyoMki vaha saba kucha karane meM sakSama hai, use koI bhI cIz2a vivaza nahIM kara sakatI|

niyata samaya ke dina loga apanI qabroM se uThakara allAha ke sAmane upasthita hoMge| usa samaya kamaz2ora anuyAyI apane saradAroM se kaheMge: (ai saradAro!) hama tumhAre anuyAyI the| tumhAre Adeza kA pAnala karate aura tumhAre manA kie hue kArya se dUra rahate the| to kyA tuma hameM allAha kI yAtanA se kucha bhI bacA sakate ho? to unake saradAra kareMge: yadi allAha ne hameM hidAyata kI taufIqa pradAna kI hotI, to hama tumheM avazya usakA mArga dikhAte| phira hama sabhI usakI yAtanA se baca jAte| lekina hama gumarAha ho gae, to hamane tumheM bhI gumarAha kara diyA| aba hamAre aura tumhAre lie barAbara hai ki hama yAtanA sahana karane so kamaz2ora ho jAe~ yA dhairya se kAma leM| hamAre lie yAtanA se bhAgane kI koI jagaha nahIM hai|

jaba jannata vAle jannata meM aura jahannama vAle jahannama meM praveza kara gae, to ibalIsa ne kahA: niHsaMdeha allAha ne tumase saccA vAdA kiyA aura usane tumase jo vAdA kiyA thA, use pUrA kara diyA| aura maiMne tumase jhUThA vAdA kiyA, isalie maiMne tumase jo vAdA kiyA thA, use pUrA nahIM kiyA| mere pAsa koI zakti nahIM thI jisake dvArA maiM tumheM duniyA meM kufra aura gumarAhI para majabUra kara sakatA| lekina daraasala maiMne tumheM kufra kI ora bulAyA aura tumhAre lie gunAhoM ko suMdara banAkara peza kiyA, to tuma turaMta mere pIche cala par3e| isalie apanI gumarAhI ke lie mujhe doSa na do, balki svayaM ko doSa do| kyoMki tuma khuda doSa ke adhika yogya ho| na maiM tumheM yAtanA se bacAne ke lie tumhArI madada ko pahu~cane vAlA hU~, aura na tuma mujhase yAtanA ko dUra karane ke lie merI madada ko pahu~cane vAle ho| maiM tumhAre upAsanA meM mujhe allAha kA sAjhI banAne kA inakAra karatA hU~| niHsaMdeha (duniyA meM allAha kA sAjhI banAkara aura usakA inakAra karake) atyAcAra karane vAloM ke lie qiyAmata ke dina dardanAka yAtanA hai, jo unakI pratIkSA kara rahI hai|

jaba allAha ne qiyAmata ke dina kAfiroM ke aMjAma kA ullekha kiyA, tAki usase sAvadhAna kiyA jAe, to ImAna vAloM ke aMjAma kA bhI ullekha kara diyA, tAki usake lie protsAhita kiyA jAe| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
atyAcAriyoM ke aMjAma ke viparIta, ImAna lAne aura acche kArya karane vAloM ko aisI jannatoM meM praveza karAyA jAegA, jinake mahaloM aura per3oM ke nIce se nahareM bahatI haiM| ve apane raba kI anumati aura sAmarthya se unameM hamezA ke lie raheMge| ve eka-dUsare kA abhivAdana kareMge, farizte bhI unakA abhivAdana kareMge aura unakA pavitra pAlanahAra bhI unakA abhivAdana karegA| yaha abhivAdana 'salAma' ke dvArA hogA|

(ai rasUla) kyA Apa nahIM jAnate ki allAha ne ekezvaravAda ke zabda (tauha़Ida ke kalimA) 'lA ilAhA illallAha' kA udAharaNa kaise diyA, jaba usakA udAharaNa eka pavitra vRkSa arthAt khajUra ke per3a ke sAtha diyA, jisakA tanA dharatI ke aMdara dha~sA huA hotA hai, jo apanI jar3o ke dvArA pAnI prApta karatA hai aura usakI zAkhA AkAza kI ora U~cI hotI hai, osa pItI hai aura acchI (sAfa) havA ko grahaNa karatI hai|
yaha acchA per3a apane pAlanahAra kI anumati se hara samaya apanA acchA phala detA hai| tathA pAka evaM ucca allAha isa AzA meM logoM ke lie udAharaNa prastuta karatA hai ki ve upadeza grahaNa kareM|

aura zirka ke duSTa zabda kA udAharaNa eka duSTa per3a kI taraha hai, jo ki iMdrAyana kI bela hai, jise usakI jar3a se ukhAr3a diyA gayA, usakI z2amIna para koI sthiratA nahIM hai, aura na hI AkAza kI ora koI bulaMdI hai| cunA~ce vaha sUkha jAtA hai aura havAe~ use ur3A le jAtI haiM| ataH kufra ke zabda kA aMjAma (bhI) vinAza hai aura kuph़ra karane vAle kA koI acchA kAma allAha kI ora nahIM car3hatA|

allAha mominoM ko tauha़Ida ke dRr3ha kalimA (zabda) ke sAtha duniyA ke jIvana meM pUrNa ImAna pradAna karatA hai yahA~ taka ki unakI mRtyu ImAna para hotI hai| aura 'baraz2aqha' ke jIvana meM unakI kabroM ke aMdara (fariztoM dvArA) savAla ke samaya (bhI sudRr3ha rakhatA hai) aura qiyAmata ke dina (bhI) unheM dRr3hatA pradAna karegA| jabaki allAha usake sAtha zirka aura kufra karake atyAcAra karane vAloM ko satyatA aura sahI mArgadarzana se bhaTakA detA hai| aura allAha jo cAhatA hai, karatA hai| jise gumarAha karanA cAhatA hai, use apane nyAya ke sAtha gumarAha kara detA hai aura jise sIdhI rAha dikhAnA cAhatA hai, use apane anugraha se sIdhI rAha dikhAtA hai| use koI majabUra karane vAlA nahIM hai|

Apane quraiza ke una logoM kA hAla dekha liyA jinhoMne allAha aura usake rasUla kA inakAra kiyA, jaba unhoMne 'harama' meM surakSA pradAna karane aura unake bIca muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko nabI banAkara bhejane kI allAha kI nemata ko badala DAlA| unhoMne usake badale usakI nematoM kI nAzukrI karate hue muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke apane pAlanahAra kI ora se lAe hue dharma ko jhuThalA diyA aura apanI jAti ke una logoM ko vinAza ke ghara meM lA utArA, jinhoMne kufra meM unakA pAlana kiyA|
vinAza kA ghara' jahannama hai, jisameM ve praveza karake usakI garmI jheleMge aura unakA yaha ThikAnA bahuta burA ThikAnA hai|

muzrikoM ne allAha ke sAjhI aura samakakSa banA lie, tAki khuda allAha ke rAste se bhaTakane ke bAda apane anuyAyiyoM ko bhI usase bhaTakA deM| (ai rasUla) Apa unase kaha deM: isa jIvana meM tuma jina icchAoM meM vyasta aura saMdeha phailAne meM lage ho, unakA kucha lAbha uThA lo| kyoMki qiyAmata ke dina tumheM Aga (naraka) hI kI ora lauTanA hai, usake alAvA tumhArA koI anya ThikAnA nahIM hai|

(ai rasUla!) Apa mominoM se kaha deM: ai momino! pUrNa rUpa se namAz2a par3ho, aura allAha ke die hue dhana se Avazyaka aura vAMchanIya kAryoM meM kharca karo, riyAkArI ke Dara se gupta rUpa se, aura khule taura para isalie ki dUsare loga tumhArA anusaraNa kareM| isase pahale ki vaha dina A jAe, jisameM na koI kraya-vikraya hogA, na chur3autI svIkAra kI jAegI ki usake dvArA allAha ke az2Aba se chuTakArA prApta kara liyA jAe, aura na koI dostI hogI ki eka dosta apane dosta ke lie sifAriza kara de|

allAha vaha hai, jisane AkAzoM aura dharatI ko kisI pUrva udAharaNa ke binA paidA kiyA, aura AkAza se bAriza kA pAnI utArA, phira usa utAre hue pAnI se (ai logo!) tumhArI jIvikA ke lie phaloM kI qismoM ko nikAlA aura nAvoM ko tumhAre vaza meM kara diyA, jo pAnI ke Upara usake anumAna ke anusAra calatI haiM, aura nadiyoM ko tumhAre lie vazIbhUta kara diyA, tAki unase pAnI pio aura apane pazuoM aura apanI khetiyoM ko sairAba karo|

usane sUrya aura cA~da ko tumhAre lie vazIbhUta kara diyA, jo lagAtAra gatizIla haiM, tathAA dina aura rAta ko tumhAre lie vazIbhUta kara diyA, jo eka-dUsare ke bAda Ate-jAte haiM; rAta tumhAre sone aura ArAma karane ke lie aura dina tumhArI gatividhi aura daur3a-dhUpa karane ke lie hai|

aura usane tumheM una saba cIz2oM meM se pradAna kiyA, jo tumane mA~gIM aura jo tumane nahIM mA~gIM| yadi tuma allAha kI nematoM kI gaNanA karo, to unakI bahutAyata aura bahulatA ke kAraNa unakI gaNanA nahIM kara sakate| kyoMki tumhAre lie jo kucha ullekha kiyA gayA hai, ve unake kucha udAharaNa haiM| nizcaya inasAna apane Apa para bar3A atyAcAra karane vAlA, allAha sarvazaktimAna kI nematoM kA bahuta kRtaghna hai|

(ai rasUla!) usa samaya ko yAda kareM, jaba ibarAhIma (alaihissalAma) ne apane beTe isamAIla aura unakI mA~ hAjara ko makkA kI ghATI meM rahane ke lie chor3ane ke bAda duA kI: ai mere pAlanahAra! isa nagara - makkA - ko, jisameM maiMne apane parivAra ko rahane ke lie chor3A hai, zAMti evaM surakSA vAlA nagara banA de| jisameM koI khUna na bahAyA jAe, aura kisI para atyAcAra na kiyA jAe| tathA mujhe aura mere baccoM ko mUrtipUjA se dUra rakha|

ai mere pAlanahAra! mUrtiyoM ne bahuta se logoM ko gumarAha kiyA hai| kyoMki unhoMne yaha socA ki ye mUrtiyA~ unake lie sifAriza kareMgI| isalie ve inake fitane (pralobhana) meM par3a gae aura allAha ko chor3akara inakI pUjA kI| ataH logoM meM se jisane bhI allAha ke ekezvaravAda aura usake AjJApAlana meM merA anusaraNa kiyA, vaha mere dala aura mere anuyAyiyoM meM se hai| aura jisane merI avajJA kI aura allAha ke ekezvaravAda aura usake AjJApAlana meM merA anusaraNa nahIM kiyA, to (ai mere raba!) tU jinake gunAhoM ko kSamA karanA cAhe, kSamA karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

ai hamAre pAlanahAra! maiMne apanI kucha saMtAna, arthAt apane beTe isamAIla aura usake beToM ko tere sammAnita ghara ke pAsa eka aisI ghATI meM basAyA hai, jisameM koI khetI yA pAnI nahIM hai| ai hamAre pAlanahAra! maiMne unheM usake pAsa isalie basAyA hai ki ve usameM namAz2a qAyama kareM| isalie (ai mere raba!) logoM ke diloM ko inakI ora aura isa nagara kI ora pralobhita kara de, aura unheM phaloM se roz2I pradAna kara, tAki ve apane Upara tere upakAra kA zukriyA adA kareM|

jaba loga qabroM se uThakara pukArane vAle kI ora tez2I se bhAgeMge, apane sira ko uThAe hue hoMge, ve ghabarAhaTa se AkAza kI ora dekheMge, unakI nigAheM unakI ora nahIM lauTeMgI, balki ve jo kucha bhI dekha rahI hoMgI usake Dara se khulI kI khulI raha jAe~gI aura unake dila qhAlI hoMge, usa dina ke dRzya kI dahazata se unameM koI samajha-bUjha nahIM hogI|

(ai rasUla!) ina jhuThalAne vAloM ko chor3a deM ki ve pazuoM kI taraha khAte raheM aura duniyA ke nazvara sukhoM kA AnaMda lete raheM tathA laMbI AzA unheM ImAna aura acche kArya se gAfila kie rakhe| jaba ve qiyAmata ke dina allAha ke sAmane upasthita hoMge, to unheM patA cala jAegA ki ve kitane ghATe meM haiM|

(ai rasUla!) hamane Apase pahale pichale kAfira samudAyoM meM (bhI) rasUla bheje the, to unhoMne una rasUloM ko jhuThalA diyA thA| isalie, Apake samudAya ke Apako jhuThalAne ke mAmale meM, Apa anUThe rasUla nahIM haiM|

ye jhuThalAne vAle loga haThI haiM, bhale hI spaSTa pramANoM ke sAtha satya unake sAmane ujAgara ho jAe| cunA~ce yadi hama unake lie AsamAna kA koI dvAra khola deM aura ve usameM car3hate cale jAe~|

paraMtu jo nikaTavartI fariztoM (malae-AlA) kI bAta cupake se suna le, to eka camakadAra jvAlA (ulkA) usakA pIchA karatI hai aura use jalA detI hai|

aura hamane dharatI ko phailAyA tAki loga usake Upara raha sakeM, aura usameM maz2abUta (aTala) pahAr3a banAe tAki vaha (dharatI) logoM ko lekara DagamagAne na lage, tathA usameM vibhinna prakAra ke paudhe ugAe jo hikamata kI apekSAnusAra nirdhArita va nirdiSTa haiM|

aura nizcaya hI qiyAmata ke dina taka tujhapara dhikkAra aura merI dayA se dUrI hai|
ibalIsa ne kahA: ai mere pAlanahAra! mujhe usa dina taka mohalata de aura jIvita rakha, jisa dina sabhI loga dobArA jIvita kie jAe~ge|

aura Apa unheM ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ke pAsa atithi banakara Ane vAle fariztoM ke bAre meM batAe~, jo unake pAsa beTe kI zubha sUcanA aura lUta alaihissalAma kI jAti ke vinAza kI sUcanA lekara Ae the|

(ai rasUla!) Apake jIvana kI qasama, niHsaMdeha lUta alaihissalAma kI jAti ke loga apanI kAmavAsanA kI prabalatA meM bhaTaka rahe the|

ghane per3oM vAlI bastI vAle, zuaiba alaihissalAma kI jAti ke loga bhI atyAcArI the| kyoMki unhoMne allAha kA inakAra kiyA thA aura usake rasUla zuaiba alaihissalAma ko jhuThalAyA thA|

ataH (ai rasUla!) Apake pAlanahAra kI qasama! hama qiyAmata ke dina una sabhI logoM se avazya pUcheMge, jinhoMne quraAna ko khaMDa-khaMDa banA liyA|
