aura kAphiroM ko allAha aura usake rasUla para ImAna lAne, tathA jo kucha rasUla lekara Ae the, usapara amala karane se kevala isa bAta ne roka diyA ki unhoMne rasUla ke mAnava jAti meM se hone kA inakAra kiyA| cunA~ce unhoMne asvIkRti vyakta karate hue kahA: kyA allAha ne hamArI ora eka manuSya ko rasUla banAkara bhejA hai?!

(ai rasUla) Apa unheM uttara dete hue kaheM: yadi dharatI para farizte basate aura tumhArI taraha zAMti ke sAtha calate-phirate, to hama avazya hI unakI ora unhI meM se eka farizte ko rasUla banAkara bhejate| kyoMki vahI unheM allAha kA saMdeza samajhA pAtA| isalie unakI ora mAnava jAti meM se rasUla bhejanA hikamata nahIM hotI| bilkula yahI hAla tumhArA bhI hai|

(ai rasUla) Apa kaha dIjie: mere aura tumhAre bIca isa bAta kI gavAhI ke lie allAha hI kAfI hai ki maiM tumhArI ora eka rasUla banA kara bhejA gayA hU~, aura maiMne vaha saMdeza tumheM pahu~cA diyA, jisake sAtha maiM tumhArI ora bhejA gayA hU~| vaha apane baMdoM kI sthitiyoM se pUrI taraha avagata hai| usase unameM se kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai| vaha diloM ke sabhI rahasyoM ko jAnane vAlA hai|

allAha jise sIdhe mArga kI taufIqa pradAna kara de, to vaha vAstava meM mArgadarzita hai| tathA vaha jise chor3a de aura pathabhraSTa kara de, to (ai rasUla!) Apa una logoM ke lie saMrakSaka nahIM pAe~ge, jo unheM satya kA mArga dikhAe~, tathA unakA kaSTa dUra kara sakeM aura unheM lAbha pahu~cA sakeM| aura hama unheM qiyAmata ke dina isa hAla meM uThAe~ge ki ve apane ceharoM ke bala ghasITe jAe~ge, ve na dekha sakeMge, na bola sakeMge aura na hI suna sakeMge| unakA ghara jisameM ve zaraNa leMge jahannama hogA| jaba bhI usakI lapaTa kama hogI, hama use aura bhar3akA deMge|

yaha saz2A jo unheM jhelanI par3egI, yaha unakA badalA hai unake hamArI apane rasUla para utArI gaI AyatoM kA inakAra karane aura maraNoparAMta punarjIvita hone ko asaMbhava samajhate hue yaha kahane ke kAraNa ki: kyA jaba hama marakara sar3I-galI haDDiyA~ aura vicUrNa Tukar3e ho jAe~ge, to kyA hama nae sire se paidA karake uThAe jAe~ge?

jaba unhoMne yaha ullekha kiyA ki ve dobArA jIvita hone kA inakAra karane ke lie kisa cIz2a ko tarka ke rUpa meM pakar3e hue haiM, to allAha ne unheM yaha kahate hue uttara diyA:
kyA (maraNoparAMta) dobArA jIvita kie jAne kA inakAra karane vAle ina logoM ko itanA nahIM patA ki jisa allAha ne itane vizAla AkAzoM aura vistRta dharatI ko paidA kiyA, vaha unakI taraha paidA karane meM (bhI) sakSama haiM? kyoMki jo mahAna cIz2oM ko paidA karane meM sakSama hai, vaha unase choTI cIz2eM bhI paidA kara sakatA hai| tathA allAha ne duniyA meM unake lie eka viziSTa samaya nirdhArita kara diyA hai, jisameM unake jIvana kA aMta ho jAegA| aura usane unake lie unake punaH jIvita hone kI bhI eka samaya sImA banA dI hai, jisameM koI saMdeha nahIM hai| tathA maraNoparAMta punarjIvana ke pramANoM kI spaSTatA ke bAvajUda, muzrikoM ne marane ke bAda dobArA jIvita kie jAne kA inakAra hI kiyA|

(ai rasUla!) Apa ina bahudevavAdiyoM se kaha dIjie: yadi tuma loga mere pAlanahAra kI dayA ke khaz2AnoM ke mAlika hote, jo na ghaTate haiM aura na samApta hote haiM, to usa samaya tuma unake samApta hone ke Dara se unheM kharca karane se ruka jAte tAki tuma g2arIba na ho jAo| aura yaha manuSya ke svabhAva hI meM hai ki vaha kaMjUsa (kRpaNa) hai, paraMtu yadi vaha momina hai, to allAha ke savAba (puNya) kI AzA meM kharca karatA hai|

jaba allAha ke nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko muzrikoM kI ora se jhuThalAne kA sAmanA karanA par3A, to phiraauna aura usakI jAti ke sAtha mUsA alaihissalAma kI kahAnI ke dvArA Apako sAMtvanA dI gaI| cunA~ce allAha ne pharamAyA:
nizcita rUpa se hamane mUsA alaihissalAma ko nau spaSTa nizAniyA~ dIM, jo unakI satyatA kI gavAhI detI thIM aura ve nizAniyA~: lAThI, hAtha, akAla, phaloM kI kamI, A~dhI (tUphAna), TiDDiyA~, jU~, meMDhaka aura khUna haiM| to Apa (ai rasUla) yahUdiyoM se pUcha lIjie ki jaba mUsA alaihissalAma unake pUrvajoM ke pAsa una nizAniyA~ ko lekara Ae, to firaauna ne unase kahA: maiM nizcaya hI (ai mUsA) tumheM eka jAdU kiyA huA AdamI samajhatA hU~; kyoMki tuma ye ajaba-gajaba (vicitra) cIz2eM lAte ho|

mUsA alaihissalAma ne use uttara dete hue kahA: (ai firaauna) tujhe nizcitatA ke sAtha vizvAsa hai ki ina nizAniyoM ko utArane vAlA kevala AkAzoM aura dharatI kA pAlanahAra hai| usane inheM apanI zakti tathA apane rasUla kI saccAI ke pramANa ke taura para utArA hai| lekina tUne inakA inakAra kiyA| aura maiM nizcita rUpa se jAnatA hU~ ki (ai phiraauna) terA sarvanAza huA|
phira firaauna ne mUsA alaihissalAma aura unakI jAti ke logoM ko misra se bAhara nikAla kara daMDita karanA cAhA| to hamane use aura usake sAtha usake sabhI sainikoM ko Dubokara vinaSTa kara diyA|

aura hamane firaauna aura usakI senA ko vinaSTa karane ke bAda banI isarAIla se kahA: tuma loga zAma (levAMta) kI dharatI para basa jAo| phira jaba qiyAmata kA dina hogA, to hama tuma sabako hisAba ke lie mahzara (qiyAmata ke maidAna) meM ekatrita kareMge|

hamane isa quraAna ko muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama para satya hI ke sAtha utArA hai| tathA yaha unapara binA kisI parivartana yA virUpaNa ke satya hI ke sAtha utarA hai| aura hamane (ai rasUla!) Apako kevala dharmaparAyaNa logoM ko jannata kI zubha sUcanA dene vAlA aura kAphiroM tathA avajJAkAriyoM ko jahannama se DarAne vAlA banAkara bhejA hai|

aura hamane yaha quraAna avatarita kiyA, jise hamane spaSTa kiyA hai aura vistAra se samajhAyA hai, isa ummIda meM ki Apa use Thahara-Thahara kara logoM ko paढ़kara sunAe~| kyoMki yaha samajhane aura ciMtana karane kA adhika kAraNa hai| tathA hamane ise ghaTanAoM aura paristhitiyoM ke anusAra thor3A-thor3A karake alaga-alaga utArA hai|

(ai rasUla) Apa kaha deM: tuma isapara ImAna le Ao, para tumhAre ImAna se isameM kucha bhI vRddhi nahIM hogI| yA tuma isa para ImAna na lAo, para tumhAre kufra se isameM koI kamI nahIM hogI| niHsaMdeha jina logoM ne pichalI AsamAnI pustakeM paढ़ rakhI haiM aura ve vaha़ya tathA nubuvvata kA jJAna rakhate haiM, jaba unake sAmane quraAna paढ़A jAtA hai, to ve AbhAra prakaTa karate hue apane ceharoM ke bala sajade meM gira jAte haiM|

aura ve apane sajade meM kahate haiM: hamArA pAlanahAra vAde ke ullaMghana se pavitra hai| cunA~ce usane muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko saMdeSTA banAkara bhejane kA jo vAdA kiyA thA, vaha hokara rahA| niHsaMdeha hamAre pAlanahAra kA isakA tathA isake alAvA anya cIz2oM kA vAdA anivArya rUpa se pUrA hone vAlA hai|

aura ve allAha ko sajadA karate hue, usake bhaya se rote hue apane ceharoM ke bala gira jAte haiM| tathA quraAna kA sunanA aura usake arthoM para ciMtana karanA unheM allAha ke prati vinamratA aura bhaya meM bar3hA detA hai|

(ai rasUla!) jisane Apake "yA allAha, yA rahamAna" kahakara pukArane kA khaMDana kiyA hai, Apa usase kaha dIjie: allAha aura rahamAna donoM hI usa mahimAvAna ke nAma haiM| ataH tuma ina donoM meM se kisI nAma se yA inake alAvA usake nAmoM meM se kisI anya nAma se use pukAro, usake sabhI nAma acche haiM| aura ye donoM unhIM acche nAmoM meM se haiM| isalie tuma use inake dvArA athavA inake alAvA usake acche nAmoM meM se kisI aura se pukAro| tathA Apa apanI nAmaz2a meM quraAna itanI U~cI AvAz2a se na par3ho ki muzrika loga suna leM aura na hI use itanI dhImI AvAz2a se par3ho ki momina loga bhI na suna pAe~| Apa ina donoM ke bIca kA rAstA apanAe~|

aura Apa (ai rasUla) kaha dIjie: saba prazaMsA usa allAha ke lie hai, jo hara prakAra kI prazaMsAoM aura stutiyoM ke yogya hai, jo saMtAna se pavitra hai aura jo sAjhI se pavitra hai| ataH usake rAjya meM koI usakA sAjhI nahIM hai| use apamAna aura beiz2z2atI chU bhI nahIM sakatI| isalie use kisI sahAyaka kI AvazyakatA nahIM, jo usakA samarthana kare aura use pratiSThA pradAna kare| aura Apa bahuta adhika usakI mahimA kA gAna kareM| ataH Apa usakI ora saMtAna, yA rAjya meM sAjhI, yA madadagAra samarthaka kI nisbata na kareM|

pUrNatA aura pratApa ke guNoM ke sAtha saba prazaMsA tathA khulI evaM chipI nematoM para hara prakAra kI stuti akele allAha ke lie hai, jisane apane baMde aura rasUla muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama para quraAna avatirata kiyA aura isa quraAna meM koI Teढ़Apana aura satya se jhukAva nahIM rakhA hai|

balki use sIdhA banAyA, jisameM koI aMtarvirodha aura vibheda nahIM hai, tAki vaha kAphiroM ko allAha ke pAsa se eka bhArI yAtanA se DarAe, jo unakI pratIkSA kara rahI hai, tathA acche karma karane vAle mominoM ko zubha sUcanA de ki unake lie eka acchA badalA hai, jisake samAna koI anya badalA nahIM ho sakatA|
ve isa pratiphala meM hamezA raheMge, jo unase kabhI khatma nahIM hogA|
tathA yahUdiyoM, IsAiyoM aura kucha muzarikoM ko DarAe, jinhoMne kahA: allAha ne koI saMtAna banA rakhI hai|

ina mithyAropaNa karane vAloM ke pAsa allAha kI ora saMtAna kI nisbata karane ke dAve kA koI jJAna yA usakA koI pramANa nahIM hai, aura na hI inake una bApa-dAdAoM ke pAsa koI jJAna thA, jinakA inhoMne isa viSaya meM anukaraNa kiyA hai| bahuta ghRNita hai vaha bAta, jo unake mu~ha se binA samajha-bUjha ke nikala rahI hai| ve kevala jhUTha bola rahe haiM, jisakA koI AdhAra aura sabUta nahIM hai|

(ai rasUla!) yadi ve isa quraAna para ImAna na lAe, to zAyada Apa afasosa aura dU:kha se khuda ko naSTa kara leMge| to Apa aisA na kareM| kyoMki unheM sIdhe mArga para lAne kI z2immedArI Apapara nahIM hai| ApakA kAma kevala saMdeza pahu~cA denA hai|

aura hamane dharatI para pAe jAne vAle sabhI prANiyoM ko usakI zobhA banA diyA hai, tAki hama unakA parIkSaNa kara sakeM ki unameM se kauna allAha ko prasanna karane vAle sabase acche kArya karatA hai aura kauna sabase bure kArya karatA hai| tAki hama pratyeka ko usake yogya badalA deM|

aura dharatI para pAe jAne vAle sabhI jIvoM ko hama vanaspati se rahita miTTI banA deMge| aura yaha dharatI para upasthita prANiyoM ke jIvana kA aMta ho jAne ke bAda hogA| ataH isase nasIhata prApta karo|

(ai rasalU) Apa haragiz2a yaha na samajheM ki guphA vAloM kI kahAnI aura unakI vaha zilA jisa para unake nAma likhe gae haiM, hamArI adbhuta nizAniyoM meM se haiM| balki usake alAvA usase bhI adhika adbhuta cIz2eM maujUda haiM, jaise ki AkAzoM aura pRthvI kI racanA|

(ai rasUla!) Apa usa samaya ko yAda kIjie, jaba ImAna vAle yuvakoM ne apane dharma ke sAtha bhAgakara guphA meM zaraNa lI, to unhoMne apane pAlanahAra se prArthanA karate hue kahA: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! tU hameM apanI ora se dayA pradAna kara, ki tU hamAre pApoM ko kSamA kara de aura hameM hamAre zatruoM se mukti pradAna kara, tathA kAphiroM se hijarata karane aura ImAna lAne ke mAmale meM tU hamAre lie satya mArga kI ora rahanumAI aura zuddhatA banA de|
phira, unake calane aura guphA meM zaraNa lene ke bAda, hamane unake kAnoM para pardA DAla diyA tAki koI AvAz2a na suna sakeM aura kaI varSoM taka sone ke lie unheM nIMda se grasta kara diyA|

phira, unakI laMbI nIMda ke bAda, hamane unheM isalie jagAyA, tAki hama jAna leM (usake jJAna ke prakaTana ke taura para) ki unake guphA meM Thaharane kI avadhi ke bAre meM paraspara virodhI do samUhoM meM se kauna usa avadhi ko adhika jAnane vAlA hai|

(ai rasUla) hama Apako unakI khabara ke bAre meM saccAI ke sAtha batA rahe haiM, jisameM koI saMdeha nahIM hai| niHsaMdeha ve kucha yuvaka the, jo apane pAlanahAra para ImAna lAe aura usakA AjJApAlana kiyA| tathA hamane unake mArgadarzana aura satya para dRढ़tA meM vRddhi kara dI|

aura hamane unake diloM ko ImAna aura usapara dRढ़tA, tathA usake lie svadeza chor3ane para dhairya ke sAtha maz2abUta kara diyA, jaba unhoMne kAfira rAjA ke sAmane khar3e hokara eka allAha para apane ImAna lAne kI ghoSaNA kI aura usase kahA: jisa pAlanahAra para hama ImAna lAe aura usakI pUjA kI, vaha AkAzoM aura dharatI kA pAlanahAra hai| hama usake sivA tathAkathita jhUThe pUjyoM kI haragiz2a pUjA nahIM kareMge| yadi hamane usake sivA kisI anya kI pUjA kI, to hamane satya se dUra eka anucita bAta kahI|

phira ve eka-dUsare kI ora yaha kahate hue mur3e: ye hamArI jAti ke loga haiM| inhoMne allAha ke alAvA dUsare pUjya banA rakhe haiM, jinakI ye pUjA karate haiM| hAlA~ki inake pAsa unakI pUjA kA koI spaSTa pramANa nahIM hai| ataH usase bar3A atyAcArI koI nahIM ho sakatA, jo allAha kI ora sAjhI kI nisbata karake usapara jhUTha gar3he|

aura jaba tumane apanI jAti se kinArA kara liyA aura ve allAha ke atirikta jinakI pUjA karate haiM, unheM chor3a diyA aura tumane akele allAha kI ibAdata kI, to aba tuma apane dharma ko bacAkara guphA meM zaraNa lo, jahA~ tumhArA pAlanahAra tumapara apanI dayA kA vistAra kara degA, jisase vaha tumhAre zatruoM se tumhArI rakSA aura surakSA karegA| tathA tumhAre lie tumhAre kAma meM usa cIz2a ko AsAna banA degA jisakA tuma lAbha uThAoge, jisase tumhAre apane logoM ke bIca rahane kI kSatipUrti ho jAegI|

cunA~ce unhoMne usakA pAlana kiyA, jisakA unheM Adeza diyA gayA thA| aura allAha ne unheM nIMda se grasta kara diyA aura unake duzmanoM se unakI rakSA kI| aura (ai unako dekhane vAle!) tuma sUraja ko dekhoge ki jaba vaha pUraba se nikalatA hai, to unakI guphA se usameM praveza karane vAle kI dAIM ora mur3a jAtA hai, aura jaba DUbatA hai, to usase katarAkara usakI bAIM ora mur3a jAtA hai aura usa (guphA) para sUraja kI kiraNeM nahIM par3atI haiM| isa prakAra ve sthAyI chAyA meM rahate haiM, sUraja kI garmI unheM nukasAna nahIM pahu~cAtI hai| ve guphA kI eka vistRta jagaha meM haiM, unheM z2arUrata bhara havA milatI rahatI hai| unake sAtha hone vAlI ye cIz2eM, jaise ki guphA meM unheM zaraNa denA, unheM nIMda se grasta karanA, sUraja kA unase katarAkara guz2aranA, unake sthAna kA vistRta honA aura unheM unakI jAti ke logeM se bacAnA: allAha kI adbhuta kArIgarI meM se haiM, jo usakI zakti ko darzAtI haiM| jise allAha hidAyata ke mArga kI taufIqa de, vaha vAstava meM mArgadarzita hai, aura jise vaha chor3a de aura pathabhraSTa kara de, to Apa usake lie koI sahAyaka nahIM pAe~ge, jo use hidAyata kI taufIqa de sake aura usakI ora usakA mArgadarzana kara sake| kyoMki mArgadarzana kevala allAha ke hAtha meM hai, usake apane hAtha meM nahIM hai|

aura (ai unakI ora dekhane vAle) tuma unakI A~kheM khulI hone ke kAraNa unheM jagA huA samajhate, jabaki vAstava meM ve soe hue the| tathA hama unheM unakI nIMda meM kabhI dAIM karavaTa aura kabhI bAIM karavaTa palaTate rahate the, tAki miTTI unake zarIra na khA le| aura unake sAtha jAne vAlA kuttA guphA ke dvAra para apanI bA~heM phailAe hue thA| yadi Apa unheM jhA~kakara dekha lete, to unake bhaya se pITha pherakara bhAga khar3e hote aura Apake dila meM unakA Dara bhara jAtA|

jisa prakAra hamane unake sAtha vaha kucha kiyA, jisakA hamane apanI zakti ke ajUboM meM se ullekha kiyA hai, usI prakAra hamane unheM eka laMbI avadhi ke bAda jagA diyA, tAki ve eka-dUsare se usa avadhi ke bAre meM pUcheM, jo unhoMne sote hue bitAI| cunA~ce unameM se kucha ne uttara diyA: hama eka dina yA dina ke kucha samaya taka soe rahe| jabaki unameM se jisake lie unake soe rahane kI avadhi spaSTa nahIM ho sakI, usane uttara diyA: tumhArA pAlanahAra hI adhika jAnatA hai ki tuma kitane dinoM taka soe rahe| ataH isake jJAna ko usI ke havAle kara do aura apane kAma meM vyasta ho jAo| isalie aba tuma apane meM se kisI vyakti ko cA~dI ke ye sikke dekara apane zahara kI ora bhejo| vaha dekha le ki nagara kA kauna vyakti adhika uttama evaM pavitra bhojana rakhatA hai, to usase tumhAre pAsa kucha khAnA le Ae| aura vaha jAte-Ate tathA saudA karate samaya sAvadhAna rahe tathA vyavahAra kuzalatA se kAma le aura kisI ko bhI tumhAre sthAna kA patA na calane de| kyoMki isase bar3A nukasAna ho sakatA hai|

yadi tumhAre samudAya ke logoM ko tumhArI sUcanA mila gaI tathA tumhAre sthAna kA patA cala gayA, to ve patthara mAra-mArakara tumhArI hatyA kara deMge athavA tumheM apane usa bhraSTa dharma meM vApasa lauTA leMge, jisapara tuma allAha kI kRpA se satya dharma kI ora mArgadarzana pAne se pahale calA karate the| aura yadi tuma usa pUrva dharma meM lauTa gae, to kabhI saphala nahIM hoge, na isa sAMsArika jIvana meM aura na hI Akhirata meM| balki allAha ne jisa satya dharma kA rAstA tumheM dikhAyA hai, use tyAgane tathA usa bhraSTa dharma meM lauTa jAne ke kAraNa, tumheM donoM lokoM meM bahuta bar3e ghATe kA sAmanA karanA par3egA|

aura jisa prakAra hamane unake sAtha hamArI zakti ko darzAne vAle adbhuta kArya kie, jaise bahuta varSoM taka unheM nIMda ke Agoza meM rakhanA aura usake bAda unheM jagAnA, usI prakAra hamane unake zahara ke logoM ko unase avagata kara diyA, tAki unake zahara ke logoM ko patA cala jAe ki allAha kA ImAna vAloM kI madada karane aura marane ke bAda dobArA jIvita karane kA vAdA saccA hai aura yaha ki qiyAmata Ane vAlI hai, usake Ane meM koI saMdeha nahIM hai| phira jaba guphA vAloM kA mAmalA prakAza meM A gayA aura unakI mRtyu ho gaI, to unase avagata hone vAloM ke bIca isa bAre meM matabheda ho gayA ki: ve unake saMbaMdha meM kyA kareM? unameM se eka samUha ne kahA: unakI guphA ke dvAra para eka bhavana banA do, jisase ve chipe tathA surakSita raheM| unakA pAlanahAra unakI sthiti ke bAre meM sabase adhika jAnatA hai| kyoMki unakI sthiti kI apekSA yaha hai ki unheM allAha ke yahA~ vizeSa sthAna prApta hai| tathA prabhAvazAlI logoM ne, jinake pAsa jJAna tathA sahI dAvata nahIM thI, kahA: hama unake isa sthAna para unake sammAna hetu tathA unake sthAna kI yAdagAra ke taura para eka masjida banAe~ge|

unakI kahAnI ke bAre meM bAtacIta karane vAle kucha loga unakI saMkhyA ke bAre meM kaheMge: ve tIna haiM, unameM se cauthA unakA kuttA hai| tathA unameM se kucha anya loga kaheMge: ve pA~ca haiM, unameM se chaThA unakA kuttA hai| jabaki ina donoM samUhoM ne jo kucha kahA hai, vaha binA sabUta ke apane gumAna ke anusAra kahA hai| unameM se kucha dUsare loga kaheMge: ve sAta haiM aura unameM se AThavA~ unakA kuttA hai| (ai rasUla!) Apa kaha dIjie: merA pAlanahAra hI unakI saMkhyA behatara jAnatA hai, unakI saMkhyA kevala kucha hI logoM ko patA hai, jinheM allAha ne unakI saMkhyA sikhAI hai| ataH Apa unakI saMkhyA yA unakI anya sthitiyoM ke bAre meM kitAba vAloM yA anya logoM se sarasarI bahasa ke alAvA gaharI bahasa na kareM| isa prakAra ki Apa usI taka sImita raheM jo unake viSaya meM Apapara vaha़ya utarI hai| tathA Apa unameM se kisI se bhI unake mAmale ke vivaraNa ke bAre meM na pUcheM, kyoMki unheM isakA jJAna nahIM hai|

aura (ai nabI) Apa haragiz2a kisI cIz2a ke bAre meM, jise Apa kala karanA cAhate hoM, yaha na kaheM: maiM kala yaha kAma karU~gA| kyoMki Apa nahIM jAnate ki Apa ise kareMge, yA Apake aura usake bIca koI bAdhA A jAegI? yaha hara musalamAna ke lie eka nirdezana hai|

paraMtu yaha ki Apa usake karane ko allAha kI cAhata ke sAtha jor3a deM aura yU~ kaheM: maiM - ina zA allAha - (yadi allAha cAhe) use kala karU~gA| aura yadi Apa yaha kahanA bhUla jAe~, to apane pAlanahAra ko "ina zA allAha " kaha kara yAda kara leM aura kaheM: mujhe AzA hai ki merA pAlanahAra mujhe isa mAmale se nikaTatara mArgadarzana aura saphalatA kI rAha dikhAegA|
aura guphA vAle apanI guphA meM tIna sau nau sAla rahe|

aura (ai rasUla) Apa kaha dIjie: allAha sabase adhika jAnatA hai ki ve apanI guphA meM kitane samaya taka Thahare, tathA usane hameM batA diyA hai ki ve usameM kitane samaya taka rahe| isalie usa mahimAvAna ke kathana ke bAda kisI anya kI bAta mAnya nahIM| AkAzoM tathA dharatI kI chipI huI samasta cIz2oM ko paidA karanA aura unakA jJAna rakhanA usI mahimAvAna kA kAma hai| vaha mahimAvAna kyA hI khUba dekhane vAlA hai! cunA~ce vaha saba kucha dekhatA hai| tathA vaha kyA hI khUba sunane vAlA hai! cunA~ce vaha saba kucha sunatA hai| usake sivA unakA koI sahAyaka nahIM hai, jo unake mAmale ko saMbhAla sake aura vaha apane zAsana meM kisI ko sAjhI nahIM banAtA hai| vaha akelA ekamAtra zAsaka hai|

jaba allAha ne yaha spaSTa kara diyA ki zAsana kevala allAha kA calatA hai, to usane apane rasUla ko apane pAlanahAra ke usa hukma ko par3hakara sunAne aura usakA pAlana karane kA Adeza diyA, jisakI ApakI ora vah़ya (prakAzanA) kI gaI hai| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
aura quraAna meM se jo kucha allAha ne ApakI ora vaha़ya kI hai (ai rasUla) Apa use par3heM aura usapara amala kareM| kyoMki usakI bAtoM ko koI badalane vAlA nahIM; isalie ve sarvathA satya aura sarvathA nyAya haiM| aura Apa usa mahimAvAn allAha ke sivA haragiz2a koI zaraNa sthala aura panAha lene kI jagaha nahIM pAe~ge, jahA~ Apa zaraNa le sakeM|

Apa apane Apako una logoM ke saMga rakheM, jo niSThApUrvaka apane pAlanahAra ko dina kI zuruAta aura usake aMta meM, ibAdata ke taura para aura kucha mA~gane ke lie, pukArate haiM| tathA Apa dhana aura sammAna vAle logoM ke sAtha baiThane kI icchA meM unase apanI A~kheM na phereM| aura Apa usakI bAta na mAneM, jisake dila para muhara lagAkara hamane use hamArI yAda se asAvadhAna kara diyA hai| jisake kAraNa usane Apako apanI baiThaka se garIboM ko haTAne kA Adeza diyA, aura usane apane pAlanahAra kI AjJAkAritA para apanI icchA ke anupAlana ko pradhAnatA dI aura usake sabhI kArya vyartha aura barbAda haiM|

aura (ai rasUla!) Apa ina logoM se, jo apane hRdaya kI lAparavAhI ke kAraNa allAha kI yAda se gAfila haiM, kaha dIjie: maiM tumhAre pAsa jo kucha lekara AyA hU~, vaha satya hai| aura vaha allAha kI ora se hai, merI ora se nahIM| aura maiM tumhArI yaha mA~ga svIkAra karane vAlA nahIM ki maiM ImAna vAloM ko niSkAsita kara dU~| aba tuma meM se jo isa saccAI para ImAna lAnA cAhe, vaha usapara ImAna le Ae aura vaha usake pratiphala se prasanna hogA| aura tuma meM se jo usapara vizvAsa na karanA cAhe, vaha vizvAsa na kare aura zIghra hI vaha usa daMDa se dukhI hogA jo usakI pratIkSA kara rahA hai| hamane kufra apanAkara svayaM para atyAcAra karane vAle logoM ke lie bhayAnaka Aga taiyAra kara rakhI hai, jisakI dIvAreM unheM gherI huI hoMgI| isalie ve usase bhAga nahIM sakeMge| agara ve apanI pyAsa kI tIvratA ke kAraNa pAnI kI faryAda kareMge, to unheM talachaTa jaisA bahuta garma pAnI diyA jAegA, jisakI garmI kI tIvratA ke kAraNa unake cehare bhuna jAe~ge| kyA burA hai vaha peya jo unheM diyA jAegA| kyoMki vaha pyAsa nahIM bujhAegA, balki use aura bar3hA degA| tathA vaha usa lapaTa ko bhI nahIM bujhAegA jo unakI khAla udher3a rahI hogI| jahannama kyA hI burA ghara hai jahA~ ve utareMge aura kyA hI burA ThikAnA hai jisameM ve ThahareMge|

jaba allAha taAlA ne atyAcAriyoM ke lie taiyAra kI gaI yAtanA kA ullekha kiyA, to usane ImAna vAloM ke lie taiyAra kie gae udAra pratiphala kA bhI ullekha kiyA, cunA~ce pharamAyA:
niHsaMdeha jo loga allAha para ImAna lAe aura neka kArya kie, unhoMne acchA kAma kiyA hai| isalie unake lie bahuta bar3A pratiphala hai| niHsaMdeha hama acche karma karane vAle logoM kA badalA vyartha nahIM karate, balki unheM koI kamI kie binA pUrA-pUrA badalA dete haiM|

ImAna evaM acche kArya karane kI vizeSatAoM se viziSTa ina logoM ke lie hamezA ke lie nivAsa karane ke lie bagIce haiM, unake mahaloM ke nIce se svarga kI mIThI nahareM bahatI haiM| ve vahA~ sone ke kaMganoM se suzobhita kie jAe~ge tathA patale aura moTe rezama se bane hare kapar3e pahaneMge| ve suMdara pardoM se sajAe gae bistaroM para Teka lagAe baiThe hoMge| unakA pratiphala bahuta acchA hai aura jannata unake lie nivAsa karane ke lie eka behatarIna ghara aura ThikAnA hai|

jaba allAha ne atyAcAriyoM tathA ImAna vAle logoM ko milane vAle badale kA ullekha kiyA, to una donoM ke lie eka udAharaNa diyA| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
aura (ai rasUla!) Apa (unake sAmane) do vyaktiyoM kA udAharaNa deM, jinameM se eka kAfira aura dUsarA momina thA| hamane unameM se kAfira ke lie aMgUra ke do bAg2a banAe| aura hamane donoM bAg2oM ko khajUra ke per3oM se ghera diyA, tathA hamane unake khAlI kSetra meM phasaleM ugAIM|

pratyeka bagIce ne apane phala die, jisameM khajUra, aMgUra aura phasaleM zAmila thIM| aura usameM se kucha bhI kama nahIM kiyA, balki pUrA-pUrA phala diyA| tathA hamane unheM AsAnI se pAnI dene ke lie unake bIca eka nahara jArI kara dI|

aura ina do bAg2oM ke mAlika ke pAsa anya dhana aura phala bhI the| cunA~ce usane garva karate hue apane momina sAthI se, jabaki vaha use prabhAvita karane ke lie usase saMbodhita thA, kahA: maiM tumase adhika dhanavAna, tumase bar3hakara sammAna vAlA aura tumase z2yAdA zaktizAlI birAdarI vAlA hU~|

aura usa kAfira ne ImAna vAle ke sAtha apane bAg2a meM praveza kiyA, tAki use apanA bAg2a dikhAe, jabaki vaha kufra aura garva ke dvArA apane Apa para atyAcAra karane vAlA thA| kAfira ne kahA: mujhe nahIM lagatA ki yaha bAg2a jo tuma dekha rahe ho, naSTa ho jAegA| kyoMki maiMne usake bAkI rahane ke kAraNa apanA lie haiM|

mujhe nahIM lagatA ki qiyAmata Ane vAlI hai| balki yaha eka niraMtara jIvana hai| aura yaha mAnate hue ki vaha A hI gaI, to jaba maiM punarjIvita kiyA jAU~gA aura apane pAlanahAra kI ora lauTAyA jAU~gA, to punarjIvana ke bAda maiM jisakI ora lauTU~gA use apane isa bAg2a se uttama pAU~gA| kyoMki isa dunayA meM mere samRddha hone kI apekSA yaha hai ki maiM punarjIvana ke bAda bhI samRddha hoU~|

usake momina sAthI ne usakI bAta kA uttara dete hue usase kahA: kyA tUne usa astitva ke sAtha qufra kiyA, jisane tere pitA Adama ko miTTI se paidA kiyA, phira tujhe vIrya se paidA kiyA, phira tujhe eka puruSa banAyA, au tere aMgoM ko ThIka-ThIka kiyA aura tujhe paripUrNa banAyA? kyoMki jo ina sabhI cIz2oM ko kara sakatA hai, vaha tujhe punaH jIvita karane meM bhI sakSama hai|

lekina maiM yaha bAta nahIM kahatA, balki maiM kahatA hU~: vaha mahimAvAn allAha hI merA pAlanahAra hai, jisane apanI nematoM ke dvArA hama para upakAra kiyA, aura maiM ibAdata meM kisI ko bhI usakA sAjhI nahIM banAtA|

aura jaba tUne apane bAg2a meM praveza kiyA, to tUne yaha kyoM nahIM kahA: jo allAha ne cAhA, allAha kI madada ke binA kisI ke lie koI zakti nahIM hai| kyoMki vahI hai, jo vaha cAhatA hai, karatA hai aura vaha sarvazaktimAn hai| yadi tU mujhe apane se z2yAdA g2arIba aura saMtAna meM kamatara dekhatA hai|

mujhe AzA hai ki allAha mujhe tumhAre bAg2a se acchA pradAna kare aura tumhAre bAg2a para AkAza se koI az2Aba bheja de| phira tumhArA bAg2a eka aisI bhUmi bana jAe, jahA~ koI vanaspati na ho, jisameM usakI cikanAhaTa ke kAraNa paira phisalate hoM|
athavA usakA pAnI dharatI kI gaharAI meM calA jAe| phira tuma kisI bhI taraha se usa taka nahIM pahu~ca sakate ho| aura agara usakA pAnI nIce calA gayA, to vaha bAkI nahIM raha sakatI|

usa momina vyakti ne jo AzA vyakta kI thI, vaha pUrI ho gaI| cunA~ce usa kAfira ke bAg2a ke phaloM ko vinAza ne ghera liyA| phira vaha kAfira apane bAg2a ke banAne aura marammata ke lie kharca kie gae dhana para afasosa ke mAre hAtha malane lagA| jabaki vaha bAg2a una chapparoM para girA par3A thA, jinapara aMgUra kI beloM ko phailAyA jAtA hai| aura vaha kahatA thA: kAza maiM apane akele pAlanahAra para ImAna lAyA hotA aura ibAdata meM usake sAtha kisI ko sAjhI na banAtA|

isa kAfira ke pAsa use usapara utarane vAle daMDa se bacAne ke lie koI samUha nahIM thA, jabaki vaha apane samUha para garva kara rahA thA| aura vaha svayaM bhI allAha ke usake bAg2a ko vinaSTa karane se bacane vAlA na thA|

usa sthiti meM, sahAyatA karanA kevala allAha ke adhikAra meM hai| vaha apane ImAna vAle mitroM ko sabase uttama badalA dene vAlA hai, kyoMki vaha unake pratiphala ko kaI gunA bar3hA detA hai, tathA vaha unake lie aMjAma ke etibAra se bhI sabase acchA hai|

aura (ai rasUla) duniyA ke dhokhe meM par3e hue logoM ko (sAMsArika jIvana kA) eka udAharaNa deM| cunA~ce duniyA kA udAharaNa usake naSTa hone aura jaldI samApta hone meM, usa bAriza ke pAnI kI taraha hai, jise hamane AkAza se utArA| phira usa jala se dharatI ke paudhe uge aura paka gae| phira vaha paudhA TUTakara cUrA-cUrA bana gayA| havAe~ jisake hissoM ko anya kSetroM meM ur3A le jAtI haiM| phira dharatI vApasa vaisI hI ho jAtI hai jaisI pahale thI| aura allAha hara cIz2a kA sAmarthya rakhane vAlA hai| use koI cIz2a vivaza nahIM kara sakatI| isalie vaha jo cAhatA hai, jIvita rakhatA hai aura jo cAhatA hai, naSTa kara detA hai|

dhana aura saMtAna sAMsArika jIvana kI zobhA haiM| aura Akhirata meM dhana kA koI lAbha nahIM hai jaba taka ki use allAha ko prasanna karane vAle kAma meM na kharca kiyA jAe| tathA allAha ke nikaTa pasaMdIdA kArya aura bAteM, savAba kI dRSTi se, saMsAra kI sabhI zobhAoM se uttama haiM| aura ve sabase uttama vastu haiM, jinakI inasAna AzA karatA hai| kyoMki duniyA kI zobhA nazvara hai, jabaki allAha ke nikaTa pasaMdIdA kAmoM aura bAtoM kA savAba bAqI rahane vAlA hai|

aura usa dina ko yAda karo, jaba hama parvatoM ko unake sthAnoM se haTA deMge| aura tuma dharatI ko sAfa aura khulA maidAna dekhoge, kyoMki usa para upasthita pahAr3a, per3a aura imArata saba gAyaba ho jAe~ge| aura hama sabhI prANiyoM ko ikaTThA kara leMge| cunA~ce hama unameM se kisI ko bhI nahIM chor3eMge, jise hamane punarjIvita karake uThAyA na ho|

aura loga Apake pAlanahAra ke samakSa paMktiyoM meM prastuta kie jAe~ge, to vaha unakA hisAba legA| aura unase kahA jAegA: tuma hamAre pAsa vaise hI akele, naMge paira, naMge zarIra aura binA qhatanA ke Ae ho, jaise hamane tumheM pahalI bAra paidA kiyA thA| lekina tuma to yaha socate the ki tuma kabhI punarjIvita nahIM kie jAoge aura hama tumheM tumhAre karmoM kA badalA dene ke lie kabhI koI samaya aura sthAna nirdhArita nahIM kareMge|

aura karmapatra rakha diyA jAegA| to kucha loga apanA karmapatra apane dAe~ hAtha meM pakar3e hoMge aura kucha use apane bAe~ hAtha meM| aura (ai inasAna) tuma kAphiroM ko dekhoge ki jo kucha usameM likhA hogA, usase Dare hue hoMge| kyoMki ve khUba jAnate hoMge ki unhoMne duniyA meM kyA kuph़ra aura pApa kie the| aura ve kaheMge: hAya hamArA vinAza aura hamArA durbhAgya! isa pustaka ko kyA huA hai ki hamAre karmoM meM se koI choTA yA bar3A nahIM chor3A hai, magara use saMrakSita kara rakhA hai aura gina rakhA hai| aura unhoMne sAMsArika jIvana meM jo pApa kie the, unheM likhA huA aura aMkita pAe~ge| aura (ai rasUla) ApakA pAlanahAra kisI para atyAcAra nahIM karegA| cunA~ce vaha kisI ko binA pApa ke daMDa nahIM degA aura na kisI AjJAkArI vyakti kI nekI meM se kucha kama karegA|

aura (ai rasUla) usa samaya ko yAda kIjie, jaba hamane phariztoM se kahA thA: tuma saba Adama ko abhivAdana ke lie sajadA karo| to una sabhI ne apane pAlanahAra ke Adeza kA pAlana karate hue unheM sajadA kiyA, paraMtu ibalIsa ne sajadA nahIM kiyA| vaha jinnoM meM se thA, fariztoM meM se nahIM thA| ataH usane sajadA karane se inakAra kiyA aura abhimAna kA zikAra ho gayA| isa taraha vaha apane pAlanahAra ke AjJApAlana se nikala gayA| to kyA phira bhI (ai logo) tuma mujhe chor3akara use aura usakI saMtAna ko apanA mitra banAte ho, hAlA~ki ve tumhAre duzmana haiM| bhalA tuma apane zatruoM ko apanA mitra kaise ThaharA rahe ho?! atyAcAriyoM kA yaha kArya kitanA burA aura ghRNita hai ki unhoMne allAha sarvazaktimAna se dostI kI bajAya zaitAna ko apanA dosta banA liyA|

ye loga jinheM tumane mujhe chor3akara apanA sahAyaka va mitra banA rakhA hai, tumhAre hI jaise baMde haiM| maiMne AkAzoM tathA dharatI ko paidA karate samaya unheM upasthita nahIM kiyA thA| balki usa samaya unakA astitva hI nahIM thA| aura na hI maiMne unameM se kucha ko dUsaroM ke paidA karane meM upasthita kiyA thA| kyoMki maiM sRjana aura prabaMdhana meM akelA hU~| aura maiM mAnava jAti aura jinna ke zaitAnoM meM se gumarAha karane vAloM ko apanA sahAyaka banAne vAlA na thA| kyoMki maiM sahAyakoM se beniyAz2a hU~|

aura (ai rasUla) unake sAmane qiyAmata ke dina kI carcA kIjie, jisa dina allAha una logoM se kahegA, jinhoMne duniyA meM usakA sAjhI banAyA thA: mere una sAjhiyoM ko pukAro, jinake bAre meM tumane dAvA kiyA thA ki ve mere sAjhI haiM, tAki ve tumhArI kucha madada kara sakeM| cunA~ce ve unheM pukAreMge, lekina ve unakI pukAra kA na koI uttara deMge aura na unakI koI madada kareMge| tathA hama pUjane vAloM aura pUje gae logoM ke bIca eka vinAza kA sthAna banA deMge, jisameM ve donoM dAkhila hoMge aura vaha jahannama kI Aga hai|

aura allAha kA sAjhI banAne vAle loga jahannama ko dekheMge, to ve pUrI taraha se nizcita ho jAe~ge ki ve usameM girane vAle haiM aura unheM koI sthAna nahIM milegA jahA~ ve usase mur3akara zaraNa le sakeM|

aura aisA na ho ki nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama Apako jhuThalAne vAloM ko jaldI yAtanA dene kI AkAMkSA kareM, allAha taAlA ne Apase pharamAyA: aura (ai rasUla!) tathA ve kAfira bastiyA~, jo tumhAre Asa-pAsa hI AbAda thIM, jaise hUda, sAleha aura zuaiba alaihissalAma kI jAtiyoM kI bastiyA~, hamane unheM vinaSTa kara diyA, jaba unhoMne kufra aura gunAhoM ke dvArA khuda para atyAcAra kiyA, aura hamane unake vinAza kA eka viziSTa samaya nirdhArita kara rakhA thA|

allAha AkAza aura dharatI kA prakAza aura una donoM meM maujUda sArI cIz2oM kA mArgadarzana karane vAlA hai| momina ke hRdaya meM allAha ke prakAza kI misAla, dIvAra meM eka tAqa kI taraha hai, jisameM eka cirAg2a hai| vaha cirAg2a eka camakate hue phAnUsa meM hai, jo motI kI taraha eka camakadAra tArA mAlUma hotA hai| vaha cirAg2a eka mubAraka per3a ke tela se jalAyA jAtA hai, jo ki z2aitUna kA per3a hai| usa per3a ko sUraja se koI cIz2a nahIM chipAtI hai, na to subaha aura na hI zAma ko| usakA tela itanA sAfa-sutharA hotA hai ki mAno Aga ke chue binA hI jala uThegA| to phira Aga ke chUne ke bAda kyA hAla hogA?! cirAg2a kA prakAza, fAnUsa ke prakAza para hai| yahI hAla momina vyakti ke dila kA hotA hai, jaba usake aMdara mArgadarzana kA prakAza camaka uThe| allAha apane baMdoM meM se jise cAhatA hai, quraAna kA pAlana karane kA sAmarthya pradAna karatA hai| tathA allAha cIz2oM ko unake samAna cIz2oM ke dvArA udAharaNa dekara spaSTa karatA hai| aura allAha hara cIz2a ko jAnane vAlA hai| usase koI cIz2a chipI nahIM hai|

jaba allAha ne isase pahale vyaska Az2Ada logoM ke (kisI anya vyakti ke ghara meM praveza karane ke lie) anumati mA~gane ke niyamoM kA ullekha kiyA, to yahA~ g2ulAmoM, nAbAlig2a Az2Ada logoM aura bAlig2a ho jAne vAle baccoM ke anumati lene ke niyamoM kA ullekha kiyA, cunA~ce pharamAyA:
ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usakI zarIyata para amala karane vAlo! tumhAre g2ulAma, tumhArI lauMDiyA~ aura Az2Ada bacce, jo yuvAvasthA ko na pahu~ce hoM, tumase tIna samayoM meM anumati mA~geM; fajra kI namAz2a se pahale, jo ki sone ke kapar3oM ko utArakara jAgane ke kapar3e pahanane kA samaya hotA hai, aura dopahara ke samaya, jaba qailUlA ke lie tuma apane kapar3e utArate ho, aura izA kI namAz2a ke bAda; kyoMki yaha tumhAre sone tathA jAgane ke kapar3e utArakara sone ke kapar3e pahanane kA samaya hai| ye tIna samaya, tumhAre lie parde ke samaya haiM| ina samayoM meM ve tumhAre pAsa tumhArI anumati ke binA nahIM A sakate| inake sivA anya samayoM meM unake binA anumati lekara Ane meM, na tumapara koI gunAha hai aura na unapara| ve tumhAre pAsa bahuta cakkara lagAne vAle haiM, tuma eka-dUsare ke pAsa Ate-jAte rahate ho| isalie unheM hara samaya binA anumati ke praveza karane se nahIM rokA jA sakatA hai| jisa taraha allAha ne tumhAre lie anumati lene ke niyamoM ko kholakara bayAna kiyA hai, usI taraha allAha tumhAre lie una AyatoM ko kholakara bayAna karatA hai, jo tumhAre lie usake nirdhArita kie hue niyamoM ko darzAtI haiM| tathA allAha apane baMdoM ke hitoM ko bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai, unake lie jo niyama nirdhArita karatA hai, usameM pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai|

jaba allAha ne praveza karate samaya anumati lene kA ullekha kiyA, to lauTate samaya bhI anumati lene kA ullekha kara diyA| cunA~ce pharamAyA:

jaba ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ne apanI jAti ko kevala allAha kI ibAdata karane tathA usake alAvA mUrtiyoM kI pUjA chor3ane kA Adeza diyA, to unakA uttara isake sivA kucha na thA ki unhoMne kahA: apane pUjyoM kA samarthana karane ke lie use mAra DAlo yA use Aga meM pheMka do| to allAha ne unheM Aga se bacA liyA| niHsaMdeha unake Aga meM pheMke jAne ke pazcAta unheM usase bacA lene meM ImAna vAloM ke lie bahuta-se upadeza hai, kyoMki yahI loga haiM, jo upadezoM se lAbha uThAte haiM|

aura ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ne apanI jAti se kahA: tumane mUrtiyoM ko pUjya banA liyA hai, jinakI tuma pUjA karate ho, tAki isa duniyA ke jIvana meM unakI pUjA ko eka-dUsare ko jAnane aura Apasa meM prema rakhane kA AdhAra banA lo| phira qiyAmata ke dina tumhAre bIca kA yaha prema samApta ho jAegA, tathA yAtanA ko dekhakara tuma eka-dUsare se alaga ho jAoge aura eka-dUsare ko dhikkArane lagoge| aura tumhArA ThikAnA jahA~ tuma zaraNa loge, Aga hI hai aura tumhAre lie koI sahAyaka nahIM hoMge jo tumheM allAha kI yAtanA se bacA sakeM, na to tumhAre una pUjyoM meM se jinakI tuma allAha ko chor3akara pUjA karate ho aura na hI unake alAvA anya logoM meM se|

aura hamane ibarAhIma ko isaha़Aqa tathA unakA putra yAqUba pradAna kiyA| aura unakI saMtAna meM nubuvvata tathA allAha kI ora se avatarita hone vAle graMtha rakha die| aura hamane unheM unake satya para dhairya rakhane kA pratiphala duniyA meM unakI saMtAna ko sadAcArI banAne aura acchI prazaMsA ke dvArA diyA, tathA Aqhirata meM unheM sadAcAriyoM kA pratiphala milegA| duniyA meM jo kucha unheM diyA gayA, vaha Aqhirata meM unake lie taiyAra kie gae udAra pratiphala meM koI kamI nahIM karegA|

aura (ai rasUla!) lUta ko yAda kareM, jisa samaya unhoMne apane samudAya se kahA: nizcaya tuma aisA ghRNita pApa karate ho, jo tumase pahale duniyA vAloM meM se kisI ne bhI nahIM kiyA| ataH tuma isa kukarma kA AviSkAra karane vAle pahale loga ho, jisase vizuddha prakRti ghRNA karatI hai|

kyA tuma apanI kAmavAsanA kI pUrti ke lie puruSoM kI pichalI zarmagAha meM Ate ho aura yAtriyoM kA rAstA rokate ho, ki ve tumhAre dvArA kie jAne vAle anaitika kRtya ke Dara se tumhAre pAsa se nahIM guz2arate haiM, tathA tuma apanI sabhAoM meM nagnatA aura apane pAsa se guz2arane vAloM ko vacana evaM karma dvArA kaSTa pahu~cAne jaise niMdanIya kArya karate ho? to lUta alaihissalAma ke unheM burAI karane se manA karane ke bAda unakA uttara isake sivA kucha nahIM thA ki unhoMne kahA: tuma hamapara allAha kI vaha yAtanA le Ao, jisakI tuma hameM dhamakI dete ho, yadi tuma apane dAve meM sacce ho|

lUta alaihissalAma ne apanI jAti ke haTha tathA allAha kI yAtanA ko halake meM lete hue usake lAne kI mA~ga karane ke bAda, apane raba se prArthanA karate hue kahA: ai mere raba! una logoM ke viruddha merI sahAyatA kara, jo kufra aura niMdanIya pApa phailAkara dharatI meM bigAr3a paidA karane vAle haiM|

aura jaba hamAre bheje hue farizte ibarAhIma ko isahAqa kI tathA unake pazcAta unake putra yAqUba kI zubha sUcanA dene ke lie Ae, to unhoMne unase kahA: hama lUta kI jAti kI bastI 'sadUma' ke logoM ko vinaSTa karane vAle haiM; kyoMki isake loga anaitikatA kA kArya karane ke kAraNa atyAcArI rahe haiM|

ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ne fariztoM se kahA: isa bastI meM, jisake logoM ko tuma vinaSTa karanA cAhate ho, lUta (bhI) haiM aura vaha atyAcAriyoM meM se nahIM haiM| fariztoM ne kahA: hama use adhika jAnane vAle haiM, jo usameM hai| hama unheM aura unake parivAra ko usa vinAza se avazya bacA leMge jo bastI ke logoM para utarane vAlA hai, sivAya unakI strI ke, jo vinAza hone vAle zeSa logoM meM se hai| ataH hama use (bhI) unake sAtha naSTa kara deMge|

aura jaba lUta alaihissalAma kI jAti ko vinaSTa karane ke lie hamAre bheje hue farizte lUta alaihissalAma ke pAsa Ae, to vaha unapara apane samudAya ke durAcaraNa ke Dara se unake Ane se duHkhI aura g2amagIna ho gae| kyoMki farizte puruSoM ke rUpa meM Ae the aura unake samudAya vAle kAmavAsanA ke lie striyoM ke bajAya puruSoM ke pAsa Ate the| fariztoM ne unase kahA: mata Daro, tumhArI jAti ke loga tumheM koI hAni nahIM pahu~cA sakate| tathA jo kucha hamane tumheM unake vinAza ke viSaya meM batalAyA hai, usapara zoka na kareM| niHsaMdeha hama tumheM tathA tumhAre parivAra ko vinAza se bacA leMge, sivAya tumhArI strI ke, jo vinAza ke lie zeSa raha jAne vAloM meM se hai| ataH hama use (bhI) unake sAtha naSTa kara deMge|

hama isa bastI vAloM para, jo kukarma kiyA karate the, AkAza se eka yAtanA utArane vAle haiM, jo ki pake hue garma pattharoM kI yAtanA hai; yaha unake ghRNita kukarma karake allAha kI avajJA karane para saz2A ke rUpa meM hai, vaha kukarma unakA mahilAoM ke bajAya puruSoM ke sAtha yauna saMbaMdha banAnA hai|
nizcaya hamane isa bastI se, jise hamane miTA diyA, una logoM ke lie eka spaSTa nizAnI chor3a dI, jo samajhabUjha rakhate haiM; kyoMki vahI loga haiM jo nizAniyoM se sIkha grahaNa karate haiM|

aura hamane madayana kI ora unake nasabI bhAI zuaiba alaihissalAma ko bhejA, to unhoMne kahA: ai merI jAti ke logo! akele allAha kI ibAdata karo aura usakI ibAdata karake aMtima dina ke pratiphala kI AzA rakho, tathA pApa karake aura use phailAkara dharatI meM bigAr3a na paidA karo|

lekina unake samudAya ne unako jhuThalA diyA| aMtataH bhUkaMpa ne unako A liyA aura ve apane gharoM meM apane mu~ha ke bala aise girakara par3e raha gae ki unake mukha miTTI se cipake hue the, ve hila nahIM sakate the|

tathA hamane hUda alaihissalAma kI jAti Ada aura sAleha alaihissalAma kI jAti samUda ko bhI vinaSTa kiyA| aura (ai makkA vAlo!) tumhAre lie hijra tathA haz2arAmauta ke zihra nAmI sthAna meM unake AvAsoM se yaha spaSTa ho cukA hai, jo tumheM unake vinAza kA saMketa detA hai| cunA~ce unake khAlI AvAsa isa bAta kI gavAhI dete haiM| tathA zaitAna ne unake kufra aura anya pApoM ko jinameM ve par3e hue the, unake lie suMdara banA diyA aura unheM sIdhe rAste se haTA diyA| hAlA~ki unake rasUloM ke unheM sikhAne ke kAraNa ve satya, pathabhraSTatA, mArgadarzana tathA gumarAhI kI samajha rakhane vAle the| lekina unhoMne mArgadarzana ke pAlana para icchA ke pAlana ko cunA|

aura (jaba qArUna ne mUsA alaihissalAma kI jAti para atyAcAra kiyA, to) hamane use tathA usake ghara ko dharatI meM dha~sAkara nAza kara diyA| tathA firaauna aura usake maMtrI hAmAna ko samudra meM Dubokara nAza kiyA| niHsaMdeha mUsA alaihissalAma unake pAsa apanI saccAI ko darzAne vAlI spaSTa nizAniyA~ lekara Ae| paraMtu una logoM ne misra kI bhUmi meM unapara ImAna lAne se abhimAna dikhAyA| aura ve hamase chUTakara hamAre daMDa se baca nahIM sakate the|

ataH hamane ukta samudAyoM meM se pratyeka ko apanI vinAzakArI yAtanA ke dvArA pakar3a liyA| unameM lUta ke samudAya ke loga the, jinapara hamane tAbar3a-tor3a kaMkarIle patthara barasAe, unameM sAleha ke samudAya aura zuaiba ke samudAya the, jinheM cIkha ne pakar3a liyA, unameM qArUna thA jise hamane usake ghara sameta dharatI meM dha~sA diyA, tathA unameM nUha ke samudAya ke loga, firaauna aura hAmAna bhI the, jinheM hamane Dubo kara vinaSTa kara diyA| allAha aisA na thA ki unheM binA pApa ke naSTa karake una para atyAcAra kare, paraMtu ve pApa karake svayaM apane Apapara atyAcAra kara rahe the, isalie ve daMDa ke pAtra the|

una muzrikoM kA udAharaNa, jo allAha ke alAvA mUrtiyA~ banAkara unake lAbha yA unakI siphAriza kI AzA meM unakI pUjA karate haiM, makar3I ke udAharaNa ke samAna hai, jisane eka ghara banAyA tAki use AkramaNa se bacAe| hAlA~ki saba gharoM se kamaz2ora ghara makar3I kA ghara hai, isalie vaha use zatru se surakSA pradAna nahIM karatA| yahI hAla unakI mUrtiyoM kA hai, ve na lAbha pahu~cAtI haiM, na hAni aura na hI sifAriza kara sakatI haiM| yadi muzrika loga ise jAnate hote, to ve mUrtiyA~ banAkara allAha ke sivA unakI pUjA nahIM karate|

nizcaya pavitra evaM sarvocca allAha janatA hai jise ve usake alAvA pUjate haiM| usameM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai| tathA vaha sabapara prabhutvazAlI hai jise parAjita nahIM kiyA jA sakatA, apanI racanA, niyati aura prabaMdhana meM pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai|

hama ina udAharaNoM ko logoM ke lie prastuta karate haiM, tAki unheM jagAyA jA sake, unheM saccAI se avagata karAyA jA sake aura usakI ora unakA mArgadarzana kiyA jA sake| aura inheM ThIka se vahI samajha sakate haiM, jo allAha kI zarIyata aura usakI hikamatoM ko jAnane vAle haiM|

pavitra evaM sarvocca allAha ne AkAzoM tathA dharatI ko satya ke sAtha paidA kiyA, usane unheM asatya ke sAtha aura vyartha nahIM banAyA| nizcaya isa racanA meM mominoM ke lie allAha kI zakti kI spaSTa nizAnI hai| kyoMki kevala ImAnavAle hI allAha kI sRSTi ko pavitra sRSTikartA ke astitva ke lie pramANa banAte haiM| rahI bAta kAphiroM kI, to ve kSitija (brahmAMDa) meM tathA svaMya apane bhItara maujUda nizAniyoM se yU~ hI guz2ara jAte haiM, ve sRSTikartA kI mahAnatA aura usakI kSamatA kI ora unakA dhyAna AkarSita nahIM karatI haiM|

(ai rasUla!) Apa logoM ke samakSa usa quraAna ko paढ़eM, jisakI allAha ne ApakI ora vaha़ya kI hai, tathA sabase pUrNa tarIke se namAz2a adA kareM| bezaka pUrNa vidhi ke sAtha paढ़I jAne vAlI namAz2a usake par3hane vAle ko pApoM tathA burAiyoM meM par3ane se rokatI hai; kyoMki yaha dila ke aMdara eka prakAza paidA kara detI hai, jo pApa karane se rokatA hai aura acche karma karane ke lie mArgadarzana karatA hai| aura nizcaya allAha kA smaraNa hara cIja se bar3A aura mahAna hai| aura jo kucha tuma karate ho, allAha use jAnatA hai, tumhAre kAryoM meM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai| aura vaha tumheM tumhAre kAryoM kA pratiphala degA, yadi bhalA hai, to bhalA (badalA) aura yadi burA hai, to burA (badalA)|

(ai ImAna vAlo!) tuma yahUdiyoM aura IsAiyoM ke sAtha sabase acche evaM Adarza tarIqe se hI saMvAda aura vAda-vivAda karo, aura vaha upadeza aura spaSTa tarkoM ke sAtha islAma kI ora bulAnA hai| paraMtu unameM se jina logoM ne haTha aura ahaMkAra ke sAtha anyAya kiyA aura tumhAre qhilAfa yuddha kI ghoSaNA kara dI, to tuma unase lar3AI karo, yahA~ taka ki ve islAma grahaNa kara leM yA apamAnita hokara 'jiz2yA' adA kareM| tathA yahUdiyoM evaM IsAiyoM se kaho: hama usa quraAna para ImAna rakhate haiM, jo allAha ne hamArI ora utArA hai, tathA hama usa taurAta evaM iMjIla para bhI ImAna rakhate haiM, jo tumhArI ora utAre gae haiM| tathA hamArA aura tumhArA pUjya eka hI hai, jisakI pUjyatA, paramezvaratva aura pUrNatA meM usakA koI sAjhIdAra nahIM hai| aura hama akele usI ke prati AjJAkArI aura vinamra haiM|

jisa taraha hamane Apase pahale ke nabiyoM para kitAbeM utArI thIM, usI taraha hamane Apa para quraAna utArA hai| to taurAta par3hane vAloM meM se kucha loga (jaise ki abdullAha bina salAma) isapara ImAna rakhate haiM; kyoMki ve apanI kitAboM meM ApakA vivaraNa pAte haiM| tathA ina muzrikoM meM se bhI kucha loga aise haiM, jo isapara ImAna rakhate haiM| aura hamArI AyatoM kA inakAra kevala vahI kAfira karate haiM, jo satya ke spaSTa hone ke bAvajUda usake inakAra ke rAste para calane ke AdI haiM|

aura (ai rasUla) Apa quraAna se pahale na koI kitAba par3hete the aura na apane dAhine hAtha se kucha likhate the| kyoMki Apa 'ummI' (anapar3ha) haiM, likhanA aura par3hanA nahIM jAnate haiM|aura agara Apa par3hanA aura likhanA jAnate hote, to ajJAnI loga ApakI nubuvvata ke bAre meM avazya saMdeha karate aura yaha tarka dete ki Apa pichalI kitAboM kI bAteM likhA karate the|

(ai rasUla!) Apa ina prastAvakoM se kaha deM: nizAniyA~ to kevala allAha ke hAtha meM haiM, vaha jaba cAhe unheM utAratA hai| unheM utAranA merA kAma nahIM hai| maiM to mAtra tumheM, spaSTa rUpa se, allAha kI yAtanA se DarAne vAlA hU~|

kyA nizAniyoM kA prastAva dene vAle ina logoM ke lie yaha kAfI nahIM hai ki hamane (ai rasUla) Apapara quraAna utArA hai, jo unake sAmane par3hA jAtA hai? niHsaMdeha unapara utarane vAle quraAna meM una logoM ke lie dayA aura upadeza hai, jo ImAna rakhate haiM| kyoMki vahI loga quraAna kI zikSAoM se lAbhAnvita hote haiM| isalie jo kucha unapara utArA gayA hai, vaha unake dvArA sujhAI gaI pichale rasUloM para utarane vAlI nizAniyoM se kahIM behatara hai|

(ai rasUla) Apa kaha deM: maiM jo kucha lekara AyA hU~, usameM merI saccAI para tathA tumhAre use jhuThalAne para allAha gavAha ke taura para kAfI hai| vaha AkAzoM meM maujUda sArI cIz2oM aura dharatI kI sArI cIz2oM ko jAnatA hai| una donoM meM se koI cIz2a usase chipI nahIM hai| tathA jina logoM ne asatya arthAt allAha ke alAvA pUjI jAne vAlI pratyeka cIz2a ko mAnA aura ekamAtra ibAdata ke haqadAra allAha kA inakAra kiyA, vahI loga ghATe meM par3ane vAle haiM, kyoMki unhoMne ImAna ke badale kufra ko cunA hai|

(ai rasUla) Apane muzrikoM ko jisa yAtanA se DarAyA hai, ve Apase usake lie jaldI macA rahe haiM| agara allAha ne unakI yAtanA ke lie eka samaya nirdhArita na kiyA hotA, jisase vaha Age-pIche nahIM ho sakatI, to unake pAsa vaha yAtanA avazya A jAtI, jisakI ve mA~ga kara rahe haiM| tathA nizcita rUpa se vaha unapara acAnaka avazya AegI, jabaki unheM usakA anumAna bhI na hogA|

ve loga Apase usa yAtanA ke lie jaldI macA rahe haiM, jisakA Apane unase vAdA kiyA hai| hAlA~ki jahannama, jisakA allAha ne kAfiroM se vAdA kiyA hai, nizcita rUpa se unheM gherane vAlI hai, jisakI yAtanA se ve baca nahIM sakate|

jisa dina yAtanA unheM unake Upara se DhA~pa legI aura unake pairoM ke nIce unake lie bistara bana jAegI, aura allAha unheM phaTakArate hue kahegA: tuma jo zirka aura pApa kiyA karate the, usakA pratiphala cakho|

ai mere baMdo jo mujhapara ImAna lAe ho, usa dharatI se hijarata (palAyana) kara jAo, jahA~ tuma merI ibAdata nahIM kara sakate| niHsaMdeha merI dharatI vizAla hai| isalie akele merI hI ibAdata karo aura kisI ko bhI merA sAjhI na banAo|
mRtyu kA Dara tumheM hijarata se na roke| kyoMki hara prANI mRtyu kA svAda cakhane vAlA hai| phira tumheM qiyAmata ke dina hisAba aura badale ke lie hamAre hI pAsa lauTakara AnA hai|

jo loga allAha para ImAna lAe aura usase nikaTa karane vAle acche kArya kie, hama unheM jannata meM U~ce-U~ce bhavanoM meM nivAsa deMge, jinake nIce se nahare bahatI haiM| ve unameM hamezA ke lie raheMge, unameM unheM vinAza kA sAmanA nahIM hogA| allAha kI AjJA ke anusAra kAma karane vAloM kA yaha kyA hI acchA badalA hai|

allAha kI AjJA kA pAlana karane vAle una logoM kA badalA kyA hI acchA hai, jinhoMne usakI AjJAkAritA para aura usakI avajJA se bacane para dhairya se kAma liyA, tathA ve apane sabhI kAmoM meM kevala apane pAlanahAra hI para bharosA rakhate haiM|

dharatI para calane vAle sabhI jAnavara - apanI bahutAyata ke bAvajUda - jo apanI roz2I ekatra nahIM kara sakate aura na hI use uThA sakate haiM, allAha unheM jIvikA pradAna karatA hai aura tumheM bhI jIvikA pradAna karatA hai| isalie tumhAre lie bhUkha ke Dara se hijarata chor3ane ke lie koI bahAnA nahIM hai| vaha tumhArI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, tumhAre irAdoM aura kAryoM ko jAnane vAlA hai| usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai aura vaha tumheM usakA badalA degA|

(ai rasUla) yadi Apa ina muzrikoM se pUcheM ki AkAzoM ko kisane paidA kiyA? aura dharatI ko kisane paidA kiyA? tathA sUrya aura cA~da ko kisane vazIbhUta kiyA, jo eka-dUsare ke bAda Ate-jAte haiM? to ve avazya kaheMge: unheM allAha ne paidA kiyA hai| to phira ve akele allAha para ImAna lAne se kaise phera die jAte haiM aura usake sivA aise devatAoM kI pUjA karate haiM, jo kisI lAbha yA hAni ke mAlika nahIM haiM?
