allAha ne eka AdamI ke sIne meM do dila nahIM banAe, na hI usane patniyoM ko niSedha (harAma hone) meM mAtAoM ke samAna banAyA, aura na hI usane mu~ha bole beToM (goda lie hue putroM) ko sage beToM ke samAna banAyA| kyoMki "z2ihAra" (arthAt kisI vyakti kA apanI patnI ko apane Upara apanI mA~ aura bahana ke samAna harAma kara lenA) aura isI taraha "mu~ha bolA beTA banAnA" (goda lenA): pUrva-islAmika rIti-rivAjoM meM se haiM, jinheM islAma ne amAnya kara diyA hai| yaha 'z2ihAra' aura 'mu~ha bolA beTA banAnA' eka kathana hai, jise tuma apane mu~ha se doharAte ho, isameM koI saccAI nahIM hai| kyoMki patnI na to mA~ hai, aura na hI mu~ha bolA beTA usa vyakti kA beTA hai, jisane use beTA banAyA hai| allAha taAlA satya kahatA hai, tAki usake baMde usa para amala kareM, aura vahI satya ke mArga kI ora rahanumAI karatA hai|

jinheM tuma apanA beTA hone kA dAvA karate ho, unheM unake asalI bApoM kI ora manasUba karo| kyoMki unheM unakI ora manasUba karanA hI allAha ke nikaTa nyAyasaMgata hai| yadi tumheM unake pitA mAlUma na hoM, jinakI ora unheM manasUba karo, to ve tumhAre dhArmika bhAI aura tumhAre gulAmI se Az2Ada kie hue loga haiM| to unheM 'ai mere bhAI' aura 'ai mere bhatIje' kahakara pukAro| yadi koI vyakti bhUla se kisI mu~ha bole beTe ko usake mu~ha bole bApa kI ora manasUba karake bulA le, to koI gunAha nahIM hai| balki gunAha usa samaya hai, jaba jAna-bUjhakara bolA jAe| aura allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko mAfa karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai ki bhUla-cUka para unakI pakar3a nahIM karatA|

paigaMbara muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama, hara usa cIz2a ke mAmale meM jisakI ora vaha ImAna vAloM ko bulAe~, una para svayaM unake apane prANoM se bhI adhika haqa rakhane vAle haiM, bhale hI unake dila dUsaroM ke prati jhukAva rakhate hoM| aura Apa sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI patniyA~ sabhI ImAna vAloM kI mAtAoM ke darje meM haiM| isalie kisI bhI momina ke lie Apa sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI mRtyu ke bAda unameM se kisI se zAdI karanA harAma (niSiddha) hai| aura riztedAra, allAha ke Adeza ke anusAra, virAsata ke mAmale meM anya ImAna vAloM aura muhAjiroM se Apasa meM eka-dUsare para adhika haqa rakhane vAle haiM, jo islAma kI zuruAta meM Apasa meM eka-dUsare kA vArisa huA karate the, phira isa taraha se Apasa meM vArisa hone ke niyama ko nirasta kara diyA gayA| paraMtu (ai ImAna vAlo!) agara tuma vArisoM ke alAvA apane anya dostoM ke lie kucha dhana kI vasIyata karanA tathA unapara upakAra karanA cAho, to tuma aisA kara sakate ho| yaha Adeza lauha़e maha़phUz2a meM aMkita hai| isalie isapara amala karanA z2arUrI hai|

aura (ai rasUla!) Apa usa samaya ko yAda kareM, jaba hamane nabiyoM se kevala eka allAha kI ibAdata karane, usake sAtha kisI ko sAjhI na banAne aura unakI ora jo vaha़ya (prakAzanA) kI gaI hai, use logoM taka pahu~cAne kA dRr3ha vacana liyA| tathA hamane vizeSa rUpa se Apase aura nUha, ibarAhIma, mUsA aura IsA bina marayama se vacana liyA| tathA hamane unase dRr3ha saMkalpa liyA ki jo kucha unheM allAha kA saMdeza pahu~cAne kI z2immedArI sauMpI gaI hai, use pUrA kareMge|

allAha ne nabiyoM se yaha dRr3ha pratijJA lI, tAki kAfiroM kI bhartsanA karate hue sacce rasUloM se unakI saccAI ke bAre meM pUche, aura allAha ne apane tathA apane rasUloM kA inakAra karane vAloM ke lie qiyAmata ke dina dardanAka yAtanA taiyAra kara rakhI hai, jo jahannama kI Aga hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane vAlo aura usakI zarIyata kA pAlana karane vAlo! tuma apane Upara allAha ke usa upakAra ko yAda karo, jaba kAfiroM kI senAe~ tumase lar3ane ke lie jatthAbaMda hokara madInA para car3ha AIM, tathA munAfiqoM evaM yahUdiyoM ne unakA samarthana kiyA| to hamane unapara pUrvI havA bheja dI, jisake dvArA allAha ke rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI madada kI gaI, tathA hamane fariztoM kI senAe~ bhejIM, jinheM tumane nahIM dekhA| ataH kAfira bhAga khar3e hue, ve kucha bhI karane meM sakSama nahIM the| aura jo kucha tuma kara rahe the, allAha use khUba dekhane vAlA thA, usameM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai| aura vaha tumheM tumhAre karmoM kA badalA degA|

aura yaha usa samaya huA jaba kAfira ghATI ke Upara se aura usake nIce se pUrva aura pazcima kI dizA se tumapara car3ha Ae, usa samaya nigAheM sArI cIz2oM se haTakara kevala duzmanoM para Tika gaIM aura gahana bhaya ke kAraNa kaleje mu~ha ko Ane lage aura tuma allAha ke bAre meM taraha-taraha ke gumAna karane lage; cunA~ce kabhI tuma jIta ke bAre meM socate, aura kabhI usase nirAzA kA gumAna karane lagate|

khaMdaqa kI lar3AI ke daurAna usa avasara para, ImAna vAloM kA isa taraha parIkSaNa kiyA gayA ki unake duzmana unapara TUTa par3e aura ve Dara kI tIvratA se burI taraha hilA die gae| aura isa parIkSaNa se yaha spaSTa ho gayA ki kauna momina hai aura kauna munAfiqa|

usa dina munAfikoM aura kamaz2ora ImAna vAle logoM ne, jinake diloM meM saMdeha hai, kahA: allAha aura usake rasUla ne hamase hamAre duzmana para vijaya aura dharatI meM hameM prabhutva pradAna karane kA jo vAdA kiyA thA, vaha asatya aura nirAdhAra thA|

aura (ai rasUla!) usa samaya ko yAda kareM, jaba munAfiqoM ke eka samUha ne madInA ke logoM se kahA: ai yasariba (islAma se pahale madInA kA nAma) vAlo! tumhAre lie qhaMdaqa ke pAsa, 'sala' pahAr3I ke dAmana meM Thaharane kA koI sthAna nahIM hai| isalie apane gharoM ko lauTa calo| aura unameM se eka samUha nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama se ghara vApasI kI anumita mA~ga rahA thA| unakA dAvA thA ki unake ghara duzmana kI z2ada meM haiM, jabaki mAmalA aisA nahIM hai jaisA ki unhoMne dAvA kiyA hai| balki ve isa jhUThe bahAne ke dvArA duzmana se bhAganA cAhate haiM|

aura agara duzmana unapara madInA meM usakI sabhI dizAoM se praveza kara jAtA, aura unase allAha kA inakAra karane aura usake sAtha sAjhI ThaharAne kI ora lauTane ke lie kahatA, to nizcaya ve apane duzmana kI yaha bAta mAna lete, aura ve islAma dharma tyAgane aura kufra kI ora palaTane meM kevala thor3I hI dera saMkoca karate|

jabaki ina munAfiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) ne uhuda ke dina yuddha se bhAgane ke bAda allAha se pratijJA kI thI ki agara allAha ne unheM kisI aura lar3AI meM zAmila hone kA avasara diyA, to ve apane duzmana se z2arUra lar3AI kareMge aura unake Dara se nahIM bhAgeMge| lekina unhoMne vAdA tor3a diyA| hAlA~ki baMde ne allAha se jo vAdA kiyA hai, usake prati vaha z2immedAra hai aura usase usakA hisAba liyA jAegA|

(ai rasUla) Apa ina logoM se kaha deM: yadi tuma marane yA qatla hone ke bhaya se lar3AI se bhAgate ho, to (yaha) bhAganA tumheM haragiz2a lAbha nahIM degA| kyoMki mauta kA samaya nirdhArita hai| aura agara tuma bhAgate ho aura tumhArI mauta kA samaya nahIM AyA hai, taba bhI tuma jIvana meM kevala thor3e samaya kA AnaMda le sakoge|

(ai rasUla) Apa unase kaha deM: agara allAha tumhAre sAtha usI mauta aura qatla kA irAdA kare, jise tuma nApasaMda karate ho, yA tumhAre sAtha salAmatI aura bhalAI kA irAdA kare, jisakI tuma AzA karate ho, to vaha kauna hai jo tumheM allAha se bacA sakatA hai?! koI bhI tumheM isase bacA nahIM sakatA| aura ye munAfiqa loga apane lie allAha ke sivA koI saMrakSaka nahIM pAe~ge, jo unake mAmale kI dekhabhAla kare aura na hI koI sahAyaka pAe~ge, jo unheM allAha kI saz2A se bacA sake|

allAha tuma meM se una logoM ko jAnatA hai, jo dUsare logoM ko allAha ke rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke sAtha milakara lar3ane se hatotsAhita karate haiM, aura jo apane bhAiyoM se kahate haiM: hamAre pAsa Ao aura unake sAtha yuddha meM zAmila na ho tAki tuma mAre na jAo| kyoMki hameM tumhAre mAre jAne kA bhaya hai| aura ye hatotsAhita karane vAle yuddha meM nahIM Ate haiM aura zAyada hI kabhI usameM bhAga lete haiM; tAki apane Apa se apamAna ko dUra kara sakeM, isalie nahIM ki ve allAha aura usake rasUla kI madada kareM|

ve tumapara (ai ImAna vAlo) apane dhana ke sAtha bar3e kaMjUsa haiM, isalie ve use kharca karake tumhArI madada nahIM karate haiM| tathA ve apanI jAnoM ke saMbaMdha meM bhI kaMjUsa haiM, isalie ve tumhAre sAtha lar3AI nahIM karate| tathA ve apanI dostI ke saMbaMdha meM bhI kaMjUsa haiM, isalie ve tumase mitratA nahIM karate| cunA~ce jaba duzmana se muThabher3a ke samaya bhaya kA sAmanA hotA hai, to Apa unheM dekheMge ki ve (ai rasUla) ApakI ora aise dekhate haiM ki unakI A~kheM kAyaratA ke kAraNa usa AdamI kI A~khoM ke ghUmane kI taraha ghUma rahI haiM, jo mauta kI pIr3A se jUjha rahA ho| phira jaba unakA bhaya jAtA rahatA hai aura ve nizciMta ho jAte haiM, to ve apanI tez2a z2abAnoM ke sAtha tumheM kaSTa pahu~cAte haiM| ve g2anImata ke mAla ke bar3e lobhI hote haiM aura usakI tAka meM rahate haiM| ye loga jo ina vizeSatAoM se viziSTa haiM, vAstava meM ImAna hI nahIM lAe haiM| isalie allAha ne inake karmoM ke savAba ko vyartha kara diyA| aura yaha vyartha karanA allAha ke lie ati sarala hai|

ye kAyara loga samajhate haiM ki allAha ke rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama aura ImAna vAloM se lar3AI ke lie ekajuTa hone vAlI senAe~ musalamAnoM kA safAyA kie binA kabhI vApasa nahIM jAe~gI| aura agara aisA ho ki ye senAe~ dobArA A jAe~, to ye munAfiqa loga pasaMda kareMge ki ve dehAtiyoM ke sAtha madInA ke bAhara nikala jAte, jahA~ se ve tumhArI khabara ke bAre meM pUchate ki: tumhAre duzmana ke tumase lar3ane ke bAda tumhAre sAtha kyA huA? aura agara ve (ai momino!) tumhAre bIca meM hote, to ve tumhAre sAtha bahuta kama hI lar3ate| isalie unakI paravAha na karo aura na hI unapara afasosa karo|

allAha ke rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ne jo kucha kahA, jo kucha aMjAma diyA aura jo kucha kiyA, usameM tumhAre lie uttama Adarza hai| cunA~ce Apa svaMya upasthita hue aura yuddha kiyA, to phira tuma usake bAda ApakI jAna se beparavAha hokara apanI jAnoM ko nichAvara karane meM kaMjUsI karate ho? aura allAha ke rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke Adarza ko vahI apanAegA, jo allAha ke pratiphala aura dayA kI AzA rakhatA ho aura Aqhirata ke dina kI AzA rakhatA ho, aura usake lie kArya karatA ho aura allAha ko bahuta z2yAdA yAda karatA ho| lekina jo vyakti Aqhirata ke dina kI AzA nahIM rakhatA hai aura allAha ko bahuta z2yAdA yAda nahIM karatA hai, to vaha allAha ke rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke Adarza ko nahIM apanAegA|

aura jaba ImAna vAloM ne unase lar3ane ke lie ekatrita senAoM ko apanI A~khoM se dekha liyA to kahA: yahI vaha parIkSaNa, vipatti aura madada (vijaya) hai, jisakA allAha aura usake rasUla ne hamase vAdA kiyA thA aura allAha aura usake rasUla isameM sacce the, cunA~ce vaha pUrA ho gayA| tathA senAoM ko dekhane se unakA allAha para ImAna aura usake prati samarpaNa aura bar3ha gayA|

ImAna vAloM meM se kucha loga aise haiM, jinhoMne allAha se kiyA huA vAdA saca kara dikhAyA| cunA~ce unhoMne allAha ke rAste meM jihAda meM dRr3hatA aura dhairya kA jo vAdA kiyA thA, use pUrA kiyA| to unameM se kucha loga mara gae yA allAha kI rAha meM zahIda ho gae aura kucha loga usake rAste meM zahIda hone kI pratIkSA kara rahe haiM| aura ina ImAna vAloM ne allAha se ki hue apane vAde ko nahIM badalA, jaisA ki munAfiqoM ne apane vAdoM ke sAtha kiyA|

tAki allAha una sacce logoM ko, jinhoMne allAha se kie hue vAde ko pUrA kiyA, unakI saccAI aura vAdA nibhAne kA badalA de, aura pratijJA ko tor3ane vAle munAfiqoM ko yadi cAhe to yAtanA de, isa prakAra ki unheM unake kufra se taubA karane se pahale hI mauta de de, yA unakI taubA qabUla karate hue unheM taubA karane kI taufIqa pradAna kara de| aura allAha apane gunAhoM se taubA karane vAle ko kSamA karane vAlA, usapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

aura allAha ne quraiza, g2atafAna aura una logoM ko jo unake sAtha the, unakI ummIdoM para pAnI phira jAne ke kAraNa unakI pIr3A aura zoka ke sAtha lauTA diyA, ve musalamAnoM kA saphAyA karane ke irAde meM kAmayAba na hue| aura allAha A~dhI bhejakara aura fariztoM ko utArakara unase yuddha karane ke lie ImAna vAloM ko kAphI ho gayA| aura allAha bar3A zaktizAlI, atyaMta prabhutvazAlI hai, jo bhI usase muqAbalA karane kI koziza karegA, vaha use parAjita aura asahAya kara degA|

allAha ne yahUdiyoM meM se una logoM ko, jinhoMne kAfiroM kI sahAyatA kI thI, unake una qiloM se utAra diyA, jahA~ ve apane duzmanoM se bacane ke lie zaraNa lete the| aura unake diloM meM bhaya DAla diyA| cunA~ce tuma (ai ImAna vAlo) unake eka giroha ko qatla kara rahe the aura eka giroha ko baMdI banA rahe the|

aura allAha ne unake vinAza ke bAda, unakI bhUmi ko khetiyoM aura qhajUra ke bAg2oM sameta tumhAre qabz2e meM kara diyA| tathA tumheM unake gharoM aura unake anya dhanoM kA mAlika banA diyA| aura tumheM qhaibara kI bhUmi kA mAlika banA diyA, jisapara tumane abhI taka apane pA~va bhI nahIM rakhe the| lekina aba usa para tumhAre qadama par3eMge| yaha ImAna vAloM ke lie eka vAdA aura khuzaqhabarI hai| aura allAha hara cIz2a para sarvazaktimAna hai, use koI cIz2a vivaza nahIM kara sakatI|

ai nabI! apanI patniyoM se kaha deM, jabaki unhoMne Apase nafaqA (bharaNa-poSaNa) meM vistAra karane kI mA~ga kI hai aura Apake pAsa una para vistAra karane ke lie kucha bhI nahIM hai: agara tuma duniyA kA jIvana aura usakI zobhA cAhatI ho, to mere pAsa Ao, maiM tumheM kucha sAmAna de dU~, jo talAqazudA mahilAoM ko diyA jAtA hai aura tumheM binA koI nuqasAna pahu~cAe yA kaSTa die talAqa de dU~|

aura agara tuma allAha kI prasannatA aura usake rasUla kI prasannatA cAhatI ho, aura Akhirata ke ghara meM jannata cAhatI ho, to apanI hAlata para sabra karo| kyoMki tumameM se jo sabra aura acche rahana-sahana ke sAtha jIvana yApana karegI, usake lie allAha ne bahuta bar3A badalA taiyAra kara rakhA hai|

ai nabI kI striyo! tumameM se jo bhI koI spaSTa pApa karegI, qiyAmata ke dina usakI yAtanA dogunI kara dI jAegI| aisA usakI sthiti aura pada ke kAraNa tathA nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke mAna-sammAna kI rakSA ke lie hogA| aura yaha dogunI yAtanA denA allAha ke lie bahuta AsAna hai|

aura tumameM se jo koI niraMtara allAha aura usake rasUla kA AjJApAlana kare aura allAha ke nikaTa pasaMdIdA neka kArya kare, hama use dUsarI mahilAoM kI tulanA meM dogunA savAba deMge| tathA hamane usake lie Akhirata meM uttama (sammAnajanaka) badalA taiyAra kara rakhA hai, jo ki jannata hai|

aura tuma apane gharoM meM ThaharI raho| isalie z2arUrata ke binA ghara se bAhara na nikalo aura islAma se pUrva kI mahilAoM kI taraha apane saundarya kA pradarzana na karo, jo puruSoM ko rijhAne ke lie apane saundarya kA pradarzana kiyA karatI thIM| aura namAz2a ko sabase pUrNa rUpa se adA karo aura apane dhana kI z2akAta do aura allAha tathA usake rasUla kA AjJApAlana karo| ai allAha ke rasUla kI patniyo aura ai Apake ghara vAlo, allAha to cAhatA hai ki tumase kaSTa aura burAI dUra kara de| tathA vaha cAhatA hai ki tumhArI AtmAoM ko; ziSTAcAra se susajjita evaM duSTa AcaraNa se rahita kara, isa taraha pUrNa rUpa se zuddha va pavitra kara de ki usake pazcAta koI gaMdagI bAkI na rahe|

tumhAre gharoM meM jo allAha ke rasUla para utarane vAlI AyateM aura usake rasUla kI pavitra sunnata paढ़I jAtI haiM, unheM yAda rakho| nizcaya hI allAha tumapara bar3A kRpAlu hai jaba usane tumapara yaha upakAra kiyA ki tumheM apane rasUla ke gharoM meM rakhA, tathA vaha tumase pUrI taraha avagata hai jaba usane tumheM apane rasUla ke lie patniyoM ke rUpa meM cayana kiyA aura tumheM ApakI ummata ke samasta mominoM kI mAoM ke rUpa meM cuna liyA|

AjJAkAritA ke sAtha allAha ke adhIna hone vAle puruSa aura adhIna hone vAlI striyA~, allAha ko saccA mAnane vAle puruSa aura saccA mAnane vAlI striyA~, allAha kA AjJApAlana karane vAle puruSa aura AjJApAlana karane vAlI striyA~, apane ImAna aura kathana meM sacce puruSa aura saccI striyA~, AjJAkAritA ke kAmoM para aura gunAhoM se dUra rahane meM aura vipatti para dhairya se kAma lene vAle puruSa aura dhairya se kAma lene vAlI striyA~, anivArya aura svaicchika dAna karane vAle puruSa aura dAna karane vAlI striyA~, allAha ke lie anivArya aura svaicchika roz2A rakhane vAle puruSa aura roz2A rakhane vAlI striyA~, apane guptAMgoM kI rakSA karane vAle puruSa aura apane guptAMgoM kI rakSA karane vAlI striyA~; unheM aise vyakti ke sAmane prakaTa karane se Dhakakara, jisake lie unheM dekhanA jAyaz2a nahIM hai tathA vyabhicAra ke duSkarma aura usakI prAraMbhika cIz2oM se dUra rahakara, tathA apane diloM aura apanI z2abAnoM se gupta aura khule taura para allAha ko bahuta adhika yAda karane vAle puruSa aura yAda karane vAlI striyA~ - allAha ne unake lie apanI ora se unake pApoM ke lie kSamA, tathA qiyAmata ke dina unake lie bahuta bar3A badalA taiyAra kara rakhA hai aura vaha jannata hai|

kisI ImAna vAle puruSa aura ImAna vAlI strI ke lie yaha ThIka nahIM hai ki jaba allAha aura usakA rasUla kisI bAta kA nirNaya kara deM, to unake lie use svIkAra karane yA asvIkAra karane kA vikalpa bAqI rahe| aura jo allAha aura usake rasUla kI avajJA kare, to vaha spaSTa rUpa se sIdhe rAste se bhaTaka gayA|

aura jaba Apa (ai rasUla) usa vyakti se, jisapara allAha ne islAma ke dvArA upakAra kiyA aura Apane use Az2Ada karake usapara upakAra kiyA - isase abhiprAya z2aida bina hArisA raz2iyallAhu anhumA haiM, jaba vaha Apake pAsa apanI patnI z2ainaba binte jahaza ko talAqa dene ke saMbaMdha meM parAmarza karane Ae - Apa usase kaha rahe the: apanI patnI ko apane pAsa roke rakho aura use talAqa na do| aura allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karake evaM usake niSedhoM se bacakara usase Daro| tathA (ai rasUla) Apa apane dila meM z2ainaba se apanI zAdI kI bAta, jisakI allAha ne ApakI ora vaha़ya utArI thI, logoM ke bhaya se chipA rahe the| jabaki allAha z2aida ke use talAqa dene phira Apake usase vivAha kA mAmalA prakaTa karane vAlA thA| hAlA~ki allAha isa bAta kA adhika yogya hai ki Apa isa mAmale meM usase DareM| phira jaba z2aida kA mana z2ainaba se alaga hone para saMtuSTa ho gayA aura use talAqa de dI, to hamane ApakA usase vivAha kara diyA, tAki ImAna vAloM para apane mu~ha bole beToM kI patniyoM se vivAha karane meM koI pApa na rahe, yadi ve unheM talAka de deM aura unakI iddata samApta ho jAe| aura allAha kA Adeza pUrA hokara hI rahatA hai, use koI rokane vAlA aura usake Age koI bAdhaka nahIM hai|

nabI muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama para usa cIz2a meM koI gunAha yA taMgI nahIM hai, jo allAha ne unake lie apane dattaka putra kI patnI se vivAha karanA vaidha kara diyA hai| vaha isa viSaya meM apane pUrva nabiyoM kI sunnata (tarIqe) kA pAlana kara rahe haiM| isalie vaha isa mAmale meM koI anokhe rasUla nahIM haiM| tathA allAha jo nirNaya kara detA hai (jaise ki isa zAdI ke pUrA hone aura goda lene kI prathA ko amAnya ghoSita karane aura isameM nabI kI koI rAya yA pasaMda na hone kA) vaha pUrA hokara rahatA hai, use koI TAla nahIM sakatA|

ye nabIgaNa, jo apane Upara utarane vAle allAha ke saMdezoM ko apane samudAyoM taka pahu~cAte haiM, aura sarvazaktimAna va mahimAvAna allAha ke alAvA kisI se bhI nahIM Darate|isalie ve isa bAta para dhyAna nahIM dete ki dUsare kyA kahate haiM jaba ve usa cIz2a ko karate haiM jisakI allAha ne unheM anumati dI hai| aura allAha apane baMdoM ke kRtyoM ko saMrakSita rakhane ke lie paryApta hai, tAki unakA hisAba le aura unheM unakA badalA de; acche karma kA acchA badalA aura bure karma kA burA badalA|

muhammada tumhAre puruSoM meM se kisI ke pitA nahIM haiM| ataH vaha z2aida ke bhI pitA nahIM haiM ki unapara z2aida kI talAqa dI huI patnI se vivAha karanA harAma (varjita) ho| balki vaha logoM kI ora allAha ke bheje hue rasUla haiM aura nabiyoM kI zrRMkhalA ko samApta karane vAle haiM|isalie unake bAda koI aura nabI nahIM hai| aura allAha hara cIz2a kA pUrNa jJAna rakhane vAlA hai, usake baMdoM kI koI cIz2a usase chipI nahIM hai|
ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usakI zarIyata para amala karane vAlo, tuma apane diloM, z2ubAnoM aura zArIrika aMgoM se allAha ko bahuta yAda karate raho|
tathA dina kI zuruAta aura usake aMta meM 'tasbIha' (subhAnallAha) aura 'tahalIla' (lA ilAhA illallAha) ke dvArA usakI pavitratA bayAna karate raho, kyoMki ye donoM pratiSThA vAle samaya haiM|

vahI hai, jo tumapara dayA karatA hai aura tumhArI prazaMsA karatA hai, tathA usake farizte bhI tumhAre lie duA karate haiM, tAki vaha tumheM kufra ke a~dheroM se nikAla kara ImAna ke prakAza kI ora lAe| aura vaha ImAna vAloM para bahuta dayAlu hai| ataH yadi ve usakI bAta mAnate hue, usake Adeza kA pAlana kareM aura usake niSedha se baceM, to vaha unheM yAtanA nahIM detA hai|

ImAna vAle jisa dina apane pAlanahAra se mileMge, usa dina unakA abhivAdana salAma (zAMti) aura hara prakAra kI burAI se surakSA hogI| aura allAha ne unake lie sammAnajanaka (va udAra) badalA - apanA svarga - taiyAra kara rakhA hai| yaha unake usakA AjJApAlana karane aura usakI avajJA se dUra rahane kA badalA hai|

ai nabI! hamane Apako logoM kI ora, unapara isa bAta kA gavAha banAkara bhejA hai ki Apane unheM vaha saMdeza pahu~cA diyA jisake sAtha Apa unakI ora bheje gae the, tathA unameM se ImAna vAloM ko usa jannata kI zubha sUcanA dene vAlA jo allAha ne unake lie taiyAra kara rakhI hai tathA kAphiroM ko usakI yAtanA se DarAne vAlA banAkara bhejA hai|

hamane Apako allAha ke Adeza se usake ekezvaravAda aura usakI AjJAkAritA kI ora bulAne vAlA banAkara bhejA hai| tathA hamane Apako eka prakAzamAn dIpa banAkara bhejA hai, jisase hara mArgadarzana cAhane vAlA prakAza prApta karatA hai|

tathA Apa allAha para ImAna rakhane vAle una logoM ko, jo usakI zarIyata para amala karate haiM, zubha sUcanA de deM ki unake lie allAha kI ora se bahuta bar3A anugraha hai, jisameM isa duniyA meM unakI madada tathA Akhirata meM jannata meM praveza karane kI saphalatA zAmila hai|

Apa kAfiroM aura munAfiqoM kI usa cIz2a meM bAta na mAneM, jo ve allAha ke dharma se rokane kI ora bulAte haiM| tathA unase upekSA kareM| zAyada yaha isa bAta kA adhika preraka ho ki ve usa cIz2a para ImAna le Ae~ jise lekara Apa unake pAsa Ae haiM| Apa apane sabhI mAmaloM meM allAha para bharosA kareM; jinameM apane duzmanoM para jIta bhI zAmila hai| tathA allAha kArasAz2a (kAma banAnevAle) ke rUpa meM paryApta hai, jisapara baMde apane duniyA aura Aqhirata ke sabhI mAmaloM meM bharosA karate haiM|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usakI zarIyata para amala karane vAlo! jaba ImAna vAlI mahilAoM se vivAha karo, phira unake sAtha sahavAsa karane se pUrva hI unheM talAqa de do, to aise meM tumhAre lie unapara 'iddata' nahIM hai, cAhe vaha mAsika dharma ke dvArA ho yA mahInoM ke dvArA| kyoMki unake sAtha sahavAsa na hone ke kAraNa yaha jJAta hai ki unakA garbha khAlI hai| tathA talAqa ke kAraNa unake TUTe hue diloM kI sAMtvanA ke lie, apanI kSamatA ke anusAra unheM kucha dhana de do| aura unheM kaSTa pahu~cAe binA, bhalAI ke sAtha unakA rAstA chor3a do|

ai nabI! hamane Apake lie ApakI una patniyoM ko vaidha kara diyA hai, jinheM Apane unakA mahara cukA diyA hai| tathA hamane Apake lie una dAsiyoM ko bhI halAla kiyA hai, jo Apake svAmitva meM haiM, jo allAha ne Apako baMdI auratoM meM se pradAna kI haiM| aura hamane Apake lie halAla kiyA hai Apake cAcA kI beTiyoM ke sAtha vivAha, ApakI phUphiyoM kI beTiyoM ke sAtha vivAha, Apake mAmA kI beTiyoM ke sAtha vivAha aura ApakI mausiyoM kI beTiyoM ke sAtha vivAha, jo Apake sAtha makkA se madInA kI ora hijarata karake AI haiM| tathA hamane Apake lie usa ImAna vAlI mahilA se bhI vivAha karanA halAla kiyA hai jo binA mahara ke svayaM ko Apako bheMTa kara de, yadi Apa usase nikAha karanA cAheM| aura hibA (anudAna) kA vivAha kevala Apa sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke lie viziSTa hai, Apake alAvA ummata ke kisI anya vyakti ke lie jAyaz2a nahIM hai| hameM jAnate haiM jo kucha hamane ImAna vAloM para unakI patniyoM ke saMbaMdha meM anivArya kiyA hai ki unake lie cAra striyoM kI sImA pAra karanA vaidha nahIM hai| tathA hama vaha bhI jAnate haiM jo hamane unakI dAsiyoM ke saMbaMdha meM unake lie dharmasaMgata kiyA hai ki unake lie kisI saMkhyA ke pratibaMdha ke binA unameM se jitanI se cAheM, lAbha uThAne kA adhikAra haiM| hamane ullikhita cIz2oM meM se Apake lie jo kucha vaidha kiyA hai, jo hamane Apake alAvA ke lie anumeya nahIM kiyA; yaha isalie hai tAki Apapara koI taMgI aura kaSTa na rahe| aura allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMdoM ko bahuta kSamA karane vAlA, unapara atyaMta dayAlu hai|

(ai rasUla!) Apa apanI patniyoM meM se jisakI bArI vilaMbita karanA cAheM, vilaMbita kara deM aura usake sAtha rAta na gujAreM| tathA uname se jise cAheM, apane pAsa rakheM aura usake sAtha rAta bitAe~| aura jinakI bArI ko Apane vilaMbita kara diyA hai, unameM se kisI ko (phira se) apane sAtha rakhanA cAheM, to isameM Apapara koI gunAha nahIM hai| Apake lie yaha vikalpa aura vistAra isa bAta ke adhika nikaTa hai ki isase ApakI striyoM kI A~kheM ThaMDI raheM aura yaha ki Apane unheM jo kucha diyA hai, usase ve saMtuSTa raheM| kyoMki unheM mAlUma hai ki Apane koI kartavya nahIM chor3A hai aura na kisI haqa kI adAyagI meM kaMjUsI kI hai| aura (ai puruSo!) tumhAre diloM meM jo kucha striyoM ko chor3akara kucha kI ora jhukAva pAyA jAtA hai, allAha usase avagata hai| allAha apane baMdoM ke kAryoM ko bhalI-bhA~ti jAnane vAlA hai, usase unameM se kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai, tathA vaha sahanazIla hai, unheM saz2A dene meM jaldI nahIM karatA, tAki ve taubA kara leM|

Apake lie (ai rasUla) apanI una patniyoM ke alAvA jo Apake nikAha meM haiM, anya mahilAoM se zAdI karanA jAyaz2a nahIM hai| tathA Apake lie unheM talAqa denA, yA unameM se kucha ko talAqa denA vaidha nahIM hai tAki unake alAvA anya mahilAoM ko le Ae~, yadyapi unake alAvA jina mahilAoM se Apa zAdI karanA cAhate haiM, unakA sauMdarya Apako kitanA hI acchA kyoM na lage| lekina Apake lie una dAsiyoM se, jo Apake svAmitva meM haiM, kisI viziSTa saMkhyA kI sImA ke binA lAbha uThAnA jAyaz2a hai| aura allAha pratyeka vastu kA saMrakSaka hai| yaha Adeza mominoM kI mAtAoM (rasUla kI patniyoM) kI pratiSThA ko iMgita karatA hai| kyoMki unheM talAqa dene aura unake rahate anya striyoM se vivAha karane se manA kiyA gayA hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usakI zarIyata para amala karane vAlo! nabI ke gharoM meM praveza na karo, sivAya isake ki unhoMne tumheM bhojana karane ke lie AmaMtrita karake aMdara Ane kI anumati pradAna kara dI ho| lekina (vahA~ jAkara) khAnA pakane kI pratIkSA meM dera taka na baiThe raho| balki jaba tumheM bhojana karane ke lie bulAyA jAe to praveza karo| phira jaba khAnA khA cuko, to uThakara cale jAo| khAne ke bAda Apasa meM bAta karate hue baiThe na raho| tumhArA isa taraha ThaharanA nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko kaSTa detA hai, lekina unheM tumheM uThakara jAne ke lie kahane meM zarma AtI hai| paraMtu allAha satya bAta kA Adeza dene se nahIM zaramAtA| isalie usane tumheM vahA~ se uThakara cale jAne kA Adeza diyA hai, tAki tuma vahA~ Thaharakara Apa sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko kaSTa na pahu~cAo| isI taraha jaba tuma nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI patniyoM se z2arUrata kA koI sAmAna, jaise bartana Adi mA~go, to use parde ke pIche se mA~go| tuma use unake sAmane hokara na mA~go tAki unapara tumhArI naz2ara na par3e| yaha nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI sthiti ko dhyAna meM rakhate hue ApakI patniyoM kI surakSA ke lie hai| sAtha hI tumhArA parde ke pIche se mA~ganA tumhAre diloM tathA unake diloM ke lie adhika pavitratA va zuddhatA kI bAta hai| tAki zaitAna tumhAre diloM tathA unake diloM meM vasavasA (bhrama) na DAle aura burAI ko zobhita na kare| tathA (ai ImAna vAlo!) tumhAre lie ucita nahIM hai ki tuma (khAnA khAne ke bAda) bAta karane ke lie Thaharakara allAha ke rasUla ko kaSTa pahu~cAo| aura na yaha ki tuma ApakI mRtyu ke bAda ApakI patniyoM se zAdI karo| kyoMki ve mominoM kI mAe~ haiM aura kisI ke lie vaidha nahIM ki apanI mA~ se vivAha kare| tumhArA isa taraha kaSTa pahu~cAnA - jisakA eka rUpa ApakI mRtyu ke bAda ApakI patniyoM se vivAha karanA hai - harAma (niSiddha) hai aura allAha ke nikaTa eka bahuta bar3A pApa mAnA jAtA hai|

tuma apane kisI kArya ko prakaTa karo yA use apane mana meM chipAkara rakho, vaha allAha se haragiz2a nahIM chipa sakatA| niHsaMdeha allAha pratyeka vastu kA jJAna rakhatA hai| usase tumhArA koI kAma yA koI anya cIz2a chipI nahIM raha sakatI| aura vaha tumheM tumhAre karmoM kA badalA degA; yadi acchA karma hai to acchA badalA aura yadi burA karma hai to burA badalA|

mahilAoM para isameM koI gunAha nahIM hai ki unake pitA, unake bacce, unake bhAI, unake bhatIje aura unake bhAMje, cAhe ve vaMza se hoM yA stanapAna se, unheM dekheM aura binA parde ke unase bAta kareM| tathA unapara isameM koI pApa nahIM hai ki momina striyA~ aura unake dAsa evaM dAsI unase binA parde ke bAta kareM| aura (ai momina striyo) allAha ke AdezoM aura niSedhoM ke bAre meM allAha se DaratI raho| kyoMki vaha tumhAre sabhI kathanoM aura karmoM ko dekhane vAlA hai|

niHsaMdeha allAha apane phariztoM ke nikaTa rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kI prazaMsA karatA hai aura farizte unake lie duA karate haiM| ai allAha para ImAna rakhane aura usakI apane baMdoM ke lie nirdhArita kI huI zarIyata para amala karane vAlo! tuma (bhI) rasUla para durUda aura khUba salAma bhejo|

jaba allAha ne rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama kA sammAna karane aura Apapara durUda bhejane kA Adeza diyA, to sAtha hI Apako kaSTa pahu~cAne se bhI manA kara diyA| cunA~ce faramAyA:
niHsaMdeha jo loga allAha aura usake rasUla ko apane zabda yA karma se kaSTa pahu~cAte haiM, allAha ne unheM loka evaM paraloka meM apanI dayA kI vizAlatA se niSkAsita kara diyA hai aura unake apane rasUla ko kaSTa pahu~cAne kI saz2A ke taura para Aqhirata meM unake lie apamAnajanaka yAtanA taiyAra kara rakhI hai|

jo loga apane zabda yA karma se ImAna vAle puruSoM aura ImAna vAlI striyoM ko kaSTa pahu~cAte haiM, binA kisI pApa ke jo unhoMne koI aparAdha karake kamAyA ho jo usa kaSTa ke pahu~cAne kA kAraNa ho, to unhoMne apane Upara jhUTha aura spaSTa gunAha kA bojha uThAyA|

ai nabI! Apa apanI patniyoM se kaha deM, tathA apanI beTiyoM se kaha deM aura ImAna vAloM kI striyoM se kaha deM ki: ve apane Upara una cAdaroM kA kucha hissA DAla liyA kareM jo ve pahanatI haiM, tAki parAe (g2aira maha़-rama) puruSoM ke sAmane unake zarIra kA koI aMga khulane na pAe| yaha isake adhika nikaTa hai ki unheM pahacAna liyA jAegA ki ve Az2Ada (va zarIfa) aurateM haiM, to koI unheM kaSTa nahIM pahu~cAegA, jisa taraha ki vaha dAsiyoM ke sAtha cher3achAr3a karatA hai| aura allAha apane taubA karane vAle baMde ke pApoM ko kSamA karane vAlA, usapara dayAlu hai|

yadi munAfiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) ne dila meM kufra chipAkara aura islAma kA DhoMga karake apane pAkhaMDa ko samApta nahIM kiyA, tathA ve loga jinake diloM meM apanI vAsanAoM ke prati lagAva kA roga hai aura ve loga jo madInA meM mominoM ke bIca phUTa DAlane ke uddezya se jhUThI khabareM phailAte rahate haiM, (yadi ye loga apanI karatUtoM se bAz2a nahIM Ae) - to hama Apako (ai rasUla!) unheM daMDita karane ke lie Adeza de deMge aura Apako unapara hAvI kara deMge| phira ve Apake sAtha madInA meM thor3e hI samaya ke lie raha sakeMge| kyoMki unake z2amIna para bhraSTAcAra karane ke kAraNa, unheM naSTa kara diyA jAegA yA madInA se niSkAsita kara diyA jAegA|
ve allAha kI dayA se niSkAsita haiM| ve jahA~ bhI mileM, pakar3e jAe~ge aura apane pAkhaMDa aura dharatI para bhraSTAcAra phailAne ke kAraNa burI taraha vadha kara die jAe~ge|
yahI munAphiqoM (pAkhaMDiyoM) ke bAre meM allAha kA niraMtara calane vAlA niyama hai, yadi ve pAkhaMDa dikhAte haiM| aura allAha kA niyama aTala hai, usameM Apako kadApi koI badalAva nahIM milegA|

(ai rasUla!) muzrika loga Apase inakAra karane aura jhuThalAne ke taura para, tathA yahUdI bhI Apase qiyAmata ke bAre meM pUchate haiM ki: usakA samaya kaba hai? Apa ina logoM se kaha deM: qiyAmata kA jJAna allAha ke pAsa hai, mere pAsa usakI koI jAnakArI nahIM hai| aura (ai rasUla!) Apako kyA patA zAyada qiyAmata nikaTa hI ho?
niHsaMdeha mahimAvAna allAha ne kAphiroM ko apanI dayA se niSkAsita kara diyA hai aura unake lie qiyAmata ke dina dhadhakatI Aga taiyAra kara rakhI hai, jo unakI pratIkSA kara rahI hai|

ve usa Aga kI yAtanA meM jo unake lie taiyAra kI gaI hai sadaiva raheMge| jisameM unheM na koI dosta milegA, jo unheM lAbha pahu~cA sake aura na koI sahAyaka milegA, jo unase yAtanA ko dUra kara sake|

qiyAmata ke dina unake cehare jahannama kI Aga meM ulaTe-palaTe jAe~ge| ve afasosa aura pachatAvA kI tIvratA se kaheMge: ai kAza! hamane apane duniyA ke jIvana meM allAha kA AjJApAlana kiyA hotA usa cIz2a kA pAlana karake jisakA usane hameM Adeza diyA thA aura usa cIz2a se bacakara jisase usane hameM rokA thA| tathA hamane usa cIz2a meM rasUla kA AjJApAlana kiyA hotA jo kucha vaha apane pAlanahAra kI ora se lAe the|

ve eka anargala aura jhUThA tarka prastuta kareMge| cunA~ce ve kaheMge: ai hamAre pAlanahAra, hamane apane saradAroM aura apanI jAti ke bar3e logoM kA kahA mAnA, to unhoMne hameM sIdhe mArga se bhaTakA diyA|

ai hamAre pAlanahAra! ina saradAroM aura bar3e logoM ko, jinhoMne hameM sIdhe mArga se bhaTakA diyA, usakA dogunA az2Aba de, jitanA tUne hameM diyA hai| kyoMki inhoMne hameM gumarAha kiyA thA| aura inheM apanI dayA se bahuta dUra kara de|

nahIM, aisA nahIM huA| balki, unhoMne (bApa-dAdA ke) anukaraNa ko tarka banAte hue kahA: hamane apane bApa-dAdA ko eka dharma aura eka mArga para pAyA hai, aura ve mUrtiyoM kI pUjA karate the| hama ina (mUrtiyoM) kI pUjA meM unhIM ke padacihnoM para cala rahe haiM|

jisa taraha ina logoM ne jhuThalAyA aura apane bApa-dAdA kA anukaraNa karane ko tarka banAyA, usI taraha (ai rasUla) hamane Apase pahale jisa bastI meM bhI kisI rasUla ko usakI jAti ke logoM ko sAvadhAna karane ke lie bhejA, to unake samRddha pramukhoM tathA bar3e logoM ne kahA: hamane apane bApa-dAdA ko eka dharma aura eka mArga para pAyA hai aura hama unhIM ke padacihnoM para cala rahe haiM| ataH ApakI jAti isa mAmale meM koI anUThI nahIM hai|

cunA~ce hamane Apase pUrva rasUloM ko jhuThalAne vAle samudAyoM se badalA liyA, so hamane unheM vinaSTa kara diyA| ataH vicAra kareM ki apane rasUloM ko jhuThalAne vAloM kA aMta kaisA huA| vAstava meM, vaha eka dardanAka aMta thA|
(ai rasUla!) usa samaya ko yAda kareM, jaba ibarAhIma alaihissalAma ne apane bApa aura apanI jAti se kahA: tuma allAha ke sivA jina mUrtiyoM ko pUjate ho, maiM unase barI hU~|

aura jaba unake pAsa yaha quraAna A gayA, jo aisA satya hai, jisameM koI saMdeha nahIM hai, to unhoMne kahA: yaha to eka jAdU hai, jisake dvArA muhammada hamapara jAdU kara detA hai| hama to isakA inakAra karate haiM| ataH hama kadApi isapara ImAna nahIM lAe~ge|
jhUThalAne vAle muzrikoM ne kahA: allAha ne isa quraAna ko muhammada jaise nirdhana anAtha para utArane ke bajAya, makkA athavA tAyafa ke do mahAna vyaktiyoM meM se kisI eka para kyoM nahIM utArA?

(ai rasUla!) kyA Apake pAlanahAra kI dayA ko ye loga bA~Tate haiM ki jise cAhate haiM dete haiM aura jise cAhate haiM nahIM dete haiM yA allAha bA~TatA hai? hamane hI duniyA meM unake bIca unakI roz2I ko bA~TA hai aura unameM se kisI ko dhanavAn aura kisI ko nirdhana banAyA hai; tAki unameM se kucha loga kucha ke adhIna ho jAe~| aura Aqhirata meM Apake pAlanahAra kI apane baMdoM ke prati dayA, usase behatara hai, jise ye loga isa nazvara duniyA ke sAmAna se ikaTThA kara rahe haiM|

agara yaha bAta na hotI ki sabhI loga kufra kI rAha para cala par3eMge, to hama una logoM ke gharoM kI chatoM ko, jo allAha kA inakAra karate haiM, cA~dI kI banA dete aura unake lie sIr3hiyA~ bhI banA dete, jinapara ve car3hate|
aura hama unheM DhIla dene tathA Az2amAne ke uddezya se, unake gharoM ke dvAra banA dete aura unake lie aise taqhta banA dete, jinapara ve takiyA lagAkara baiThate|

tathA hama unake lie sonA banA dete| ye sArI cIz2eM sAMsArika jIvana kI sukha sAmagrI ke sivA kucha nahIM haiM| inakA lAbha bahuta kama hai, kyoMki ye bAkI rahane vAlI nahIM haiM| aura Aqhirata meM jo nemata hai, vaha (ai rasUla!) Apake pAlanahAra ke nikaTa una logoM ke lie uttama hai, jo allAha se, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usakI manA kI huI cIz2oM se bacakara, Darate haiM|

jo quraAna ko dhyAnapUrvaka na par3hane ke kAraNavaza usase vimukha ho jAtA hai, usapara, saz2A ke taura para, eka zaitAna niyukta kara diyA jAtA hai, jo hamezA usake sAtha lagA rahatA hai aura use pathabhraSTatA meM bar3hAtA rahatA hai|

aura ye sAtha rahane vAle (zaitAna), jo quraAna se mu~ha pherane vAle logoM para niyukta kara die jAte haiM, avazya unheM allAha ke dharma se rokate haiM| cunA~ce ve na allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karate haiM aura na usakI manA kI huI cIz2oM se bacate haiM| aura yaha samajhate haiM ki ve satya ke mArga para calane vAle haiM| isI kAraNa ve apanI gumarAhI se taubA nahIM karate haiM|

yahA~ taka ki jaba allAha ke z2ikra se mu~ha mor3ane vAlA vyakti qiyAmata ke dina hamAre pAsa AegA, to kAmanA karate hue kahegA: ai kAza! mere aura (ai hamezA sAtha rahane vAle zaitAna!) tere bIca pUrva aura pazcima ke bIca kI dUrI hotI| tU to bahuta burA sAthI hai|

allAha qiyAmata ke dina kAfiroM se kahegA: Aja tumhArA yAtanA meM eka sAtha honA, tumheM haragiz2a lAbha na degA, jabaki tuma zirka aura pApa ke dvArA apane Upara atyAcAra kara cuke ho| kyoMki tumhAre sAthI tumhArI ora se tumhArI yAtanA kA kucha bhI vahana nahIM kareMge|

jaba muzrikoM ne yaha samajhA ki IsA alaihissalAma, jinakI IsAI pUjA karate haiM, allAha ke pharamAna: (إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنْتُمْ لَهَا وَارِدُونَ) ''niHsaMdeha tuma aura jinheM tuma allAha ke sivA pUjate ho, saba naraka kA IMdhana baneMge, tuma usameM praveza karane vAle ho|'' (sUratula aMbiyA: 98) meM dAkhila haiM, tathA allAha ne IsA alaihissalAma kI pUjA karane se vaise hI rokA hai, jaise mUrtiyoM kI pUjA se rokA hai, to acAnaka (ai rasUla!) aura unhoMne kahA: kyA hamAre pUjya behatara haiM yA IsA?! z2ibA'rA ke putra aura usa jaise logoM ne yaha udAharaNa satya taka pahu~cane ke lie nahIM diyA hai, balki bahasa karane aura jhagar3ane ke lie diyA hai| kyoMki ve aise loga haiM ki jhagar3anA unake svabhAva meM dAkhila hai|

phira IsAiyoM ke samUhoM ne IsA alaihissalAma ke bAre meM paraspara matabheda kiyA; cunA~ce unameM se kucha kA kahanA hai ki vaha pUjya haiM, tathA kucha kA kahanA hai ki vaha allAha ke beTe haiM| jabaki unameM se kucha kahate haiM ki vaha aura unakI mA~ donoM pUjya haiM| to jina logoM ne (IsA alaihissalAma ke bAre meM pUjya hone, yA allAha kA beTA hone yA tIna pUjyoM meM se tIsarA hone kI bAta kahakara) apane Upara atyAcAra kiyA hai, unake lie duHkhadAyI yAtanA kI qharAbI hai, jo qiyAmata ke dina unakI pratIkSA kara rahI hai|

niHsaMdeha kufra aura pApa karane vAle aparAdhI qiyAmata ke dina jahannama kI yAtanA meM hoMge, jisameM ve sadaiva raheMge|

aura vahI hai jisane bahudevavAdiyoM ke hAthoM ko tumase roka diyA, jaba unameM se lagabhaga assI AdamI hudaibiyaha meM tumheM nukasAna pahu~cAne ke lie Ae| tathA usane tumhAre hAthoM ko unase roka diyA| ataH tumane na to unheM qatla kiyA aura na hI unheM nukasAna pahu~cAyA| balki unheM baMdI banAne meM sakSama banAe jAne ke bAda bhI tumane unheM rihA kara diyA| aura jo kucha tuma karate ho, allAha use hamezA se khUba dekhane vAlA hai, tumhAre karmoM meM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai|

ye vahI loga haiM jinhoMne allAha aura usake rasUla kA inakAra kiyA, tumheM masjida-e-harAma se rokA aura qurbAnI ke jAnavaroM ko rokA, isa hAla meM ki ve apane z2abaha ke sthAna harama taka pahu~cane se roke hue the| yadi vahA~ kucha allAha para ImAna rakhane vAle puruSoM aura usapara ImAna rakhane vAlI striyA~ maujUda na hotIM, jinheM tuma nahIM jAnate, to tuma unheM kAfiroM ke sAtha qatla kara dete, phira tumheM unheM anajAne meM qatla karane se pApa lagatA aura khUna bahA denA par3atA; to tumheM makkA para car3hAI karane kI anumati de dI jAtI, tAki allAha jise cAhe apanI rahamata meM dAkhila kara de, jaise makkA ke ImAna vAle loga| agara makkA meM kAfira loga mominoM se alaga hote, to hama una logoM ko dardanAka yAtanA dete, jinhoMne allAha aura usake rasUla kA inakAra kiyA|

jaba allAha aura usake rasUla kA inakAra karane vAloM ne apane diloM meM haTha ko jagaha dI, jAhiliyyata (pUrva-islAmI yuga) kA haTha, jisakA saMbaMdha satya ko sAbita karane se nahIM, balki icchAoM ke pAlana se hai| isalie unhoMne hudaibiyA ke sAla, allAha ke rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke makkA meM praveza ko asvIkAra kara diyA; isa Dara se ki unheM yaha zarma na dilAyA jAe ki muhammada una para hAvI ho gae| to allAha ne apane rasUla para aura mominoM para apanI ora se zAMti evaM sthiratA utAra dI| isalie krodha ne unheM bahudevavAdiyoM ke sAtha unake kAryoM jaisA vyavahAra karane ke lie prerita nahIM kiyA| aura allAha ne mominoM ko satya ke vacana kA pratibaddha kara diyA, jo ki 'lA ilAhA illallAha' hai aura yaha ki ve usake adhikAra ko pUrA kareM| so unhoMne aisA karake dikhAyA aura ImAna vAle dUsaroM kI tulanA meM isa vacana ke adhika haqadAra the, tathA ve isake yogya loga the; kyoMki unake diloM meM jo acchAI thI allAha use jAnatA thA| aura allAha hamezA se saba kucha jAnane vAlA hai, usase kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai|

nizcaya allAha ne apane rasUla ke satya ke sAtha saccA svapna dikhAyA, jaba usane Apako use Apake sapane meM dikhAyA aura Apane apane sAthiyoM ko usakI sUcanA dI| jo ki yaha thA ki Apa aura Apake sAthI apane duzmanoM se surakSita allAha ke sammAnita ghara meM dAkhila hoMge| unameM se kucha apane sira mu~DavAne vAle hoMge aura kucha bAla kaTAne vAle, yaha umrA ke anuSThAna ke aMta kA sUcaka hogA|allAha ko (ai momino!) tumhAre hita kI una bAtoM kA jJAna hai, jo tuma nahIM jAnate, ataH usa varSa makkA meM praveza ke dvArA sapane kI pUrti se pahale usane eka nikaTa vijaya rakha dI| aura yaha allAha kI banAI huI hudaibiyaha kI saMdhi hai tathA usake bAda hudaibiyaha meM zAmila mominoM ke hAthoM para ghaTita hone vAlI qhaibara kI vijaya hai|

allAha hI hai, jisane apane rasUla muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko spaSTa vivaraNa aura satya dharma arthAt islAma ke sAtha bhejA; tAki vaha use usake sabhI virodhI dharmoM se U~cA kara de| tathA allAha ne isakI gavAhI dI hai aura allAha gavAha ke rUpa meM paryApta hai|

muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) allAha ke rasUla haiM aura unake sahAbA jo unake sAtha haiM, yuddha karane vAle kAfiroM ke khilApha bahuta saqhta haiM, Apasa meM dayAlu, eka-dUsare ke prati sahAnubhUti rakhane vAle aura eka-dUsare se prema karane vAle haiM| (ai dekhane vAle!) tuma unheM allAha ke sAmane rukU' aura sajadA karate hue dekhoge, ve allAha se anurodha karate haiM ki unheM kSamA aura uttama badalA pradAna kare aura unase prasanna ho jAe| unakI nizAnI unakA raMga rUpa tathA unake ceharoM para sajadoM ke cihna hogI| unake ceharoM se namAz2a kA nUra Tapaka rahA hogA| unakA yaha vivaraNa mUsA alaihissalAma para utarane vAlI kitAba taurAta meM varNita vivaraNa hai| IsA alaihissalAma para utarane vAlI kitAba iMjIla meM unakA udAharaNa yaha hai ki ve ApasI sahayoga aura apanI pUrNatA meM, usa paudhe ke samAna haiM, jisane apanA koMpala nikAlA, phira vaha zaktizAlI aura moTA hokara apane tane ke bala para khar3A ho gayA, usakI zakti aura pUrNatA khetI karane vAloM ko bhAtI hai; tAki allAha una (sahAbA) ke dvArA kAphiroM ko gussA dilAe aura ve unakI zakti, eka-dUsare se aTUTa saMbaMdha aura pUrNatA ko dekhakara jala-bhuna jAe~| allAha ne sahAbA meM se una logoM se, jo allAha para ImAna lAe aura neka amala kie, unake pApoM kI kSamA kA vAdA kiyA hai, isalie unake gunAhoM para unakI pakar3a nahIM karegA| tathA apanI ora se bahuta bar3e pratiphala kA vAdA kiyA hai, jo ki jannata hai|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane vAlo aura usakI zarIyata kA pAlana karane vAlo! kisI vacana yA karma dvArA allAha aura usake rasUla se Age na bar3ho| aura allAha se, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karake aura usake niSedhoM se bacakara, Darate raho| niHsaMdeha allAha tumhArI bAtoM ko sunane vAlA, tumhAre kAryoM ko jAnane vAlA hai| unameM se koI bhI cIz2a usase chUTa nahIM sakatI aura vaha tumheM unakA badalA degA|

ai allAha para ImAna rakhane vAlo aura usakI zarIyata kA pAlana karane vAlo! usake rasUla ke sAtha ziSTAcAra se peza Ao aura nabI se bAta karate samaya apanI AvAz2a ko unakI AvAz2a se U~cI na hone do, aura unheM Apasa meM eka-dUsare ko pukArane kI taraha unake nAma se na pukAro| balki unheM ai nabI! aura ai rasUla! kahakara vinamratA se pukAro; aisA na ho ki kahIM tumhAre karmoM kA badalA akAratha calA jAe aura tumheM isakA ehasAsa taka na ho|

Apako ApakI patniyoM ke kamaroM ke bAhara se pukArate haiM, dhairya rakhate aura Apako na pukArate yahA~ taka ki Apa unake pAsa nikala kara Ate, phira ve dhImI AvAz2a meM Apase bAta karate; to yaha unake lie Apako bAhara se pukArane kI tulanA meM behatara hotA; kyoMki isameM Adara aura sammAna pAyA jAtA hai| tathA allAha unameM se tathA unake alAvA logoM meM se taubA karane vAloM ke pApoM ko mAfa karane vAlA hai aura unheM unakI ajJAnatA ke kAraNa kSamA karane vAlA, unapara dayA karane vAlA hai|

aura (ai ImAna vAloM!) jAna lo ki tumhAre bIca allAha ke rasUla maujUda haiM jinapara vaha़ya (prakAzanA) utaratI hai| isalie jhUTha bolane se sAvadhAna raho| kyoMki allAha unapara vaha़ya utArakara unheM tumhAre jhUTha ke bAre meM batA degA| vaha use adhika jAnate haiM jisameM tumhArA hita hai| agara vaha tumhAre bahuta-se sujhAvoM meM tumhArI bAta mAna leM, to tuma kaThinAI meM par3a jAoge, jo vaha tumhAre lie pasaMda nahIM karatA hai| lekina allAha ne apane anugraha se tumhAre lie ImAna ko priya kara diyA aura use tumhAre diloM meM suMdara banA diyA hai, isalie tuma ImAna le Ae tathA usane kufra, avajJA aura pApa ko tumhAre lie ghinaunA banA diyA| ye loga jo ina guNoM se susajjita haiM vahI hidAyata aura bhalAI ke rAste para calane vAle haiM|

tumheM jo kucha prApta huA (jaise tumhAre diloM meM bhalAI ko suMdara aura burAI ko apriya banAnA), vaha kevala allAha kA anugraha hai, jo usane tumapara kiyA hai aura usakI nemata hai, jo usane tumheM pradAna kI hai| aura allAha apane baMdoM meM se use khUba jAnane vAlA hai, jo usakA zukra adA karatA hai, isalie use sAmarthya pradAna karatA hai, tathA pUrNa hikamata vAlA hai kyoMki vaha hara cIz2a ko usake ucita sthAna para rakhatA hai|

ai allAha para ImAna lAne vAlo aura usakI zarIyata para amala karane vAlo! tumhAre puruSoM kA koI samUha dUsare samUha kA maz2Aka na ur3Ae, saMbhava hai ki jinakA maz2Aka ur3AyA jA rahA hai, ve allAha ke nikaTa acche hoM, aura mAyane vahI rakhatA hai jo allAha ke nikaTa hai| aura na koI striyA~ dUsarI striyoM kA maz2Aka ur3Ae~, saMbhava hai ki jina striyoM kA maz2Aka ur3AyA jA rahA hai, ve allAha ke nikaTa behatara hoM| aura apane bhAiyoM para doSa na lagAo, kyoMki ve tumhArI apanI jAnoM ke darje meM haiM| aura tumameM se koI kisI ko aisI upAdhi ke dvArA zarama na dilAe, jise vaha nApasaMda karatA hai, jaisA ki allAha ke rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke Agamana se pahale kucha aMsAriyoM kA hAla thA| tumameM se jo aisA karegA, vaha avajJAkArI hai| ImAna ke bAda avajJA kI vizeSatA bahuta burI vizeSatA hai| aura jisane ina pApoM se taubA nahIM kI, to vahI loga apane kie hue pApoM ke kAraNa khuda ko vinAza ke saMsAdhanoM meM lAkara, apane Apapara atyAcAra karane vAle haiM|

ai logo! hamane tumheM eka nara arthAt tumhAre pitA Adama alaihissalAma aura eka mAdA arthAt tumhArI mA~ havvA se paidA kiyA| isa taraha tumhArA vaMza eka hI hai| isalie tuma vaMza meM eka-dUsare para garva na karo| phira usake bAda hamane tumako bahuta sI jAtiyA~ aura bikhare hue gotra banAe; tAki tuma eka-dUsare ko pahacAno, na ki usapara ghamaMDa karo| kyoMki eka-dUsare se pratiSThita hone kA mAnadaMDa kevala taqvA (parahez2agArI) hai| isalie Age pharamAyA: niHsaMdahe tumameM sabase sammAna vAlA allAha ke nikaTa vaha hai, jo tumameM sabase z2yAdA taqvA vAlA hai| nizcaya allAha tumhArI sthitiyoM ko jAnane vAlA, tumhArI pUrNatA aura apUrNatA ke bAre meM avagata hai, isameM se kucha bhI usase chipA nahIM hai|

kucha badduoM ne, allAha ke rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ke pAsa Akara kahA: hama allAha aura usake rasUla para ImAna le Ae| (ai rasUla!) nizcita rUpa se - gunAha, atyAcAra aura rasUla kI avajJA para AdhArita - kAnAphUsI zaitAna kI ora se apane dostoM ke lie use zobhita karake prastuta karane aura phusaphusAne ke kAraNa hai| tAki vaha ImAna vAloM ko isa bAta se zokAkula kara de ki unake viruddha cAla calI jA rahI hai| hAlA~ki zaitAna aura usakA yaha suzobhIkaraNa, allAha kI marz2I aura icchA ke binA ImAna vAloM ko kucha bhI nuqasAna nahIM pahu~cA sakatA| aura ImAna vAloM ko apane sabhI mAmaloM meM allAha hI para bharosA karanA cAhie|

jaba allAha ne bAtacIta ke ziSTAcAra kA ullekha kiyA, to sabhAoM ke ziSTAcAra kA bhI ullekha kara diyA| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
ai allAha para ImAna rakhane vAlo aura usakI zarIyata para amala karane vAlo! jaba tumase kahA jAe ki majalisoM (baiThakoM) meM jagaha kuzAdA kara do, to unameM jagaha banA diyA karo| allAha tumhAre sAMsArika jIvana tathA Aqhirata meM tumhAre lie vistAra paidA karegA| aura jaba tumase kahA jAe: kucha majalisoM se uTha jAo, tAki vahA~ pratiSThita loga baiTha sakeM, to vahA~ se uTha jAyA karo| allAha tumameM se una logoM ke darjoM (padoM) ko bahuta U~cA karegA, jo ImAna lAe aura jo jJAna die gae| aura allAha tumhAre kAryoM se pUrI taraha avagata hai| usase tumhAre kAryoM meM se kucha bhI chipA nahIM hai| aura vaha tumheM unakA badalA degA|

jaba sahAbA nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallama se bahuta z2yAdA kAnAphUsI karane lage, to allAha ne pharamAyA: ai ImAna vAlo! jaba tuma rasUla se gupta rUpa se bAta karanA cAho, to gupta rUpa se bAta karane se pahale sadaqA peza karo| yaha sadaqA peza karanA tumhAre lie uttama aura adhika pavitra hai| kyoMki usameM allAha kA AjJApAlana hai, jo diloM ko zuddha (pavitra) karatA hai| agara tumheM sadaqA karane ke lie kucha na mile, to unase gupta rUpa se bAta karane meM tumapara koI gunAha nahIM hai| kyoMki allAha apane baMdoM ke gunAhoM ko mAfa karane vAlA aura unapara dayA karane vAlA hai| yahI kAraNa hai ki usane unheM kevala usI cIz2a kA bAdhya kiyA hai,jo ve kara sakate haiM|

kyA tuma rasUla se saragozI karane se pahale sadaqA dene ke kAraNa garIbI se Dara gae? so, yadi tumane allAha ke isa Adeza kA pAlana nahIM kiyA, aura allAha ne tumheM kSamA kara diyA ki ise chor3ane kI chUTa pradAna kara dI, to aba tuma uttama tarIqe se namAz2a qAyama karo, apane dhana kI z2akAta do, tathA allAha evaM usake rasUla kA anusaraNa karo| allAha tumhAre kAryoM se pUrI taraha avagata hai| usase tumhArA koI kAma chipA nahIM hai| aura vaha tumheM tumhAre karmoM kA badalA degA|

kyA (ai rasUla) Apane una munAfiqo (pAkhaMDiyoM) ko nahIM dekhA, jinhoMne una yahUdiyoM ko mitra banA liyA, jinapara unake kufra aura pApoM ke kAraNa allAha krodhita huA? ye munAfiqa na to mominoM meM se haiM aura na yahUdiyoM meM se| balki ve duvidhA meM par3e hue haiM, na idhara ke haiM, na udhara ke| tathA ve qasameM khAte haiM ki ve musalamAna haiM, aura unhoMne musalamAnoM kI sUcanAe~ yahUdiyoM ko nahIM pahu~cAI haiM| jabaki ve apanI qasama meM jhUThe haiM|

allAha ne unake lie Aqhirata meM bar3I kaThora yAtanA taiyAra kara rakhI hai| kyoMki vaha unheM jahannama ke pAtAla meM dAkhila karegA| nizcaya ve duniyA meM kufra ke bahuta hI bure kAma karate rahe haiM|

unhoMne apanI qasamoM ko, jo ve khAyA karate the, kufra ke kAraNa qatla hone se bacane ke lie DhAla banA lI, kyoMki unhoMne qasamoM ke mAdhyama se apanI jAna aura mAla kI rakSA ke lie musalamAna hone kA dikhAvA kiyA| isa taraha unhoMne logoM ko satya se phera diyA| kyoMki ve musalamAnoM ko kamaz2ora aura hatotsAhita karate the| ataH unake lie apamAnajanaka yAtanA hai, jo unheM apamAnita aura tiraskRta karegI|

jisa dina allAha una sabako badale ke lie punarjIvita karake uThAegA, unameM se kisI ko bhI nahIM chor3egA, to ve allAha ke sAmane qasameM khAe~ge ki ve kufra aura nifAqa para nahIM the| balki, ve allAha ko prasanna karane vAle kAma karane vAle momina the| ve Aqhirata meM allAha ke sAmane qasameM khAe~ge, jaise ki ve duniyA meM (ai momino) tumhAre sAmane kasameM khAkara kahate the ki ve musalamAna haiM| ve samajheMge ki ina qasamoM kI vajaha se jo ve allAha ke sAmane khA rahe haiM, kisI aise AdhAra para haiM, jo unheM koI lAbha pahu~cAegA, yA unase koI nukasAna dUra kara degA| suna lo, ve vahI haiM jo vAstava meM duniyA meM bhI apanI qasamoM meM tathA Akhirata meM bhI apanI qasamoM meM jhUThe haiM|

zaitAna unapara hAvI ho gayA hai aura unheM apane vasavase ke z2arie allAha kI yAda bhulA dI hai| isalie unhoMne allAha ko khuza karane vAle kArya nahIM kie| balki aise kArya kie jo use nArAz2a karane vAle haiM| ina vizeSatAoM vAle loga hI ibalIsa ke sainika aura usake anuyAyI haiM| suna lo, nizcaya ibalIsa ke sainika aura usake anuyAyI hI duniyA aura Aqhirata meM kSati uThAne vAle haiM| kyoMki unhoMne mArgadarzana ko gumarAhI ke badale meM aura jannata ko jahannama ke badale meM beca diyA hai|
niHsaMdeha jo loga allAha aura usake rasUla kA virodha karate haiM, vahI loga una kAfira samudAyoM meM zAmila haiM, jinheM allAha ne duniyA evaM Aqhirata meM apamAnita aura tiraskRta kiyA hai|

allAha ne apane pUrva jJAna ke AdhAra para nirNaya kara diyA hai ki nizcita rUpa se maiM aura mere rasUla hI tarka aura zakti ke sAtha apane duzmanoM para vijayI raheMge| nizcaya allAha apane rasUloM kI sahAyatA karane para sarvazaktimAna, prabhutvavazAlI hai, jo unake duzmanoM se badalA letA hai|

Apa (ai nabI) una logoM ko jo allAha evaM qiyAmata ke dina para ImAna rakhate haiM, aisA nahIM pAe~ge ki ve una logoM se prema karate aura mitratA rakhate hoM, jo allAha aura usake rasUla se duzmanI rakhate haiM, yadyapi ye allAha aura usake rasUla ke duzmana unake pitA, yA unake putra, yA unake bhAI, yA unake qabIle vAle hI kyoM na hoM, jinase ve saMbaMdhita hote haiM| kyoMki ImAna allAha aura usake rasUla ke duzmanoM se mitratA rakhane se rokatA hai, aura kyoMki ImAna kA baMdhana sabhI baMdhanoM se sarvopari hai| ataH, TakarAva ke samaya ImAna ke baMdhana ko prAthamikatA dI jAegI| jo loga allAha aura usake rasUla se duzmanI rakhane vAloM se mitratA nahIM rakhate - bhale hI ve inake riztedAra hoM -, yahI ve loga haiM, jinake diloM meM allAha ne ImAna ko jamA diyA hai, isalie vaha parivartita nahIM hotA| tathA unheM apane pramANa aura prakAza ke sAtha maz2abUta kara diyA hai| aura unheM qiyAmata ke dina sadaiva rahane vAlI jannatoM meM dAkhila karegA, jinake mahaloM aura per3oM ke nIce se nahare bahatI hoMgI| ve hamezA ke lie vahIM raheMge| unakI nemateM unase bAdhita nahIM hoMgI aura na hI ve (svayaM) usase nAza hoMge| allAha unase isa taraha prasanna ho gayA ki usake bAda kabhI bhI nArAz2a nahIM hogA| tathA ve bhI allAha se prasanna ho gae, kyoMki usane unheM aisI nemateM pradAna kIM, jo kabhI qhatma nahIM hoMgI, jinameM allAha mahimAvAn ko dekhanA bhI zAmila hai| ukta vizeSatAoM se viziSTa loga hI allAha kI senA haiM, jo allAha ke AdezoM kA pAlana karate haiM aura usake niSedhoM se dUra rahate haiM| suna lo, nizcaya allAha ke sainika hI duniyA aura Aqhirata meM apanI apekSita cIz2oM ko pAne meM, tathA apanI ghRNita va bhayAvaha cIz2oM se bacane meM saphala hone vAle haiM|

AkAzoM meM aura dharatI para jo bhI prANI haiM, saba allAha kI mahAnatA kA varNana karate haiM tathA hara usa cIz2a se use pavitra ThaharAte haiM, jo usakI mahimA ke yogya nahIM hai| tathA vaha prabhutvazAlI hai, jisapara kisI kA z2ora nahIM calatA, apanI racanA, zarIyata aura nirNaya (taqadIra) meM hikamata vAlA hai|

vahI hai, jisane allAha ke sAtha kufra karane aura usake rasUla muhammada sallallAhu alaihi va sallama ko jhuThalAne vAle banI naz2Ira ko, madInA meM sthita unake gharoM se, madInA se zAma (levAMta) kI ora unake pahale hI deza-nikAlA ke samaya niSkAsita kara diyA| ye taurAta vAle yahUdiyoM meM se the| yaha unake apanI pratijJA ko tor3a dene aura usapara muzrikoM ke sAtha ho jAne ke bAda huA| allAha ne unheM zAma kI ora nikAla diyA| jabaki ve isa qadara zaktizAlI aura tAqatavara the ki tumane (ai momino!) socA bhI nahIM thA ki unheM kabhI apane gharoM se nikalanA par3egA| aura ve khuda bhI samajha rahe the ki unake banAe hue qile unheM allAha kI pakar3a aura yAtanA se bacA leMge| lekina allAha kI pakar3a unake pAsa vahA~ se AI, jahA~ se Ane kA unheM anumAna nahIM thA| cunA~ce allAha ne apane rasUla ko unase yuddha karane aura unheM unake gharoM se nikAla bAhara karane kA Adeza de diyA| sAtha hI allAha ne unake diloM meM atyadhika bhaya DAla diyA| ve apane gharoM ko aMdara se apane hI hAthoM se vidhvaMsa kara rahe the, tAki musalamAna unase lAbha na uThA sakeM tathA musalamAna unheM bAhara se vidhvaMsa kara rahe the| ataH ai samajha-bUjha rakhane vAlo! ina logoM ko inake kufra ke kAraNa jisa cIz2a kA sAmanA karanA par3A, usase sIkha grahaNa karo| isalie unakI taraha mata bano, anyathA unhIM ke jaise badale aura saz2A kA sAmanA karanA par3egA|

aura agara allAha ne unapara unheM unake gharoM se bAhara nikAla diyA jAnA na likha diyA hotA, to nizcaya vaha duniyA meM unheM qatla aura qaida kI saz2A detA, aura unake lie Aqhirata meM Aga kI yAtanA hai, jo unakI pratIkSA kara rahI hai, jisameM ve hamezA ke lie raheMge|

tumane (ai momino ke samudAya) banI naz2Ira ke yuddha ke daurAna, allAha ke duzmanoM ko bhar3akAne ke lie jo bhI khajUra ke per3a kATe yA jo per3a unake tanoM para khar3e chor3a die tAki unase lAbha uThAo, vaha allAha ke Adeza se thA| vaha dharatI meM bigAr3a paidA karanA nahIM thA, jaisA ki unhoMne dAvA kiyA hai| yaha saba isalie huA tAki allAha apanI avajJA se nikala jAne vAle una yahUdiyoM ko apamAnita kare, jinhoMne vacana tor3A aura vaphAdArI ke rAste ko tyAgakara vizvAsaghAta kA rAstA cunA|

aura allAha ne banI naz2Ira kI saMpatti meM se apane rasUla ko jo kucha diyA, to use pAne ke lie tumane ghor3e aura U~Ta nahIM daur3Ae aura tumheM usake lie kaThinAI kA sAmanA nahIM karanA par3A| lekina allAha apane rasUla ko jisapara cAhatA hai, prabhutva pradAna kara detA hai| cunA~ce usane apane rasUla ko banI naz2Ira para prabhutva pradAna kara diyA| isalie Apane binA yuddha kie unake nagara para vijaya prApta kara lI| aura allAha hara cIz2a kA sAmarthya rakhatA hai| use koI cIz2a vivaza nahIM kara sakatI|

allAha ne apane rasUla ko bastiyoM vAloM kI saMpatti meM se jo kucha binA yuddha kie diyA hai, vaha allAha ke lie hai, vaha jise cAhe pradAna kare, tathA usake rasUla ke lie hai jo unake svAmitva meM hai, tathA banI hAzima aura banI muttaliba meM se Apake riztedAroM ke lie hai; unake lie usake muAvaz2e ke rUpa meM hai jo unheM dAna se roka diyA gayA hai, tathA anAthoM ke lie, g2arIboM ke lie aura usa pathika ke lie hai jisakA kharca samApta ho gayA ho| yaha Adeza isalie diyA gayA hai, tAki aisA na ho ki dhana kevala amIroM ke bIca ghUmatA rahe aura g2arIba loga usase vaMcita raha jAe~| aura rasUla tumheM binA yuddha ke prApta hone vAle dhana meM se jo kucha deM, use (ai ImAna vAlo!) le lo aura jisase tumheM roka deM, usase ruka jAo| aura allAha se, usake AdezoM kA pAlana karate hue aura usake niSedhoM se bacate hue, Darate raho| nizcaya allAha bahuta kaThora saz2A dene vAlA hai| ataH usakI saz2A se baco|

jaba allAha ne muhAjiroM kA ullekha kiyA aura unakI prazaMsA kI, to aMsAriyoM kA bhI ullekha kiyA aura unakI prazaMsA kI| cunA~ce pharamAyA:
aura ve aMsAra, jo muhAjiroM se pahale se madInA meM nivAsa karate the tathA unhoMne allAha aura usake rasUla para ImAna ko cuna liyA thA, ve una logoM se prema karate haiM, jo makkA se hijarata karake unake yahA~ Ae haiM| tathA apane diloM meM allAha ke rAste meM hijarata karane vAle logoM ke bAre meM koI krodha tathA IrSyA nahIM pAte, jaba muhAjiroM ko binA yuddha ke prApta hone vAle dhana meM se kucha diyA jAtA hai aura unheM nahIM diyA jAtA| aura ve sAMsArika phAyadoM ke mAmale meM, muhAjiroM ko khuda se Age rakhate haiM, yadyapi khuda g2arIba aura z2arUratamaMda hoM| aura jisake dila ko allAha dhana kI lAlaca se bacA le, aura vaha use allAha kI rAha meM kharca karane lage, to aise hI loga haiM jo apanI AkAMkSAoM kI prApti aura jisa cIz2a se Darate haiM usase mukti meM saphala hone vAle haiM|

aura jo ina logoM ke bAda Ae aura qiyAmata ke dina taka bhalAI ke sAtha unakA anusaraNa kiyA, ve kahate haiM: ai hamAre pAlanahAra! hameM kSamA kara de aura hamAre una islAmI bhAiyoM ko bhI kSamA kara de, jo hamase pahale allAha aura usake rasUla para ImAna lAe haiM| tathA hamAre diloM meM kisI momina ke prati ghRNA tathA dveSa na rakha| ai hAmAre pAlanahAra! nizcaya tU apane baMdoM ke prati bahuta snehaka, unapara atyaMta dayAlu hai|

kyA (ai rasUla) Apane una logoM ko nahIM dekhA, jinhoMne kufra ko chipAyA aura ImAna kA pradarzana kiyA ki ve vikRta taurAta ko mAnane vAle yahUdiyoM meM se apane kAfira bhAiyoM se kahate haiM: apane gharoM ke aMdara DaTe raho, hama tumhArI sahAyatA se pIche nahIM haTeMge aura tumheM asahAya nahIM chor3eMge| yadi musalamAnoM ne tumheM yahA~ se bAhara nikAla diyA, to hama bhI tumhAre sAtha ekajuTatA dikhAte hue nikala khar3e hoMge| tathA hama kisI kI bhI bAta nahIM mAneMge, jo hameM tumhAre sAtha bAhara jAne se rokanA cAhegA| aura agara musalamAnoM ne tumase yuddha kiyA, to hama unake viruddha tumhArI madada kareMge| hAlA~ki allAha gavAhI detA hai ki niHsaMdeha munAfiqa apane isa dAve meM jhUThe haiM ki yadi yahUdiyoM ko nikAlA gayA to ve unake sAtha nikala khar3e hoMge aura yadi unase yuddha kiyA gayA to ve unakI ora se yuddha kareMge|

agara musalamAnoM ne yahUdiyoM ko nikAla diyA, to ve unake sAtha nahIM nikaleMge| aura agara musalamAnoM ne unase yuddha kiyA, to ve unakI sahAyatA aura madada nahIM kareMge| aura agara unakI madada aura sahAyatA karane ke lie nikale bhI, to unase pITha pherakara bhAga khar3e hoMge| phira isake bAda munAfiqoM kI madada nahIM kI jAegI, balki allAha unheM apamAnita aura tiraskRta karegA|

nizcaya munAfikoM aura yahUdiyoM ke diloM meM (ai momino) tumhArA bhaya allAha (ke bhaya) se adhika hai| aura yaha (arthAt unakA tumase atyadhika DaranA aura allAha kA Dara kamaz2ora honA) isa kAraNa hai ki ve aise loga haiM, jo kucha nahIM samajhate| kyoMki yadi ve samajhate, to unheM patA hotA ki allAha Darane aura bhayabhIta hone ke adhika yogya hai| kyoMki usI ne tumheM unapara prabhutva pradAna kiyA hai|

yahUdI tumase (ai momino) ikaTThe hokara yuddha nahIM kareMge, paraMtu qilebaMda bastiyoM meM yA dIvAroM ke pIche se| kyoMki ve apanI kAyaratA ke kAraNa tumhArA sAmanA nahIM kara sakate| unake bIca duzmanI ke kAraNa unakI Apasa kI lar3AI bahuta saqhta hai| Apa samajhate haiM ki ve ekajuTa haiM aura unake aMdara ekatA hai, jabaki saccAI yaha hai ki unake dila alaga-alaga haiM| yaha vibheda aura duzmanI isa kAraNa hai ki ve buddhi nahIM rakhate| kyoMki yadi ve buddhi rakhate, to satya ko jAnate aura usakA pAlana karate aura usake bAre meM vibheda na karate|
